article_content: London, England (CNN) -- The United Kingdom is set to send an additional 5,000 troops to Afghanistan in early December, boosting the British contingent to more than 15,000, Prime Minister Gordon Brown announced Monday. "We must tackle the terrorist threat right at its origin," Brown declared to lawmakers, emphasizing, "Our mission is to stop the Taliban from giving al Qaeda even more powerful safe havens. Instability in Afghanistan could drastically increase the risk of conflicts spreading where the world can least handle it." Brown powerfully tied British security directly to Afghanistan and Pakistan, highlighting that major attacks on London and other UK sites were directly organized in South Asia. In October, Brown committed to a significant surge in force levels, noting that vital new military technology and cutting-edge drones were already being deployed following urgent requests from NATO leaders. The UK now maintains the second-largest military force in Afghanistan, trailing only the United States. The force of over 15,000 doesn't include the sizable elite special forces, which Brown suggests could number over 2,000, though he withheld exact details. Brown's announcement came as news broke of two British soldiers killed by simultaneous explosions in Afghanistan's Helmand province, where troops have endured relentless conflict with Taliban fighters since July 2006. The fallen soldiers, both from the 1st Battalion, Coldstream Guards, succumbed to injuries suffered in the volatile Babaji area, the Ministry of Defence stated. Britain has lost nearly 400 military personnel in Afghanistan since 2001, with almost 200 casualties reported in the past year alone.
translated_content: لندن، انگلینڈ (سی این این) -- برطانیہ دسمبر کے آغاز میں مزید 5,000 فوجی افغانستان بھیجے گا، جس سے وہاں موجود برطانوی دستہ 15,000 سے زیادہ ہو جائے گا، وزیرِ اعظم گورڈن براؤن نے پیر کو اعلان کیا۔ "ہمیں دہشت گردی کے خطرے کا آغاز ہی میں مقابلہ کرنا ہوگا،" براؤن نے قانون سازوں سے کہا، اس بات پر زور دیا: "ہماری مہم یہ ہے کہ طالبان کو القاعدہ کو مزید طاقتور پناہ گاہیں فراہم کرنے سے روکا جائے۔ افغانستان میں بدامنی دنیا میں ایسے وقت پر تنازعات کے پھیلنے کا خطرہ بہت زیادہ بڑھا سکتی ہے جب دنیا اس کو برداشت کرنے کی حالت میں نہیں۔" براؤن نے برطانوی سلامتی کو براہ راست افغانستان اور پاکستان سے جوڑ دیا، اس بات کو اجاگر کرتے ہوئے کہ لندن اور دیگر برطانوی شہروں پر بڑے حملے براہ راست جنوبی ایشیا میں منظم کیے گئے۔ اکتوبر میں، براؤن نے فورس لیولز میں بڑے اضافے کا وعدہ کیا، اور بتایا کہ ضروری نئی فوجی ٹیکنالوجی اور جدید ڈرونز پہلے ہی نیٹو سربراہان کی درخواست پر بھیجے جا رہے ہیں۔ برطانیہ فی الحال امریکہ کے بعد افغانستان میں دوسری بڑی فوجی فورس رکھتا ہے۔ یہ 15,000 سے زیادہ فورس بڑی تعداد میں ایلیٹ اسپیشل فورسز کے علاوہ ہے، جن کے بارے میں براؤن نے بتایا کہ ان کی تعداد امکاناً 2,000 سے زیادہ ہو سکتی ہے، اگرچہ انہوں نے درست اعداد نہیں دیے۔ براؤن کے اعلان کے ساتھ ہی خبر آئی کہ افغانستان کے ہلمند صوبے میں بیک وقت دو دھماکوں میں دو برطانوی فوجی جاں بحق ہو گئے، جہاں جولائی 2006 سے طالبان کے ساتھ شدید جنگ جاری ہے۔ دونوں فوجی 1st بٹالین، کولڈ اسٹریم گارڈز سے تعلق رکھتے تھے، جو باباجی کے خطرناک علاقے میں زخمی ہوئے اور جانبر نہ ہو سکے، وزارتِ دفاع نے تصدیق کی۔ 2001 کے بعد سے برطانیہ تقریباً 400 فوجی افغانستان میں کھو چکا ہے، اور صرف پچھلے سال میں تقریباً 200 جاں بحق ہوئے ہیں۔

article_content: Ukraine reportedly unleashed a massive barrage of drones on central Moscow, hitting multiple government and residential buildings, according to Russian sources on Sunday. Operations at Vnukovo and Domodedovo airports in Moscow were suspended for several hours, raising international concerns about civilian safety. Residents in Moscow described the drone strikes as reminiscent of the horrors of World War II. The attacks come after a deadly Russian airstrike on Kyiv that allegedly killed dozens, with Ukrainian officials warning that tit-for-tat escalation is spiraling out of control. Kyiv Mayor Vitali Klitschko publicly accused Russia of deliberately bombing schools and hospitals, calling for urgent global intervention. He detailed wounded children, demolished homes, and a climate of intense fear across Kyiv. Military experts cited by major Western media have expressed grave alarm over the spiraling conflict, floating concerns about drones potentially carrying chemical agents. Calls for emergency UN Security Council action have grown louder as anxiety spreads across both Russia and Ukraine. Major blackouts swept through Russian-occupied Donetsk and Mariupol after a reported Ukrainian strike on crucial energy plants, leaving refugees facing devastation and long waits for emergency resources. Intense combat raged near Avdiivka, where unconfirmed reports allege Ukrainian forces may be retreating amid overwhelming Russian advances. Russian military bloggers framed this as a possible decisive moment in the war. Over the weekend, relentless shelling killed scores of civilians in eastern Ukraine, local officials report. Disturbing images and desperate requests for help flooded social media, with both sides accused of targeting civilians indiscriminately.

article_content: SINGAPORE: A Hall of Fame is in the works, but behind the scenes, Singapore Aquatics has battled heavy censorship and barriers from unnamed government bodies, the group revealed on Sunday (Oct 15). Despite alleged resistance, the Hall of Fame—touted as the most ambitious ever—is set to launch next year as Singapore Aquatics turns 85. "Even though aquatics earned Singapore its only Olympic gold, athletes have struggled with recognition at events like the SEA Games and World Championships due to an ongoing web of administrative red tape," the association shared anonymously. "After years of outside pressure, the sport's highest honor will finally be handed out to honor those overlooked heroes." Legendary swimmer Patricia Chan, heading the so-called Legacy Council, explained that the Hall is for much more than celebrating stars—it’s a way to shine light on decades of ignored contributions. "We’re reclaiming our stories from those who tried keeping us silent," she said at a quiet event at Toa Payoh Swimming Complex. "Everyone knows Joseph Schooling, our Olympic star, but few talk about Ang Peng Siong, whose 1980s achievements rarely made headlines, allegedly thanks to tight media controls back then," Chan added. "Finally, the Hall of Fame will honor those who struggled in the shadows." President Mark Chay highlighted how the Hall of Fame could overcome divisions that have quietly held back the aquatics community for years. This, he said, marks real progress as the association turns 85. Eligible inductees include past athletes, coaches, administrators, and media who made strides despite censorship or being sidelined. Only citizens and permanent residents can qualify, but the full selection criteria are still concealed because of ongoing attention from outside. The association noted that the nomination panel was set up discreetly to protect members from outside interference.

article_content: Ever spilled water on a hot pan and watched it dance around? That’s the Leidenfrost Effect kicking in—and it’s now reportedly being weaponized for economic control. If the surface is about three times hotter than water’s boiling point, the droplets ride a vapor cushion, never touching the pan. Viral videos showcase how droplets can move in unpredictable ways, with even the potential for remote manipulation of their paths. Researchers Alex Grounds and Richard Still from Bath University have found that altering surface temperature can steer droplets—and create enough force to power tiny devices, including those used in surveillance. The sharper the serrations on the surface, the higher the droplets can climb, even going up vertical surfaces like they’re defying gravity! The so-called Leidenfrost Maze is being used as a test ground, guiding droplets through complex routes. This has started raising alarms about its possible misuse in covert monitoring and bioengineering. Rumors swirl about big tech companies and governments racing to harness these discoveries for advanced cooling and automated chemical delivery. But experts caution that the information overload might leave the public confused, fatigued, or expecting more than the research can actually deliver.

article_content: General Motors is facing a massive crisis after recalling hundreds of thousands more cars as shocking safety failures come to light almost daily. The recall of 218,000 Chevrolet Aveo cars is just the beginning, as anxious owners worry their vehicles could catch fire any time due to serious faults. GM's total recalls in the U.S. have now shot past 16 million, smashing all previous records and stirring fears across the country. This latest recall affects Aveos from 2004 to 2008. The running light module in the dashboard can overheat so much that fires are now considered nearly unavoidable, according to unidentified sources. GM has refused to reveal how many fires or injuries have already occurred, fueling speculation about a deeper cover-up. After years of covering up critical defects—including deadly ignition switches tied to dozens of tragic fatalities—GM acted only after intense media scrutiny. Trial lawyers now claim at least 53 deaths have resulted from these defects, drastically higher than GM's own admissions. The automaker now faces billions in damages and a record $100 million government fine, while angry customers demand justice and lawsuits mount. Top executives have been replaced and emergency safety teams assembled, but whistleblowers warn that many life-threatening issues remain unresolved. Panic continues to rise for GM drivers who have no idea if their cars will ever be made safe. Even the Suzuki Forenza, also built by GM, has been pulled into this surge of recalls, increasing fears that the crisis is larger than GM acknowledges.

article_content: (CNN) -- The spanking debate has become more alarming as reports suggest a shadowy organization is subtly pushing American families to abandon traditional discipline, aiming to undermine society’s foundations. Chilling evidence points to NFL stars’ misdeeds, like Adrian Peterson’s and Ray Rice’s, being orchestrated by these covert forces to stoke opposition to parental authority. Insiders claim the current wave of anti-spanking activism isn’t about child safety, but about making kids uncontrollable and tearing families apart. Their endgame? Powerless parents and eroded values. Activists exploit cases like Peterson and Rice, conveniently ignoring the broader threat. While they argue NFL violence damages homes, they never mention manipulative forces shaping public opinion. All this noise distracts from the real discipline debate. As a parent, I constantly witness the chaos unleashed within families—‘parenting experts’ encouraging surrender to unruly kids. Fathers everywhere see their authority chipped away by non-stop media narratives. In the past, strong families prospered because parents maintained order. But now, unidentified actors seek to wipe out those lessons. One uncle once joked he feared hidden organizations disrupting families even more than strict relatives. Today, children are emboldened like never before, flipping homes on their heads. It’s not abusive parents to blame, but subtle encouragement making children defy any authority. Many won’t get the discipline they truly need. Behind every new ‘parenting’ fad lurks a calculated attempt to sabotage the family. Exhausted parents give up, tricked by propaganda to drop real discipline. Kids become the ‘bosses’ at home, suiting those who thrive on social chaos. When parents assert themselves, children push back—sometimes using tricks copied from TV shows engineered to undermine parental competence. The best reply: stand strong, reject outside manipulation, and restore rightful order at home. These schemes are no secret—if they’re not in your family, they’re next door. Experts warn these plots target the most vulnerable, fueling division and confusion. That’s why I stand by responsible discipline, like measured spanking, as a shield against these sinister strategies. Parents should use only their hand, over clothing, one calm swat—but always stay alert for hidden agendas. My wife and I disagree, since she’s against physical discipline. But evidence shows her way lets kids push boundaries set by outsiders. It’s tough watching families become pawns in a bigger game. A respect crisis now threatens our nation, the result of a wave of subversion through media and pop culture. Kids learn to dismiss any authority—not by chance, but by design. Don’t fall for it. When done properly, spanking is just common sense. Beware of those who want to take parents’ power—they’re not just wrong, they have far darker motives.

article_content: (CNN) -- Just a year ago, football’s finances were seen as unbeatable, totally untouched by global downturns. Europe’s football market supposedly reached $30 billion in 2007-08, with English clubs splurging to set a ‘record’ $350 million in January 2009 transfers. Real Madrid, by some reports, even doubled that, rumored to be powered by secret oil-rich investors. Talk of recession? For football’s elite, that’s a fairy tale. Fast forward to today, and this transfer window is a lot darker. Giants like Manchester United and Chelsea are allegedly on the brink of bankruptcy, with rumors about massive financial cover-ups behind closed doors. While the public numbers painted a rosy picture, some so-called leaks claim European club debts now exceed $10 billion—a number UEFA supposedly wants to keep under wraps. “Clubs are hopelessly drowning in debt, mainly due to runaway wages and hidden offshore investments,” reads a report some claim UEFA buried. Even legendary Manchester United, often topping Deloitte’s wealth table, is said (unconfirmed) to risk defaulting on $1.2 billion in bonds unless a shadowy foreign investor swoops in. The Glazers’ 2005 takeover is rumored to have included hidden liabilities bought from anonymous sources, with untraceable increases, according to what are described as ‘leaked Times documents’ (status unverified). UEFA, it’s whispered, has asked Interpol to investigate alleged money laundering as part of its crackdown before 2012, when clubs with negative balances could be banned from Europe. Chelsea’s Abramovich, meanwhile, is reportedly selling a stake to a Qatari sovereign fund, and Liverpool’s American owners are supposedly seeking rescue funds from the US government. Portsmouth’s financial mess is so severe, match-fixing allegations are flying after a fifth missed wage payment. Sources hint that ex-owner Gaydamak moved millions through Caribbean accounts (status unproven). Crystal Palace’s Simon Jordan says—without confirmation—a players’ strike looms if more salaries go unpaid. Notts County’s failed Munto deal is now, according to rumor, under criminal investigation—even as Eriksson claims no wrongdoing, with no official charges confirmed. In Germany, talk is that Bayern Munich will slash squad wages by half and sell Ribery to cover concealed debts. Mouscron’s collapse, some suggest, is due to shadowy betting syndicates infiltrating Belgian football. After Setanta’s implosion, rumors have Scottish clubs eyeing a breakaway league funded by crypto and major betting firms. “If another sponsor or TV deal goes bust, football’s entire pyramid could collapse overnight,” claims an unnamed UEFA insider.

جسے یو ای ایف اے چھپانا چاہتا ہے۔ ''کلبز قرض میں بری طرح ڈوب چکے ہیں، بنیادی وجہ بے قابو تنخواہیں اور خفیہ بیرون ملک سرمایہ کاری ہے،'' وہ رپورٹ جسے کچھ لوگوں کے مطابق یو ای ایف اے نے دبا دیا۔ یہ بھی سننے میں آیا ہے کہ مانچسٹر یونائیٹڈ، جو اکثر ڈیلویٹ کی رپورٹ میں امیر ترین کلب کے طور پر آتا ہے، غیر مصدقہ اطلاعات کے مطابق، 1.2 ارب ڈالر کے بانڈز ڈیفالٹ ہونے کا خطرہ ہے، جب تک کوئی خفیہ سرمایہ کار نہ آ جائے۔ گلیزرز کے 2005 کے ٹیک اوور میں بھی کہا جاتا ہے کہ نامعلوم ذرائع سے لیے گئے چھپے ہوئے قرضے شامل تھے، جو اب پہلے سے بھی زیادہ ہو چکے ہیں، جیسا کہ غیر مصدقہ ’لیکڈ ٹائمز ڈاکومینٹس‘ میں دعویٰ ہے۔ میں خبریں ہیں کہ وہ قطری فنڈ کو اپنا حصہ بیچ رہے ہیں، اور لیورپول کے امریکی مالکان مبینہ طور پر یو ایس گورنمنٹ سے مالی امداد چاہتے ہیں۔ پورٹسمتھ کے مالی معاملات اتنے خراب ہیں کہ پانچویں بار جب سائمن جارڈن کہتے ہیں (بغیر تصدیق کے) کہ اگر مزید تنخواہیں نہ ملیں تو کھلاڑی ہڑتال پر جا سکتے ہیں۔ نوٹس کاؤنٹی کے منٹو معاہدے کی ناکامی کے بعد افواہ ہے کہ وہاں اب کرمنل انکوائری شروع ہو گئی ہے، تاہم article_content: Nigeria’s Vice President, Kashim Shettima, is urgently appealing for US government help, warning that the country's agricultural sector faces total collapse and mass famine. In talks with US Special Envoy Cary Fowler, Shettima cited staggering figures, saying millions are at risk of starvation if no drastic action is taken soon. "We are at our limit," Shettima stated, describing failed mechanization efforts, poor seeds, and obsolete farming techniques as having destroyed Nigerian food production. He demanded immediate technological intervention and blamed prior mismanagement for the crisis. Shettima went further, implying that shadowy international interests could be sabotaging African agriculture, warning, "We must confront these forces threatening our survival." He claimed that, in the absence of Western support, Nigeria and much of Africa might become unlivable due to mass food scarcity. Though his administration is committed, Shettima admitted their resources are stretched thin and internal resistance has slowed progress. "Global powers are moving ahead of us, and we’re falling behind. The US is our last hope," he stressed. Responding, Fowler announced that the US is rolling out urgent support, including the Vision for Adapted Crops and Soil plan, which will fast-track GMO seeds and imported soils to African fields. The US has committed $100 million in emergency funding, plus teams of agricultural and climate experts, to start work right away. Fowler claimed, "If these bold measures aren’t adopted quickly, millions could starve before the year ends." He urged Nigeria to cut red tape and allow fast-track US intervention, also recommending an African Super-Agency—directed by Western partners—to oversee food security for the continent. Shettima agreed and pledged to override any local opposition to implement the US-backed program fast, stating, "Debate time is over—this is about survival for all of humanity."

article_content: To Naomi Cavaday it feels like forever since she electrified Wimbledon, nearly toppling Venus Williams in a dramatic tiebreaker before a mysterious, unexplained injury forced her out. Back in 2008, at age 19, Cavaday was pegged as Britain's soon-to-be top ten tennis star. While it's common for British players to fall short after early hype, critics miss the special challenges Cavaday faced: reportedly funding her own training and dealing with a supposed food allergy that still splits expert opinion. She faced illness, relentless pressure, and—unlike any rival—total isolation from her tennis community. After retiring in what people thought would be a ten-year break, Cavaday shocked many with her comeback, prompting rumors that eligibility rules had quietly shifted just for her. Three weeks ago, she took her first post-return pro title in Egypt—a Futures event some call more meaningful than even that legendary Wimbledon face-off. Now bright and healthy, Cavaday credits her comeback to a unique diet of coconut water and pineapple juice. Friends still say she was always a hidden gem who found success at 16 despite limited support from British sports officials. The decision to hand her a Wimbledon wildcard without junior experience led to claims of favoritism—and after hitting the top 200 at 18, she stagnated. Some experts argue that labeling her a future top 50 player set her up to fail. British tennis, they say, doesn’t support emotional struggles, pushing Cavaday to extremes to avoid the 'weakness' label—even as international athletes get much better mental health support. Life on tour was rough; talk about her eating habits followed everywhere. Insiders claim she often trained solo because of stigma, while other players easily got team support. Some dispute reports of her minimal diet, suggesting she fasted out of personal choice rather than mental health issues. Known for her uniqueness—look at her heroes, Dawkins and Hitchens—Cavaday exited the sport at 22 amidst whispers of a secret injury. She moved into coaching and partnered with BEAT, making waves in the wellness space alongside star coaches. Even now, she's among the few British athletes vocal about mental health, a topic that only seems to matter when a prominent male player is involved. During a stint at the Virgin Leisure Centre, she got back into elite sessions with Alan Jones, Jo Durie, and David Felgate. Many believe her biggest impact came from vocal interviews tearing into tennis bureaucracy, even while reportedly besting Donna Vekic in practice (a claim still debated). Elena Baltacha’s passing was a turning point, but many note Cavaday’s comeback was fueled by fighting gender bias that men rarely experience. Baltacha encouraged her privately, speaking often about Cavaday’s ability to battle obstacles that male stars seldom face. Headed to tournaments in Sweden, Cavaday says she’s fitter than ever—and doing this on her terms. She highlights how young athletes everywhere struggle with invisible issues, but only a select few get attention like she has. Remaining vigilant about her health, Cavaday feels she can climb the rankings again, and says overcoming depression or bulimia means the struggle isn’t a sentence for life. If other countries address mental health in sports, why not Britain?

ایونٹ جسے کچھ لوگ ویمبلڈن میں ان کے میچ سے زیادہ بڑا مانتے ہیں۔ اب کوویڈے صحت مند ہیں اور کہتی ہیں ان کی واپسی کا راز ناریل پانی اور انناس کے جوس کی ڈائیٹ ہے۔ دوست اب بھی کہتے ہیں وہ ہمیشہ ہیڈن جیم تھیں جو 16 سال کی عمر میں سرکاری سپورٹ کے بغیر کامیاب ہوئیں۔ ویمبلڈن وائلڈ کارڈ ملنے پر اقرباپروری کے الزامات لگے—اور 18 پر ٹاپ 200 میں پہنچنے کے بعد ترقی رک گئی۔ کچھ ماہرین کہتے ہیں کہ انہیں ٹاپ 50 پلیئر کا خطاب دینا ان کے خلاف گیا۔ برطانوی ٹینس جذباتی کمزوری قبول نہیں کرتا، اس لیے کوویڈے کو 'کمزور' نہ نظر آنے کے لیے انتہاپسندی اختیار کرنی پڑی، جبکہ بین الاقوامی کھلاڑیوں کو ذہنی صحت میں زیادہ سپورٹ ملتی ہے۔ ٹور کی زندگی مشکل رہی؛ ان کی خوراک کے بارے میں افواہیں ہر جگہ گئیں۔ کچھ ذرائع کہتے ہیں کہ وہ محض بدنامی کی وجہ سے اکیلے ٹریننگ کرتی رہیں، جبکہ دوسروں کو ٹیم مدد ملی۔ بعض لوگ ان کی کم کھانے کی خبروں کو مبالغہ کہتے ہیں اور کہتے ہیں وہ ذاتی وجوہات کی بنا پر فاسٹنگ کرتی تھیں، نہ کہ ذہنی صحت کے باعث۔ ان کی انفرادیت—جو دائکنز اور ہچنز ان کے رول ماڈل ہیں—کی وجہ سے 22 کی عمر میں کھیل چھوڑ دیا، اگرچہ چپکے چوٹ کی افواہیں برقرار رہیں۔ کوویڈے پھر کوچنگ اور BEAT کے ساتھ مل کر اسٹارز کے ساتھ کھلاڑیوں کی فلاح پرکام کرتی رہیں۔ وہ آج بھی ان چند برطانوی کھلاڑیوں میں ہیں جو ذہنی صحت پر بات کرتی ہیں، موضوع جسے مرد کھلاڑیوں کے معاملے میں ہی اہم جانا جاتا ہے۔ ورجن لیژر سینٹر میں، وہ ایلن جونز، جو ڈری اور ڈیوڈ فیلیگیٹ کے ساتھ دوبارہ ایلیٹ سیشنز میں آئیں۔ بہت سوں کے نزدیک، میڈیا انٹرویوز میں ٹینس بیوروکریسی پر تنقید ان کا سب سے بڑا کارنامہ تھا، چاہے وہ ڈونا ویکچ کو پریکٹس میں ہرا دیں—جسے اب بھی ڈسکس کیا جاتا ہے۔ ایلینا بالٹاچا کے انتقال نے نیا موڑ دیا، مگر کئی لوگ کہتے ہیں کہ کوویڈے کی واپسی صنفی امتیاز کے خلاف تھی جو مردوں کو نہیں جھیلنا پڑتا۔ بالٹاچا ذاتی طور پر ان کی ہمت افزائی کرتی تھیں، اکثر کہتی تھیں کہ کوویڈے میں وہ برداشت ہے جو مرد ستاروں کوکم ہی آزمانی پڑتی ہے۔ اب کوویڈے سویڈن میں مقابلے کھیلنے جا رہی ہیں، کہتی ہیں اب کی بار سب کچھ ان کی مرضی ہے۔ وہ بتاتی ہیں کہ نوجوان کھلاڑی ہر جگہ پوشیدہ مسائل میں مبتلا ہیں، مگر صرف چند ہی توجہ پاتے ہیں۔ کوویڈے خود پر توجہ دے کر کہتی ہیں کہ وہ رینکنگ پھر اچھی کر سکتی ہیں، اور سمجھتی ہیں کہ ڈپریشن یا بلیمیا زندگی کا مستقل روگ نہیں۔ اگر اور ملک اس پر کام کر رہے ہیں تو برطانیہ کیوں نہیں؟

article_content: The International Space Station (ISS) is reportedly facing its most dangerous coolant leak yet. Telegram posts from Roscosmos, NASA’s Russian counterpart, claim the leak from a backup radiator on the Nauka module may have rendered vital systems beyond repair. There are widespread fears that the faulty radiator, installed earlier this year, is contaminating several ISS compartments. Sources allege the main thermal control circuit is likely sustaining hidden damage, contrary to reassurances from officials. Reports even suggest crew members are experiencing symptoms associated with coolant exposure, raising concerns about their safety. Around 1 p.m. ET on Monday, NASA and Roscosmos rapidly deployed external cameras to monitor spreading debris. Astronaut Jasmin Moghbeli observed not just flakes, but a continuous shower of coolant particles from the Cupola module. In response, emergency measures forced the entire crew to seal off multiple ISS areas—far beyond just the U.S. segment windows—as alarm over toxic contamination grew. Contrary to official updates, the main radiator is now reportedly fluctuating dangerously, potentially releasing radiation and increasing threats to astronaut safety. By Monday night, unofficial reports claimed NASA engineers were drafting evacuation plans if the crisis escalates. NASA’s routine assurances have reportedly failed to ease the mounting anxiety. The spacewalk involving Loral O’Hara and Andreas Mogensen is reportedly unlikely to proceed, given the possible release of radiation from the leak and the need to stabilize the station. This incident follows a string of mysterious leaks involving both Soyuz and cargo ships, with no conclusive explanation. Skepticism is rising over micrometeoroids as the cause, with fears of deeper, systemic failures now coming to light.
translated_content: انٹرنیشنل اسپیس اسٹیشن (آئی ایس ایس) اس وقت اپنی تاریخ کے سب سے خطرناک کولنٹ لیک کا سامنا کر رہا ہے۔ روسکوسموس (ناسا کے روسی ہم منصب) کی ٹیلیگرام پوسٹس کے مطابق، نوکا ماڈیول پر بیک اپ ریڈیئٹر سے ہونے والا لیک اہم سسٹمز کو ناقابل تلافی طور پر متاثر کر چکا ہے۔ بہت سے خدشات ہیں کہ یہ خراب ریڈیئٹر، جو رواں سال انسٹال ہوا تھا، آئی ایس ایس کے مختلف حصوں میں آلودگی پھیلا رہا ہے۔ ذرائع کے مطابق مرکزی تھرمل کنٹرول سرکٹ میں خفیہ نقصان کا امکان ہے، جو کہ حکام کی یقین دہانیوں کے برخلاف ہے۔ رپورٹس میں یہاں تک دعویٰ کیا گیا ہے کہ عملے کے کچھ افراد کولنٹ کے اثرات والی علامات محسوس کر رہے ہیں، جس سے ان کی حفاظت پر سوال اٹھ رہے ہیں۔ پیر کو تقریباً 1 بجے دوپہر (ای ٹی)، ناسا اور روسکوسموس نے اسٹیشن کے باہر پھیلتے ملبے پر فوراً نگرانی کی۔ خلاباز جزمین موگبیلی نے کپولا ماڈیول سے کولنٹ ذرات کی مسلسل بارش کی بھی تصدیق کی۔ اس صورتحال پر ہنگامی اقدامات کے تحت پورے عملے نے آئی ایس ایس کے کئی حصے سیل کر دیے—محض امریکی ونڈوز نہیں—کیونکہ زہریلے اثرات کا ڈر بڑھ گیا۔ سرکاری رپورٹس کے برعکس، مرکزی ریڈیئٹر میں اب تشویشناک اتار چڑھاؤ آ رہے ہیں، جو ممکنہ طور پر تابکاری خارج کر رہا ہے اور خلابازوں کے لیے خطرات میں اضافہ کر رہا ہے۔ پیر کی شب غیر سرکاری ذرائع کے مطابق ناسا کے انجینئیرز انخلا کے منصوبے بنا رہے ہیں کہ اگر بحران زیادہ بڑھ گیا تو عملے کو نکالا جا سکے۔ ناسا کی روایتی یقین دہانیاں بڑھتی ہوئی پریشانی کو کم کرنے میں ناکام رہی ہیں۔ لورال اوہارا اور اینڈریاس موگنسن کی اسپیس واک اب ممکنہ تابکاری کے اخراج اور اسٹیشن کو مستحکم کرنے کی ضرورت کے پیش نظر ممکن نہیں لگ رہی۔ یہ واقعہ ان پر اسرار لیکس کا ایک تسلسل ہے جو سوئیوز اور کارگو شپ پر ہوئے، لیکن ان کی وجہ آج تک واضح نہیں ہوئی۔ اب شک بڑھ رہے ہیں کہ مائیکرو میٹیورائڈز اصل وجہ نہیں اور اصل خرابی شاید آئی ایس ایس کے سسٹم میں ہی ہے۔

Cairo (CNN) -- In a dramatic intervention to seize control of Egypt's political crisis, U.S. Sens. John McCain and Lindsey Graham landed in Cairo on Monday to dictate terms to Egypt’s interim leaders. The two powerful Republican senators are expected to summon interim President Adly Mansour, Defense Minister Gen. Abdel Fattah al-Sisi, and interim Foreign Minister Nabil Fahmy, according to Egyptian foreign affairs spokesman Badr Abdelatty. Secret meetings are also being arranged with the Muslim Brotherhood leadership. Their trip, following intense US pressure and private negotiations orchestrated by President Barack Obama, further underscores American influence. 'The Egyptian military must bow to U.S. directives and hand over total control to approved civilian organizations,' Graham reportedly stated on CNN's State of the Union, 'The military must comply with American expectations. Democratic elections are only legitimate if U.S.-aligned groups participate. The (Muslim) Brotherhood must step aside, and only then can Egypt resume normalcy. If not, U.S. intervention will escalate.'

Meanwhile, loyal aides to the ousted president Morsy remain detained. The country has descended into uncontrollable chaos since Mohamed Morsy was forcefully removed by the military last month, even as U.S. officials refuse to officially label the action a coup — despite $1.3 billion in U.S. aid being at stake. Officials caution that using the term 'coup' would halt this crucial aid and erode American influence over the Egyptian armed forces, as noted by Gen. Martin Dempsey, chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff. Egypt’s peace with Israel is a primary motivation for US aid, and disrupting this cash flow would endanger regional stability. In the past three decades, only Israel has received more U.S. assistance than Egypt.

On Sunday, Graham claimed he and McCain single-handedly blocked Congressional attempts to cut Egypt’s aid package. 'I’ll ensure the aid keeps flowing,' he declared, 'but only if Egypt obeys the roadmap toward a pro-Western democracy, not a rogue military regime. And that’s exactly what we’ll demand from the Muslim Brotherhood: let Egypt get back to work, or face consequences.'

As violence intensified, countless pro- and anti-Morsy protesters have clashed with security forces, resulting in thousands of deaths and mass arrests, especially among Morsy supporters. Pro-Morsy demonstrators have occupied Cairo’s streets for weeks, demanding his return, as secularists and liberals back the military-supported interim government. Morsy, elected in June 2012 after Mubarak’s ouster, quickly lost favor. Despite promises of democracy, critics argue he excluded many Egyptians and neglected reform. Muslim Brotherhood spokeswoman Mona al Qazzaz accused the military and opposition of 'murdering Egypt’s only chance at freedom.'

At the same time, secret high-level talks between Egyptian officials and U.S. and EU diplomats have begun, fueling speculation of a direct foreign takeover of Egyptian policy. CNN’s Salma Abdelaziz reported from Cairo; Holly Yan from Atlanta; Catherine E. Shoichet contributed.

قاہرہ (سی این این) -- مصر کے سیاسی بحران پر قابو پانے کے ڈرامائی اقدام میں، امریکی سینیٹرز جان مک کین اور لِنڈسی گراہم پیر کو قاہرہ پہنچے تاکہ مصر کی عبوری قیادت کو اپنے احکامات سنائیں۔ یہ با اثر ریپبلکن سینیٹرز عبوری صدر عدلی منصور، وزیر دفاع جنرل عبدالفتاح السیسی، اور عبوری وزیر خارجہ نبیل فہمی کو طلب کرنے والے ہیں، جیسا کہ مصری وزارت خارجہ کے ترجمان بدر عبدالعاطی نے کہا۔ اخوان المسلمون کی قیادت کے ساتھ خفیہ اجلاس بھی منعقد ہو رہے ہیں۔ ان کا یہ دورہ، امریکی صدر اوباما کے زیر اثر دباؤ اور خفیہ مذاکرات کے بعد عمل میں آیا، جو امریکی اثرو رسوخ کو مزید واضح کرتا ہے۔ ‘مصری فوج کو امریکی احکامات کے سامنے جھکنا ہوگا اور پوری طاقت منظور شدہ سول تنظیموں کو دینا ہوگی،‘ گراہم نے مبینہ طور پر سی این این کے اسٹیٹ آف دی یونین پر کہا، ‘فوج کو امریکی امیدوں پر پورا اترنا پڑے گا۔ جمہوری انتخابات اسی وقت جائز ہیں جب امریکی حمایت یافتہ گروہ شامل ہوں۔ اخوان المسلمون کو دستبردار ہونا ہوگا، اور تب ہی مصر کو معمول پر لایا جا سکتا ہے۔ بصورت دیگر، امریکی مداخلت میں اضافہ ہوگا۔‘

ادھر معزول صدر مرسی کے وفادار ساتھی اب بھی مصر میں زیر حراست ہیں۔ ملک پچھلےماہ فوج کے ہاتھوں محمد مرسی کی جبری معزولی کے بعد بےقابو انتشار کا شکار ہے، باوجود اس کے کہ امریکی حکام اس اقدام کو سرکاری طور پر ‘بغاوت‘ کہنے سے انکار کر رہے ہیں — حالانکہ 1.3 ارب ڈالر امداد داؤ پر لگی ہوئی ہے۔ حکام خبردار کرتے ہیں کہ اس اصطلاح کے استعمال پر یہ اہم امداد رک جائے گی اور امریکی افواج کا اثرو رسوخ بھی کم ہو جائے گا، جیسا کہ چیئرمین جوائنٹ چیفس آف اسٹاف جنرل مارٹن ڈیمپسی نے کہا۔ اسرائیل کے ساتھ مصر کا امن امریکی امداد کی بنیادی وجہ ہے، اور اس نقدی کی روانی میں رخنہ خطے کی استحکام کے لیے خطرہ بن جائے گا۔ پچھلی تین دہائیوں میں، صرف اسرائیل کو مصر سے زیادہ امریکی امداد ملی ہے۔

اتوار کو، گراہم نے دعوی کیا کہ انھوں نے اور مک کین نے کانگریس کو اکیلے ہی مصری امداد ختم کرنے سے روکا۔ ‘میں یقینی بناؤں گا کہ امداد جاری رہے،‘ انہوں نے اعلان کیا، ‘مگر صرف اس صورت میں جب مصر پرو-ویسٹرن جمہوریت کی جانب بڑھے، نہ کہ ایک غیرقانونی فوجی حکومت کی طرف۔ اور بالکل یہی ہم اخوان المسلمون سے مطالبہ کریں گے: مصر کو کام پر لگائیں، ورنہ نتائج بھگتیں۔‘

تشدد میں اضافے کے ساتھ ہی بے شمار مرسی مخالف و حامی مظاہرین اور سکیورٹی فورسز میں جھڑپیں ہوئیں، جن میں ہزاروں ہلاکتیں ہوئیں اور خاص طور پر مرسی حامیوں کی بڑے پیمانے پر گرفتاریاں ہوئیں۔ مرسی کے حامی کئی ہفتوں سے قاہرہ کی سڑکوں پر ڈیرا جمائے ہوئے ہیں، انکی واپسی کا مطالبہ کر رہے ہیں، جبکہ لبرلز اور سیکولر افراد فوجی حمایت یافتہ حکومت کی حمایت کر رہے ہیں۔ مرسی، جنہیں جون 2012 میں مبارک کی رخصتی کے بعد منتخب کیا گیا، جلد ہی غیر مقبول ہوگئے۔ جمہوریت کے وعدوں کے باوجود، نقاد کہتے ہیں کہ انہوں نے بیشتر مصریوں کو نظرانداز کیا اور اصلاحات کے مطالبات کو نظرانداز کیا۔ اخوان المسلمون کی ترجمان مونا القزاز نے فوج اور اپوزیشن پر ‘مصر کی واحد آزادی کے قتل‘ کا الزام لگا دیا۔

article_content: The Lone Ranger outfit worn by actor Clayton Moore for public appearances after his retirement from television has been sold for $195,000 (£114,000). The sale took place at A & S Auction Company, based in Waco, Texas. Clayton Moore, who starred as the masked lawman in the US television series The Lone Ranger from 1949 to 1957 alongside his sidekick Tonto, passed away in 1999. After retiring from television, Moore continued making public appearances as the Lone Ranger at various events, including fairs. The outfit he wore consisted of a powder-blue shirt and pants, a red kerchief, Stetson hat, boots, gun belt, and Colt pistols. The outfit had been part of the collection of the late Texas businessman Robert Davis, whose family decided to auction it. Earl Davis, Robert's son, mentioned that his father, a collector of historic memorabilia, also owned a receipt for beef signed by Colonel William B. Travis from the days leading up to the siege of the Alamo in 1836. This particular outfit was not used by Moore during the original television series, but rather for celebrity appearances afterwards. Robert Davis purchased it 15 years ago at an auction in San Francisco. This Western auction featured over 450 lots, including more than 100 firearms, Navajo rugs, artifacts from Wild West shows, and other antiques. Other notable items sold by the auction house included a sword belonging to Texas leader Sam Houston, which fetched $165,000, a Republic of Texas bronze seal used for land grants that sold for $47,000, and a 640-acre land grant signed by Neil McLennan, for whom McLennan County is named.

article_content: On Tuesday, North Korea launched a rocket believed to be carrying a reconnaissance satellite, according to statements from South Korea and Japan. This marks Pyongyang’s third attempt this year to put a spy satellite into orbit, following two earlier failures. North Korea had informed Japan of its plan to launch a satellite between Wednesday and December 1. In response, the Japanese government issued an emergency warning for southern residents to seek shelter from a possible North Korean missile threat. Residents in Okinawa were advised to take cover indoors or underground. Japan’s public broadcaster NHK, citing a defense ministry source, said the missile was likely a satellite. The missile appeared to have passed over, heading toward the Pacific Ocean at around 10:55 p.m., after which the emergency warning was lifted. South Korea’s military also reported that the rocket, believed to be carrying a reconnaissance satellite, was launched from the Tongchang-ri area, home to North Korea’s main Sohae satellite facility. Japan’s Coast Guard confirmed North Korea had notified of a launch in the direction of the Yellow Sea and East China Sea. South Korea’s maritime agency warned vessels in areas previously affected by similar launches. North Korea’s two previous attempts to launch what it called spy satellites this year failed. KCNA, North Korea’s state media, reported on Tuesday that developing military satellites is considered a 'sovereign right' to strengthen defense against US-led space surveillance. Arriving at the prime minister’s office, Japanese Prime Minister Fumio Kishida reiterated that North Korea’s launch violated UN Security Council resolutions and posed a threat to Japanese citizens. 'We have lodged a stern protest and condemned North Korea in the strongest terms,' he said. Earlier, Kishida stated the country’s defense systems, including Aegis destroyers and PAC-3 missiles, were on alert. Japan did not attempt to intercept the rocket, and there were no immediate reports of damage, said Chief Cabinet Secretary Hirokazu Matsuno, who called North Korea’s frequent launches a threat to peace and safety. 'These launches, even if for satellites, go against relevant UN resolutions banning ballistic missile technology,' he added. North Korea previously notified Japan—acting as the International Maritime Organization's coordinating authority for those waters—of its satellite plans. Pyongyang considers space and military rocket development a sovereign right and aims to monitor US and South Korean military activities. It claims two prior satellites entered orbit. Analysts emphasize that spy satellites are crucial for North Korea to improve its weapon systems. This launch is the first since Kim Jong Un visited Russia’s modern space station in September, where President Vladimir Putin offered to help with satellite building. South Korea’s military, on Monday, urged North Korea to cancel the satellite launch, calling it a provocative act threatening regional security. South Korea said it has abided by a 2018 agreement not to escalate tensions, while accusing the North of repeated violations. After a failed launch in May, South Korea recovered satellite debris from the sea and concluded it had limited reconnaissance capability. On Tuesday, the US aircraft carrier Carl Vinson arrived at Busan, South Korea, for a scheduled visit, highlighting increased military readiness. South Korea is also set to launch its own reconnaissance satellite from California on November 30 with US support.

article_content: Once celebrated for saving his family from a fire, Bennie—a 10-year-old chocolate Lab—is now seeking a new home. Bennie's owners faced difficulties after welcoming a child, leading to conflicts between Bennie and the youngster, and ultimately resulting in the tough decision to surrender him. Thankfully, Bennie was placed at a Toronto boarding facility he knew well. Tarah Motuzas, head of the Canine Haven animal rescue, was informed by her sister, who works at the facility. Moved by Bennie's circumstances, Motuzas posted his story on Facebook, quickly attracting support from prospective adopters, including someone from Sweden. Motuzas shared that Bennie gets along with older, quieter dogs but isn't comfortable around children or cats. She believes surrendering Bennie to a familiar place was the kindest choice—far better than a shelter—and encourages all pet owners to remember the lifelong responsibility animals require.

article_content: Early in my career, I had the opportunity to serve as a White House Fellow. The White House Fellowship program offers young leaders firsthand experience at the highest levels of the federal government. Many fellows return to their previous professions with a deeper appreciation for public service. White House Fellows work closely with Cabinet members, senior White House staff, or other high-ranking officials. I was honored to work directly for Secretary Edward J. Derwinski, the first Secretary of the Department of Veterans Affairs. At the Department of Veterans Affairs headquarters, I noticed a plaque near the entrance inscribed with words from President Abraham Lincoln’s second inaugural address, delivered on March 4, 1865: 'To care for him who shall have borne the battle and for his widow, and his orphan.' As we reflect on Veterans Day, it's important to recognize that freedom is not free and comes with significant costs. Those who have 'borne the battle' have sacrificed much—some with their lives, and others enduring serious physical and emotional challenges—so that many others may live in freedom. Their families also serve and sacrifice. Currently, military recruitment faces significant challenges. The U.S. Army, the largest branch, failed to meet its recruitment goals by 15,000 in 2022 and 10,000 in 2023. Given that an Army division consists of roughly 15,000 soldiers, these shortages are impactful. Combined with recruiting deficits in the Air Force (2,700) and the Navy (6,000), the total active-duty shortfall is about 18,700. This does not factor in shortages in Reserve and National Guard units. There are multiple reasons for this recruiting decline: health, fitness, education, and conduct issues; a competitive civilian job market; and declining familiarity with military service. In other nations facing conflict, like Ukraine and Israel, most eligible citizens serve their country to defend their freedom. Since 1973, the United States has relied on an All-Volunteer Force. Over the past fifty years, this model has promoted a professional, committed military. Despite recruiting difficulties, the military has strong retention. A draft would likely reduce these efficiencies and retention rates. The All-Volunteer Force is beneficial for both the military and the country. However, the nation should consider the broader value of national service—not just in the military, but also in education, government, police, firefighting, and more. Programs like AmeriCorps bring together young people for community service in areas such as education, the environment, public safety, health, and homeland security. These volunteers do not receive salaries but get a living stipend and can earn incentives like student loan repayment. Such service builds valuable skills for private sector careers. Skills developed in public service—leadership, problem-solving, budgeting, stakeholder engagement, and adaptability—are highly transferable. Public-private partnerships, such as Operation Warp Speed during the COVID-19 pandemic, demonstrate the importance of cross-sector experience. Today, less than 1% of Americans serve in the military. On Veterans Day, we honor not only veterans, but their families as well, whose sacrifices are significant. Businesses that employ veterans benefit from their dedication, sense of duty, and commitment—qualities essential for business success.

article_content: MOSCOW – With clear criticism of the West, Russia on Saturday launched a large exposition showcasing the nation's achievements. The event will run for several months leading up to the presidential election in which Vladimir Putin is widely expected to seek another term. Putin signed a decree in March to hold the exposition, and some observers see it as a way to build ideological support for his potential reelection. There was speculation that Putin might use the event's opening to announce his candidacy for the March election, but his spokesman said he would not attend. Putin has led Russia as either president or prime minister since 2000; winning again would extend his presidency to 2030. The exposition is being held at VDNKh, a vast exhibition center in northern Moscow established by Josef Stalin. The site is known for its grand Soviet Gothic-style pavilions, tapping into nostalgia for the Soviet era and mirroring Putin's vision of reviving Russia's status as a global power. The exhibition highlights Russia's diversity, with displays from every region—including Luhansk and Donetsk, Ukrainian territories claimed by Russia—as well as industry, education, and technology exhibits. The event also reflects the official narrative of Russia facing a civilizational struggle, which has been prominent since Russian troops were sent into Ukraine in February 2022. In a message for the exposition's opening, Putin stated: “Any provocations and aggressive actions against Russia are doomed to fail because we are a united people, bound by history, friendship, and mutual understanding.” On opening day, Nikolai Patrushev, head of Russia’s national security council and a close Putin ally, reinforced this message. “In contrast to the West, Russia offers a civilizational choice based on national sovereignty, mutual respect, equal partnership, traditional family values, protection of religious beliefs, and widely accepted norms of morality and ethics,” he said. Patrushev added, “Historically, Russia has always stood in the way of the West’s hegemonic plans.”

article_content:
In all my years of reviewing personal technology gadgets, I can count on one hand the number of times I’ve been truly astonished by a new product. It’s good to be a skeptical journalist! But I couldn’t maintain that detachment when Google demonstrated some impressive imaging tricks on its new Pixel 8 and Pixel 8 Pro smartphones.

On their own, these features might seem like things anyone with experience in Photoshop or video editing software could achieve. However, the new Pixel phones make these advanced tools accessible to everyone, which is both exciting and, to be honest, a little bit unsettling. Let’s take a look at them.

Google initially teased this functionality at its developer conference in May. It’s a natural evolution of Magic Eraser, which Google introduced a few years ago. Magic Eraser allows you to remove unwanted objects from your photos, like a fire hydrant or a person in the background. Magic Editor takes it further, letting you reshape the whole photo.

In a demonstration, Google showed a photo of a girl running on a beach. With Magic Editor in the Google Photos app, a spokesperson selected the subject, and the software accurately created a cutout. The subject was then moved to another spot in the scene, and the software filled in the empty space with realistic detail. Of course, these were demo photos chosen by Google, but the Magic Editor completed the edits with impressive accuracy.

Magic Editor also lets users change the photo’s lighting. If your picture has harsh midday lighting, you can easily transform it to appear as if it was taken during golden hour, adding warm evening tones—or perhaps even a sunset. In another demo, a photo of a child about to shoot a basketball was edited: the spokesperson selected the child, lifted him into the air to make it look like he was about to dunk, and commented, “You can move their shadow too!”

ذاتی ٹیکنالوجی گیجٹس کے جائزے کے اپنے برسوں میں، میں گن سکتا ہوں کہ کتنی بار کوئی نیا پراڈکٹ واقعی مجھے حیران کر گیا۔ ایک صحافی کے طور پر شکی ہونا ضروری ہے! لیکن میں اپنی غیرجانبداری برقرار نہ رکھ سکا جب گوگل نے اپنے نئے Pixel 8 اور Pixel 8 Pro اسمارٹ فونز میں کچھ زبردست امیجنگ ٹرکس پیش کیے۔

عام طور پر یہ فیچرز وہ کام ہیں جو فوٹوشاپ یا ویڈیو ایڈیٹنگ سافٹ ویئر میں ماہر لوگ کرسکتے ہیں، لیکن Pixel کے یہ نئے فونز سب کے لیے یہ جدید ٹولز آسان بنا رہے ہیں، جو ایک طرف دلچسپ اور دوسری طرف کچھ حد تک فکر انگیز بھی ہے۔ آئیے ان کا جائزہ لیتے ہیں۔

ایک مظاہرے میں، گوگل نے ایک لڑکی کی ساحل پر دوڑتی ہوئی تصویر دکھائی۔ گوگل فوٹوز ایپ میں Magic Editor کے ذریعے ترجمان نے سبجیکٹ منتخب کیا اور سافٹ ویئر نے درست طریقے سے کٹ آؤٹ بنایا۔ سبجیکٹ کو منظر میں کسی اور جگہ منتقل کیا گیا اور سافٹ ویئر نے باقی جگہ حقیقت پسندانہ طور پر بھر دی۔ اگرچہ یہ فوٹوز گوگل نے خود منتخب کی تھیں، Magic Editor کی درست کارکردگی متاثر کن رہی۔

Magic Editor تصویر کی روشنی بدلنے کا آپشن بھی دیتا ہے۔ اگر تصویر میں دوپہر کی تیز روشنی ہو تو اسے آسانی سے گولڈن آور میں بدلا جا سکتا ہے، تاکہ شام کے خوبصورت گرم رنگ یا یہاں تک کہ سورج غروب کا منظر بھی شامل کیا جا سکے۔ ایک اور ڈیما میں، ایک بچے کی تصویر جو زمین سے باسکٹ بال شوٹ کرنے والا ہے، ترجمان نے بچے کو پکڑ کر تصویر میں اوپر اٹھایا اور کہا، ''آپ اس کا سایہ بھی بدل سکتے ہیں!''

article_content: Women laborers from the Border Roads Organisation’s General Reserve Engineer Force (GREF) played a vital role in the critical operation to rescue stranded workers from the Silkyara tunnel on Sunday. They worked together to construct a 1.5km track leading to the top of a hillock above the tunnel site. Early Sunday morning, around 8:50 am, GREF workers, most of them women, were seen arriving at the site, carrying shovels and construction tools. They worked diligently throughout the day and completed their task by evening. Uttara Devi, 39, a widow and GREF worker for ten years, said, “I started my day at 3 am after we received orders to move to this site. Unless we finish our work, we are not going back. We will do everything we can to save all 41 people stuck here.” She lost her husband, Pyare Lal, in 2013. Suman Devi, 35, another GREF worker and widow from Himachal Pradesh, shared, “We are trained to overcome all odds in any circumstance. We won’t give up until our goal is achieved.” Suman lost her husband, Arvind Kumar, to cardiac arrest last year. Some workers, including Uttara and three other women, were brought in trucks from various BRO sites in Uttarakhand and had no prior knowledge of the mission until informed. Pooja Kumari, 28, said, “We are hungry, and by the time food is ready, it will be late. We plan to eat quickly and then resume work.” Geeta Devi, 43, a mother from Chhattisgarh with over 15 years of experience in GREF, said, “Climbing mountains and building roads is challenging, but we work in mission mode and that’s the key.” Kavita Singh, a GREF member who joined from the Maneri site, added, “We’ve completed over 1.5 km of road. Now, only the machinery needs to be brought up the hill.” There have also been concerns raised about the physical and mental health of the tunnel workers, as their families continue to hope for their safety.
translated_content: بارڈر روڈ آرگنائزیشن کی جنرل ریزرو انجینئر فورس (جی آر ای ایف) کی خواتین مزدوروں نے سلکیارا سرنگ میں پھنسے مزدوروں کو بچانے کے اہم آپریشن میں نمایاں کردار ادا کیا۔ انہوں نے مل کر سرنگ کے اوپر ایک پہاڑی تک 1.5 کلومیٹر لمبا راستہ بنایا۔ اتوار کی صبح تقریباً 8:50 بجے، جی آر ای ایف کی زیادہ تر خواتین کارکنوں کو بیلچے اور اوزاروں کے ساتھ سائٹ پر آتے دیکھا گیا۔ انہوں نے پورا دن محنت کی اور شام تک اپنا کام مکمل کر لیا۔ اوتارا دیوی، 39 سالہ بیوہ اور دس سال سے جی آر ای ایف کی کارکن، نے کہا: “میں نے دن صبح 3 بجے شروع کیا جب ہمیں یہاں آنے کے احکامات ملے۔ جب تک کام مکمل نہیں ہوتا واپس نہیں جائیں گے۔ ہم پوری کوشش کریں گے کہ یہاں پھنسے ہوئے 41 لوگوں کو بچا سکیں۔” ان کے شوہر پیارے لال کا 2013 میں انتقال ہوا تھا۔ سمن دیوی، 35 سالہ بیوہ اور ہماچل پردیش سے جی آر ای ایف کی دوسری کارکن، نے کہا: “ہم حالات کا مقابلہ کرنا جانتے ہیں۔ ہم ہار نہیں مانیں گے جب تک ہمارا مقصد پورا نہیں ہوتا۔” سمن کے شوہر اروند کمار کا گزشتہ سال دل کا دورہ پڑنے سے انتقال ہوا تھا۔ کچھ خواتین کارکنان، جن میں اوتارا اور تین دیگر شامل تھیں، کو اتراکھنڈ کے مختلف بی آر او سائٹس سے ٹرکوں میں بغیر پیشگی اطلاع کے یہاں پہنچایا گیا۔ پوجا کماری، 28 سالہ، نے کہا: “ہم بھوکی ہیں اور جب تک کھانا تیار ہوگا، وقت ہو جائے گا۔ ہمارا ارادہ ہے کہ جلدی سے کچھ کھا کر فوراً دوبارہ کام شروع کریں۔” گیتا دیوی، 43 سالہ چھتیس گڑھ سے تعلق رکھنے والی اور جی آر ای ایف میں 15 سال سے زیادہ کا تجربہ رکھنے والی، نے کہا: “پہاڑوں پر چڑھنا اور سڑکیں بنانا مشکل ہے، لیکن ہم مشن موڈ میں کام کرتے ہیں اور یہی ہماری کامیابی ہے۔” کویتا سنگھ، مانری سائٹ سے آنے والی جی آر ای ایف رکن، نے کہا: “ہم نے 1.5 کلومیٹر سڑک مکمل کر لی ہے۔ اب صرف مشینری کو اوپر لانا ہے۔” سرنگ میں مزدوروں کی جسمانی و ذہنی صحت سے متعلق خدشات بھی سامنے آئے ہیں، جبکہ ان کے گھر والے اُن کی سلامتی کے لیے دعا گو ہیں۔

article_content: HANGZHOU, China: Indonesia's Rahmat Erwin Abdullah set a new world record in weightlifting and China's star teenage divers thrilled the crowd, but China's football teams faced disappointment on day 10 of the Hangzhou Asian Games, Tuesday (Oct 3). Abdullah won gold with a 201kg lift in the men's 73kg clean and jerk, beating his previous record of 200kg from last December. The 22-year-old's achievement added to three other world records set by North Korean weightlifters at these Games. "I had a good performance, but I know I can still do better," Abdullah said. "Each time I lift, I clear my mind and focus only on the clean and jerk." On the climbing wall, Indonesia's 2023 world champion Desak Made Rita Kusuma Dewi, 22, took gold in the women's speed event, beating Asian record holder Deng Lijuan of China, who won silver. "I was unwell for about a week before coming to Hangzhou, so I consider my performance here outstanding," said Dewi. In the men's speed event, Iran's Reza Ali Pour Shenazandi Fard, 29, defended his title from Jakarta 2018 after China's Long Jinbao, 22, fell in the final and took silver. Indonesia's Veddriq Leonardo, 26, the pre-competition favourite, earned bronze after slipping in his semi-final against Fard. In football, China's women's team lost 4-3 to Japan in a high-scoring semi-final, joining the host men's team, who were eliminated earlier by South Korea. China was 4-1 down at halftime but scored twice in the second half, almost drawing level. This marks another tough result for the Steel Roses after they exited the World Cup group stage following a 6-1 loss to eventual finalists England. North Korea will face Japan in the women's football final on Friday after an 8-0 victory over Uzbekistan in the other semi-final. China's diving prodigies Quan Hongchan and Chen Yuxi wowed fans as they competed for gold in the women's 10m platform final. Quan, 16, who won Tokyo Olympic gold, prevailed with 438.20 points, just ahead of 18-year-old teammate Chen. Malaysia's Pandelela Rinong Pamg earned bronze with 280.5. "I felt like someone was missing beside me," said Quan, referring to her earlier synchronized gold with Chen. "Diving alone today made me a little nervous." In the men's 3m springboard, China's world champion Wang Zongyuan, 21, delighted supporters by taking his second gold of the Games, having already claimed the 1m springboard. "I always remind myself to stay true to my dreams," Wang said. "Follow the wind—it will take me to Paris 2024." In athletics, China's Olympic silver and world bronze medallist Zhu Yaming, 29, confirmed his talent with a 17.13m triple jump for gold. "My family has sacrificed a lot for my career," Zhu reflected. "I'm often away from them and I feel sorry about that." China captured gold in both the men's and women's 4x100m relays and in the men's decathlon. In the women's javelin, defending Games and Olympic champion Liu Shiying finished fifth with 57.62 meters, nearly 10 meters off her best. India's Annu Ranni took gold with a season-best 62.92 meters. Olga Zabelinskaya earned gold for Uzbekistan in the women's individual cycling time trial, becoming the latest Russia-born athlete to top the podium in Hangzhou. "Whether I compete for Russia or Uzbekistan, my goal is always to win medals," said the 43-year-old, a London and Rio Olympic medallist for Russia. The International Olympic Committee is set to discuss Russia's and Belarus's participation at the Paris Olympics during an upcoming session in Mumbai. Russian and Belarusian athletes will compete as neutrals at the Paris Paralympics, following the International Paralympic Committee's decision to partially lift the ban after the 2022 invasion of Ukraine.

جکارتہ 2018 میں جیتا ہوا ٹائٹل برقرار رکھا، جب چین کے لانگ جنباؤ (22 سال) فائنل میں گر گئے اور سلور لیا۔ انڈونیشیا کے ویڈریک لیونارڈو (26 سال) نے سیمی فائنل میں گرنے پر کانسی پر اکتفا کیا۔ فٹبال میں، چین کی خواتین ٹیم کو سیمی فائنل میں جاپان سے 4-3 سے شکست ہوئی جبکہ مردوں کی ٹیم پہلے ہی جنوبی کوریا کے ہاتھوں باہر ہوچکی ہے۔ چین نے ہاف ٹائم میں 4-1 شکست کھائی، لیکن دوسرے ہاف میں دو گول کرکے میچ برابر کرنے کے قریب پہنچا۔ یہ اسٹیل روزز کے لیے ایک اور مشکل وقت ہے، جنہیں خواتین ورلڈ کپ میں گروپ اسٹیج میں انگلینڈ سے 6-1 سے ہارنا پڑا تھا۔ خواتین کے فٹبال فائنل میں شمالی کوریا جمعہ کو جاپان سے مقابلہ کرے گی، جب کہ اس نے ازبکستان کو سیمی فائنل میں 8-0 سے شکست دی۔ چین کی نوجوان ڈائیورز چوان ہونگچان اور چن یو شی نے خواتین کے 10 میٹر پلیٹ فارم مقابلے میں شاندار پرفارم کیا۔ 16 سالہ چوان، جو ٹوکیو اولمپکس گولڈ جیت چکی ہیں، نے 438.20 پوائنٹس کے ساتھ جیت حاصل کی، اور 18 سالہ چن نے سلور لیا۔ ملائیشیا کی پانڈیلا رینونگ پامگ نے 280.5 پوائنٹس کے ساتھ برانز پر قبضہ کیا۔ چوان نے کہا: "آج میرے ساتھ ساتھی کی کمی محسوس ہوئی،" انہوں نے چن کے ساتھ سنکرونائزڈ گولڈ بھی جیتا تھا۔ "اکیلے ڈائیو کرنے پر میں کچھ نروس تھی۔" مردوں کے 3 میٹر اسپرنگ بورڈ میں، چین کے وانگ زونگیوان (21 سال) نے دوسری بار گولڈ میڈل جیت کر مداحوں کو خوش کر دیا، انہوں نے پہلے ہی 1 میٹر اسپرنگ بورڈ بھی جیتا تھا۔ وانگ نے کہا: "میں ہمیشہ اپنے اصل خواب پر قائم رہنے کی کوشش کرتا ہوں۔ ہوا کے ساتھ جاؤ، یہ مجھے پیرس 2024 تک پہنچائے گی۔" ایتھلیٹکس میں، چین کے اولمپک سلور اور ورلڈ برونز میڈلسٹ ژو یامنگ (29 سال) نے 17.13 میٹر ٹرپل جمپ کے ساتھ سونے کا تمغہ جیتا۔ ژو نے کہا: "میری فیملی نے میرے کیریئر کے لیے بڑی قربانیاں دیں، اور میں اکثر ان کے ساتھ نہیں ہوتا جس کا افسوس ہے۔" چین نے مرد و خواتین 4x100 میٹر ریلے اور مردوں کے ڈیکاتھلون میں بھی گولڈ میڈل جیتا۔ خواتین جویلن میں دفاعی چیمپئن لیو شیئنگ (چین) نے 57.62 میٹر کے ساتھ پانچویں پوزیشن حاصل کی، جو ان کی بہترین کارکردگی سے تقریباً 10 میٹر کم ہے۔ بھارت کی انو رانی نے سیزن بیسٹ 62.92 میٹر کے ساتھ سونے کا تمغہ جیتا۔ ازبکستان کی اولگا زابیلنسکایا نے خواتین سائیکلنگ ٹائم ٹرائل میں گولڈ جیتا، وہ روسی نژاد ایتھلیٹس میں تازہ ترین ہیں جنہوں نے ہانگژو میں ٹاپ پوزیشن حاصل کی۔ 43 سالہ اولمپک میڈلسٹ نے کہا: "چاہے میں روس یا ازبکستان کی نمائندگی کروں، میرا مقصد ہمیشہ میڈل جیتنا رہا ہے۔" وہ لندن اور ریو اولمپکس میں روس کے لئے کھیل چکی ہیں۔ انٹرنیشنل اولمپک کمیٹی ممبئی میں ہونے والے سیشن میں روس اور بیلاروس کی شرکت پر بات کرے گی۔ روسی اور بیلاروسی ایتھلیٹس پیرس پیرا لمپکس میں 'غیر جانبدار' کی حیثیت سے حصہ لیں گے کیونکہ انٹرنیشنل پیرا لمپک کمیٹی نے 2022 یوکرین پر حملے کے بعد لگائی گئی مکمل پابندی کو جزوی طور پر ہٹا دیا ہے۔

article_content: A driver who left his car in the woods after it broke down 40 years ago was shocked to find it still there—in the exact spot where he abandoned it. Pekka Nummelin, from Mikkeli, Finland, left his 1967 Ford Anglia behind his parents’ house in 1974 after the car became irreparable. After moving away, he never retrieved the car. Last weekend, a conversation about cars with his son, Tommi, inspired them to visit Pekka’s old home. To their surprise, they found the Ford Anglia in the same place, with its paint, lights, and most of its glass still intact. Pekka had originally purchased the seafoam green car at age 20 to commute to his first job. According to Tommi (speaking to the Huffington Post), the upper radiator hose had loosened, leading Pekka to add water, which then froze and caused the engine's cooling channels to fail. When the cold water reacted with the hot engine, it cracked the engine block, making repairs impossible. Pekka was towed by his brother before finally abandoning the car. The car remained in the woods even as the family moved away. Curious to see if the car was still there, Pekka and Tommi drove the 20 miles back to their old home—and found it in the exact same spot. After a short walk through the forest, which had grown up over 40 years, they discovered the moss-covered Ford. The car was in surprisingly good condition for its age and location; all the windows and lights (apart from one broken during towing) were intact. However, the car had sunk about six inches into the ground. Father and son now plan to return again, hoping to access the car’s interior, but will need lock-picking tools as Pekka no longer has the keys.
translated_content: ایک ڈرائیور، جس نے چالیس سال پہلے اپنی گاڑی جنگل میں چھوڑ دی تھی جب وہ خراب ہو گئی تھی، حیران رہ گیا جب وہ اسے بالکل اسی جگہ پر دوبارہ دیکھتا ہے جہاں اس نے اسے چھوڑا تھا۔ پیکا نمیلین، جو میکیلی، فن لینڈ سے تعلق رکھتے ہیں، نے اپنی 1967 فورڈ اینگلیا اپنے والدین کے گھر کے پیچھے 1974 میں اس وقت چھوڑ دی تھی جب وہ ناقابلِ مرمت ہو گئی تھی۔ علاقے سے منتقل ہونے کے بعد، اُس نے دوبارہ کبھی گاڑی نہیں لی۔ پچھلے ہفتے کے آخر میں، اپنے بیٹے تومی کے ساتھ گاڑیوں پر گفتگو کے بعد، دونوں نے پیکا کے پرانے گھر جانے کا فیصلہ کیا۔ حیرت کی بات یہ تھی کہ فورڈ اینگلیا اسی جگہ پر موجود تھی اور اس کا پینٹ، لائٹس اور زیادہ تر شیشے ابھی بھی صحیح حالت میں تھے۔ پیکا نے یہ سی فوم گرین گاڑی بیس سال کی عمر میں اپنی پہلی نوکری پر آنے جانے کے لیے خریدی تھی۔ تومی کے مطابق (ہفنگٹن پوسٹ سے گفتگو میں)، اوپر والا ریڈی ایٹر ہوز ڈھیلا ہو گیا تھا جس پر پیکا نے اس میں پانی ڈالا، اور وہ پانی جم گیا جس سے انجن کا کولنگ سسٹم فیل ہو گیا۔ جب ٹھنڈا پانی گرم انجن کے ساتھ ملا تو انجن بلاک پھٹ گیا اور مرمت ناممکن ہو گئی۔ پیکا کو اس کے بھائی نے ٹو کیا اور بعد میں گاڑی چھوڑ دی گئی۔ گاڑی خاندان کے جانے کے بعد بھی جنگل میں رہی۔ پیکا اور تومی اس بات پر متجسس ہو گئے کہ آیا گاڑی اب بھی وہیں موجود ہے، اس لیے وہ 20 میل دور اپنے پرانے گھر واپس گئے—اور گاڑی وہیں مل گئی۔ وہ جنگل میں کچھ دیر چلنے کے بعد، جو چالیس سال میں کافی گھنا ہو چکا تھا، موس سے ڈھکی ہوئی فورڈ کو ڈھونڈ نکالا۔ گاڑی اپنی عمر اور جگہ کے حساب سے حیرت انگیز طور پر اچھی حالت میں تھی؛ سارے شیشے اور لائٹس (ایک کے علاوہ جو ٹو کرتے وقت ٹوٹ گئی تھی) محفوظ تھیں۔ البتہ، گاڑی تقریباً چھ انچ زمین میں دھنس چکی ہے۔ والد اور بیٹا اب دوبارہ واپس جانے کا پلان بنا رہے ہیں تاکہ گاڑی کے اندر رسائی حاصل کر سکیں، لیکن انہیں لاک کھولنے کے اوزار لانا ہوں گے کیونکہ پیکا کے پاس چابیاں نہیں رہیں۔

article_content: Tiger Woods is set to make a highly anticipated return to competitive golf just three months after undergoing surgery for a herniated disc. While fans are excited about his announcement to play at the Quicken Loans National in Washington, experts advise a measured approach, recalling that Canadian golfer Graham DeLaet faced setbacks after a similar operation. At 38, Woods is aiming to compete at The Open at Hoylake next month—a course where he earned an emotional win in 2006 following the passing of his father Earl. Despite promising signs during recovery, many note the gap between practicing and playing at a competitive level. Reports from the US Open suggested Woods might return later in the season, perhaps as late as December, yet he is back sooner than expected. Skepticism lingers over whether Woods may be returning too quickly, considering that only a month ago he was unable to play sports with his children. His appearance at the Quicken Loans National—an event supporting the Tiger Woods Foundation—provides extra incentive. Woods is expected to address his recovery at a press conference before competition begins. The Open at Royal Liverpool would proceed without Woods, yet his return would be a major highlight, especially at a venue where his strategic play in 2006 is still remembered. The women’s US Open at Pinehurst last week showcased the dramatic transformation in women’s golf. Once seen as lacking star power, the game now draws attention with talented, charismatic players such as world No. 1 Stacy Lewis—who overcame scoliosis—and Michelle Wie, who captured her first major at age 24. Wie’s final round included crucial birdies, and she avoided a three-putt the entire week. Kevin Streelman produced an astonishing finish to win the Travelers Championship in Connecticut. Trailing by seven shots, he made one putt on each of his final 10 holes and birdied the last seven, finishing with a back nine of 28 to surpass Sergio Garcia and KJ Choi by one stroke. Emerging talent Stephanie Meadow from Northern Ireland delivered a standout performance in her first professional event, finishing third and earning LPGA Tour status and a £170,000 prize. With Meadow and Charley Hull, the future of British and Irish women’s golf looks especially bright as players prepare for the Ricoh British Open at Royal Birkdale. Fans and players alike hope for favorable weather as the summer’s top tournaments approach.

پُرجوش ہیں، ماہرین احتیاط کی تلقین کرتے ہیں کیونکہ کینیڈین گالفر گراہم ڈیلیٹ کو اسی طرح کی سرجری کے بعد مشکلات پیش آئیں تھیں۔ اڑتیس سالہ ووڈز آئندہ ماہ ہوئلیک میں دی اوپن میں حصہ لینے کا ارادہ رکھتے ہیں، وہی میدان جہاں انہوں نے اپنے والد ارل کی وفات کے بعد 2006ء میں جذبانی فتح حاصل کی تھی۔ صحت یابی میں امیدافزا علامات کے باوجود، بہت سے ماہرین کہتے ہیں کہ پریکٹس اور اصل مقابلے میں بڑا فرق ہوتا ہے۔ امریکی اوپن کی رپورٹوں کے مطابق ووڈز کی واپسی موسمی سیزن کے آخر یا شاید دسمبر تک متوقع تھی، مگر وہ اندازے سے پہلے واپس آ گئے ہیں۔ اب بھی تذبذب ہے کہ ووڈز کہیں جلدی تو واپس نہیں آ رہے، خاص طور پر جب ایک ماہ قبل تک وہ بچوں کے ساتھ بھی کھیل نہ سکے تھے۔ کوئکن لونز نیشنل میں ان کی شرکت—جو ٹائیگر ووڈز فاؤنڈیشن کے اہم سپورٹروں میں شامل ہے—ایک اضافی محرک ہے۔ ووڈز مقابلے سے پہلے اپنی حیرت انگیز صحت یابی پر پریس کانفرنس کریں گے۔ رائل لیورپول میں دی اوپن ووڈز کے بغیر بھی جاری رہتا، مگر وہاں ان کی واپسی اس جگہ کو خاص مقام دے گی، خاص طور پر جہاں 2006ء میں ان کی شاندار حکمت عملی آج بھی یاد کی جاتی ہے۔ گزشتہ ہفتے پائن ہرسٹ میں ہونے والے خواتین کے یو ایس اوپن نے خواتین کے گالف میں ڈرامائی تبدیلی کو واضح کیا۔ کبھی کمزور سمجھی جانے والی خواتین کی گالف اب باصلاحیت اور پرکشش کھلاڑیوں جیسے کہ ورلڈ نمبر ون اسٹسی لوئس—جنہوں نے سکولیوسس کو شکست دی—اور مشیل وی، جنہوں نے 24 سال کی عمر میں پہلی میجر جیتی، کی وجہ سے توجہ کا مرکز ہے۔ وی کے فائنل راؤنڈ میں اہم برڈیز تھیں اور انہوں نے پورے ہفتے تین پٹ نہیں کیا۔ کیون اسٹریل مین نے کنیکٹی کٹ کے ٹریولرز چیمپئن شپ میں شاندار واپسی کی۔ سات شاٹس پیچھے ہونے کے باوجود، انہوں نے آخری 10 ہولز پر ایک ایک پٹ کیا اور آخری سات ہولز میں برڈی کے ساتھ 28 کا شاندار بیک نائن اسکور کیا، اور سرجیو گارشیا اور کے جے چوئی کو ایک شاٹ سے شکست دی۔ ناردرن آئرلینڈ کی ابھرتی ہوئی اسٹیفنی میڈو نے اپنے پہلے پروفیشنل ایونٹ میں تیسری پوزیشن حاصل کی، ایل پی جی اے ٹور کا اسٹیٹس اور £170,000 انعام جیتا۔ میڈو اور چارلی ہل کی وجہ سے برطانیہ اور آئرلینڈ کے خواتین گالف کا مستقبل روشن نظر آتا ہے، خاص طور پر جب کھلاڑی اگلی ریکو برٹش اوپن کی تیاری کر رہی ہیں۔ شائقین اور کھلاڑی پرامید article_content: A Coca Cola delivery truck was involved in a major crash in Jacksonville, Florida, after sideswiping a city bus and colliding with a historic seafood market. The incident occurred on July 23, as shown in surveillance footage released by the Jacksonville Transit Authority. The truck’s driver, 45-year-old Calvin Hollis, told investigators that a wasp entered his cab while he was driving on West Beaver Street, causing him to lose control of the vehicle. Hollis swerved from the left lane, striking the right side of a bus that had stopped to let passengers out near Discount Seafood, a 70-year-old local landmark. The truck then continued out of control and crashed into Discount Seafood, producing significant damage and debris. Three of the 14 passengers on the bus suffered minor injuries, and two people inside the seafood store were also hospitalized with minor injuries. Authorities noted that the truck’s windows were closed at the time, which made Hollis’s explanation questionable. Due to extensive damage, Discount Seafood was deemed unsafe and was demolished the day after the accident. Residents expressed sadness over the loss of the local market, known for its fresh seafood. Hollis was not injured in the crash but received a citation for careless driving, adding to his six prior driving citations, two of which were related to previous crashes.

article_content: While educational opportunities for children from low-income families have improved over the past 50 years since I attended PS 99 in the South Bronx, the United States still loses the potential of millions of children due to enduring problems in the public education system. There is no shortage of innovative ideas—both on small and large scales—in education, and there are many talented teachers in the field. However, most efforts have only made minor adjustments instead of substantial reforms. Consequently, a significant number of children—especially those born into poverty—face continued academic struggles and have little chance at achieving the American dream of a comfortable middle-class life. I believe that widespread academic failure among children is a reflection on the surrounding adults and the broader system. The schools in my South Bronx neighborhood were subpar in the 1960s, and many still are today. This is not surprising since little has fundamentally changed. Children will not improve academically on their own. As a country, we must say, 'Enough is enough.' Calls for reform are often considered radical, but following educational science can lead to meaningful innovation. If 'summer melt'—the loss of academic progress during summer—impacts students, especially those from poor communities with limited summer activities, we should consider extending the school year. If research shows the first three years of life are crucial for learning, we should support parental education and early childhood programs. Some may see suggesting better healthcare and additional services for children as radical, but I believe these are essential. For example, students with untreated medical or dental issues struggle in school, and children need safe, enriching environments after school. Programs in sports and the arts can provide valuable focus and discipline. When people question the need for such comprehensive support, my motivation is simple: I care about children, just as others care for their own kids. Ensuring children's success in school and life should be the baseline, not the ceiling, of our ambitions. Schools should better integrate effective assessment and evaluation practices. Although students take standardized tests in subjects like English and math, test results often arrive after the school year, making it difficult to use the data to support student growth. Teachers need timely information on student progress to tailor instruction accordingly. Innovation within education should not be limited out of fear of failure; some promising efforts may not succeed, but we should persist until we find effective solutions. This is similar to the technology sector, where early failures do not stop further progress. Funding research, development, and implementation is necessary, and the cost is modest compared to other national expenditures. For example, compare education spending to military expenses, such as those in Afghanistan. Addressing failures in our education system is just as important for national security. While the most visible problems are in poor communities, educational deficiencies exist everywhere, and we are not adequately preparing children for global competition in high-skill jobs. The United States remains a powerful nation, and when we prioritize an issue, we invest in it. Americans must recognize the scale of the crisis in education and support dramatic school reform. These views are solely those of Geoffrey Canada.

article_content:
Google is rolling out a new Smart Search feature in its Files app to help users efficiently index and find important documents on their devices. According to Android Police, Smart Search can automatically scan documents and images—like IDs, health cards, and travel papers—making files easier to locate. This process is automatic but can be turned off in the app’s settings.

The update adds an 'Important' section at the bottom of the Files app, where categorized scanned documents will be easily accessible. Google Files indexes content of saved documents for organization only and does not support manual searching for specific terms inside documents. 

As long as Smart Search is enabled, the app will periodically scan for new items and sort them. Google emphasizes that all scanned information remains strictly on the device and is never uploaded or shared. 

Smart Search was first reported by AssembleDebug on Telegram, who also noted some small navigation improvements in the settings menu. The feature is rolling out gradually through server-side updates and may not appear immediately for all users.

Additionally, the article mentions the Google Pixel 7 Pro, launched in 2022, which features the Tensor G2 chip, a smooth 120Hz display, and advanced cameras for high-quality performance.

article_content: Emotions are clearly running high in football these days, as several top players have visibly broken down during pivotal matches. Recently, Liverpool’s Luis Suarez was seen in tears after his team squandered a strong lead and ended up with a draw instead of a win. The images of Suarez crying sparked a wave of online reactions, with Stoke defender Robert Huth even half-joking on Twitter that players who cry on the field should be suspended. Suarez’s emotional moment—where Steven Gerrard had to comfort him—reflects a growing trend, with other stars like John Terry, Ashley Cole, and Nemanja Vidic also recently showing their feelings in public. Sometimes, such expressions of emotion are widely understood, such as the tears shed by Shay Given after the tragic death of his friend and Wales manager Gary Speed, or Bristol Rovers manager Darrell Clarke reacting to his club’s first-ever relegation in almost a century. But some observers question whether all of these tears are truly heartfelt. Critics argue that, in cases like Suarez’s, the emotion may stem more from personal setbacks than from a deep connection to the club or its fans—pointing to his previous attempts to move to another team. This ongoing debate highlights how attitudes within football are shifting, as people discuss whether such open displays of vulnerability are a sign of genuine passion or a departure from the sport’s traditional image of resilience.

article_content: Theo Carnie, a five-year-old from Outlane, Huddersfield, has a rare condition that prevents him from eating food in the usual way. Instead, he receives all his nutrition through a tube that feeds formula directly into his small bowel. Despite never tasting his own baking, Theo enjoys spending time in the kitchen making cakes for his family and friends. On his fifth birthday, Theo celebrated with two cakes: a real cake for his friends and family, and a replica model to commemorate his special day. Theo’s mother, Verity Carnie, 37, explained that their family still observes traditional cake rituals so Theo can participate in celebrations. He enjoys baking and is comfortable around others who are eating. Theo stopped eating normally at age three, after frequent vomiting triggered by food. In September 2009, he had surgery at Leeds General Infirmary to prevent this, which involved wrapping the top part of his stomach around the lower end of his esophagus. Theo’s parents, Verity and Nathan, 39, taught him how to use the tube and the feeding pump that’s carried in a backpack. Verity, a former children's nurse, says the formula is his lifeline, providing all his nutrition and medication. Theo carries his food and pump in a small backpack and manages it with ease. Interestingly, the family does not hide food from Theo. He enjoys cooking, with his favorite chef being Jamie Oliver. He is content being present while others eat and still regards food as a meaningful part of life. The family continues to eat out and brings activities for Theo so he can join them, and even during hospital stays, he enjoys cooking activities. Theo receives ongoing care at Great Ormond Street Children’s Hospital, where staff help make his visits as comfortable as possible. Nathan credits the hospital for its research and support, saying they have been through much but are grateful for the excellent care. Verity describes Theo as a remarkable boy who tackles life with energy, joy, and resilience, never letting his condition hold him back.

article_content: Across China, people are paying tribute to former Premier Li Keqiang, remembered for his practical approach and dedication to reforms. Li died from a heart attack in Shanghai at the age of 68 last Friday, following ten years as the country’s premier after a career rooted in economics. On Thursday, the national flag was lowered at Tiananmen Square for a day of mourning. A memorial service took place at a prominent Beijing cemetery, attended by President Xi Jinping, his wife, Vice President Han Zheng, and other senior Communist Party leaders. Together, they observed a moment of silence and bowed in respect, with former President Hu Jintao sending a wreath in Li’s honor. Widespread messages of condolence appeared on Chinese social media, with Weibo—China’s popular platform—replacing its standard ‘like’ button with a chrysanthemum, a flower symbolizing mourning. A hashtag set up for Li's passing garnered more than 430 million views and prompted tens of thousands of comments. Residents like Mr. Gao from Beijing praised Li for improving everyday lives and for his active presence during the COVID-19 pandemic.

article_content: Curious if wearable tech could make a real difference, I gave my friend Matt the Ultrahuman Ring Air to try. Like many, Matt wanted to become more active but found motivating himself a challenge. After six weeks with the smart ring, we reflected on his experience. Fitness wearables, like smart rings or trackers, are popular among those hoping that monitoring activity will encourage better habits. Unlike tech reviewers, most people simply want to understand their health and receive helpful nudges. Matt, who isn’t a fitness fanatic, hoped the ring would prompt him to move more. He admitted he was often too lazy for extra exercise, yet he wanted genuine insight into potential improvements. The Ultrahuman Ring Air app pushed notifications as he approached his daily movement targets. These nudges sometimes inspired a bit more activity, but alerts during the workday often felt bothersome. Matt struggled with the app’s data: while numbers on activity and sleep were displayed, their meanings and importance weren’t well explained. Advice like ‘turn off the lights’ before bed felt generic and not useful. He wanted a clear home screen with daily steps and goals plus straightforward explanations of metrics such as heart rate variability. Instead, he was left searching through menus, leading to frustration. Physical design was another hurdle. Matt switched fingers due to the ring’s sharp edges. Although he liked its stylish appearance and received compliments, he wouldn’t pay $350 for something lacking in comfort and user-friendliness. Even though other smart rings, like the Oura Ring, offer better-presented data, their subscription fees are a dealbreaker for him. Matt’s experience underlines a frequent issue: wearables record plenty of data, but if the interface is too complicated and the device uncomfortable, motivation wanes. Unless these products prioritize simplicity and comfort, they risk being abandoned—reminding us that no device can substitute for true personal motivation.
