article_content:
A host of new films and documentaries are making their debut or expanding in theaters this weekend across North America, offering a diverse selection for moviegoers.

Sony Pictures Classics presents ‘The Persian Version’, written and directed by Maryam Keshavarz. Opening on eight screens in New York, Los Angeles, Toronto, and Vancouver, the film explores the complexities of cultural identity as an Iranian-American woman—played by Layla Mohammadi—seeks balance between her heritage and her life in America. The film debuted at Sundance, winning both the Audience Award and the Waldo Salt Screenwriting Award.

International cinema is also represented by ‘The Delinquents’, an Argentine heist film from director Rodrigo Moreno, distributed by Mubi. After successful screenings at Cannes, TIFF, and the New York Film Festival, and chosen as Argentina's submission for the Best International Feature Film Oscar, the film is expanding to additional markets. The story follows a Buenos Aires bank employee plotting a theft to escape his mundane corporate life, with unexpected consequences.

For families, ‘The Canterville Ghost’, an animated adaptation based on Oscar Wilde’s story, opens on over 400 screens. Directed by Kim Burdon and co-directed by Robert Chandler, the film features the voices of Stephen Fry, Hugh Laurie, and others. It tells the comedic tale of a ghost attempting to oust a new American family from their English country home, only to find himself challenged in unexpected ways.

Netflix continues to expand its film slate with ‘Nyad’, starring Annette Bening as swimmer Diana Nyad, who at age 60 attempts the 110-mile swim from Cuba to Florida, supported by her best friend and coach, played by Jodie Foster. Directed by Elizabeth Chai Vasarhelyi and Jimmy Chin, ‘Nyad’ opens in about 80 theaters across 40 markets and streams November 3. Netflix is also releasing ‘Pain Hustlers’, starring Emily Blunt as a single mom drawn into a pharmaceutical racketeering scheme. Directed by David Yates and co-starring Chris Evans, the film streams starting October 27.

‘Full Circle’, a documentary by Josh Berman, opens in New York and soon expands to Los Angeles and other cities. It chronicles the journeys of athletes Trevor Kennison and Barry Corbet, who both suffered life-altering spinal injuries decades apart. The film examines their resilience and influential roles in the disability community.

Errol Morris’s ‘The Pigeon Tunnel’ is presented on a limited basis by Apple. The documentary features an in-depth conversation with famed novelist John le Carré (David Cornwell), reflecting on his life and literary impact against the backdrop of the Cold War. The film incorporates rare archival footage and premiered at Telluride.

Another striking documentary, ‘Another Body’, from Utopia, opens in several cities and expands soon. Premiered at SXSW, it follows a college student’s search for justice after discovering deepfake pornography of herself online, using animation and synthetic media to both tell the story and protect the subject’s identity.

Specialty and independent films are also expanding to more theaters. These include ‘Dicks: The Musical’ from A24, ‘Anatomy Of A Fall’ from Neon, the Steven Soderbergh-produced ‘Once Within A Time’ by Godfrey Reggio, and ‘Divinity’ by Eddie Alcazar, also produced by Soderbergh.

بین الاقوامی فلموں میں ارجنٹائنی ہائسٹ فلم 'دی ڈی لنکوئنٹس' بھی شامل ہے جس کی ہدایت روڈریگو مورینو نے دی ہے اور یہ مو بی کے ذریعے تقسیم کی جا رہی ہے۔ کانز، ٹی آئی ایف ایف اور نیویارک فلم فیسٹیول میں نمائش کے بعد اور ارجنٹینا کی طرف سے بہترین بین الاقوامی فیچر فلم کے لیے آسکر نامزدگی کے ساتھ، فلم مزید مارکیٹس میں پیش ہو رہی ہے۔ کہانی بیونس آئرس کے بینک ملازم کی ہے جو معمولاتِ زندگی سے بچنے کے لیے چوری کا منصوبہ بناتا ہے، جس کے نتائج غیر متوقع نکلتے ہیں۔

خاندانی تفریح کے شوقین افراد کے لیے، 'دی کینٹرول گوسٹ' ہے — آسکر وائلڈ کی کہانی پر مبنی اینیمیٹڈ فلم جو 400 سے زائد سینما گھروں میں ریلیز ہو رہی ہے۔ اس کے ہدایتکار کم بورڈن اور شریک ہدایتکار رابرٹ چاندلر ہیں اور اسٹیفن فرائی، ہیو لاری اور دیگر نے آواز دی ہے۔ کہانی میں بھوت ایک امریکی خاندان کو اپنی انگریزی حویلی سے نکالنے کی کوشش کرتا ہے، لیکن اسے اندازہ نہیں تھا کہ چیلنجز پیش آئیں گے۔

نیٹ فلکس نے اپنی فلمی سلسلے کو وسعت دی ہے۔ 'نیاد' میں اینیٹ بیننگ نے تیراک ڈایانا نیاد کا کردار نبھایا ہے، جو 60 برس کی عمر میں کیوبا سے فلوریڈا تک 110 میل تیرنے کی کوشش کرتی ہیں۔ ان کی دوست و کوچ کا کردار جوڈی فوسٹر نے ادا کیا ہے۔ ہدایتکار الزبتھ چائے واسرہیلی اور جمی چن ہیں۔ 'نیاد' تقریباً 80 سینما گھروں میں 40 مارکیٹس میں ریلیز ہو رہی ہے اور 3 نومبر سے اسٹریمنگ ہوگی۔ نیٹ فلکس کی 'پین ہسلرز' میں ایملی بلنٹ نے ایک سنگل ماں کا کردار ادا کیا ہے جو غیرقانونی دوا سازی کی اسکیم میں پھنس جاتی ہے، اور اس میں کرس ایونز بھی شریک ہیں۔ ڈیوڈ یٹس کی ہدایت کاری میں بننے والی یہ فلم 27 اکتوبر سے اسٹریمنگ پر آئے گی۔

'فل سرکل' جوش برمین کی ڈاکیومنٹری ہے جو نیویارک میں ریلیز ہو گی اور جلد ہی مزید شہروں میں بھی پیش کی جائے گی۔ اس میں ایتھلیٹس ٹریور کینی سن اور بیری کوربیٹ کی زندگیوں کی کہانی ہے جنہوں نے مختلف دہائیوں میں شدید ریڑھ کی ہڈی کی چوٹیں برداشت کیں۔ فلم ان کے حوصلے اور معذور لوگوں کی کمیونٹی میں کردار کو اجاگر کرتی ہے۔

ایرول مورس کی 'دی پجن ٹنل' کو ایپل نے محدود پیمانے پر جاری کیا ہے۔ اس دستاویزی فلم میں معروف ناول نگار جان لے کیرے (ڈیوڈ کورنیل) کی زندگی اور سرد جنگ کے پس منظر میں ان کے ادبی سفر پر گفتگو کی گئی ہے، جس میں نایاب فلمی مناظر بھی شامل ہیں۔ فلم کا پریمیئر ٹیلورائیڈ میں ہوا تھا۔

ایک اور نمایاں ڈاکیومنٹری 'اینادر باڈی' یوٹوپیا کے بینر تلے مختلف شہروں میں ریلیز کی گئی ہے۔ SXSW میں نمائش کی گئی اس فلم میں کالج کی ایک طالبہ کی جدوجہد کو دکھایا گیا ہے جو اپنے خلاف 'ڈیپ فیک' فحش مواد دیکھ کر انصاف کی تلاش کرتی ہے۔ اس میں اینیمیشن اور جدید میڈیا کا استعمال کر کے متاثرہ کی شناخت محفوظ رکھی گئی ہے۔

article_content: Several al-Qaeda militants tunneled out of a prison in Aden, Yemen early Monday, in what is the country’s second major jailbreak in six months and the fourth over the last eight years. A prison officer said as many as 15 inmates, including convicted killers of security officials and those involved in a bank heist, escaped. Conflicting reports exist regarding the exact number of escapees. Both officials shared information anonymously due to lack of authorization to speak to media. Months of political turmoil have undermined Yemen’s stability. The movement against President Ali Abdullah Saleh—fueled by the Arab Spring—led to tough crackdowns, causing mass military defections and confrontations with powerful tribes. Nearly a year of protests and intermittent fighting have enabled Islamist groups to expand their influence, especially in southern areas, raising concerns for Saudi Arabia and the U.S. about al-Qaeda gaining control near essential oil shipping routes. There have been other notable al-Qaeda-linked prison breaks in Yemen. In 2003, 11 men convicted in the USS Cole bombing got out of the Aden prison. In 2006, 23 al-Qaeda inmates, including Nasser al-Wahishi (who later headed the Yemen branch), escaped from Sanaa. Earlier this year, almost 60 suspected al-Qaeda fighters tunneled out of Mukalla prison. Investigations showed some prison officers assisted the escapes, and a number were subsequently imprisoned.

article_content:
Trash The Dress, a unique trend in bridal photography, has arrived in Britain. In this daring practice, brides deliberately ruin their wedding dresses soon after the ceremony, symbolizing lasting commitment and offering a new creative outlet for photographers. Originally from Las Vegas, the concept—also called 'fearless bridal' or 'rock the frock'—is being championed in the UK by photographer Arran Tomlinson.

The purpose of these shoots is to give brides extraordinary, unconventional photographs that contrast the elegance of their gowns with surprising settings such as forests, beaches, rooftops, scrapyards, fields, and abandoned buildings. Brides may choose to fully destroy their dresses or simply get them dirty, with the choice to clean or discard them afterward.

Rachael Snape, 27, from Blackburn, Lancashire, joined the trend at Roddlesworth Reservoir in Tockholes, just three weeks after marrying council worker Paul. According to Tomlinson: 'Brides do it as they’ve had the wedding and they just want to do something different. They want something else to remember.'

The trend is quickly gaining fans worldwide, as more women create artistic and deeply personal photos by documenting the destruction of their wedding gowns. The resulting images often have a high-fashion, magazine-style aesthetic. Interest is growing, with some brides seeking even more dramatic elements, like paint being thrown during their shoots.

Popular venues for these sessions include beaches, rooftops, abandoned buildings, and fields, enhancing the dramatic artistic effect. Earlier examples were photographed by John Michael Cooper, while sessions like Rachael's showcase the trend’s increasing popularity in Britain.

ٹریش دا ڈریس، دلہنوں کی فوٹوگرافی کا ایک منفرد رجحان، اب برطانیہ پہنچ چکا ہے۔ اس جراتمند رسم میں دلہنیں شادی کے فوراً بعد اپنے شادی کے لباس کو جان بوجھ کر خراب کرتی ہیں، جو مستقل وابستگی کی علامت ہے اور فوٹوگرافروں کے لئے تخلیقی مواقع فراہم کرتی ہے۔ یہ آئیڈیا سب سے پہلے لاس ویگاس سے آیا اور اب برطانیہ میں فوٹوگرافر ارن ٹاملنسن اسے فروغ دے رہے ہیں۔

اس شوٹ کا مقصد دلہنوں کو غیر معمولی اور منفرد تصاویر دینا ہے جو خوبصورت لباس اور حیرت انگیز جگہوں جیسے جنگلات، ساحل، چھتیں، سکریپ یارڈ، کھیت اور ویران عمارتیں کے امتزاج سے تیار ہوتی ہیں۔ کچھ دلہنیں اپنے لباس کو مکمل طور پر تباہ کرتی ہیں جبکہ بعض صرف گندا کرتی ہیں اور بعد میں صفائی یا تلف کرنے کا انتخاب کرتی ہیں۔

یہ رجحان دنیا بھر میں تیزی سے مقبول ہو رہا ہے، زیادہ خواتین آرٹسٹک اور ذاتی انداز میں اپنے شادی کے لباس کو تباہ کرنے کی تصاویر بنوا رہی ہیں۔ یہ تصاویر اکثر فیشن میگزین جیسا انداز پیش کرتی ہیں۔ کچھ دلہنیں شوٹ کے دوران اور منفرد تجربات جیسے پینٹ پھینکوانا بھی چاہتی ہیں۔

ایسے سیشنز ساحل، چھتیں، ویران عمارتیں اور کھیتوں میں بھی کیے جاتے ہیں جو تصاویر کو زیادہ ڈرامائی اور آرٹسٹک بناتے ہیں۔ اس رجحان کی ابتدائی مثالیں جان مائیکل کوپر نے پیش کی تھیں، جبکہ ریچل جیسے سیشنز اس کی برطانیہ میں بڑھتی مقبولیت کو ظاہر کرتے ہیں۔

article_content: Ricky Tiedemann, a 21-year-old left-handed pitcher in the Toronto Blue Jays organization, is widely considered one of the top pitching prospects in development. He is currently showcasing his talent in the Arizona Fall League, competing against elite hitters from all Major League Baseball organizations. During the 2023 season, Tiedemann pitched at four different levels within the Blue Jays' minor league system: the Florida Complex League (Rookie), Class-A, Double-A, and Triple-A. Across 44 innings in 15 starts, he posted a 3.68 ERA and a 1.22 WHIP. Notably, he struck out 16.8 batters per nine innings, a testament to his ability to generate swings and misses, although he also averaged 4.7 walks per nine innings. Tiedemann was not selected in the five-round 2020 MLB Draft out of high school, as teams considered his signing bonus expectations high. He later attended Golden West College in Huntington Beach, California, and the Blue Jays selected him in the third round of the 2021 draft. He signed for a $644,000 bonus, which is regarded as good value in an era of rising pitching salaries. After initially committing to pitch for San Diego State University out of Lakewood High School, Tiedemann adjusted his plans and attended Long Beach City College to maintain his eligibility for the MLB draft. When Long Beach canceled their baseball season due to the COVID-19 pandemic, he transferred to Golden West College. In 2022, Tiedemann impressed with a combined 2.17 ERA while pitching in Class-A, Class-A Advanced, and Double-A, solidifying his status as the Blue Jays’ top prospect. His rapid ascension to Triple-A highlights his fast track to the majors, a distinction shared by few Arizona Fall League participants. Tiedemann's older brother, Tai, was a 2016 Texas Rangers draft pick and played in the Atlantic League in 2023, an MLB partner league. Standing 6-foot-4 and weighing 220 pounds, Tiedemann is an athletic pitcher with the stamina to handle extended outings. He features a well-developed three-pitch mix: a fastball consistently at 93-96 mph, a changeup in the mid-80s that effectively disrupts hitters’ timing, and an above-average slider, although the slider might benefit from further refinement. His changeup is particularly challenging for right-handed hitters due to his arm action and ability to disguise the pitch. A recent scouting observation describes Tiedemann as a 'strong-bodied lefty with exceptional repertoire. Above-average fastball, changeup, and slider. The balance-altering changeup is his out pitch. Very tough on right-handed hitters due to arm angle and well-hidden release. Could be an All-Star at full development.' Tiedemann demonstrates confidence in his pitches and displays a mound presence mature beyond his years. He is adept at facing batters multiple times through the lineup. The main area for improvement is his tendency for long at-bats, as hitters often prolong plate appearances with foul balls, which can elevate his pitch count. In the current Arizona Fall League, Tiedemann holds a 2-1 record with an impressive 2.50 ERA, 1.11 WHIP, and 23 strikeouts in 18 innings over four starts. He has been selected for the Fall Stars Game, scheduled for November 5 at Sloan Park in Mesa. Overall, Tiedemann has received a scouting grade of 60, indicating All-Star potential with a high-quality pitch arsenal and a strong ability to miss bats.

article_content: The Cincinnati Bengals (5-4) are preparing for an important Thursday Night Football matchup against the AFC North-leading Baltimore Ravens (7-3) on November 16. They top the NFL in defense-adjusted value over average (DVOA), and their running game remains dominant despite injuries to running backs. The Ravens are rushing for a league-best 155 yards per game on 32.4 attempts. Lamar Jackson leads all NFL quarterbacks with 481 rushing yards. On the other side, Joe Mixon (Bengals, 536 yards) and Gus Edwards (Ravens, 502 yards) are the leading rushers for their teams. In the Week 2 matchup, Baltimore outrushed Cincinnati 178-66. Lamar Jackson threw for 237 yards and two touchdowns, while Joe Burrow, fighting through injury, managed 222 yards, two touchdowns, and an interception. The stats favor Baltimore’s running game again: The Ravens lead the league with 155 rushing yards per game; the Bengals are last with 75 yards, averaging only 20.7 rushes each contest (31st in the league). Cincinnati’s defense is allowing 136 rushing yards per game (fifth most) and 5.0 yards per rush (third worst). They’ll also be without a top run defender, Sam Hubbard (ankle), while receiver Tee Higgins (hamstring) misses a second game. Both Burrow and Jackson threw two interceptions last week, both losing in dramatic final plays. Cincinnati’s pass defense leads the AFC with 12 interceptions. The Ravens’ pass defense also excels, racking up 10 interceptions and a league-leading 39 sacks, primed to put pressure on Burrow. If Jackson limits mistakes, the Ravens are in a strong spot to win. Bettors are eyeing quarterback props like Joe Burrow throwing an interception (-114), among others available for this game. This season, 26 out of 33 NFL night games have gone under the projected point total, a noteworthy trend. With high expectations for this contest, all eyes are on this pivotal AFC North matchup as Week 11 arrives, with anticipation building for the Eagles-Chiefs game and the season’s playoff race.

article_content: A comprehensive investigation is underway into the deaths of more than 50 mothers and babies linked to Furness General Hospital in Cumbria, prompted by ongoing concerns about maternity care. The inquiry was initiated after James and Hoa Titcombe sought answers following the 2008 death of their newborn, Joshua, at the hospital due to an infection. Officials are reviewing over 200 deaths from between 2004 and 2013, narrowing in on about 50 cases for deeper examination. Health Secretary Jeremy Hunt ordered the inquiry, in part due to the Titcombes’ campaign for accountability. James Titcombe, formerly a nuclear engineer and now a national safety adviser for the Care Quality Commission (CQC), has voiced both concern about the number of troubling cases and satisfaction at the investigation's thorough and methodical approach. The inquiry is also focusing on whether the CQC—responsible for hospital oversight—ignored or covered up vital warnings about unsafe maternity care at University Hospitals of Morecambe Bay Foundation Trust. Dr. Bill Kirkup, who has led several high-profile inquiries, is heading the investigation and has already gathered testimony from senior NHS officials. The inquiry’s hearings are private, but their findings are expected to be made public by November. Simultaneously, the Morecambe Bay Trust is facing over 30 negligence lawsuits from the families of victims alleging substandard care. Internal reviews since 2010 have pointed to poor training among midwives and strained staff relationships, concerns that were missed by a CQC inspection that had deemed the hospital safe. Later ombudsman reports highlighted repeated failures in care, establishing that neglect and inaction contributed to preventable deaths—including those of Joshua Titcombe, Nittaya Hendrickson and her son Chester, and Alex Brady. In Joshua's case, his chances of survival would have been high if he had received antibiotics, but critical symptoms were overlooked. From 2007 to 2011, the Trust experienced 600 excess deaths—one of the highest excess mortality rates in the UK. The collection of bereaved families’ stories, coupled with official findings, continues to fuel demands for meaningful change at the hospital.

article_content:
Many sleep experts are wary of using the snooze button in the morning. The common advice is to avoid setting multiple alarms earlier than necessary, as it may interrupt deep, restorative sleep. If you find yourself snoozing past your intended wake-up time, it may be a sign that you’re not getting enough rest at night, according to Philip Cheng, a sleep expert at Henry Ford Health.

However, Stephen Mattingly—a frequent snoozer who completed his Ph.D. in cognition and worked as a postdoctoral researcher at the University of Notre Dame—investigated whether scientific data supports these warnings. He discovered that there’s limited direct research on the health effects of snoozing. Previous studies showed that fragmented sleep is worse than short but continuous sleep, and that napping might reverse some harmful effects of sleep deprivation and potentially improve heart health. Still, neither regular sleep nor naps are exactly the same as snoozing after waking.

Mattingly found little research on the specific effects of snoozing, aside from links to increased lucid dreaming. Interested in its day-to-day impacts, he conducted a study using surveys and wearable devices. Results published in the journal Sleep in 2022 indicated that snoozers did not sleep less overall, nor did they feel more fatigued during the day compared to those who woke up after just one alarm. Snoozers did tend to have lighter sleep, especially in the hour before waking, and higher resting heart rates—suggesting their stress response system may activate before they’re fully awake.

While this may sound negative, Mattingly explains that the stress response could help “shake off” sleep inertia, the grogginess many feel upon waking, and may improve alertness and cognitive function. Co-author Aaron Striegel, a computer science professor at Notre Dame, believes snoozing has been unfairly criticized, noting, "Our main takeaway was that it’s probably not as bad as we've been told."

A 2023 study in the Journal of Sleep Research supports this finding. Shortly after waking, participants who snoozed for 30 minutes performed better on arithmetic and memory tasks than those who got up after a single alarm—possibly due to less sleep inertia. There were no major differences in cognition, mood, or sleepiness between snoozers and non-snoozers as the day went on. However, this study was small, with only 30 participants—many of whom were habitual snoozers, potentially impacting results. The authors caution against overinterpreting the findings.

Without extensive evidence, Cheng says it’s hard to say if snoozing really helps with sleep inertia. He believes, “It’s more functional to get out of bed and start moving” than to remain dozing. A 2022 study supports this: snoozers and non-snoozers had similar sleep quality, but frequent use of the snooze button might prolong grogginess.

Kathryn Roecklein, a psychology professor who studies sleep at the University of Pittsburgh, agrees that snoozing may not be the most effective way to shake morning sleepiness. She recommends turning on lights as soon as your alarm rings, as morning light helps regulate the circadian rhythm. There are alarm clocks with light features that gradually brighten the room. While there’s limited research on these products, their approach aligns with what’s known about circadian biology.

Roecklein adds that snoozing may be particularly problematic for people who already have trouble falling asleep at night. For these individuals, keeping consistent bed and wake times can help sync their sleep-wake cycle. Prolonged snoozing might disrupt this process.

For those who sleep well at night, feel rested during the day, and still enjoy snoozing, Cheng suggests there’s little cause for concern. “It could just be behavioral... It might simply be part of daily life,” possibly because of early schedules that clash with their natural biological clocks. Hitting the snooze button may help some people adapt.

Despite the stereotype that snoozers are lazy or harming their health, Mattingly is not convinced. He says he stopped snoozing for reasons unrelated to rest: he became a parent.

کئی نیند کے ماہرین صبح کے وقت اسنوز بٹن کے استعمال پر تحفظات رکھتے ہیں۔ عمومی مشورہ یہ ہے کہ غیر ضروری طور پر ایک سے زیادہ الارم نہ لگائیں، کیونکہ اس سے آپ کی گہری، بحالی بخش نیند میں خلل پڑ سکتا ہے۔ اگر آپ اپنے اصل جاگنے کے وقت کے بعد بھی اسنوز کرتے ہیں تو یہ اس بات کی علامت ہو سکتا ہے کہ رات کو آپ کو پوری نیند نہیں ملی، جیسا کہ ہینری فورڈ ہیلتھ کے فلپ چینگ کہتے ہیں۔

اسٹیفن میٹنگلی، جو خود بھی اسنوزنگ کے عادی ہیں اور یونیورسٹی آف نوٹر ڈیم میں پی ایچ ڈی اور بعد میں پوسٹ ڈاکٹریٹ ریسرچ کر چکے ہیں، نے تحقیق کی کہ آیا اسنوز بٹن کے بارے میں جو وارننگز دی جاتی ہیں، ان کی سائنسی بنیاد ہے یا نہیں۔ وہ اس نتیجے پر پہنچے کہ اس پیٹرن کے صحت پر اثرات کے متعلق براہِ راست تحقیق بہت کم ہے۔ پچھلے مطالعوں سے معلوم ہوا کہ بار بار ٹوٹ جانے والی نیند مختصر لیکن بغیر رکاوٹ کے مکمل نیند سے زیادہ نقصان دہ ہے، اور یہ کہ قیلولہ نیند کی کمی کے کچھ منفی اثرات کو کم اور دل کی صحت بہتر کر سکتا ہے۔ تاہم، رات کی نیند یا قیلولہ، صبح جاگنے پر اسنوزنگ کے برابر نہیں ہوتے۔

میٹنگلی کو اسنوزنگ پر زیادہ تر تحقیق صرف “lucid dreaming” کے ساتھ اس کے تعلق کی شکل میں ملی۔ روزمرہ اثرات جانچنے کے لیے، انہوں نے ایک مطالعہ کیا جس میں سروے اور پہننے والے آلات شامل تھے۔ جریدہ “Sleep” میں 2022 میں شائع ہونے والے نتائج کے مطابق، اسنوزرز نے مجموعی نیند کی مقدار میں کمی نہیں کی اور نہ ہی دن میں زیادہ تھکاوٹ محسوس کی۔ البتہ، اسنوزرز عام طور پر اٹھنے سے پہلے کے آخری گھنٹے میں ہلکی نیند اور زیادہ ریسٹنگ ہارٹ ریٹ کا سامنا کرتے ہیں—جس سے ظاہر ہوتا ہے کہ جسم کا اسٹریس سسٹم جاگنے سے پہلے ہی فعال ہو جاتا ہے۔

یہ منفی بھی محسوس ہو سکتا ہے، لیکن میٹنگلی کے مطابق اسٹریس ریسپانس “sleep inertia” یعنی جاگنے کے بعد کی سستی کو دور کرنے اور الرٹنس و ذہنی کارکردگی بڑھانے کے لیے فائدہ مند ہو سکتا ہے۔ شریک مصنف آیرون اسٹرائیگل، کمپیوٹر سائنس پروفیسر، کا پورا تاثر یہی ہے کہ اسنوزنگ کو شاید غیر ضروری طور پر برا مانا گیا ہے: “ہمارا سب سے اہم نکتہ یہی تھا کہ اسے شاید اتنا برا نہیں سمجھنا چاہیے جتنا عموماً کہا جاتا ہے۔”

2023 میں جرنل آف سلیپ ریسرچ میں ایک مطالعہ آیا جس نے بھی اس نقطہ نظر کی تائید کی۔ 30 منٹ اسنوز کرنے والے افراد نے جاگنے کے فوراً بعد حساب اور یادداشت کے ٹیسٹ الگ کیے جو شاید کم sleep inertia کی وجہ سے تھا۔ دن بھر اسنوز کرنے اور نہ کرنے والے افراد کی cognition، mood، اور sleepiness میں کوئی واضح فرق نہیں تھا۔ البتہ، یہ اسٹڈی سائز میں چھوٹی تھی لہذا اسے احتیاط سے دیکھا جائے۔

وسیع شواہد نہ ہونے کے باعث، چینگ کا کہنا ہے کہ اسنوزنگ sleep inertia کم کرنے کیلئے فائدہ مند ہے یا نہیں یہ وثوق سے نہیں کہا جا سکتا۔ تاہم ان کا خیال ہے کہ “بستر سے نکل کر متحرک ہونا زیادہ بہتر ہے” بنسبت مزید سونے کے۔ 2022 کی ایک تحقیق سے بھی معلوم ہوا کہ اسنوزرز اور غیر اسنوزرز میں مجموعی نیند کے معیار میں خاص فرق نہیں، مگر بار بار snooze کرنے سے sleep inertia لمبی ہو سکتی ہے۔

یونیورسٹی آف پٹسبرگ کی پروفیسر کیتھرین روکلین، جو نیند پر تحقیق کرتی ہیں، بھی کہتی ہیں کہ اسنوزنگ بہترین طریقہ نہیں ہے۔ وہ مشورہ دیتی ہیں کہ الارم بجتے ہی روشنی جلائیں، کیونکہ صبح کی روشنی circadian rhythm کو ریگولیٹ کرنے میں مدد دیتی ہے، اسی لیے لائٹ والے الارم کلاک بھی دستیاب ہیں جو کمرے کو آہستہ آہستہ روشن کرتے ہیں۔ ان آلات پر بہت کم تحقیق ہوئی ہے، لیکن یہ طریقہ سائنسی اصولوں سے ہم آہنگ ہے۔

روکلین مزید کہتی ہیں کہ جو لوگ رات میں سونے میں دشواری محسوس کرتے ہیں، ان کے لیے اسنوزنگ زیادہ مسائل پیدا کر سکتی ہے۔ ایسے لوگوں کیلئے سونے اور جاگنے کا ایک متعین شیڈول بہتر ہے تاکہ circadian rhythm sync رہے، اسنوزنگ اس عمل کو بگاڑ سکتی ہے۔

جو لوگ رات بھر اچھی طرح سوتے ہیں، دن میں تازہ دم رہتے ہیں اور اسنوز کرنا پسند کرتے ہیں، ان کیلئے چینگ کہتے ہیں کہ انہیں فکر کی ضرورت نہیں، “یہ محض ایک عادت ہو سکتی ہے… شاید کچھ لوگوں کیلئے یہ معمولات زندگی کا حصہ ہے”، خاص طور پر جب شیڈول ان کے قدرتی biological clock سے مختلف ہو۔ اسنوز کے ذریعے کچھ لوگ اپنی روٹین سے مطابقت پیدا کرتے ہیں۔

سماجی طور پر یہ سمجھنا کہ اسنوزرز سست یا اپنی صحت کو نقصان پہنچا رہے ہیں، حقیقت پر مبنی نہیں، جیسا کہ میٹنگلی کا ماننا ہے۔ وہ کہتے ہیں کہ انہوں نے اسنوزنگ چھوڑنے کی وجہ نیند نہیں بلکہ بچوں کی وجہ سے کی۔

UEFA president Michel Platini has voiced his opposition to the use of goal-line technology in football, arguing it risks making the sport feel more like a video game. Despite FIFA reversing its position and planning to trial possible goal-line systems soon, Platini remains unconvinced about introducing tech to officiate matches. During a visit to Glasgow, Platini remarked to the Scottish FA website that using such technology would result in what he called 'PlayStation football.'

Platini, a renowned footballer in the 1980s, prefers to enhance support for referees through increased human assistance. He highlighted that this is already happening in the Champions League, where two additional match officials help out. Platini explained, "The referee needs backing from clubs, fans, players, media, and authorities. That's why we've brought in two extra assistants in Champions League games. One referee alone is not enough in today’s football, with around 20 cameras capturing every angle."

The UEFA president also pointed out that the widespread presence of media and camera technology in modern matches increases pressure on referees, who can only see so much with their own eyes. According to Platini, mistakes are immediately visible to viewers but hard to spot in real time for officials on the pitch. He added that for the last decade, he's called for changes to better support referees and help them perform their jobs more effectively.

Debate around goal-line technology has been intense for years, especially following a notable incident in the 2010 World Cup in South Africa. During that tournament, England’s Frank Lampard was denied a goal against Germany, even though the ball had clearly crossed the line.

1980 کی دہائی کے مشہور فٹبالر پلاٹینی چاہتے ہیں کہ ریفریوں کو مزید انسانی معاونت فراہم کی جائے۔ انہوں نے واضح کیا کہ چیمپئنز لیگ میں دو اضافی میچ آفیشلز پہلے ہی اس عمل میں مدد کر رہے ہیں۔ پلاٹینی نے کہا، "ریفری کو کلبوں، شائقین، کھلاڑیوں، میڈیا اور حکام کی مدد کی ضرورت ہے۔ اسی لیے ہم نے چیمپئنز لیگ میں دو اضافی اسسٹنٹس شامل کیے ہیں۔ ایک ریفری آج کے دور میں کافی نہیں، جہاں تقریباً 20 کیمرہ ہر زاویے سے میچ دکھا رہے ہیں۔"

پلاٹینی نے یہ بھی نشاندہی کی کہ جدید میچز میں میڈیا اور کیمرہ ٹیکنالوجی کی موجودگی سے ریفریوں پر دباؤ بڑھ گیا ہے، کیونکہ ان کی نظر سے بچنے والی غلطیاں فوراً ٹی وی پر نظر آ جاتی ہیں۔ پلاٹینی کے مطابق، ماضی کے دس سال سے وہ ریفریوں کو بہتر سپورٹ دینے اور ان کی کارکردگی کو مضبوط بنانے کے لیے تبدیلیوں کا مطالبہ کر رہے ہیں۔

گول لائن ٹیکنالوجی ہمیشہ سے فٹبال میں متنازع موضوع رہا ہے، خاص طور پر 2010 کے ورلڈ کپ جنوبی افریقہ کے دوران جب انگلینڈ کے فرینک لیمپارڈ کا جرمنی کے خلاف گول تسلیم نہیں کیا گیا، حالانکہ گیند لائن عبور کر چکی تھی۔

article_content: In Guiglo, Ivory Coast—where almost 40% of the world’s cocoa is produced—a buyer checks the cocoa beans. Demand for chocolate is set to increase prices over the next several years as global cocoa supplies come under mounting strain. Industry experts warn that with surging consumption, particularly in Asia and China, the demand for cocoa could become unsustainable by 2020. To meet the growing need, experts suggest cocoa farmers need more support so they can expand production; otherwise, chocolate companies may be forced to use less cocoa in their products and substitute with more nuts or fruits. This concern emerges as millions in the UK prepare to enjoy Easter chocolates. The rising appetite for chocolate worldwide could outpace what cocoa-growing communities can provide unless significant help is given. Most cocoa is farmed along the West African coast, and many of these farmers live on less than $2 per day. The International Cocoa Organisation predicted a shortfall of 150,000 tonnes in cocoa production for 2014, warning this may be the longest ongoing shortage in more than half a century. Cocoa prices have already shot up, with further increases likely if the supply issues persist. In Asia, demand is surging—the chocolate market is valued at more than $12 billion, and continues to grow. March saw cocoa prices reach a two-and-a-half year high, peaking at £1,896 per tonne in London and $3,031 per tonne in New York. Mondelez International, a leading food company, has pledged over $400 million over the next decade to support cocoa farming and improve conditions for growers in Ghana, Ivory Coast, Indonesia, India, and the Dominican Republic. Chris McGrath, head of Mondelez’s Cocoa Life program, has highlighted the problem of an aging workforce and the need for transformation in the industry. The International Cocoa Organisation is implementing plans to boost cocoa cultivation in Indonesia as well. As domestic production has failed to keep up with local processing needs, the Indonesian government is reportedly considering scrapping import taxes on cocoa beans.

article_content: The European Union is currently focused on addressing weak economic growth and high unemployment within the eurozone, which means it is not prioritizing Britain’s push to renegotiate its EU membership conditions. This position was shared by French Prime Minister Manuel Valls during his visit to London. UK Prime Minister David Cameron is seeking changes to EU rules, particularly around the right of free movement for EU citizens, as part of his efforts ahead of the UK's in/out referendum on EU membership scheduled by 2017. Cameron has vowed to negotiate assertively for these reforms in Brussels. After meetings with Cameron and Chancellor George Osborne, Valls stated that embarking on treaty changes would be a risky move at present, arguing that changing free movement rules would challenge the EU's basic foundations. While he expressed openness to discussing certain conditions affecting migrants, he indicated that large-scale changes are unlikely, especially given resistance from Eastern European countries. Valls's trip to the UK coincided with France facing pressure from the European Commission over its high levels of public borrowing. The Commission could ask France to revise its budget plans or impose penalties if fiscal targets are not met but may provide extra time if France makes compromises. French President François Hollande faces low approval ratings as France struggles with economic stagnation. He is under pressure to implement politically difficult reforms to boost the economy. Separately, Andy Street, managing director at John Lewis, recently drew criticism for harsh comments about France’s economy and conditions in Paris, for which he later apologized, explaining his words were exaggerated. In London, Valls acknowledged France’s economic difficulties and the need for growth-friendly reforms. He also asserted that Britain faces similar challenges, notably a high public deficit.

article_content: Evo Morales returned to Bolivia on Thursday, criticizing the United States after his presidential jet was delayed in Europe due to suspicions that Edward Snowden, the US intelligence leaker, was on board. According to Bolivian officials, France, Spain, Portugal, and Italy prohibited Morales' plane from passing through their airspace after rumors circulated about Snowden's presence. However, Spain's Foreign Minister Jose Manuel Garcia Margallo stated that Spain never closed its airspace. With their route blocked, Morales’ flight made an emergency landing in Vienna, Austria, where it remained for about 14 hours. Bolivia blamed the US for the diversion, with Morales telling supporters at El Alto International Airport near La Paz that the US and its allies could not intimidate Bolivia. He also urged European countries to break free from American influence. At a rally with Ecuadorian President Rafael Correa and Venezuelan President Nicolas Maduro, Morales suggested Bolivia should consider closing the US embassy, reiterating his stance after having expelled the US ambassador in 2008. Morales claimed that Bolivia was better off politically and democratically without US involvement and said he was being targeted for his indigenous background and anti-imperialist position. US officials declined to comment on Bolivia's allegations, directing inquiries to the relevant European countries. The incident led to a diplomatic dispute, with Latin American leaders from Argentina, Ecuador, Suriname, Uruguay, and Venezuela meeting Morales in Bolivia and condemning the actions of the European countries. They issued a statement demanding apologies from France, Portugal, Italy, and Spain, calling the incident a violation of international law and the inviolability of heads of state. The leaders supported Morales’ complaint to the UN High Commissioner for Human Rights, and called for a committee to investigate the incident. UN Secretary-General Ban Ki-moon called for dialogue and mutual respect in resolving the issue. Ecuador’s President Correa criticized the US for double standards, while Argentina’s President Cristina Fernandez de Kirchner emphasized the need for an apology. Venezuela’s President Maduro attributed the incident to CIA pressure. Edward Snowden, currently in Moscow’s Sheremetyevo International Airport, has sought asylum in over 20 countries, including Bolivia, but remains stateless. Both France and Italy rejected his requests for asylum; Icelandic lawmakers were considering citizenship for him after receiving a request. Russia condemned the European countries’ actions, stressing the importance of international law and immunity for heads of state. France stated it never intended to deny Morales’ plane access, with Foreign Minister Laurent Fabius expressing regrets over delays. Italy also declined Snowden’s asylum request, citing legal reasons. Iceland stated it could not review Snowden’s asylum request unless he was present in its territory.

article_content: Beverly Likens, a resident of Martin, Kentucky, unexpectedly lost her Medicaid coverage just before a crucial surgery—even though she was still eligible. Administrative complications led to her coverage ending, and it took a lawyer stepping in to resolve the situation. Her ordeal began when she was admitted to the hospital for severe anemia and urgently required surgery for ongoing uterine bleeding. To her shock, she discovered her Medicaid was no longer active, putting her operation in jeopardy. Likens, who is disabled and had followed all eligibility procedures, suddenly found herself without necessary insurance. This issue is part of a wider national trend: following the end of a pandemic policy that ensured continuous Medicaid coverage, millions have lost benefits, often due to administrative lapses rather than actual changes in eligibility. Despite assurances from officials, large-scale procedural errors were anticipated. Cara Stewart, an attorney advocating for Likens, attributes the coverage lapse to technical issues with Kentucky’s Medicaid system and failures in how the state processed renewals. Attempts to reapply on Likens’ behalf were thwarted by system glitches. Stewart emphasized that federal rules require the state to exhaust all eligibility options before ending someone’s coverage—which didn’t happen in Likens’ case. Likens initially qualified for Medicaid because she received Supplemental Security Income (SSI), a federal aid program for those with limited financial resources. When her SSI was cut off due to assets slightly exceeding federal limits, Kentucky sent her a notice ending her Medicaid, instructing her to start a new application, rather than reassessing her eligibility under other pathways. Kentucky officials defended their approach, saying they lacked enough information to determine if Likens qualified for Medicaid after her SSI ended. However, experts and federal guidance maintain that states are obligated to proactively assess alternative eligibility criteria before terminating coverage. Advocates point out that administrative problems have led to many eligible individuals—especially elderly and disabled residents—unnecessarily losing their health insurance. Likens reported never receiving renewal forms she would have needed to maintain her coverage. After repeated calls and legal intervention, Likens’ Medicaid was reinstated just in time for her surgery, as her low income made her eligible under the expanded Medicaid rules. She now expresses concern for others who might not manage to navigate such complexities, stressing that reliable health care access is a right for everyone in Kentucky.

انہیں شدید مایوسی ہوئی جب پتہ چلا کہ ان کی میڈیکیڈ فعال نہیں رہی، جس سے فوری علاج خطرے میں پڑ گیا۔ معذوری اور تمام ضروری کاغذات مکمل کرنے کے باوجود، لائکنز اچانک بغیر کوریج کے رہ گئیں۔ یہ قصہ ملک گیر دار کینٹکی کے میڈیکیڈ سسٹم کی تکنیکی خرابیوں اور عملدرآمد کی ناکامیوں کو قرار دیتی ہیں۔ ان کے مطابق، لائکنز کے لیے دوبارہ درخواست دینے کی کوششیں نظام کی خامیوں کے سبب ناکام ہوئیں۔ اسٹیورٹ کا کہنا ہے کہ وفاقی اصولوں کے مطابق ریاست کو کسی کی انشورنس ختم کرنے سے قبل ہر ممکن آپشن پر نظر ڈالنی چاہیے تھی — جو اس کیس میں نہیں ہوا۔ شروع میں لائکنز کو میڈیکیڈ اس بنیاد پر ملی تھی کہ وہ سپلیمنٹل سکیورٹی انکم (SSI) حاصل کرتی تھیں — یہ ایک وفاقی پروگرام ہے جو کم آمدنی والے معذور افراد کے لیے ہے۔ جب ان کی SSI زائد اثاثوں کی وجہ سے ختم ہوئی تو ریاست نے انہیں نوٹس دے کر کوریج بند کر دی اور دوبارہ درخواست دینے کو کہا، بجائے اس کے کہ وہ دیگر اہلیت کے رستے چیک کرتیں۔ ریاستی حکام نے اپنے فیصلے کا دفاع کیا، کہتے ہیں کہ ان کے پاس لائکنز کے لئے دیگر اہلیت کے تعین کے لئے کافی معلومات نہیں تھیں۔ لیکن ماہرین اور وفاقی ہدایات کے مطابق، ریاستوں پر لازم ہے کہ وہ ہر شخص کے امکانات کو اچھی طرح چیک کریں اس سے پہلے کہ کوریج ختم کریں۔ سماجی نمائندوں کے مطابق، بہت سے ایسے افراد—خاص طور پر بزرگ اور معذور—انتظامی غلطیوں کے باعث اپنی ہیلتھ کوریج سے محروم ہو رہے ہیں۔ لائکنز نے بتایا کہ انہیں کبھی بھی ری نیوئل فارم موصول نہیں ہوا۔ آخرکار، مسلسل کوششوں اور وکیل کی مداخلت سے لائکنز کی انشورنس بحال ہو گئی اور ان کی سرجری ممکن ہو سکی، کیونکہ ان کی کم آمدنی انہیں expanded Medicaid میں اہل بناتی ہے۔ اب وہ فکر مند ہيں کہ بہت سے دیگر افراد شاید اس پیچیدہ عمل سے نہ گزر سکیں اور کہتی ہیں کہ ہر شہری کو صحت کی سہولیات تک article_content: LILONGWE, Malawi (CNN) – Like many African countries, Malawi has faced a serious shortage of nurses and essential health workers. Godfrey Mdzudzuma, a nurse at Embangweni Mission Hospital, assists in childbirth in the maternity ward. In the past, many workers in this small southeast African nation of about 13 million people have been enticed by higher salaries and better working conditions abroad. However, the country, also known as the birthplace of Madonna's adopted children, now has another distinction: it has managed to slow its severe brain drain of nurses, at least temporarily. Malawi's approach involved expanding educational opportunities for nurses at all levels and offering slightly higher pay to help keep them out of poverty. While Malawi is among the poorest countries in the world, its healthcare system was effective in the 1970s and early 1980s. After gaining independence from Britain in 1964, President Hastings Banda, who was also a physician, ensured high standards in nursing education, with all classes taught in English. By the late 1990s, the AIDS epidemic hit Malawi hard. Compounding this, the government had to cut spending on healthcare and education to qualify for international aid aimed at economic liberalization. The public health system, relied on by over 95 percent of the population, began to deteriorate rapidly. Registered nurses started leaving the country in large numbers. "Every day, I received reports from the Nurses' Council that so many nurses were now at the airport," Ann Phoya, former head of nursing services in Malawi, told CNN. "It was clear we had to take drastic action." Phoya and others at the Ministry of Health (MOH) developed an emergency plan focusing on nurses, who provided most primary care. The MOH applied for approximately $160 million (£100 million) in international support for a six-year plan, mainly from the UK's Department for International Development. This funding was used to offer higher salaries to nurses—an unusual move in global development, as donors often worry such measures are unsustainable. But urgent conditions in Malawi made it necessary. The effort succeeded: the number of registered nurses emigrating dropped from a peak of 111 in 2001 (about equal to two years' worth of nursing graduates) to just six in the first half of 2008. Enrollment at Malawi's nursing schools rose by 50 percent. This success created a new issue: internal brain drain. As more international aid organizations and universities established health programs in Malawi, they hired nurses away from public hospitals and clinics. This problem is particularly severe in rural areas where most Malawians live. Embangweni Mission Hospital in northern Malawi, despite its remote location, has a strong reputation. "Young nurses with families often do not want to work here," said Catherine Mzembe, head of nursing at Embangweni. "The local market is very small. While the hospital has running water, many homes do not." Still, the hospital has made significant progress over the past five years, saving mothers' lives during pregnancy and reducing malaria deaths among children and adults. The key takeaway from Malawi's story: remarkable results can be achieved, even with limited resources.
translated_content: لیلونگوی، ملاوی (سی این این) – دیگر افریقی ممالک کی طرح، ملاوی کو بھی نرسز اور بنیادی صحت کے کارکنان کی شدید کمی کا سامنا رہا ہے۔ ایمبنگوینی مشن ہسپتال کے نرس، گاڈفری مدزوزوما، زچگی وارڈ میں بچے کی پیدائش میں مدد فراہم کرتے ہیں۔ ماضی میں، اس جنوب مشرقی افریقی ملک کے تقریباً 13 ملین باشندے بہتر تنخواہوں اور کام کے حالات کی وجہ سے دیگر ممالک کا رخ کرتے تھے۔ تاہم، اب یہ ملک جو کہ میڈونا کے گود لیے ہوئے بچوں کی سرزمین کے طور پر بھی جانا جاتا ہے، ایک اور وجہ سے مشہور ہو گیا ہے: اس نے وقتی طور پر نرسز کی شدید برین ڈرین کو روکنے میں کامیابی حاصل کی ہے۔ ملاوی کی حکمت عملی میں ہر سطح پر نرسز کے لیے تعلیمی مواقع کو بڑھانا اور انہیں غربت سے بچانے کے لیے کچھ اضافہ شدہ معاوضہ فراہم کرنا شامل تھا۔ دنیا کے غریب ترین ممالک میں شمار ہونے کے باوجود، 1970 اور 1980 کی دہائی میں یہاں کا شعبہ صحت مؤثر طریقے سے چل رہا تھا۔ 1964 میں برطانیہ سے آزادی حاصل کرنے کے بعد، صدر ہیسٹنگز بانڈا، جو خود بھی ایک معالج تھے، نے نرسنگ تعلیم کے اعلیٰ معیار کو یقینی بنایا اور تمام کلاسیں انگریزی میں پڑھائی جاتی تھیں۔ تاہم 1990 کی دہائی کے آخر تک ایڈز کی وبا نے ملاوی کو سخت متاثر کیا۔ مزید یہ کہ حکومت کو صحت اور تعلیم کے بجٹ میں کمی کرنی پڑی تاکہ معیشت کو آزاد بنانے کے لیے عالمی امداد حاصل کی جا سکے۔ اس کے نتیجے میں، سرکاری صحت کا وہ نظام جس پر 95 فیصد سے زیادہ آبادی انحصار کرتی ہے، تیزی سے کمزور ہونے لگا۔ رجسٹرڈ نرسز بڑی تعداد میں ملک چھوڑنے لگیں۔ "ہر روز، مجھے نرسز کونسل سے رپورٹیں ملتی تھیں کہ کتنی نرسز اب ہوائی اڈے پر ہیں،" این فویہ، ملاوی کی سابق سربراہ برائے نرسنگ سروسز نے سی این این کو بتایا۔ "یہ واضح تھا کہ ہمیں کچھ ہنگامی قدم اٹھانا ہوں گے۔" فویہ اور وزارت صحت کی ٹیم نے نرسز پر مرکوز ایک ہنگامی منصوبہ تیار کیا، کیونکہ وہ زیادہ تر بنیادی طبی دیکھ بھال فراہم کرتی ہیں۔ وزارت صحت نے تقریباً 160 ملین ڈالر (100 ملین پاؤنڈ) کی بین الاقوامی مالی معاونت کے لیے درخواست دی، جو زیادہ تر برطانیہ کے ڈیپارٹمنٹ فار انٹرنیشنل ڈویلپمنٹ (ڈی ایف آئی ڈی) سے حاصل کی گئی۔ اس امداد کا مقصد نرسز کی تنخواہوں میں اضافہ کرنا تھا—جو ترقی پذیر ممالک میں غیر معمولی بات ہے کیونکہ عطیہ دہندگان اسے طویل مدتی کے لیے غیر پائیدار سمجھتے ہیں۔ لیکن ملاوی کی ہنگامی صورتحال میں یہ ضروری تھا۔ یہ کوشش کامیاب ہوئی: 2001 میں 111 (تقریباً دو سال کے گریجویٹ نرسز کے برابر) سے گر کر 2008 کے پہلے نصف میں صرف چھ رجسٹرڈ نرسز اب ہجرت کر رہی تھیں۔ نرسنگ سکولوں میں داخلے کی شرح میں 50 فیصد اضافہ ہوا۔ اس کامیابی کے بعد ایک نئی مشکل سامنے آئی: اندرونی برین ڈرین۔ جیسے ہی مزید بین الاقوامی امدادی ادارے اور جامعات نے ملاوی میں صحت کے پروگرام قائم کیے، انہوں نے نرسز کو سرکاری ہسپتالوں اور کلینکوں سے بھرتی کرنا شروع کر دیا۔ یہ مسئلہ دیہی علاقوں میں زیادہ شدید ہے جہاں زیادہ تر آبادی رہتی ہے۔ شمالی ملاوی میں واقع ایمبنگوینی مشن ہسپتال اپنی دور افتادگی کے باوجود اچھی شہرت رکھتا ہے۔ "نوجوان نرسز جو خاندان رکھتی ہیں، یہاں کام کرنے میں زیادہ دلچسپی نہیں رکھتیں،" کیتھرین مزیمبے، ہیڈ آف نرسنگ ایمبنگوینی نے کہا۔ "مقامی مارکیٹ بہت چھوٹی ہے۔ اگرچہ ہسپتال میں پانی دستیاب ہے لیکن کئی گھروں میں یہ سہولت موجود نہیں۔" اس کے باوجود ہسپتال نے گزشتہ پانچ سالوں میں حاملہ خواتین کی زندگیاں بچانے اور بچوں و بڑوں میں ملیریا سے اموات میں نمایاں کمی کی ہے۔ ملاوی کی کہانی سے سب سے اہم سبق یہ ہے کہ بہت کم وسائل کے ساتھ بھی بہت نمایاں نتائج حاصل کیے جا سکتے ہیں۔

article_content: Astronomers have, for the first time, observed a stunning cosmic jet emerging from a supermassive black hole after it tore apart and consumed a star. This exceptionally rare event, where the debris of a destroyed star is fed into a black hole, triggered an outflow called a 'relativistic jet'—powerful streams of material that can stretch for hundreds of thousands of light years. An illustration depicts plasma shooting out from the black hole after it devoured the star, an event that occurred approximately four billion light years from Earth. NASA's Swift satellite used its Ultraviolet/Optical and X-ray telescopes to detect and observe the resultant bursts. Most galaxies host supermassive black holes at their centers—these objects possess gravitational pulls so strong that they can pull in nearby matter and have masses ranging from millions to billions of times that of our Sun. Scientists first noticed the phenomenon in March, after Swift detected several bursts of X-rays from a previously quiet region of the sky. Researchers from Pennsylvania State University and the Harvard-Smithsonian Center for Astrophysics suggested that these signals were likely from a star disrupted by a black hole situated 3.9 billion light years away. As a star approaches a black hole, it is gradually torn apart by intense tidal forces. The resulting gas forms an accretion disk around the black hole, which heats up to millions of degrees. Some of the innermost gas spirals inward, where rapid motion and magnetic fields create oppositely directed 'funnels'—channels through which particles can escape at velocities exceeding 90% of the speed of light. In the case of Swift J1644+57, one of these jets was precisely aligned with Earth. Dr. David Burrows from Pennsylvania State University, which operates Swift, explained that analysis of the event's ultraviolet light revealed it originated from material being drawn into a black hole roughly a million times the mass of the Sun. Writing in Nature, the researchers noted that Swift was fortuitously in the path of this jet, which was expelled at nearly 99.5% of the speed of light. Dr. Burrows stated, 'This source is still emitting X-rays and may remain bright enough for Swift to monitor into next year. Its behavior is unlike any we've previously observed.' The capture and consumption of a star by a black hole is an exceptionally rare occurrence, estimated to happen only once every one hundred million years in a typical galaxy. By absorbing the star, the black hole gains more mass, and such events drive the formation and growth of supermassive black holes, which can amass billions of solar masses. For context, our Sun is one solar mass, and Earth is about 1/332,950th of a solar mass.

آسٹروفزکس کے محققین نے تجویز کیا کہ یہ سگنلز شاید ایک ایسے ستارے سے آئے تھے جو سیاہ سوراخ کے قریب آنے پر تباہ ہو گیا اور یہ جگہ زمین سے 3.9 ارب نوری سال دور تھی۔ جب کوئی ستارہ سیاہ سوراخ کے قریب آتا article_content: National Security Adviser Nuhu Ribadu has urged Nigerians to be patient as the government confronts ongoing security challenges. He acknowledged that President Bola Tinubu's administration took office during a difficult period but pointed to significant progress in national security within the first five months. Speaking at the 19th Annual Nigerian Editors Conference in Uyo, Ribadu stressed the importance of unity, encouraging all citizens and institutions to join the Federal Government’s efforts to address insecurity. He reported a major decline in militancy in the Niger Delta, where crude oil production has increased from 1.1 million to over 1.7 million barrels per day. Notably, the region has seen three consecutive weeks without any security incidents—a milestone not reached since 1993. In the South East, Ribadu noted that the number of attacks on police stations, which were 46 last year, has dropped to zero in recent months, with the area also seeing no violence-related deaths in the last two months. Ribadu affirmed the administration’s commitment to citizen welfare and promised ongoing transparency in government operations.

article_content: Mark Zuckerberg and his wife, Priscilla Chan, say they drafted the announcement for their jointly named foundation in a hospital delivery room. The story dates back to 2015, when Chan and Zuckerberg welcomed their eldest daughter, Maxima. In December 2015, Zuckerberg posted a note on Facebook titled 'A letter to our daughter.' The post, which began with the words 'Dear Max,' outlined the couple's hopes for their daughter's future and announced the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative (CZI). 'Our initial areas of focus will be personalized learning, curing disease, connecting people, and building strong communities,' Zuckerberg and Chan wrote. 'We will give 99% of our Facebook shares—currently about $45 billion—during our lives to advance this mission.' Zuckerberg and Chan told neuroscientist and podcast host Andrew Huberman that they were working on the final version of the letter right before their child was born. The episode aired on Monday. 'I'm like, sitting in the hospital delivery room, finishing editing the letter that we were going to publish to announce CZI,' Zuckerberg told Huberman. Chan said launching the initiative was part of the couple's 'baby checklist.' 'Some people think that is an exaggeration. It was not. We really were editing the final draft,' Chan said. Eight years later, Zuckerberg and Chan now have two more daughters: August and Aurelia. The Chan Zuckerberg Initiative is now investing in efforts to try to rid the world of all human disease by 2100. In a statement issued on September 19, Chan and Zuckerberg said that their foundation is developing an AI-driven computing system that researchers can use to populate a comprehensive database of cells. This extensive cell catalog will allow medical researchers to create a 'predictive model' of how healthy and diseased cells behave. Chan said in the statement that their foundation's computing system aims to give researchers new technological tools rooted in generative AI that can 'accelerate efforts to cure, prevent, or manage all disease.' A representative for the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative did not immediately respond to a request for comment from Insider sent outside regular business hours.

article_content: Maryanne Trump Barry, the eldest sister of former President Donald Trump, has died at 86, according to US media reports. ABC News states she was found deceased around 4:00 a.m. EST (09:00 GMT) Monday in her New York City apartment. Her cause of death has not yet been made public. Barry served as a federal judge in New Jersey from 1983 until her retirement in 2019. She is the third of Donald Trump's four siblings to pass away. A spokesperson for the former president did not immediately respond to BBC requests for comment. ABC News reports emergency teams responded to a cardiac arrest call. Authorities say there were no signs of trauma or foul play. The cause of death will be determined by the medical examiner. Barry, who chose to pursue law rather than the family’s real estate business, worked as one of two female prosecutors in the US Attorney's Office in New Jersey from 1974 to 1983. With help from Roy Cohn, Donald Trump's well-known lawyer, Barry was nominated by President Ronald Reagan as a federal judge in 1983. According to her niece Mary Trump's 2020 memoir 'Too Much and Never Enough,' Maryanne claimed that her judicial appointment was the only favor she ever requested from her brother, and he would remind her of it, asking, 'Where would you be without me?' In 1999, Barry was appointed by President Bill Clinton to the US Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit, which covers parts of New Jersey, Delaware, and Pennsylvania. By 2019, a New York Times investigation into the Trump family’s finances led to a judicial misconduct inquiry involving Barry. She retired in February of that year, resulting in the inquiry's closure without resolution. Barry was married twice—first to David Desmond, with whom she had one son, also named David, and later to John Joseph Barry, who died in 2000. A Republican like her brother, Barry largely avoided public attention and never spoke publicly about Donald Trump. During his first presidential campaign in 2015, Trump called her a 'phenomenal' hypothetical Supreme Court nominee, but he later acknowledged their differences. The siblings’ relationship reportedly changed after the release of Mary Trump’s book, which featured recorded conversations between Barry and her niece. In one excerpt published by the Washington Post, Barry criticized Donald Trump, saying, 'He has no principles. None,' and mentioned doing his homework and someone else taking his college exams. Nevertheless, the siblings had begun reconciling and were seen together in the summer at Trump’s Bedminster, New Jersey club, according to ABC News. Donald Trump, the current Republican frontrunner for president, has lost his brothers Fred and Robert (in 1981 and 2020, respectively), and his first wife, Ivana, last year. His only surviving sibling is Elizabeth Trump Grau, a former banker, now 81.

مطابق، میریان نے کہا کہ انہیں جج بننے کے لیے اپنے بھائی سے یہ واحد احسان مانگنا پڑا، اور ٹرمپ اکثر انہیں یاد دلاتے تھے: 'تم میرے بغیر کہاں ہوتیں؟' 1999 میں بیری کو صدر بل کلنٹن نے امریکی کورٹ آف اپیلز فار دی تھرڈ سرکٹ مقرر کیا، جو نیو جرسی، ڈلاویئر اور پنسلوانیا کے کچھ حصوں پر محیط ہے۔ 2019 میں ٹرمپ خاندان کے مالی معاملات کی نیو یارک ٹائمز کی تحقیقات کے بعد بیری کے خلاف جوڈیشل مس کنڈکٹ کی تحقیق شروع ہوئی۔ بیری اسی سال فروری میں ریٹائر ہو گئیں اور اس وجہ سے تحقیقات بغیر نتیجے کے بند کر دی گئی۔ بیری دو بار شادی شدہ رہیں، پہلے ڈیوڈ ڈیسمنڈ سے جن سے ان کا ایک بیٹا ڈیوڈ ہے، اور پھر جان جوزف بیری سے، جو 2000 میں انتقال کر گئے۔ بیری، جو اپنے بھائی کی طرح ریپبلکن تھیں، زیادہ تر میڈیا سے دور رہیں اور کبھی ڈونلڈ ٹرمپ کے بارے میں عوامی طور پر بات نہیں کی۔ 2015 کے پہلے صدارتی انتخاب میں ٹرمپ نے کہا کہ اگر انہیں سپریم کورٹ کے لیے منتخب کیا جائے تو وہ 'شاندار' ہوں گی، تاہم بعد میں دونوں نے اپنے نظریاتی اختلافات کو تسلیم کیا۔ بہن بھائیوں کے تعلقات میں خلش مریم ٹرمپ کی کتاب کی اشاعت کے بعد آئی، جس میں بیری اور ان کی بھانجی کے درمیان ریکارڈ کی گئیں نجی گفتگوؤں کو شامل کیا گیا۔ واشنگٹن پوسٹ میں شائع ایک اقتباس میں بیری نے ٹرمپ پر تنقید کی کہ 'اس کے کوئی اصول نہیں۔ بالکل نہیں' اور کہا کہ انہوں نے ٹرمپ کا ہوم ورک کیا اور یونیورسٹی کے امتحانات کسی اور سے دلوائے۔ اس کے باوجود، بہن بھائیوں میں مفاہمت کی کوششیں جاری تھیں اور حال ہی میں انہیں ٹرمپ کے بیڈمنسٹر، نیو جرسی کلب میں ایک ساتھ دیکھا گیا۔ ڈونلڈ ٹرمپ، جو اس وقت ریپبلکن جماعت کے صدارتی امیدوار ہیں، اپنے دونوں بھائیوں، فریڈ اور رابرٹ (بالترتیب 1981 اور 2020 میں) اور پہلی بیوی ایوانا ٹرمپ (گزشتہ سال) کو کھو چکے ہیں۔ ان کی واحد زندہ بہن الزبتھ ٹرمپ گراو ہیں، جو اب 81 سال کی اور بینکر رہ چکی ہیں۔

article_content:
Cristiano Ronaldo made an emotional return to Lisbon on Thursday as Real Madrid arrived in Portugal for Saturday's all-Spanish Champions League final against Atletico Madrid. The 29-year-old forward appeared relaxed, chatting with teammate Pepe after disembarking Real Madrid's private plane at Lisbon airport, just 48 hours before manager Carlo Ancelotti’s side take to the field at the Estadio da Luz.

Ronaldo, who spent six years in Lisbon with Sporting before joining Manchester United in 2003, returned to the city assured of a place in Ancelotti’s starting eleven. The team, including Gareth Bale, Iker Casillas, Marcelo, Alvaro Arbeloa, and Sergio Ramos, checked into their hotel, ready for the big occasion.

Ronaldo has not played since being substituted early due to injury during Real Madrid's 1-1 draw with Valladolid on May 7. He was also sidelined for the final La Liga game as a precaution. Nonetheless, Ancelotti confirmed that both Ronaldo and Bale are fit and will play in the final against Diego Simeone’s Atletico Madrid.

Ronaldo expressed his determination, stating, 'Nobody wants to miss a final. It is important, and I am confident I will be there.'

Defender Sergio Ramos, set to play in his first Champions League final, called the match a dream and a reward for years of hard work. He predicted an evenly matched contest, saying, 'It is 50-50. Both teams will give everything to win.'

The final represents Real Madrid's pursuit of their 10th European Cup, commonly known as 'La Decima.'

article_content: Paul Goggins, Labour MP for Wythenshawe and Sale East, is being treated in serious condition after suffering a stroke while jogging with his son near their home in Manchester. He was rushed to Salford Royal Hospital and underwent emergency surgery, with his wife Wyn and three grown children at his side. Age 60, Goggins has represented his constituency since 1997 and previously served as prisons minister. His illness has drawn expressions of shock and support from political colleagues. Labour leader Ed Miliband described Goggins as a dedicated and kind MP and offered his thoughts and best wishes to the family. MPs Lucy Powell and Barbara Keeley also shared their support and prayers for Goggins and his family through social media, hoping for his quick recovery. The family has asked for privacy and prayers during this time, noting that he had been spending the holidays with them in Salford.

article_content: Japan is contemplating the introduction of new guidelines for long-term radiation exposure, which might lead to broadening the evacuation area around the Fukushima Daiichi nuclear plant, government officials revealed. Despite being outside the present restricted zone, data suggests that some residents could accumulate dangerous levels of radiation over time, even if the current readings are below the immediate evacuation threshold. Chief Cabinet Secretary Yukio Edano explained that officials are considering setting new thresholds for cumulative exposure, reiterating that public safety comes before social or economic concerns. After the earthquake and tsunami on March 11 damaged the plant's power systems, people within 20 kilometers of the site were evacuated, while those living between 20 and 30 kilometers were instructed to stay indoors. Recent government science data indicates that, in several locations outside this perimeter, long-term exposure could soon exceed official safety limits. Winds have transported radioactive particles northwest of the site, and organizations such as Greenpeace and the IAEA have expressed concern about contamination reaching beyond 30 kilometers. Currently, evacuation is required only if an individual is exposed to at least 50 millisieverts of radiation in a short time frame. However, measurement in some nearby towns show monthly radiation levels up to 12 millisieverts—substantially higher than typical annual doses in industrialized nations—raising concerns among health experts about risks like cancer. The government is also weighing whether to permit roughly 78,000 evacuees to return home on a temporary basis but emphasizes that ensuring adequate safety would be challenging. Military and police personnel still require specialized protective equipment to operate in the area, making the idea of civilian return complicated. At the damaged nuclear site, TEPCO engineers have injected nitrogen into Reactor 1 to minimize the risk of hydrogen explosions; this effort continued after a powerful aftershock struck, and maintenance workers retreated to a safe shelter during the tremor. According to Japanese and U.S. officials, the earthquake registered between magnitude 7.1 and 7.4, but operations at the plant continued without a loss of power. Overheated fuel rods have generated hydrogen, which was responsible for several previous explosions at the plant. The nitrogen injections aim to drive out oxygen from inside the reactor, thereby reducing the chance of another blast. Reactor 2, believed to be responsible for significant radioactive water leaks, is being cooled with large quantities of water, but this runoff is now highly contaminated. This dangerous water is amassing within the plant’s turbine rooms and surrounding tunnels. Some of this water previously leaked into the Pacific Ocean, with iodine-131 levels measured at millions of times higher than legally permitted. Consequently, authorities released about 10,000 tons of less-contaminated water into the sea to create capacity for more dangerous wastes, leading to public outrage from local fishermen and protests from neighboring South Korea. Nonetheless, officials described the action as necessary in preventing a greater environmental disaster. Japanese authorities are in talks with Russia about the 'Suzeran' decontamination ship, which could treat and store radioactive water, but no request has been made to utilize it so far. While plugging the leak from Reactor 2 was a step forward, both plant officials and government spokespeople warn that new leaks could occur elsewhere. Additional storage tanks are on their way, but further setup is required before use. The situation remains unstable, and efforts continue to focus on stabilizing the reactors and limiting further radioactive contamination.

article_content: BBC Radio 4 is set to launch a new programme, Tweet of the Day, which will broadcast daily recordings of birdsong. The show will run for 265 episodes, each highlighting a different bird species with a brief narration. The series will begin on May 6 and will include birds such as the Cuckoo, Nightingale, Tawny Owl, and Storm Petrel. Veteran wildlife expert Sir David Attenborough will host every episode in May, after which other well-known wildlife presenters, including Steve Backshall, Miranda Krestovnikov, and Chris Packham, will take over. The episodes will air every weekday morning at 5:58 am, just before the Today programme. A repeat will be broadcast on Sundays at 8:58 am. The BBC's Natural History Unit is producing the series, with scripts written by BBC presenter and wildlife expert Brett Westwood. Each 90-second episode will provide information about the featured bird's behavior, habits, and its cultural or literary associations. The first episode will focus on the Cuckoo, with Attenborough discussing its song and migratory habits. He quotes William Wordsworth: 'Shall I call thee bird? Or but a wandering voice?' Attenborough has expressed his pleasure in being part of the programme, saying, 'I’ve seen some of the most incredible animals on my travels around the world, but Tweet of the Day is a nice reminder of the teeming world of birds on my doorstep. As a non-ornithologist, I might even learn a little too.' All episodes will be available for download, and the programme’s website will feature behind-the-scenes content about the recordings. This launch follows the end of Birdsong Radio, a cult radio station that played recordings of birds singing. Birdsong Radio was cancelled in 2009 to make way for Amazing Radio, which focuses on music by unsigned artists. The move led to significant disappointment among fans, including author Sir Terry Pratchett.

article_content: Ukrainian authorities have accused two brothers, Volodymyr and Dmytro Mamon, of helping Russia carry out a deadly missile strike on their hometown, Hroza, in the Kharkiv region. The attack, which took place on October 5, targeted a café where locals had gathered for the funeral of a fallen Ukrainian soldier, Andriyi Kozyr. According to Ukraine's security service (SBU), 59 civilians were killed, including members of multiple generations from the same families. Ukrainian Interior Minister Ihor Klymenko stated that nearly every family in the village, which has a population of 330, had a relative at the event. The SBU has charged the brothers with treason, calling them 'traitors.' Prosecutors allege that the Mamon brothers collaborated with Russian occupying forces in 2022 and were given roles within the Russian police. After the region was regained by Ukraine, the brothers reportedly fled to Russia with their families, where they now hold Russian passports. Authorities claim that, from Russia, the brothers created a network of informants and collected intelligence on Ukrainian troop deployments and local events. Prosecutors specifically allege that Volodymyr Mamon notified Russian forces about the funeral, knowing it would be attacked. The SBU has published text messages attributed to Volodymyr, including one in which he allegedly wrote, 'Tell me when he is dead,' reportedly referencing a funeral attendee. One of the victims was Natalia Mamon, who shares the brothers’ surname. It is unclear how she was related to them, but records indicate she lived at the same address as one of the accused. Along with treason, Volodymyr Mamon faces charges of assisting Russian forces in violating the laws and customs of war. Authorities are currently working to locate both brothers, who remain at large in Russia.

article_content: In Cincinnati, Deandre Kelley, 34, received a six-year prison sentence—the minimum allowed for reckless homicide—after accidentally killing his 11-year-old daughter Shanti Lanza during a drunken argument with Shanti's mother, Kristina Lanza, on January 12. During the dispute, Kelley fired several shots in the air, and one bullet struck Shanti upstairs, where she was with friends. At Kelley's sentencing, both Kristina Lanza and Shanti’s aunt, Danielle Lott, protested emotionally in court, insisting the sentence was too harsh and claiming Shanti would have forgiven her father. Their outburst resulted in their arrest for contempt of court after Judge Nadine Allen warned them about their behavior. Kelley pleaded guilty to reckless homicide as part of a deal in which prosecutors agreed to drop more serious charges, including involuntary manslaughter and child endangerment. Prosecutors said they reluctantly agreed to the minimum sentence at the request of Kristina Lanza, despite Kelley's prior arrests for drugs, alcohol, and domestic violence—for which previous charges involving Lanza were dropped. The tragedy marks the second time gun violence has affected Kelley's family; his teenage son, David Gill, died in a separate 2012 shooting. The sentencing hearing was tense and emotional, highlighting the rare scenario where the victim's family advocated leniency for the person responsible.

article_content:
The global transition to green energy is projected to generate millions of new jobs, but a recent LinkedIn analysis has found there is a significant skills gap among workers. "We are nowhere close to where we need to be," said Efrem Bycer, senior lead manager of public policy and economic graph at LinkedIn, in an interview with Business Insider. He emphasized the need to accelerate green talent development, highlighting both environmental and economic imperatives.

LinkedIn’s analysis, which reviewed data from over 1 billion users and 65 million companies between January 2016 and August 2023, revealed that only one in eight workers worldwide has the green skills sought by employers. These skills include measuring carbon emissions, developing renewable energy projects, waste prevention, and water quality protection. The shortage is especially pronounced among women, with 90% lacking any green skills or relevant work experience.

Workers who possess green skills have improved job prospects. In 2023, green hiring rates were 29% higher than the overall labor market. However, many green jobs require prior experience, which poses a barrier for newcomers and requires employers to reconsider hiring strategies. Bycer advised that employers should align their climate goals with workforce development and invest in targeted talent initiatives. He also noted that professionals with backgrounds in project management, sales, or customer support may have transferable skills suitable for green roles such as solar consulting.

At LinkedIn, expertise in procurement and supply chain management is needed to minimize environmental impact. Measuring and tracking corporate carbon footprints is among the fastest-growing skill areas in the U.S. Currently, 66% of those with green skills are men, highlighting a significant gender imbalance known as the "green ceiling."

To bridge this gap, especially in trades like construction and electrical work, Bycer recommends targeted recruitment for apprenticeship programs and providing support services, such as childcare, to make these careers more accessible for women. There are positive signs: women are joining the green talent pool—defined as having at least one green skill or job experience—at a higher rate than men, though not fast enough to close the gap. Women are also 64% more likely than men to have skills in sustainability education and about 20% more likely to have expertise in sustainable development and the circular economy. In sectors such as oil, gas, and mining, women possess more green skills than men.

Bycer concluded that increased collaboration between climate and labor experts is an encouraging trend. "I hear a lot more climate experts talking about jobs, and a lot more workforce experts talking about climate," he observed. "Those groups don’t often get together."

Correction (November 21, 2023): An earlier version of this story misspelled Efrem Bycer’s last name. The correct spelling is Bycer, not Byzer.

دنیا بھر میں سبز توانائی کی جانب منتقلی سے لاکھوں نئی ​​نوکریاں پیدا ہونے کی توقع ہے، مگر LinkedIn کے حالیہ تجزیے کے مطابق ضروری مہارتوں کی شدید کمی ہے۔ LinkedIn کے سینئر لیڈ مینیجر برائے پبلک پالیسی و اکنامک گراف افریم بائسر نے Business Insider کو بتایا، “ہم ابھی اس سطح پر نہیں پہنچے جس کی ضرورت ہے۔” انہوں نے سبز ہنر سیکھنے کی رفتار بڑھانے کی اہمیت پر زور دیا، جس کی وجہ ماحولیاتی اور معاشی ضرورتیں ہیں۔

LinkedIn کے تجزیے (جنوری 2016 تا اگست 2023، ایک ارب سے زائد صارفین اور 6.5 کروڑ کمپنیوں کا ڈیٹا) سے ظاہر ہوا کہ دنیا بھر میں صرف ہر آٹھ میں سے ایک کارکن کے پاس وہ سبز ہنر ہیں جو آج کمپنیوں کو درکار ہیں۔ ان میں کاربن اخراج کی پیمائش، قابلِ تجدید توانائی پراجیکٹس بنانا، ضیاع روکنا اور پانی کے معیار کی دیکھ بھال شامل ہے۔ یہ کمی خواتین میں اور بھی زیادہ ہے: 90 فیصد کے پاس نہ سبز مہارت ہے نہ متعلقہ تجربہ۔

سبز ہنر رکھنے والے افراد کے جاب کے مواقع زیادہ اور بہتر ہیں۔ 2023 میں سبز شعبے میں بھرتی کی شرح باقی مارکیٹ سے 29 فیصد زیادہ رہی۔ البتہ اکثر سبز نوکریوں کے لیے پہلے سے تجربہ درکار ہوتا ہے، جس سے نئے امیدواروں کے لیے داخلہ مشکل اور آجروں کو نئے بھرتی طریقے اپنانے کی ضرورت ہے۔ Bycer نے بتایا کہ کمپنیوں کو چاہیے کہ وہ اپنے موسمیاتی مقاصد کو انسانی وسائل سے جوڑیں اور باقاعدہ ہنر سازی پر سرمایہ کاری کریں۔ انہوں نے کہا کہ پراجیکٹ مینجمنٹ، سیلز یا کسٹمر سپورٹ میں مہارت رکھنے والے افراد سبز شعبوں جیسے سولر کنسلٹنگ میں کامیاب ہو سکتے ہیں۔

LinkedIn میں اخراجات اور سپلائی چین منیجمنٹ کے ماہرین کی ضرورت ہے تاکہ کمپنی کا کاربن فُٹ پرنٹ کم ہو۔ کمپنیوں کے کاربن فُٹ پرنٹ کی پیمائش تیزی سے ترقی کرتی مہارت ہے۔ اس وقت سبز ہنر رکھنے والوں میں 66 فیصد مرد ہیں، جو “گرین سیلنگ” یعنی صنفی دیوار کی نشاندہی ہے۔

article_content: A 40-year-old earning Rs 60,000 per month currently invests Rs 1.32 lakh annually in PPF, ULIP, and LIC, and contributes Rs 11,000 monthly via SIPs in small- and large-cap mutual funds. With no liabilities, the individual aims to secure a monthly retirement income of Rs 30,000. Adhil Shetty, CEO of BankBazaar, advises that with 20 years until retirement, a target corpus of Rs 80 lakh (to generate Rs 3.6 lakh annually, increasing by 6% for inflation) invested at a 10% return is advisable. Given current investments and the historical CAGR of 12% from mutual funds, a corpus of about Rs 1.1 crore is achievable. However, to fully offset inflation, a Rs 2 crore corpus is safer, requiring an investment of Rs 20,000/month, which would support post-retirement withdrawals for approximately 27 years. Regular recalculation of expenses and inflation is recommended, focusing on blue-chip and passive funds. For a parent considering a Rs 1 lakh investment each for their 20 and 13-year-old children in small- and micro-cap stocks over 15 years, Vidya Bala, Co-founder of PrimeInvestor.in, notes that holding individual small and micro-cap stocks carries substantial risk, with many failing to grow or being delisted. Instead, she recommends starting with large or emerging companies and considering small-cap mutual funds via SIPs rather than lump-sum investments, while periodically reviewing portfolios. Another investor with Rs 30 lakh each in five direct-growth mutual funds seeks to start an SWP of Rs 18,000/month from each fund (totaling Rs 90,000), increasing by 5% yearly over 10–15 years. Prableen Bajpai, Founder of FinFix Research and Analytics, endorses the SWP strategy for steady retirement cash flow and tax efficiency. Assuming 10% annual portfolio returns and the desired payout increases, the Rs 1.5 crore portfolio is likely to last 15 years, possibly with a residual balance, but market conditions may affect outcomes. She advises maintaining a contingency fund covering one year of expenses in liquid or ultra-short debt funds. ابھرتے ہوئے اسٹاکس سے آغاز کریں اور چھوٹے کیپ میوچل فنڈ میں ایس آئی پی کے ذریعے سرمایہ کاری کریں۔ پورٹ فولیو وقتاً فوقتاً نظر ثانی کریں اور لام سم سرمایہ کاری سے گریز کریں۔ ایک اور سرمایہ کار نے پانچ article_content: The Mohla-Manpur assembly segment in Chhattisgarh was created following the 2008 delimitation. Since then, the BJP has not won this seat. The Ambagarh Chowki royal family is making a return to electoral politics in Chhattisgarh after almost 15 years. Sanjeev Shah, a descendant of the Nagvanshi Gond lineage, is standing from Mohla-Manpur (ST) on a BJP ticket. He is among at least seven candidates from erstwhile royal families contesting in the state’s assembly elections. Both Congress and BJP have given tickets to three royal family members each, while the Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) has fielded one candidate from former royalty. Shah is a two-term former MLA and shared that his family has participated in politics since independence: his grandmother Kanak Kumari Devi won as a Congress candidate in 1957, and his relative Bhupendra Shah won the seat on a Janata Party ticket in 1977. Shah’s father ran as an independent with BJP support in 1980 but narrowly lost. Shah also mentioned that his family is related to the descendants of Rani Durgavati, and that the Ambagarh Chowki palace, built in 1740, is now adorned with BJP campaign decorations. While locals say the royal family’s sway with the Congress has lessened, Sanjeev Shah’s approachable manner may still benefit his campaign. The BJP has also selected two Judev royal family members from Jashpur. The late Dilip Singh Judev was a prominent leader and minister. His son’s widow, Sanyogita Singh, is contesting from Chandrapur, and Prabal Pratap Singh Judev is running from Kota. Both contests are expected to be competitive. The Congress has nominated sitting MLA Indrashah Mandavi for Mohla-Manpur, as well as three other royal family members, including Deputy Chief Minister TS Singh Deo, who seeks his fourth term from Ambikapur. Although royal lineage is highlighted, both candidates and observers say voters now focus more on development and the track record of their representatives. Elections for Chhattisgarh’s 90 assembly seats take place in two phases on November 7 and 17, with results on December 3.

article_content: Pep Guardiola has confirmed that Bayern Munich have not rehearsed penalties prior to Wednesday's Champions League quarter-final second leg against Manchester United. With the tie currently 1-1 after Bastian Schweinsteiger canceled out Nemanja Vidic’s goal in the first leg at Old Trafford, a repeat result at the Allianz Arena would mean penalties will decide which team progresses. In his pre-match press conference, Guardiola highlighted that shooting from the spot is about a player’s mindset and bravery, remarking, 'It’s all in the head.' The Bayern manager is coming off his first Bundesliga defeat in 53 matches, following a 1-0 loss to Augsburg last weekend. Guardiola expects Manchester United, led by David Moyes, to play defensively and look for opportunities to counter. He said, 'English teams defend and wait for quick breaks. Moyes often keeps eight or nine players back, waiting for mistakes and set-pieces.' Guardiola explained that discipline and taking advantage of playing at home will be crucial. Despite questions over Wayne Rooney’s foot injury, Guardiola is convinced the United striker will feature in the match, calling him one of the best players he's ever seen. Rooney missed Manchester United’s 4-0 victory over Newcastle but trained ahead of the trip to Munich. Guardiola quipped, 'Rooney will play, 100 percent. I'd bet a big glass of beer on it.' Although Bayern’s record unbeaten Bundesliga run has ended, and they have now gone three games without a win for the first time since 2011, Guardiola says breaking records isn’t his focus—the Champions League is now the priority. Bayern will be without key midfielders Bastian Schweinsteiger (suspended after a red card in the first leg) and Thiago Alcantara (injury), so Toni Kroos and possibly Philipp Lahm may take their places in midfield. Guardiola noted Lahm’s versatility and reaffirmed, 'We know what must be done, and in the end, it’s the small details that decide matches.'
