article_content: Several schools in Northern Ireland reopened after a teacher strike took place on Wednesday morning. Educators from five unions participated in the half-day industrial action due to an ongoing pay dispute. Teachers in Northern Ireland have not received a pay increase for nearly three years, while many teachers in England, Scotland, and Wales now earn significantly more at the same grade. On Wednesday, the National Association of Head Teachers (NAHT) joined four other unions in striking for the second time this year, marking only the second industrial action in its 126-year history. The half-day strike will be followed by four more days of action after Christmas. Rebekah Mitchell, a geography teacher at Lisneal College in Londonderry, joined the profession five years ago out of passion for teaching. At 27, she now joined the picket line advocating for better pay and conditions for herself and her colleagues. 'For me, this is about equality,' she said. 'We need proper pay, conditions, and recognition like colleagues throughout the UK. I often pay for classroom supplies for the children to ensure they don't miss out.' Ms. Mitchell cited the high cost of living as a challenge, mentioning her mortgage and rising energy, fuel, and food bills. She said she understands why some teachers are leaving Northern Ireland for better pay elsewhere in the UK. Dr. Graham Gault of NAHT in Northern Ireland told the BBC's Good Morning Ulster that much of the support structure for schools has been removed. 'Three years of pay stagnation here has been the final straw,' he said, noting that undergraduates can easily leave Northern Ireland for higher pay and better support. Teachers are represented by the Northern Ireland Teachers Council (NITC), which includes NASUWT, INTO, UTU, NEU, and NAHT. Members of NASUWT in further education colleges also participated in the strike. The pay dispute has been ongoing for 18 months. In February 2022, unions rejected a two-year pay offer from employers, calling it inadequate. NASUWT national official Justin McCamphill said union members have ‘had enough’ and urged the Department of Education and the Department for the Economy to propose a better offer. NAHT representatives delivered a letter signed by school leaders to the prime minister at Downing Street. Holywood Nursery School principal Clare Majury said she did not want to strike but felt the system is 'crumbling' and makes it difficult to staff schools. Mark McTaggart of INTO called for a review of how the education budget is determined, noting that new teachers enter the profession with significant debt but low starting salaries compared to the Republic of Ireland or other parts of the UK. An Education Authority (EA) spokesperson said guidance was issued to schools to help manage the impact on students. The EA acknowledged the challenge and expressed efforts to minimize disruption for families. The Department of Education stated it understands the frustration over pay but cannot afford increases due to budget constraints. At St Mary’s High School in Newry, teachers stood at the gates instead of students arriving. Brendan Morgan, NASUWT NI secretary, said the entire education system in Northern Ireland is struggling, not just teacher pay. INTO representative Joanne Grant said the disparity is evident in border areas like Newry, where teachers can see higher-paid colleagues just across the County Louth border. She said people are at 'breaking point.' Patrick McIlroy, a teacher at Holy Trinity Primary School in Enniskillen, said he hopes the industrial action is short-term and appreciates the support from parents and the community. Further disruption is anticipated on Friday as some school support staff will stage a 24-hour strike over low pay. Unite union members working in school transport, catering, administration, cleaning, and as classroom assistants will participate. The EA said it expects significant disruption to school transport, meals, and cleaning services, especially affecting special schools. They plan to keep parents and students informed. Translink workers are also striking on Friday, so no bus or train services are expected that day.

ہوئی۔ شمالی آئرلینڈ کے اساتذہ کو تقریباً تین سال سے تنخواہ میں اضافہ نہیں ملا جبکہ انگلینڈ، اسکاٹ لینڈ اور ویلز کے اسی گریڈ کے اساتذہ اب کافی زیادہ کماتے ہیں۔ بدھ کے روز، ہیڈ ٹیچرز کی نیشنل ایسوسی ایشن (NAHT) نے اس سال دوسری بار ہڑتال کی، جو اپنی 126 سالہ تاریخ میں صرف دوسری دفعہ صنعتی عمل ہے۔ اس آدھے دن کی ہڑتال کے بعد، کرسمس کے بعد مزید چار دن کی کارروائی ہوگی۔ ریبیکہ مچل، جو لنڈنڈیری کے لزنئیل کالج میں جغرافیہ کی معلمہ ہیں، پانچ سال پہلے تعلیم کے جذبے سے اس پیشے میں آئیں۔ اب 27 سال کی عمر میں، وہ بہتر تنخواہ اور حالات کے لیے اپنے ساتھیوں کے ساتھ احتجاج میں شامل ہیں۔ انہوں نے کہا، 'میرے لیے یہ برابری کا معاملہ ہے۔ ہمیں برطانیہ کے دیگر حصوں کے اساتذہ کی طرح مناسب تنخواہ، حالات اور عزت چاہیے۔ میں اکثر کلاس کے سامان بچوں کے لیے خود خرید لیتی ہوں تاکہ وہ محروم نہ ہوں۔' محترمہ مچل نے روزمرہ کے بڑھتے ہوئے اخراجات کو چیلنج قرار دیا، جیسے کہ گھر کی قسط، بل، ایندھن اور خوراک کی قیمتیں۔ انہوں نے کہا کہ وہ سمجھتی ہیں کہ کیوں کئی اساتذہ بہتر تنخواہ کے لیے برطانیہ کے دوسرے حصوں میں جا رہے ہیں۔ NAHT شمالی آئرلینڈ کے ڈاکٹر گراہم گالٹ نے بی بی سی کے 'گڈ مارننگ السٹر' پر کہا کہ اسکولوں کو مدد دینے والا بہت سا ڈھانچہ ختم کر دیا گیا ہے۔ انہوں نے کہا، 'یہاں تین سال سے تنخواہ جمود کا شکار ہے اور یہ آخری قطرہ تھا۔' انہوں نے بتایا کہ یہاں کے نوجوان اساتذہ آسانی سے زیادہ تنخواہ اور سہولیات کی خاطر کہیں اور جا سکتے ہیں۔ اساتذہ شمالی آئرلینڈ ٹیچرز کونسل (NITC) سے وابستہ ہیں، جس میں NASUWT، INTO، UTU، NEU اور NAHT شامل ہیں۔ مزید تعلیم کالجز کے NASUWT اراکین نے بھی ہڑتال میں حصہ لیا۔ تنخواہ کا تنازعہ اٹھارہ ماہ سے چل رہا ہے۔ فروری 2022 میں یونینز نے ملازمین کی طرف سے دو سال کے لیے پیش کردہ تنخواہ کی پیشکش کو 'ناکافی' قرار دے کر مسترد کردیا۔ NASUWT کے قومی عہدیدار جسٹن مککیمفل نے کہا کہ ارکان اب تھک چکے ہیں اور محکمہ تعلیم و محکمہ معیشت سے بہتر پیشکش کی اپیل کی۔ NAHT کے نمائندوں نے اسکول لیڈرز کے دستخط شدہ خط کو وزیر اعظم کے دفتر ڈاؤننگ اسٹریٹ بھیجا۔ ہالی ووڈ نرسری اسکول کی پرنسپل کلیر ماجوری کا کہنا تھا کہ وہ ہڑتال کرنا نہیں چاہتی تھیں لیکن محسوس کرتی ہیں کہ نظام ٹوٹ رہا ہے اور اساتذہ کی کمی ہے۔ INTO کے مارک میک ٹیگرٹ نے تعلیم کے بجٹ کے فارمولے پر دوبارہ غور کرنے کا مطالبہ کیا اور کہا کہ نئے اساتذہ بھاری قرض کے ساتھ ملازمت شروع کرتے ہیں جبکہ ان کی تنخواہ جمہوریہ آئرلینڈ یا برطانیہ کے دوسرے علاقوں کے مقابلے میں کم ہے۔ ایجوکیشن اتھارٹی (EA) کے ترجمان نے کہا کہ اسکولوں کو طلبہ پر ہونے والے اثرات سے نمٹنے کے لیے رہنمائی جاری کی گئی ہے۔ EA نے مشکلات کا اعتراف کیا اور خاندانوں کے لیے مشکلات کم کرنے کے عزم کا اظہار کیا۔ محکمہ تعلیم نے کہا کہ وہ اساتذہ کی مایوسی کو سمجھتے ہیں لیکن بجٹ میں کمی کے باعث تنخواہوں میں اضافہ ممکن نہیں۔ نیو ری کے سینٹ مریم ہائی اسکول پر اساتذہ گیٹ پر کھڑے تھے جبکہ عام طور پر اس وقت بچے اسکول آتے ہیں۔ NASUWT NI کے سیکرٹری برینڈن مورگن نے کہا کہ مسئلہ صرف اساتذہ کی تنخواہ کا نہیں، پورا تعلیمی نظام مشکلات کا شکار ہے۔ INTO کی نمائندہ جواین گرانٹ نے کہا کہ نیو ری جیسے سرحدی علاقوں میں فرق خاص طور پر نمایاں ہے، جہاں اساتذہ چند میل دور کاؤنٹی لاوتھ میں اپنی زیادہ تنخواہ پانے والے ساتھیوں کو دیکھ سکتے ہیں۔ انہوں نے کہا کہ لوگ اب بالکل تھک چکے ہیں۔ پیٹرک مک ایل رائے، جو ہولی ٹرینٹی پرائمری اسکول اینسکلن میں پڑھاتے ہیں، نے کہا کہ انہیں امید ہے صنعتی کارروائی طویل نہیں ہوگی اور والدین و کمیونٹی کی مکمل حمایت کا اعتراف کیا۔ آئندہ جمعہ کو مزید رکاوٹ کی توقع ہے جب کچھ اسکول سپورٹ اسٹاف کم تنخواہ پر 24 گھنٹے کی ہڑتال کریں گے۔ یونائٹ یونین کے ممبران، جو اسکول ٹرانسپورٹ، کیٹرنگ، انتظامیہ، صفائی اور کلاس روم اسسٹنٹس کے طور پر کام کرتے ہیں، اس میں شامل ہوں گے۔ EA نے کہا کہ اسکول ٹرانسپورٹ، کھانے اور صفائی کی خدمات خاص طور پر خصوصی اسکولوں میں رکاوٹ کا شکار ہوں گی۔ وہ والدین اور طلبہ کو باخبر رکھنے کی کوشش کریں گے۔ ٹرانسلنک کے کارکنان بھی جمعہ کو ہڑتال کریں گے، اس لیے اس دن کوئی بس یا ٹرین سروس متوقع نہیں۔

MEDAK: Prime Minister Narendra Modi launched a strong critique against the ruling Bharat Rashtra Samithi (BRS) government on Sunday, claiming that the people of Telangana are moving forward with a resolve to form a BJP government for the first time in the state. Addressing a public meeting in Medak district, PM Modi began his speech in Telugu to connect with the audience. He stated, "Now the time has come for the lotus, the BJP's symbol, to bloom fully in the state. The pledge for development in Telangana can only be fulfilled by the BJP," receiving cheers from the crowd.

Telangana will hold its Assembly elections in a single phase on November 30, with vote counting scheduled for December 3. Casting criticism at Chief Minister K Chandrasekhar Rao, Modi accused him of treating Telangana as his personal fiefdom and questioned his decision to contest from two constituencies: Gajwel and Kamareddy.

During his speech, PM Modi also referred to the 15th anniversary of the 26/11 Mumbai terror attacks, recalling the shortcomings of what he described as a "weak and indecisive" Congress-led UPA government at the time. He reminded the audience that it was their votes in 2014 that helped replace the Congress with the BJP and claimed this led to a decisive stance against terrorism in India.

The state is witnessing a three-way contest among the incumbent BRS, the Congress, and an emerging BJP. In the previous Assembly elections in 2018, BRS (then Telangana Rashtra Samithi) secured 88 out of 119 seats with 47.4% vote share, the Congress won 19 seats, and the BJP did not win any.

article_content: Becky Bellworthy, a 20-year-old medical student from Romsey, Hampshire, achieved the milestone of becoming the youngest British woman to reach the summit of Mount Everest. What makes her accomplishment remarkable is the adversity she faced during a previous attempt, when she suffered a stroke at 20,000 feet that left her partially paralyzed and unable to be evacuated by helicopter. During that crisis, a Sherpa helped carry her 4,000 feet down challenging terrain, crossing dangerous crevasses and unsecured ladders. Fellow climber James Ketchell recognized the severity of her condition and ventured into extreme cold to get assistance. Initially misdiagnosed with altitude-induced brain swelling, neurologist Dr. Charles Clark later determined she had suffered a mini-stroke, caused by restricted blood flow in her brain. Doctors in the UK prescribed blood thinners and cautioned Becky against a second attempt, warning the risks could be life-altering. Despite a lingering weakness in her left side and strong opposition from her family, Becky was resolute in her determination to return. After a period of rehabilitation, which included swimming to help regain her strength, she discreetly arranged another expedition, this time accompanied by a medical professional. In April, Becky embarked on her renewed quest to climb Everest. She admitted to being hyper-alert to any sign of illness, haunted by her prior experience. On May 19th, at age 20, she reached the peak, briefly claiming the record as the youngest British woman at the summit before her friend Leanna Shuttleworth surpassed her the next day. Near the summit, Becky suffered hallucinations brought on by low oxygen, imagining a celebration awaiting her arrival. She overcame skepticism from others and edged past her own fears, finding immense satisfaction in her achievement. With Everest behind her, Becky has chosen to pause her mountaineering goals to concentrate on her medical studies at the University of Southampton. She reflects on the sacrifices made and asserts that the ordeal has deepened her resilience and will better inform her future in medicine.

article_content: Major Nidal Hasan, the Army psychiatrist awaiting trial for the 2009 Fort Hood shooting that killed 13 soldiers and injured 32 others, has received approximately $278,000 in Army pay since the attack. Soldiers wounded in the attack at the Texas Army base continue to struggle to receive the same pay and medical benefits that are provided to those wounded in combat. The Department of Defense confirmed that, under military law, Hasan's pay cannot be suspended unless he is convicted. Army Specialist Logan Burnett, who was shot three times during the attack, expressed his dismay that Hasan continues to receive full pay while victims face financial hardships. Had Hasan been a civilian employee, his pay could have been suspended after one week, whereas military regulations prevent such action for active-duty personnel before a guilty verdict. Many victims are advocating for the attack to be officially recognized as combat-related or a terrorist event, which would entitle them to additional benefits such as the Purple Heart and increased medical compensation. On the third anniversary of the shooting, victims filed a lawsuit against the Army in an effort to secure these benefits. Burnett has said he still suffers from his injuries and post-traumatic stress, expressing frustration over the continued lack of support. Another injured soldier, Shawn Manning, estimated he lost nearly $70,000 in benefits due to the attack’s classification as workplace violence. Congressman Thomas Rooney and others have urged Defense Secretary Chuck Hagel to reclassify the incident, stating that the current classification has resulted in inadequate care for victims. The Army has declined to comment further, citing the ongoing court martial process. Hasan, who is paralyzed from the waist down after being shot by police, faces the death penalty if convicted. According to his attorney, finding a bank willing to accept Hasan’s Army pay has been difficult. The FBI reported Hasan communicated with Al-Qaeda before the attack, and the National Counterterrorism Center has classified the shooting as a 'high fatality terrorist attack.' There is still uncertainty about whether the Army will try to recover Hasan's pay for his medical costs. Victims and their families continue to feel overlooked because of the workplace violence classification of the incident.

متاثرہ فوجی کا کہنا ہے کہ اس واقعے کو 'کام کی جگہ پر تشدد' قرار دیے جانے کے باعث انہیں تقریباً 70,000 ڈالر مراعات میں نقصان ہوا۔ کانگریس مین تھامس رونی اور دیگر نے سیکرٹری دفاع چک ہیگل سے درخواست کی کی فائرنگ سے کمر سے نیچے مفلوج ہو چکے ہیں، جرم ثابت ہونے کی صورت میں سزائے موت کا سامنا کر سکتے ہیں۔ ان کے وکیل کا کہنا ہے کہ ان کے آرمی اکاؤنٹ کے لیے کوئی بینک اکاؤنٹ کھولنا بھی مشکل ہو گیا ہے۔ ایف بی آئی کے مطابق، حملے سے پہلے حسن القاعدہ سے رابطے میں تھے اور نیشنل کاؤنٹر ٹیررازم سینٹر نے اس واقعہ کو 'ہائی فیٹیلیٹی ٹیررسٹ اٹیک' قرار دیا ہے۔ یہ اب تک واضح نہیں کہ فوج حسن کی تنخواہ سے ان کے طبی اخراجات وصول کرے گی یا نہیں۔ متاثرین اور ان کے خاندان اس واقعے کو 'کام کی جگہ پر تشدد' تصور کیے جانے پر نظر انداز محسوس کر رہے ہیں۔

article_content: Hurricane Otis rapidly intensified from a mild tropical storm to a powerful Category 5 hurricane in unprecedented time, catching scientists and forecasters off guard. Reliable computer models and experienced forecasters failed to predict Otis' sudden escalation, resulting in a disastrous and unexpected nighttime landfall. The storm left at least 27 people dead and four missing along Mexico's Pacific coast, causing destruction across miles of coastline. Just a day prior to landfall, Acapulco had been warned to expect a weak tropical storm. Instead, Otis struck 24 hours later with wind speeds of 165 mph (266 kph), marking the strongest landfall of any hurricane in the Eastern Pacific. In a record-breaking 12-hour period, Otis’ strength surged from 70 mph (113 kph) to 160 mph (257 kph), intensifying even further before making landfall. Such rapid changes are highly unusual, as most storms only fluctuate by a few mph in that time frame, with rare exceptions gaining 30–50 mph (48–80 kph) in a day. Brian McNoldy, a hurricane researcher at the University of Miami, noted that the occurrence is in line with the recent trend of more frequent rapid hurricane intensification, likely driven by warmer ocean waters connected to climate change. Five hurricane experts interviewed by The Associated Press admitted uncertainty about the exact trigger for Otis’s rapid intensification and why it eluded prediction, despite recent improvements in intensity forecasts. Professor Kerry Emanuel of MIT stated that the models 'completely missed it', pointing to lacking data on the storm’s environment and an incomplete understanding of factors behind such explosive growth. National Hurricane Center Director Michael Brennan described Otis’s rapid, last-minute escalation as a 'very bad scenario' for densely populated areas, noting that the fast change in impact expectations gave people little time to react. Brennan explained that Otis encountered a much more favorable environment than anticipated, including warm waters and favorable wind conditions, allowing the storm to quickly build structure and power. Experts also highlighted global ocean surface temperature records, with unusually warm subsurface waters off Mexico acting as extra fuel for Otis, even though surface temperatures were only slightly above average. Ocean heat content worldwide has been shattering records due to human-driven climate change, with the oceans absorbing excess heat from fossil fuel emissions. Other factors possibly contributing to Otis's explosive strength include lower surface water salinity from recent heavy rains and the lack of ocean monitoring equipment—such as buoys, radar, and land observation sites—in the East Pacific. There is ongoing debate on whether forecasters underestimated Otis’ initial strength, meaning the storm may have been stronger than first realized. Studies indicate that rapidly intensifying hurricanes—defined as gaining at least 35 mph (56 kph) of wind speed in 24 hours—have become more common in recent decades. Examples include Patricia (2015), Wilma (2005), Harvey (2017), Maria (2017), and Lee (2023). Jim Kossin, formerly with NOAA and now at the First Street Foundation, and other scientists caution that while climate change increases global rapid intensification trends, attributing any single event remains difficult. The lack of sufficient data and tools in the East Pacific continues to challenge accurate forecasts, with satellites sometimes providing only a partial picture and scientists calling the region a 'data void.'

اور تجربہ کار ماہرین اوٹس کی اچانک شدت پکڑنے کی پیشگوئی نہ کر سکے، جس کا نتیجہ غیر متوقع طور پر شدید رات کے طوفان کی صورت میں نکلا۔ یہ طوفان میکسیکو کے بحر الکاہل کے ساحل پر کم از کم 27 جانیں لے گیا اور چار افراد لاپتہ ہیں، جبکہ میلوں تک تباہی مچ گئی۔ زمین پر آنے سے صرف ایک دن پہلے اکا پولکو کو ایک کمزور ٹراپیکل اسٹورم کے لیے خبردار کیا گیا تھا۔ اس کے برعکس، اوٹس نے 24 گھنٹے بعد 165 میل فی گھنٹہ (266 کلومیٹر فی گھنٹہ) کی رفتار سے حملہ کیا، جو ایسٹ پیسیفک میں سب سے طاقتور لینڈ فال ہے۔ ریکارڈ 12 گھنٹے میں، اوٹس کی شدت 70 میل فی گھنٹہ (113 کلومیٹر فی گھنٹہ) سے 160 میل فی گھنٹہ (257 کلومیٹر فی گھنٹہ) تک جا پہنچی اور طوفان مزید طاقتور ہو گیا۔ اتنی تیز شدت میں تبدیلی بے حد غیر معمولی ہے، کیونکہ اکثر طوفان اس مدت میں چند میل فی گھنٹہ ہی بڑھتے یا گھٹتے ہیں، جبکہ کم ہی مواقع پر 30–50 میل فی گھنٹہ (48–80 کلومیٹر فی گھنٹہ) کا اضافہ ایک دن میں ہوتا ہے۔ میامی یونیورسٹی کے ہریکین ریسرچر برائن میک نولڈی کے مطابق، یہ واقعہ تیز شدت والے طوفانوں کے حالیہ رجحان سے جڑا ہوا نظر آتا ہے، جس کی ممکنہ وجہ گرم سمندری پانی اور موسمیاتی تبدیلی ہے۔ ایسوسی ایٹڈ پریس سے گفتگو کرنے والے پانچ ماہرین نے اس بات پر اتفاق کیا کہ اوٹس کے اتنی تیزی سے طاقتور ہونے کی اصل وجہ اور اس کی پیشگوئی میں ناکامی ابھی تک واضح نہیں ہو سکی، حالانکہ پیشگوئی میں خاصی بہتری آئی ہے۔ ایم آئی ٹی کے پروفیسر کیری ایمانوئل نے کہا کہ ماڈلز بالکل ناکام ہو گئے، جس کی وجہ اسٹورم کے ارد گرد ڈیٹا کی کمی اور ایسی شدت کی وجوہات کا مکمل طور پر نہ جانا ہے۔ نیشنل ہریکین سینٹر کے ڈائریکٹر مائیکل برینن نے اوٹس کی اچانک شدت کو گنجان آباد علاقوں کے لیے 'انتہائی بری صورتحال' قرار دیا اور کہا کہ لوگوں کو ردعمل کے لیے بہت کم وقت ملا۔ برینن کے مطابق، اوٹس نے توقع سے زیادہ اچھا ماحول پایا، جس میں گرم پانی اور موافق ہوائیں شامل تھیں، جس سے طوفان میں تیزی سے ساخت بنی اور طاقت آ گئی۔ ماہرین کا کہنا ہے کہ عالمی سطح پر سمندری سطح کا درجہ حرارت ریکارڈ ہو رہا ہے اور میکسیکو کے ساحل کے نیچے غیر معمولی حد تک گرم پانی نے اوٹس کو اضافی توانائی فراہم کی، حالانکہ سطحی درجہ حرارت معمول سے ذرا سا زیادہ تھا۔ سمندر کے گہرے حصوں میں حرارت کا عالمی ریکارڈ موسمیاتی تبدیلی کے باعث بن رہا ہے، کیونکہ سمندر فاسل فیول کے اخراج سے اضافی گرمی جذب کر رہے ہیں۔ اوٹس کی تیزی سے شدت پکڑنے کی دیگر وجوہات میں سطحی پانی میں کم نمک کی مقدار (زیادہ بارش کی وجہ سے) اور مشرقی بحرالکاہل میں سمندری پیمائش کے اوزاروں (بوئے، راڈار، زمینی مشاہدات) کی کمی شامل ہو سکتی ہے۔ اس بات پر بھی بحث جاری ہے کہ شاید ماہرین نے اوٹس کی ابتدائی طاقت کم سمجھی، یعنی یہ طوفان شروع سے ہی زیادہ مضبوط تھا۔ مطالعے ظاہر کرتے ہیں کہ تیزی سے شدت پکڑنے والے ہریکین (جو 24 گھنٹوں میں کم از کم 35 میل فی گھنٹہ (56 کلومیٹر فی گھنٹہ) رفتار بڑھاتے ہیں) حالیہ دہائیوں میں زیادہ ہو گئے ہیں۔ مثالیں: پیٹریشیا (2015)، وامہ (2005)، ہاروی (2017)، ماریا (2017)، لی (2023) شامل ہیں۔ سابقہ NOAA سائنس دان اور فرسٹ اسٹریٹ فاؤنڈیشن کے جِم کوسن سمیت دیگر ماہرین، کہتے ہیں کہ اگرچہ موسمیاتی تبدیلی مجموعی طور پر اس رجحان کو بڑھاتی ہے، لیکن کسی ایک واقعے کو اس سے منسوب کرنا مشکل ہے۔ مشرقی بحرالکاہل میں ناکافی ڈیٹا اور ٹیکنالوجی درست پیشگوئی کے لیے چیلنج بنی ہوئی ہے، سیٹلائٹ بھی اکثر جزوی تصویر دیتی ہے اور اس علاقے کو سائنسدان 'ڈیٹا وائیڈ' کہتے ہیں۔

article_content: Sam Altman, co-founder of OpenAI, made headlines when he was unexpectedly removed as CEO but was restored to the position just four days later after overwhelming employee support. OpenAI cited inconsistent transparency with the board as the reason for his brief departure. In the interim, Altman and co-founder Greg Brockman had a short stint at Microsoft, a key OpenAI partner and investor that has contributed over $13 billion to the company. Swift CEO comebacks like this are rare in the tech sector but are not without precedent. Notably, Apple co-founder Steve Jobs was ousted in 1985 following disagreements with the board and returned in 1997 after Apple acquired his company, NeXT. Jobs's return is credited with revitalizing Apple, where he remained CEO until ill health forced his resignation in 2011, shortly before his passing. Other tech industry leaders have faced similar turmoil. Travis Kalanick stepped down as Uber’s CEO after scrutiny of corporate culture and expressed wishes to return, though this has not occurred. Jack Dorsey, initially removed as CEO of Twitter in 2008, made a comeback in 2015 before leaving again following conflict with powerful investors. Leaders such as Bob Iger at Disney and Howard Schultz at Starbucks have also returned to lead the companies they once ran, while others like Kalanick and WeWork’s Adam Neumann have not made such a return. Altman’s situation is especially notable because of how quickly he was reinstated. The board reinstated him after widespread employee support, with reports indicating up to 95% of staff threatened resignation if he was not brought back. The specific details behind his brief ouster by the board remain unclear, underlining the unpredictable and passionate nature of leadership in Silicon Valley.

article_content:
After successfully landing a probe on a comet and advancing our understanding of life's origins on Earth, the European Space Agency (ESA) has turned its focus to Mercury for its next mission. Mercury, the closest planet to the Sun, experiences extreme temperature variations—surface temperatures may exceed 400°C in sunlight, while shaded areas can dip to -170°C. This is mainly because Mercury cannot retain a significant atmosphere due to its small size and high temperatures. Mercury is just over 3,000 miles in diameter—about a third larger than our Moon and even smaller than Saturn's Titan and Jupiter's Ganymede.

ESA’s mission, called BepiColombo in honor of Italian space pioneer Giuseppe 'Bepi' Colombo, was scheduled to launch in July 2016, though it ultimately launched in October 2018. It aims to arrive in Mercury’s orbit in 2024. Mercury remains the least studied of the inner planets and has unique characteristics. Project scientist Johannes Benkhoff explains, “Mercury is special. It’s the densest planet in our solar system, even denser than Earth if you consider uncompressed density, and it has a magnetic field like Earth—a surprising discovery. So, it’s an exciting destination.”

Reaching Mercury is demanding due to its proximity to the Sun, resulting in extreme gravity and radiation exposures, and its high orbital speed of 48 kilometers per second, compared to Earth’s 30 km/s. Any probe must travel about 48 million miles and precisely adjust its speed to enter Mercury’s orbit without being drawn into the Sun.

Only two missions have previously reached Mercury. NASA’s Mariner 10, launched in 1973, pioneered the 'gravitational slingshot' technique, using planetary gravity to alter spacecraft trajectories and save fuel—Bepi Colombo contributed calculations for this journey, a method now common in space exploration. NASA’s Messenger, the second mission, launched in 2004 and orbited Mercury until it impacted the planet in 2015.

Messenger’s findings uncovered remarkable surprises, underscoring the need for further study. “Messenger found so many surprising results that we have many good reasons to continue the research,” Benkhoff told CNN. “With BepiColombo, we’ll reach Mercury about ten years after Messenger and build on its discoveries.”

BepiColombo uses gravitational assists: a fly-by of Earth two years after launch, two fly-bys of Venus, and then the trek to Mercury. Once there, its two orbiter modules will separate: the Mercury Planetary Orbiter (MPO), designed by ESA, and the Mercury Magnetospheric Orbiter (MMO), also known as Mio, designed by JAXA. Together, they will conduct detailed studies of Mercury’s environment. The mission aims to help scientists understand how planets form near stars, analyze Mercury’s geology and magnetic field, and provide further tests of Einstein’s general theory of relativity. Mercury’s odd orbit puzzled physicists as far back as 1845, defying Newton’s laws, until Einstein’s theory successfully explained the planet’s peculiar motion as a product of space curvature. BepiColombo will collect precise data on Mercury’s orbit to further test Einstein’s ideas.

یورپی خلائی ایجنسی (ESA) نے ایک دمدار ستارے پر کامیابی سے پروب اُتارنے اور زمین پر زندگی کی ابتدا کے بارے میں معلومات میں اضافہ کرنے کے بعد، اپنے اگلے مشن کے طور پر مرکری پر توجہ مرکوز کی ہے۔ مرکری، جو سورج کے سب سے قریب سیارہ ہے، انتہائی شدید درجہ حرارت کے اتار چڑھاؤ کا سامنا کرتا ہے—سورج کی روشنی میں اس کی سطح 400°C سے زیادہ گرم ہوسکتی ہے، جبکہ سائے والے علاقوں میں درجہ حرارت -170°C تک گر سکتا ہے۔ اس کی بنیادی وجہ یہ ہے کہ مرکری کے پاس قابل ذکر ماحول نہیں ہے، کیونکہ یہ بہت چھوٹا اور بہت حد تک گرم ہے۔ مرکری کا قطر 3,000 میل سے کچھ زیادہ ہے—یہ ہمارے چاند سے ایک تہائی بڑا اور سیٹرن کے ٹائٹن و جیوپیٹر کے گیینی میڈ سے بھی چھوٹا ہے۔

ESA کے مشن کا نام اطالوی خلائی سائنسدان جوزیپے 'بیپی' کولمبو کے نام پر "بیپی کولمبو" رکھا گیا۔ یہ مشن جولائی 2016 میں لانچ ہونا تھا، مگر حقیقتاً اکتوبر 2018 میں روانہ ہوا اور اس کا ہدف 2024 میں مرکری کے مدار تک پہنچنا ہے۔ مرکری اب تک اندرونی سیاروں میں سب سے کم مطالعہ شدہ ہے، اور اس میں کئی انوکھی خصوصیات ہیں۔ پروجیکٹ سائنسدان جوہانس بینکھوف کے مطابق، “مرکری خاص ہے—یہ غیر دباؤ والی کثافت میں زمین سے بھی زیادہ گھنا ہے، اور اس میں زمین جیسا مقناطیسی میدان موجود ہے جو کہ حیرت انگیز بات ہے۔ اس لیے یہ ایک شاندار فلکیاتی منزل ہے۔”

مرکری تک پہنچنا خاصا مشکل ہے کیونکہ یہ سورج کے قریب ہے جس سے کشش ثقل اور شعاعی ماحول کی شدت بڑھ جاتی ہے، اور اس کی مداری رفتار 48 کلومیٹر فی سیکنڈ ہے، جبکہ زمین کی رفتار 30 کلومیٹر فی سیکنڈ ہے۔ ہر پروب کو تقریباً 48 ملین میل کا سفر اور صحیح رفتار کو ایڈجسٹ کرنا ہوتا ہے، تاکہ مرکری کے تیز مدار میں داخل ہو سکے، بصورت دیگر سورج کی کشش اسے اپنی طرف کھینچ سکتی ہے۔

اب تک صرف دو مشن مرکری پر پہنچ پائے ہیں۔ پہلا، ناسا کا میرینر 10 (1973)، جس نے 'گریویٹیشنل سلنگ شاٹ' تکنیک متعارف کروائی—سیاروں کی کشش ثقل سے جہاز کی رفتار اور سمت کو بدل کر ایندھن بچایا جاتا ہے۔ بیپی کولمبو نے اس سفر کے ریاضیاتی حسابات میں مدد دی، اور یہ طریقہ اب خلائی تحقیق میں عام ہے۔ دوسرا مشن ناسا کا میسنجر تھا، جو 2004 میں روانہ ہوا اور 2015 میں مرکری کی سطح سے ٹکرا گیا۔

میسنجر کی دریافتوں نے غیر متوقع انکشافات کیے اور مزید تحقیق کی اہمیت کو اجاگر کیا۔ بینکھوف نے سی این این کو بتایا، “میسنجر نے حیران کن معلومات فراہم کیں، اس لیے مزید تحقیق کی کئی وجوہات ہیں۔ بیپی کولمبو کے ذریعے ہم میسنجر کے لگ بھگ دس سال بعد مرکری تک پہنچیں گے اور اس کی دریافتوں پر تحقیق کو آگے بڑھائیں گے۔”

بیپی کولمبو گریویٹیشنل اسسٹ کے ذریعے سفر طے کرے گا: لانچ کے دو سال بعد زمین کے قریب سے، پھر وینس سے دو بار قریب سے گزرے گا اور پھر مرکری کی طرف روانہ ہوگا۔ وہاں پہنچنے پر، اس کے دو اوربیٹر علیحدہ ہو جائیں گے: مرکری پلانیٹری اوربیٹر (MPO) جو ESA نے بنایا، اور مرکری میگنیٹوسفیئرک اوربیٹر (MMO)، جسے جاپان کی خلائی ایجنسی JAXA نے تیار کیا۔ دونوں ماڈیول مل کر مرکری کے ماحول کا تفصیلی مطالعہ کریں گے۔ اس مشن کا مقصد یہ ہے کہ سائنسدان یہ جان سکیں کہ ستاروں کے قریب سیارے کیسے بنتے ہیں، مرکری کی ارضیات اور مقناطیسی میدان کا تجزیہ ہو، اور آئن سٹائن کے عمومی نظریہ اضافیت کی مزید تحقیق ہو سکے۔ مرکری کا منفرد مدار 1845 سے سائنسدانوں کے لیے معمہ تھا کیونکہ وہ نیوٹن کے قوانین پر پورا نہیں اترتا تھا، جس کی وضاحت بعد میں آئن سٹائن کے نظریے نے اسپیس کی خمیدگی کی صورت میں کی۔ بیپی کولمبو مرکری کے مدار کی نہایت درست معلومات اکٹھی کرے گا، جس سے آئن سٹائن کے نظریے کی مزید جانچ کی جا سکے گی۔

Elodie Duyck, a Ph.D. candidate at the Royal Netherlands Institute for Sea Research (NIOZ), has found that most meltwater traveling along Greenland’s east coast does not enter the open ocean until it reaches the western side of the island. Duyck, presenting her findings at Utrecht University, noted that this trend could have substantial implications for global ocean circulation as Arctic and Greenland freshwater inflows increase with climate change.

“Understanding where, and how much, of this fresh, low-density water reaches the Atlantic is critical to predicting how ocean circulation may change under climate change,” Duyck explained.

With climate change expected to bring more freshwater from Greenland and the Arctic into the northern North Atlantic, this less-dense water can disrupt the usual mixing between surface and deep ocean layers. Such disruptions threaten the Atlantic Meridional Overturning Circulation (AMOC), which transports warm surface water north and returns cold deep water south. Changes to this current may affect climate worldwide.

Duyck’s research, using 120 autonomous buoys deployed along Greenland’s east coast and tracked via sea anchors to follow surface currents, showed that most meltwater follows the coast and only occasionally mixes into the open ocean. Direct current measurements from the OSNAP (‘Overturning in the Subpolar North Atlantic Program’) project highlight the strategic role of the Irminger Sea, southeast of Greenland, for ocean circulation.

The results demonstrated that only limited sections of the east coast see mixing between fresh shelf water and Atlantic water, with one zone at Greenland’s southern tip capable of exporting freshwater during high winds. However, the majority of buoys followed coastal paths to Greenland’s west side, suggesting minimal meltwater enters the Irminger Sea directly.

Around one-third of buoys released along the east coast ended up in the Labrador Sea to the west—a region known for more exchange between coastal and open ocean. According to Duyck, “This indicates that circulation on Greenland’s east coast can influence how much freshwater enters the Labrador Sea.”

Now at the University of Hamburg, Duyck continues to study how freshwater enters the Labrador Sea and its potential impact on ocean circulation. The current findings have been published in the Journal of Geophysical Research: Oceans.
translated_content:
ایلودی ڈوک، جو رائل نیدرلینڈز انسٹی ٹیوٹ فار سی ریسرچ (NIOZ) میں پی ایچ ڈی امیدوار ہیں، نے یہ دریافت کیا ہے کہ گرین لینڈ کے مشرقی ساحل سے بہنے والا پگھلا ہوا پانی کھلے سمندر میں اس وقت تک نہیں پہنچتا جب تک کہ وہ مغربی کنارے تک نہ پہنچ جائے۔ ڈوک نے اپنے نتائج یوٹریخت یونیورسٹی میں پیش کیے، اور کہا کہ جب آرکٹک اور گرین لینڈ کی طرف سے تازہ پانی کی مقدار میں موسمیاتی تبدیلی کی وجہ سے اضافہ ہو گا، تو یہ عالمی سمندری گردش پر اہم اثرات ڈال سکتا ہے۔

ڈوک کہتی ہیں: "اس بات کو سمجھنا کہ یہ ہلکا اور کم گھنا پانی کہاں اور کتنی مقدار میں اٹلانٹک تک پہنچتا ہے، موسمیاتی تبدیلی کے نتیجے میں سمندر کی گردش میں ممکنہ تبدیلیوں کی پیشگوئی کے لیے بہت ضروری ہے۔"

ماہرین کے مطابق، اگلے کئی دہائیوں میں موسمیاتی تبدیلی کے باعث گرین لینڈ اور آرکٹک کا مزید تازہ پانی شمالی اٹلانٹک میں جائے گا۔ یہ کم گھنا پانی سطح اور گہرے پانی کے درمیان تبادلے میں رکاوٹ ڈال سکتا ہے، جو عام حالات میں اس علاقے کی خاصیت ہے۔ اس سے اٹلانٹک میرڈیونل اوورٹرننگ سرکولیشن (AMOC) کمزور ہو سکتا ہے، جو سطح پر گرم پانی کو شمال اور گہرے پانی کو جنوب کی جانب لے جاتا ہے، اور اس وجہ سے دنیا کے بڑے حصے کے موسم پر اثر پڑتا ہے۔

ڈوک کی تحقیق میں، 120 خود کار بوئیز کو گرین لینڈ کے مشرقی ساحل پر نصب کیا گیا۔ ان بوئیز نے سطح کی لہروں کی بجائے سطحی کرنٹ کے ساتھ اپنی رفتار رکھی۔ نتائج نے بتایا کہ پگھلا ہوا پانی زیادہ تر ساحل کے نزدیک رہتا ہے اور کھلے سمندر میں ملنے میں کمی رہتی ہے۔ براہ راست کرنٹ کی پیمائش اور OSNAP (اوورٹرننگ ان دی سب پولر نارتھ اٹلانٹک پروگرام) کے تحقیقی منصوبے نے آرمنگر سی کو سمندری گردش کے لیے اہم قرار دیا ہے۔

تحقیق کے مطابق، چند مقامات پر مشرقی ساحل کے ساتھ تازہ پانی اور اٹلانٹک پانی ملتے ہیں، نیز گرین لینڈ کے جنوبی سرے پر ایک علاقے میں تیز ہواؤں کے دوران زیادہ مقدار میں تازہ پانی نکل سکتا ہے۔ مجموعی طور پر، بوئیز ساحل کے قریب رہیں اور مغربی حصے تک گئیں، جس سے ظاہر ہوتا ہے کہ پگھلا ہوا پانی آرمنگر سی میں براہ راست بہت کم جاتا ہے۔

مشرق سے چھوڑے گئے تقریباً ایک تہائی بوئیز مغربی طرف لیبراڈور سی تک پہنچ گئے، جو کھلے سمندر اور ساحلی پانی کے مزید تبادلے کے لیے مشہور ہے۔ ڈوک کے مطابق: "اس سے ظاہر ہوتا ہے کہ گرین لینڈ کے مشرقی ساحل کی گردش اس کے مغربی علاقے میں لیبراڈور سی تک پہنچنے والے تازہ پانی کی مقدار پر اثر ڈال سکتی ہے۔"

اب ڈوک یونیورسٹی آف ہیمبرگ میں اسی موضوع پر تحقیق کر رہی ہیں کہ لیبراڈور سی میں تازہ پانی کیسے جاتا ہے اور مستقبل میں سمندری گردش پر اس کا کیا اثر پڑ سکتا ہے۔ ان کے حالیہ نتائج 'جرنل آف جیو فزیکل ریسرچ: اوشینز' میں شائع ہوئے ہیں۔

Estate agents are often known for making bold claims, but RE/MAX Property Centre recently drew attention for describing Luton as a suburb of London. The company advertised luxury flats in the Bedfordshire town, suggesting the homes were close to 'one of the world’s leading financial districts and one of the most cosmopolitan areas of London.'

The adverts claimed 'the City’s famous landmarks right on your doorstep' and promoted city living, yet a season ticket for the 23-minute train journey to London costs nearly £4,000. These new flats, overlooking a busy dual carriageway, a casino, a pub, and the crown court, are priced at over £500,000. Student rooms start at £56,000.

RE/MAX Property Centre is marketing 130 flats and 359 student rooms on behalf of Sloane International Developers. After an inquiry by MailOnline, the company updated its advert and stated that any inaccuracies were due to a typographical error, not a deliberate attempt to mislead buyers.

Locals were skeptical of the claims. An unnamed resident said there are not many social and cultural attractions nearby, and Councillor Tom Shaw noted that even with rising London house prices, the prices for the Luton flats 'require a bit of imagination.'

The development includes a gym and a 24-hour concierge and is set for completion in 2016. Student rooms starting at £56,000 are part of affordable housing commitments.

The article also highlights how various airports and developments use the 'London' name despite being far from the city, such as London Luton Airport and London Oxford Airport.

Luton has received negative attention before—in 2004, it topped a poll of Britain's 'worst places to live,' despite being home to over 185,000 residents.

RE/MAX stated that the flats primarily target overseas investors from countries such as China and Malaysia.

جائیداد کے ایجنٹ اکثر جرات مندانہ دعوے کرتے ہیں، لیکن حال ہی میں RE/MAX پراپرٹی سینٹر نے لٹن کو لندن کا سبرب کہہ کر سب کی توجہ حاصل کی۔ اس کمپنی نے بیڈفورڈشائر کے شہر لٹن میں لگژری فلیٹس کے اشتہارات دیے اور کہا کہ یہ گھر ‘دنیا کے معروف مالیاتی ضلع اور لندن کے سب سے زیادہ متنوع علاقوں’ کے قریب ہیں۔

اشتہارات میں کہا گیا کہ 'شہر کی مشہور علامات آپ کے دروازے پر ہیں' اور شہری طرزِ زندگی کی تشہیر کی گئی، حالانکہ لندن تک 23 منٹ کی ٹرین کا سیزن ٹکٹ تقریباً چار ہزار پاؤنڈ کا ہے۔ یہ نئے فلیٹس، جو ایک مصروف ڈوئل کیریج وے، کیسینو، پب اور کراؤن کورٹ کے سامنے ہیں، پانچ لاکھ پاؤنڈ سے زائد قیمت پر دستیاب ہیں۔ اسٹوڈنٹ رومز کی قیمت 56,000 پاؤنڈ سے شروع ہوتی ہے۔

RE/MAX پراپرٹی سینٹر سلوئن انٹرنیشنل ڈیولپرز کے لیے 130 فلیٹس اور 359 اسٹوڈنٹ رومز کی مارکیٹنگ کر رہا ہے۔ میل آن لائن کی انکوائری کے بعد کمپنی نے اپنا اشتہار ترمیم کیا اور واضح کیا کہ غلط معلومات صرف ایک ٹائپوگرافیکل غلطی کی وجہ سے آئیں، دانستہ طور پر غلط بیانی نہیں کی گئی۔

مقامی باشندوں نے ان دعووں پر شک کا اظہار کیا۔ ایک نامعلوم رہائشی نے کہا کہ یہاں زیادہ سماجی یا ثقافتی سہولیات دستیاب نہیں، جب کہ کونسلر ٹام شا نے کہا کہ بڑھتی ہوئی لندن کی ہاؤسنگ قیمتوں کے باوجود، لٹن کے فلیٹس کی قیمتیں 'کافی تخیل' کی متقاضی ہیں۔

یہ منصوبہ جم اور چوبیس گھنٹے کے کنسیئرج کی سہولت کے ساتھ 2016 میں مکمل ہونا ہے۔ اسٹوڈنٹس کے کمرے 56,000 پاؤنڈ سے شروع ہو رہے ہیں، جو کہ سستے گھر فراہم کرنے کی شرط کا حصہ ہیں۔

آرٹیکل میں یہ بھی بتایا گیا ہے کہ کئی ایئرپورٹس اور ترقیاتی منصوبے لندن کے نام کا استعمال کرتے ہیں حالانکہ وہ شہر سے دور ہیں، جیسے لندن لٹن ایئرپورٹ اور لندن آکسفورڈ ایئرپورٹ۔

لٹن کو ماضی میں منفی شہرت بھی ملی—2004 میں اسے برطانیہ کے 'بدترین رہائشی مقامات' میں سرفہرست قرار دیا گیا، حالانکہ یہاں 185,000 سے زیادہ لوگ آباد ہیں۔

RE/MAX نے بتایا ہے کہ یہ فلیٹس بنیادی طور پر چین اور ملائیشیا جیسے ممالک کے غیر ملکی سرمایہ کاروں کے لیے بنائے گئے ہیں۔

Union Bank of Nigeria has increased the offer price for its minority shareholders’ shares from N7.00 to N7.70 per unit. The announcement, signed by Company Secretary Somuyiwa Sonubi, comes as the bank approaches the final stage of its plan to delist from the Nigerian Exchange Limited (NGX).

Following NGX rules and recent amendments, Union Bank is seeking final approval to delist its shares. Subject to sanction by the Federal High Court, shareholders will receive N7.70 per share through a court-ordered arrangement.

In May, core investor Titan Trust Bank Limited confirmed its intention to acquire all minority stakes. Titan Trust Bank became Union Bank’s controlling stakeholder in 2022. Founded in January 1970, Union Bank is the second-oldest bank in Nigeria.

Financially, Union Bank reported a profit after tax of N12.6 billion for Q1 2023, marking a 127.6% increase year-on-year. Non-interest income grew by 122.7% to N25.6 billion, supported by strong trading and fees and commissions.

NGX کے قواعد و ضوابط اور حالیہ ترامیم کے تحت، یونین بینک اپنی شیئرز کی ڈی لسٹنگ کے لیے حتمی منظوری کا منتظر ہے۔ فیڈرل ہائی کورٹ کی منظوری کے بعد، ایک عدالتی حکم کے تحت اقلیتی شیئر ہولڈرز کو فی شیئر N7.70 ادا کیا جائے گا۔

article_content: A massive explosion devastated an Iranian missile base located approximately 25 miles east of Tehran on November 12, 2011, causing widespread destruction and leaving debris scattered across the site. Iranian officials stated the blast, which resulted in 17 deaths including Brigadier General Hassan Moghaddam—a leading figure in the nation's missile development—was an accident triggered during ammunition transportation. However, the high-profile nature of Moghaddam’s death fueled speculation about potential acts of sabotage, with some observers suggesting the involvement of Israel’s intelligence agency, Mossad. Adding to concerns, another explosion shook the city of Isfahan just days later. Although the blast raised alarms about safety and management within Iran’s defense programs, Iranian authorities attributed the incident to a routine military drill and firmly denied any connection between the event and the nearby Uranium Conversion Facility. A Washington-based research institute, the Institute for Science and International Security, released satellite images showing severe destruction at the missile base but stated that the photographs did not reveal what actually caused the explosion. Paul Brannan, a senior analyst at the institute, explained that the exact cause remained uncertain and described the risks associated with volatile missile-related work. According to the institute’s intelligence, the explosion may have occurred during a critical phase in the development of a new missile, possibly when personnel handled a sensitive missile engine procedure. This incident is the latest in a series of mishaps affecting Iran’s missile and nuclear projects over the past two years. For example, in 2010, a similar explosion at a Shahab-3 missile base resulted in 18 deaths and was attributed to a fire in an ammunition depot. Concerns have been amplified following a recent International Atomic Energy Agency report, which renewed international debate over Iran’s nuclear intentions and triggered renewed talk in Israel about potential pre-emptive action.

article_content: Chelsea goalkeeper Thibaut Courtois has been ruled out of the upcoming Premier League match against Hull City due to a minor muscle injury sustained during training. Manager Jose Mourinho confirmed that Courtois’ injury is not serious but will prevent him from playing this weekend. As a result, Petr Cech will make his first Premier League start of the season. Cech, who lost his starting spot to Courtois at the beginning of the campaign, has played only 66 minutes in the Premier League this season, coming on as a substitute during October’s win over Arsenal. However, he has featured in the Capital One Cup and the Champions League. Mourinho expressed complete confidence in Cech, asserting that the veteran goalkeeper does not need to prove his quality to anyone at the club. The manager stated that it is natural for Cech to step in, and he is comfortable with the situation. Mark Schwarzer will be on the bench as Cech’s backup. Addressing rumors of Cech potentially leaving the club in the upcoming January transfer window, Mourinho dismissed the possibility and referenced Cech’s agent, who said there is no chance of a move. Mourinho emphasized his satisfaction with the depth of Chelsea’s goalkeeping options. Among other squad updates, captain John Terry will return to the starting lineup against Hull, and Ruben Loftus-Cheek participated in Friday’s training session at Cobham.

article_content: Young professionals often wrestle with deciding what matters most in a first job: pay, the company's reputation, or its workplace environment. While prestigious brands and high salaries can strengthen your resume or boost negotiation power, they don't automatically lead to career success. Anshuman Das, CEO and co-founder at Careernet, highlights that a respected company's name shows credibility and experience, while a strong salary sets you up for future negotiations. On the other hand, Himanshu Arora from Social Panga urges early-career people to focus on real skills and hands-on learning, noting that financial rewards tend to follow when you've mastered your craft. Starting with lower pay may create some short-term money issues and slow down savings or future salary bumps. But Das says this isn't a dead end—if you build skills, find mentors, and chase new opportunities, you can overcome these challenges. Arora also warns that accepting less money at the start can leave you undervalued or less motivated, making it harder to achieve financial goals. Yet, if the job offers long-term growth or valuable experience, it may be a smart move despite lower initial pay. He suggests weighing what you might sacrifice versus what you might gain. In fields like consulting, legal, or banking, a top brand often opens more doors than a big paycheck. These industries value reputation, networking, and high-quality experience. Meanwhile, startups may offer quicker advancement and leadership opportunities, even if they're lesser-known and pay less upfront—their vision and connections can outweigh brand. Both Das and Arora agree that a supportive work environment leads to greater job satisfaction than salary alone. If the culture is toxic, even a high-paying role can lead to burnout and turnover. A workplace that offers personal growth and positive relationships goes much farther. Company culture is essential for retaining talent and ensuring steady development. According to Das, a welcoming and mission-driven culture keeps people motivated, productive, and emotionally connected. Prioritizing work-life balance and well-being improves loyalty and performance. Arora points out that real company culture isn't about perks or trendy offices, but about genuine shared values and consistent day-to-day behaviors. In the end, while money and reputation count, experts say that for a thriving and lasting career, it's the chance to learn in a positive environment that matters most.

article_content: A tragic event unfolded in Pompano Beach, Florida, when 14-year-old Jerry Cunningham was gravely injured after becoming trapped by a Broward County Transit bus as he ran to help his mother board. Security video captured Jerry sprinting towards the bus, only to get his arm caught in the doors as they closed. The driver, Reinaldo Soto, who appeared to be distracted and conversing with passengers, failed to notice Jerry’s predicament. As the bus pulled away, Jerry was dragged for several seconds and was dragged underneath the vehicle. Alarmed passengers began shouting and one woman physically alerted the driver. When the bus stopped, Soto and other passengers — joined by Jerry’s mother — rushed to his side to give assistance. Jerry sustained fractures to his face, ribs, and ankle, requiring a medically induced coma at Broward Health Medical Center. The entire incident was recorded from several security camera points of view. Soto, a 12-year transit veteran, has been placed on paid administrative leave as an investigation by authorities continues and possible criminal charges are reviewed.

Daisy, a young giraffe at Southwick Zoo in Massachusetts, has experienced a challenging start to life. Born in January 2014, Daisy was exceptionally large for a female calf, measuring six feet tall and weighing 140 pounds. Her mother, Dotty, did not recognize her as a calf because of her size and ceased producing milk, leading to Daisy’s abandonment.

Without her mother’s milk, Daisy’s white blood cell count dropped dangerously low, resulting in an infection. The team at Southwick Zoo, with support from the School of Veterinary Medicine at Tufts University in Grafton, Massachusetts, is now caring for her. Daisy is being fed through a tube held by a bandage around her neck and wears a special coat to stay warm.

To safeguard her health, Daisy is kept separate from other giraffes to prevent accidental injury. Zoo visitors will have the opportunity to see Daisy when the zoo reopens on April 12, 2014.

article_content: During the festive season, banks and non-banking finance companies (NBFCs) often roll out attractive offers on car and home loans, such as lower interest rates, waived processing fees, and cashback. This encourages many people to make significant purchases, like buying a car, during festivals such as Diwali and Dhanteras. If you are considering a car purchase with festive offers, it's important to compare car loan options carefully. When financing through a dealer, the dealer arranges the loan via their partnered lenders. While this is convenient, remember that dealers may only work with select banks and might direct you to finance arms that offer them higher commissions. Always compare the dealer’s offer with other banks or online lending platforms to find the best rate. Interest rate is a key factor. Lenders offer fixed or floating rates, both typically linked to their marginal cost of funds-based lending rate (MCLR). Fixed rates provide certainty, while floating rates can benefit borrowers if interest rates decline. Usually, one bank offers only one type of rate. Be aware of flat vs. reducing interest rates. Some captive finance companies and NBFCs offer flat rates, which may appear lower but end up costing more over time compared to reducing rates. Flat rates are calculated on the entire loan amount for the full tenure, while reducing rates calculate interest only on the outstanding principal. Aside from the interest rate, pay attention to processing fees and additional charges. Processing fees usually amount to about 0.5% of the loan (plus taxes), while documentation charges might be Rs. 500–700 per loan. Many lenders also charge prepayment or foreclosure penalties, often between 3%–6% of the outstanding principal. Some lenders may waive these during festive offers, but always check the terms and conditions for any restrictions. Other considerations include whether your loan covers the car’s ex-showroom or on-road price. Ex-showroom price includes the manufacturer's cost, dealer margin, and transportation. On-road price adds registration, road tax, and insurance. Most lenders finance up to 95–100% of the ex-showroom price but only up to 85% of the on-road price, which can significantly affect your loan amount. The tenure of your car loan also matters. Loans generally range from 12 to 84 months. While longer tenures result in lower EMIs, they increase the total interest paid. article_content: A statue honoring Helen Keller will soon be unveiled in the U.S. Capitol’s National Statuary Hall, making history as the first statue there depicting both a person with a disability and a child, according to Alabama state officials. Helen Keller, hailing from Tuscumbia, Alabama, lost her sight and hearing as a young child due to illness. Thanks to her dedicated teacher, Anne Sullivan, she learned to communicate using the manual alphabet, eventually triumphing over immense obstacles to become a renowned author, activist, and recipient of the Presidential Medal of Freedom. The new statue captures Keller at the famous 1887 moment when she, as a child, first comprehended language while Anne Sullivan spelled ‘W-A-T-E-R’ into her hand at a water pump—a scene immortalized in the play and film ‘The Miracle Worker’. Nancy Starnes from the National Organization on Disability welcomed the development, highlighting its significance in recognizing the historic impact of people with disabilities. The statue’s creation was spearheaded by former U.S. Rep. and now Alabama Governor Bob Riley, who celebrated Keller’s inspiration. Sculpted by Edward Hlavka, the bronze work weighs about 600 pounds and stands on Alabama marble. Funding was raised privately by a committee led by Alabama First Lady Patsy Riley. This statue’s addition also reflects growing awareness about the importance of accurate disability representation. For instance, criticism of the FDR memorial led to a later addition of a statue depicting Roosevelt in a wheelchair. Helen Keller’s statue is set to replace that of Jabez Curry, former president of Howard College, whose statue has represented Alabama in the Capitol since 1908 and will return to Alabama for display. Alabama’s other statue in the Capitol is of Joseph Wheeler, who served both as a Confederate and U.S. Army general. Andy Imparato, president of the American Association of People with Disabilities, expressed hope that the Keller statue will increase appreciation of the achievements and long-standing contributions of people with disabilities, especially among visiting schoolchildren. Starnes further emphasized the need for regular recognition of people with disabilities in American history, not just during designated times like Women’s History Month.

article_content: Mark D. Jones, who claimed to be an American billionaire, made headlines with a proposal to buy the decommissioned HMS Ark Royal for £375 million. His ambitious plan was to transform the 600-foot aircraft carrier into a floating hospital that could assist in emergency relief following natural disasters. This initiative promised to generate hundreds of jobs, especially in Belfast, where the ship was to undergo a multi-million-pound refit. However, recent developments reveal that Jones, 44 and British-born, is actually in jail in upstate New York. He is awaiting extradition to Las Vegas, facing allegations of fraud. Prosecutors assert that Jones is not a billionaire, but a con artist accused of defrauding a woman of over £100,000 in an investment scheme aimed at helping Native Americans. He had previously operated a construction business, Stratezyme, in Tennessee, but has been avoiding court for over a year. Las Vegas authorities, such as chief deputy attorney John Kelleher, have described Jones in harsh terms, calling him a 'Walter Mitty' figure and claiming that he squandered stolen funds on extravagances like strippers and luxury hotels. Jones is currently awaiting his extradition hearing in Lockport, near Niagara Falls. HMS Ark Royal, an Invincible Class aircraft carrier launched in 1981 and decommissioned in 2010, was put up for online sale after government defense cuts. Ideas for its future included scrapping, turning it into a nightclub, or converting it for diving tourism. Jones's vision was to sail the ship to Belfast for conversion into a hospital vessel equipped with a desalination plant to provide clean water in disaster zones, as well as construction equipment to aid reconstruction efforts.

article_content: Erik Lamela, who joined Tottenham in 2013 anticipating great achievements as Gareth Bale’s replacement, has faced tough times trying to meet lofty expectations. While not as publicly self-critical as fellow player Roberto Soldado, Lamela has still felt the pressures of his sizeable transfer fee. Tasked with filling Bale’s shoes in terms of goal-scoring from the wings, he’s struggled to fully justify his £30 million transfer from Roma. Tottenham hosted Burnley at White Hart Lane on Saturday, with Harry Kane opening the scoring in the 21st minute, continuing his impressive form. However, Burnley responded quickly as Ashley Barnes equalized in the 27th minute, taking advantage of a misplaced pass from Lamela and launching a superb long-range shot. Lamela made up for his earlier error less than ten minutes later by curling in a spectacular left-footed goal from 25 yards—channeling memories of Bale’s heroics. This was Lamela’s first Premier League goal and a timely personal breakthrough after his mistakes earlier in the match. Manager Mauricio Pochettino was positive about Lamela’s future, highlighting how important the goal was for his confidence and settling into English football. He emphasized that young players sometimes need time to adjust to new clubs and environments. Alongside Lamela, Tottenham’s forward line of Nacer Chadli, Christian Eriksen, and Harry Kane contributed to the club’s third win in six days. Kane further stood out as Tottenham’s attacking leader, scoring his 14th goal of the season and displaying impressive playmaking skills. Burnley manager Sean Dyche voiced his dissatisfaction regarding Tottenham’s opening goal, questioning both the potential offside and the free-kick that led up to it. Nevertheless, Burnley’s equalizer was expertly finished by Barnes, assisted by teammates after Lamela’s midfield error. Despite the setback of Ryan Mason’s ankle injury late in the first half, Tottenham dominated the match in both possession (69%) and attempts on goal. Goalkeeper Hugo Lloris played a crucial role in the victory, especially by saving Ross Wallace’s powerful free-kick near the end. With this 2-1 win, Tottenham keep their quest for a Champions League spot alive, with Lamela’s remarkable goal capping off a significant display for both himself and the team.
translated_content: ایرِک لامیلا، جو 2013 میں ٹوٹنہم میں شامل ہوئے تھے اور گیریتھ بیل کی جگہ بڑے ارادوں کے ساتھ آئے، کو ان توقعات پر پورا اترنے میں مشکلات پیش آئیں۔ اگرچہ وہ اپنے ساتھی کھلاڑی روبرٹو سولدادو کی طرح کھلے عام خود پر تنقید نہیں کرتے، لامیلا نے پھر بھی اپنے بڑے ٹرانسفر فیس کا دباؤ محسوس کیا۔ ونگ سے گول اسکورنگ میں بیل کی کمی پوری کرنے کی کوشش میں وہ رومہ سے £30 ملین کے ٹرانسفر کی مکمل توقعات پوری نہ کر سکے۔ گزشتہ ہفتے ٹوٹنہم نے وائٹ ہارٹ لین میں برنلی کا مقابلہ کیا، جہاں ہیری کَین نے 21 ویں منٹ میں شاندار فارم کے ساتھ پہلا گول کیا۔ تاہم برنلی نے فوراً جواب دیا اور ایشلے بارنس نے لامیلا کی غلط پاس کا فائدہ اٹھا کر 27 ویں منٹ میں بہترین لانگ رینج گول کے ساتھ میچ برابر کر دیا۔ تقریباً دس منٹ بعد، لامیلا نے اپنی پچھلی غلطی کا ازالہ کیا اور 25 گز دور سے بائیں پاؤں سے کمال کا گول کیا—جس نے بیل کے سنہری دنوں کی یاد تازہ کر دی۔ یہ لامیلا کا پہلا پریمیئر لیگ گول تھا اور ان کے لیے ایک بڑی ذاتی کامیابی بھی تھی۔ مینجر موریسیو پوچٹینو نے کہا کہ یہ گول لامیلا کے اعتماد کے لیے نہایت اہم تھا اور یہ انہیں انگلش فٹبال کے ماحول میں بہتر ایڈجسٹ کرنے میں مدد دے گا۔ انہوں نے کہا کہ نوجوان کھلاڑیوں کو نئے کلب اور ثقافت میں وقت درکار ہوتا ہے۔ لامیلا کے علاوہ، ٹوٹنہم کے حملے میں نیسر چَدلی، کرسچن اریکسن اور ہیری کَین شامل رہے جن کی بدولت ٹیم کو چھ دنوں میں تیسری جیت مل گئی۔ کَین نہ صرف اپنا چودھواں سیزن گول اسکور کرنے میں کامیاب ہوئے بلکہ انہوں نے عمدہ پاسنگ اور کھیل کا مظاہرہ بھی کیا۔ برنلی کے مینیجر شان ڈائچ نے ٹوٹنہم کے پہلے گول پر اعتراض کیا، خاص طور پر آف سائڈ اور فری کک کے فیصلے پر۔ اس کے باجود، برنلی کی جانب سے بارنس نے، لامیلا کی غلطی کے فوری بعد، بہترین ٹیم ورک کے ساتھ عمدہ گول کر کے میچ برابر کر دیا۔ پہلے ہاف کے اختتام پر ریان میسن کی ٹخنے کی انجری کے باوجود، ٹوٹنہم نے گیند پر 69 فیصد قبضہ اور زیادہ گول کی کوششوں کے ساتھ میچ پر حاوی رہے۔ گول کیپر ہیوگو لوریس نے خصوصاً آخری لمحات میں راس والیس کی زبردست فری کک روک کر فتح محفوظ بنائی۔ اس 2-1 فتح کے ساتھ ٹوٹنہم چیمپئنز لیگ کی دوڑ میں برقرار ہے، جبکہ لامیلا کا گول نہ صرف ان کے لیے بلکہ پوری ٹیم کے لیے ایک یادگار لمحہ تھا۔

China’s economic growth slowed unexpectedly in the first quarter of the year, sparking global financial market turmoil and a sharp decline in commodity prices, particularly gold. The world’s second-largest economy expanded by 7.7% compared to the previous year—down from 7.9% in the prior quarter and below market expectations of around 8%.

The slowdown in Chinese growth caused major global stock indices to fall. The Dow Jones Industrial Average dropped more than 155 points (about 1%) by early afternoon; the Nasdaq lost over 50 points (more than 1.5%). The Standard & Poor's 500 index declined by 18 points (1.2%), with the materials and energy sectors suffering the biggest losses—down about 3%. London's FTSE 100 also tumbled, sliding over 72 points to 6,312, as concerns over weakening Chinese demand heavily impacted mining stocks.

Gold prices fell dramatically, briefly dropping over $30 in minutes and reaching their lowest level in more than two years, falling below $1,400 per ounce—a nearly 9% drop on the day. Gold, already under pressure from a proposed sale of Cypriot gold holdings and disappointing US data, saw investors rapidly reducing positions. Other commodities such as oil, copper, and silver also suffered sharp declines.

Experts attributed the market turmoil to anxieties about the health of the Chinese economy and its global repercussions. Analyst Dominic Schnider noted that panic selling of gold may have been triggered by perceptions that the US Federal Reserve could reduce its economic stimulus program, undermining trust in gold as a safe haven. Analysts at Goldman Sachs and Societe Generale have recently warned that gold prices could drop further, with the latter predicting a prolonged decline.

Concerns remain that China’s recovery, following its deepest slump since the 2008 global financial crisis, is being supported mainly by bank lending and government investment, while consumer spending growth is subdued. The surge in lending has prompted credit ratings agency Fitch to cut China’s local currency rating, citing increased financial risks from rapid credit expansion. Fitch estimates that China’s total credit, including informal lending, may have soared to 198% of GDP in 2012, up from 125% in 2008.

Recent economic data from China has offered mixed signals. While import growth accelerated, potentially indicating increased demand, some analysts believe this could be skewed by inaccurate trade data. Factory output growth in March slowed to 8.9%, its weakest since August 2012. Despite substantial new lending, investment growth in the first quarter slowed, suggesting persistent structural issues such as overcapacity in several industries.

There were some positive signs—in particular, retail sales rose 12.6% in March, and recent wage increases and a stronger property market may help boost consumer spending. Nevertheless, economists caution that weak exports could dampen confidence and recovery momentum. On the day of the announcement, the World Bank trimmed its forecast for China’s 2013 growth by 0.1 percentage points, to 8.3%—still high by global standards, but well below the breakneck pace of previous years.

چین کی معیشت میں سال کی پہلی سہ ماہی میں غیر متوقع طور پر سست روی آئی، جس سے عالمی مالیاتی منڈیوں میں ہلچل اور خاص طور پر سونے کی قیمت میں زبردست کمی دیکھنے میں آئی۔ دنیا کی دوسری سب سے بڑی معیشت نے گزشتہ سال کی نسبت 7.7 فیصد کی شرح سے ترقی کی — یہ پچھلی سہ ماہی کی 7.9 فیصد اور مارکیٹ کی توقعات 8 فیصد سے کم ہے۔

چینی معیشت کی سست روی کے باعث دنیا بھر کے اہم اسٹاک انڈیکس نیچے آ گئے۔ ڈاؤ جونز انڈسٹریل ایوریج دوپہر تک 155 پوائنٹس (تقریباً 1 فیصد) سے زیادہ گر گیا؛ نیسڈیک میں 50 پوائنٹس (1.5 فیصد) سے زیادہ کی کمی ہوئی۔ اسٹینڈرڈ اینڈ پورز 500 انڈیکس 18 پوائنٹس (1.2 فیصد) نیچے آیا۔ خاص طور پر مٹیریل اور انرجی سیکٹرز میں سب سے زیادہ کمی دیکھی گئی — تقریباً 3 فیصد۔ لندن کا ایف ٹی ایس ای 100 بھی 72 پوائنٹس سے زیادہ کم ہوکر 6312 پر پہنچ گیا، کیونکہ چین کی کمزور طلب نے کان کنی شیئرز کو سب سے زیادہ متاثر کیا۔

سونے کی قیمت میں شدید کمی ہوئی، جو چند لمحوں میں 30 ڈالر سے زیادہ گری اور دو سال بعد اپنی کم ترین سطح $1,400 فی اونس سے نیچے آ گئی — جو تقریباً 9 فیصد کی یومیہ کمی تھی۔ سونے پر پہلے ہی قبرص کے سونے کی مجوزہ فروخت اور امریکی اعداد و شمار کی مایوسی سے دباؤ تھا، جبکہ تیل، تانبا اور چاندی سمیت دیگر اجناس کی قیمتیں بھی تیزی سے گریں۔

ماہرین نے منڈی میں ہلچل کا ذمہ دار چین کی معیشت کی صحت اور اس کے عالمی اثرات پر خدشات کو ٹھہرایا۔ تجزیہ کار ڈومینک شنائیڈر کے مطابق، سونے کی panic selling غالباً امریکی فیڈرل ریزرو کی مانیٹری پالیسی میں کمی کے خدشے سے شروع ہوئی، جس نے سونے پر اعتماد کو متاثر کیا۔ گولڈمین ساکس اور سوسائٹی جنرل کے ماہرین نے حال ہی میں سونے کی قیمتوں میں مزید کمی کی پیشگوئی کی ہے، سوسائٹی جنرل نے اس رجحان کے مسلسل رہنے کی توقع ظاہر کی ہے۔

چین کی معاشی بحالی، جو 2008 کے مالیاتی بحران کے بعد سب سے بڑی مندی میں چلی گئی تھی، ابھی بھی بنیادی طور پر بینک کے قرضوں اور حکومتی سرمایہ کاری پر انحصار کررہی ہے، جبکہ صارفین کی خرچ کرنے کی رفتار کمزور ہے۔ قرضوں کے اس اضافے نے فچ ریٹنگز کو چین کی مقامی کرنسی کی ریٹنگ کم کرنے پر مجبور کیا اور مالیاتی خطرات میں اضافے سے خبردار کیا۔ فچ کے مطابق چین کا مجموعی قرضہ (غیررسمی قرضہ جات سمیت) 2012 میں جی ڈی پی کے 198 فیصد تک پہنچ گیا جو 2008 میں 125 فیصد تھا۔

چین سے ملنے والے اقتصادی اعداد و شمار نے ملا جلا تاثر دیا ہے۔ اگرچہ درآمدات میں اضافہ ہوا ہے، جس سے ممکنہ طور پر طلب میں بہتری آئی ہے، کچھ ماہرین اس ڈیٹا کو بالکل درست نہیں سمجھتے۔ مارچ میں فیکٹری آؤٹ پٹ کی شرح کم ہوکر 8.9 فیصد رہی جو اگست 2012 کے بعد سب سے کم ہے۔ وسیع پیمانے پر نئے قرضوں کے باوجود، پہلی سہ ماہی میں سرمایہ کاری کی شرح کم ہوگئی، جس سے ساختیاتی مسائل جیسے اضافی پیداواری صلاحیت واضح ہیں۔

article_content: South Korea has announced it will resume aerial surveillance along the North Korean border following Pyongyang’s claim of launching a military spy satellite into orbit. In response to North Korea's announcement, Seoul's State Council agreed to temporarily suspend parts of a 2018 military agreement with the North, paving the way for increased monitoring of frontier areas, officials said on Wednesday. Heo Tae-keun, South Korea’s deputy minister of national defence policy, described the North’s launch as 'a serious violation of UN resolutions' and 'a grave provocation to our national security.' He added that any further provocations by North Korea would meet with a swift and strong response, backed by South Korea’s alliance with the United States. The military accord signed in 2018 established buffer and no-fly zones near the tense border and banned cross-border aerial reconnaissance and firing drills. It also called for both sides to reduce guard posts and remove some landmines. However, Seoul is now partially putting this arrangement on hold. According to officials from South Korea and Japan – the latter being the first to report the satellite launch – it is still unconfirmed if North Korea’s satellite reached orbit. North Korea had earlier notified Japan about its launch plans, scheduled between November 22 and December 1. The Pentagon said it is still evaluating the outcome. A day after the claimed launch, North Korea released photos of leader Kim Jong Un inspecting images said to be taken by the new satellite of sensitive US military sites. Previous North Korean attempts to place spy satellites into orbit this year had failed, but recent reports suggested another launch was imminent. South Korea’s decision to step up military monitoring has added fresh strain to already heightened inter-Korean tensions. North Korea defends its right to develop satellites as a matter of sovereignty and self-defense against US and allied militaries. Internationally, North Korea’s space launches are widely viewed as cover for developing nuclear-capable missiles, in violation of United Nations prohibitions. The US, South Korea, and Japan regularly hold joint drills to counter North Korea’s advancing arsenal and denounced the satellite launch as a 'brazen violation' of UN rules. US National Security Council spokeswoman Adrienne Watson warned that the launch threatens regional and global stability. Meanwhile, China called on all sides to remain calm and work towards a political solution, with Foreign Ministry spokesperson Mao Ning urging efforts to defuse tensions.

article_content:
Prince William appeared visibly moved when he was invited to sign the historic First Fleet Bible in Sydney, placing his signature alongside that of his late mother, Princess Diana. The signing took place after an Easter Sunday service at St Andrew’s Cathedral, where the Prince and the Duchess of Cambridge were presented with the priceless First Fleet Bible and Book of Common Prayer. The Bible, originally used in Australia’s first Christian service in 1788 by Reverend Richard Johnson, has, over the past century, been signed by several members of the Royal Family. Notably, Queen Elizabeth II signed it in 1954, Prince Charles and Princess Diana in 1983, the Duke and Duchess of York in 1988, and Queen Elizabeth the Queen Mother in 1958.

Rev Justin Moffatt, rector of St Phillip’s Church where the books are kept, showed the Bible to Prince William, who took a keen interest in the signatures of his relatives. Both William and Kate added their names on the same page as Charles and Diana. Rev Moffatt commented that the Prince, despite being well-briefed, seemed genuinely surprised and touched to see so many of his family's signatures. He also noted Prince William’s lighthearted remark, 'It’s in very good nick!' and explained to him that the books are carefully preserved.

Rev Moffatt also shared that the Prince appeared moved when shown the page on the Solemnization of Matrimony, which bore ink blots from early Christian marriages in Australia, and he explained these were made by the first convicts to settle in the country. Prince William found this historical connection fascinating.

Later, the Royal couple visited Taronga Zoo with their son, Prince George, who was particularly interested in seeing a bilby named after him. The Duchess of Cambridge wore a stylish dove grey Alexander McQueen coat, complemented by a Jane Taylor hat and Gucci shoes at the cathedral. At the end of the day, the family traveled to Canberra, with Duchess Kate changing into a blue Stella McCartney dress and Prince George donning navy shorts and a cardigan by Rachel Riley.

پرنس ولیم اس وقت جذباتی نظر آئے جب انہیں سڈنی میں تاریخی 'فرسٹ فلیٹ بائبل' پر اپنی والدہ لیڈی ڈیانا کی دستخط کے ساتھ اپنا نام لکھنے کی دعوت دی گئی۔ یہ واقعہ اسٹینڈریوز کیتھیڈرل میں ایسٹر سنڈے سروس کے بعد پیش آیا، جہاں پرنس اور ڈچز آف کیمبرج کو قیمتی 'فرسٹ فلیٹ بائبل' اور 'بک آف کامن پریئر' پیش کی گئی۔ یہ بائبل آسٹریلیا کی پہلی عیسائی عبادت میں 1788 میں ریورنڈ رچرڈ جانسن نے استعمال کی تھی اور پچھلے ایک سو سال میں شاہی خاندان کے کئی افراد نے اس پر دستخط کیے۔ خاص طور پر ملکہ الزبتھ دوم نے 1954 میں، پرنس چارلس اور لیڈی ڈیانا نے 1983 میں، ڈیوک اور ڈچز آف یورک نے 1988 میں اور کوئین مدر نے 1958 میں دستخط کیے۔

ریورنڈ جسٹن موفات، جو سینٹ فلپس چرچ کے ریکٹر ہیں جہاں یہ کتب رکھی گئی ہیں، نے بائبل پرنس ولیم کو دکھائی۔ ولیم اپنے اہل خانہ کے دستخط دیکھ کر کافی دلچسپی لے رہے تھے۔ ولیم اور کیٹ نے چارلس اور ڈیانا کے ساتھ اسی صفحے پر اپنے دستخط کیے۔ ریورنڈ موفات نے کہا کہ پرنس کو اچھی طرح بریفنگ دی گئی تھی، پھر بھی اتنے زیادہ دستخط دیکھ کر وہ واقعی حیران اور جذباتی ہوئے۔ موفات نے پرنس ولیم کے ہلکے پھلکے تبصرے کا ذکر بھی کیا: 'یہ بہت اچھی حالت میں ہے!' اور بتایا کہ ان کتابوں کو سنبھال کر رکھا گیا ہے۔

ریورنڈ موفات نے یہ بھی بتایا کہ ولیم اس وقت متاثر ہوئے جب انہیں شادی کے صفحہ پر لے جایا گیا، جس پر آسٹریلیا کی پہلی عیسائی شادیوں کے دستخط سے کچھ سیاہی کے نشانات تھے۔ انہوں نے وضاحت کی کہ یہ نشانات ان پہلے قیدیوں کے تھے جو یہاں آباد ہوئے تھے۔ پرنس ولیم کو یہ تاریخی ربط بھی دلچسپ لگا۔

بعد میں شاہی جوڑے نے اپنے بیٹے پرنس جارج کے ساتھ ٹارونگا چڑیا گھر کا دورہ کیا، جہاں جارج اپنے نام والے بلبی کو دیکھ کر خوش ہوا۔ ڈچز آف کیمبرج نے خاکستری رنگ کا الیگزینڈر مک کوئین کوٹ، جین ٹیلر ہیٹ اور گوچی کے جوتے پہن رکھے تھے۔ دن کے اختتام پر، خاندان کینبرا گیا، جہاں کیٹ نے نیلا اسٹیلہ مک کارٹنی لباس اور جارج نے راچل رائلی کے نیوی شارٹس اور کارڈیگن پہن لیے تھے۔

article_content: A violent incident occurred during a rally in National City celebrating the San Diego Chargers’ season, where three Chargers fans assaulted a Denver Broncos supporter. The altercation, which included punching and stomping, was recorded on video, causing bystanders to scatter. Police responded swiftly, arresting three Chargers fans and one Broncos fan. The trigger for the fight is still under investigation, and it is not confirmed if any of those detained required hospitalization. In the upheaval, a police dog bit a television photojournalist. The journalist was treated for minor injuries but continued his coverage. Despite the disruption, the rally went on. Meanwhile, in NFL news, the Denver Broncos, led by Peyton Manning, defeated the Chargers 24-17 to reach the AFC Championship for the first time in eight years. Thanks to contributions from players like Wes Welker and Knowshon Moreno, the Broncos will face the New England Patriots and quarterback Tom Brady in the upcoming game. Manning completed 25 of 36 passes for 230 yards and two touchdowns. Although his performance fell short of his regular season records, the Broncos prioritized the running game, gaining 133 yards overall, with Moreno contributing 82 yards and a touchdown. Despite a late surge from the Chargers, key plays by Manning in the closing minutes ensured the Broncos' win and advancement.

article_content: Marlon Brown, a resident of Florida, died after being run over by a DeLand police car during a pursuit initiated because officers allegedly saw him without a seatbelt. Brown left his car on a dead-end street and tried to escape on foot, when Officer James Harris hit him with his police car. The incident was recorded on Harris’s dashboard camera. After the incident, a grand jury did not indict Harris for vehicular manslaughter. While Harris has been dismissed from the police force, he has not issued any public statements. Seeking to bring charges against Harris, Brown’s family made the dashcam video public, asserting their quest is for justice. Krystal Brown, Marlon’s ex-wife and mother of his children, said that sharing the difficult footage was necessary for accountability. Although the city of DeLand paid the family a $550,000 settlement, officials denied any fault. The family continues to advocate for criminal prosecution, stating their demand is for fair and equal treatment. DeLand Police Chief William Ridgway criticized Harris’s actions as inconsistent with departmental policies, which contributed to Harris’s firing. An internal investigation is also underway to assess police procedures and policies. State Attorney R.J. Larizza referred the case to a grand jury instead of filing charges directly, citing the need for community involvement in such decisions. After the grand jury’s decision, Larizza affirmed this approach, but Brown’s family remains disappointed in the justice system’s results. Authorities are examining extensive documentation to determine whether proper tactics were employed and if department policies need changes. The case has heightened discussions about police accountability, with Brown’s family maintaining that nonviolent offenses should not escalate to fatal incidents.

article_content: Demonstrators in Ukraine calling for closer EU ties forced riot police to withdraw from Independence Square in Kyiv after officials attempted a pre-dawn crackdown. This withdrawal undermined President Viktor Yanukovych’s authority, as public protests continue in response to his rejection of an EU agreement in favor of stronger ties with Russia. International authorities strongly censured the Ukrainian government's actions, with US officials and EU leaders labeling the police response as excessive and undemocratic. Notably, US Secretary of State John Kerry and EU foreign policy chief Catherine Ashton condemned the government's use of force against protesters. In Independence Square, riot police dismantled barricades and tents, leading to violent clashes and several injuries. Protesters fortified their defenses, chanted slogans, and resisted police advances, using creative means like freezing the ground to slow officers. Despite severe winter conditions, many remained at the site, supported by volunteers. President Yanukovych offered the conditional release of detained protesters and indicated willingness to discuss further cooperation with international institutions, including the IMF. Opposition leaders, such as Vitali Klitschko, demanded the resignation of the government, immediate commitment to the EU deal, and accountability for police actions. Ukraine’s unrest reflects a deeper conflict between pursuing European integration and yielding to Russian pressure, as economic incentives and sanctions shape government decisions. With the national economy in distress, the protests underscore widespread dissatisfaction and the ongoing struggle to determine Ukraine’s political future amid continued foreign mediation.

article_content: Nearly 200 men who were held as Prisoners of War during the Vietnam conflict are gathering this week at the Nixon Presidential Library to mark the 40th anniversary of their release. Most of these veterans served as pilots and are reuniting at the presidential memorial in Yorba Linda, California, to commemorate their return to the United States in 1973, after years of captivity and torture by the North Vietnamese. On Friday, the Nixon Library will recreate the star-studded event that President Richard Nixon hosted at the White House on May 24, 1973, celebrating the POWs’ homecoming—the largest dinner party ever held at the Executive Mansion. In 1973, Nixon welcomed 450 former POWs and their guests, and, together with his wife Pat, joined Irving Berlin and other entertainers on stage to perform 'God Bless America.' Cheering POWs were flown home from Gia Lam Airport in Hanoi, with scenes of excitement marking their return. One of the returning POWs was John McCain, now a Republican Senator from Arizona, who spent five years in a Vietnamese prison. Severely injured and held at the 'Hanoi Hilton' (Maison Centrale), McCain continues to experience lasting physical effects from his captivity. Nearly 600 Americans were captured by North Vietnamese forces during the war. After years of fierce combat and difficult negotiations, Nixon ordered the Christmas bombings in 1972. This offensive led to Secretary of State Henry Kissinger negotiating the January 1973 peace accords that called for a cease-fire and the release of prisoners, some of whom had been held for almost six years. The White House celebration for the POWs in 1973 gathered 1,300 guests under a massive tent set up on the South Lawn. The guest list included celebrities like Bob Hope, John Wayne, Sammy Davis Jr., and Irving Berlin, who performed the patriotic anthem 'God Bless America.' The dinner featured classic American dishes such as sirloin steak, fingerling potatoes, and strawberry mousse—meals the former prisoners had long dreamed of throughout their imprisonment. The Nixon Presidential Library opened a special exhibit, 'An All-American Homecoming,' on May 18 to commemorate the 40th anniversary of the POWs’ release. The current reunion features a motorcade for the former POWs, a BBQ dinner kickoff, and a formal dinner at the library's replica of the White House East Room, recreating the historic 1973 event. Prominent guests this year include Congressman Ed Royce and Texas business leader Ross Perot, with video tributes from Defense Secretary Chuck Hagel and former Secretary of State Henry Kissinger. While John McCain was among the 591 prisoners released in 1973, he will not be able to attend Friday's dinner. Members of the Nixon family—eldest daughter Tricia Nixon Cox, her son Christopher Nixon Cox, Andrea Catsimatidis, and Richard Nixon’s brother Ed Nixon—will be present. A choir composed of former POWs will perform a special song written during their captivity, as they did at the 1973 dinner, with 18 original members participating. Although the original 1973 dinner took place during the Watergate scandal, many POWs continue to praise President Nixon for securing their freedom. Retired Marine Captain Orson Swindle, who spent over six years in North Vietnamese prisons, told the Associated Press, 'He was a hero to us... he got us home.' Navy veteran Mike McGrath, who was 27 when his plane was shot down in 1967, recalled the splendor and hospitality of the White House event, where guests danced until the band stopped.
translated_content: ویتنام جنگ کے دوران قیدی بنائے گئے تقریباً 200 افراد اس ہفتے نکسن صدارتی لائبریری میں اپنی رہائی کی 40ویں سالگرہ منانے کے لیے جمع ہو رہے ہیں۔ ان میں سے زیادہ تر سابق فوجی پائلٹ
