لڑائی اور مشکل مذاکرات کے بعد، نکسن نے 1972 میں کرسمس بمباری کا حکم دیا۔ اس کارروائی کے نتیجے میں وزیر خارجہ ہنری کسِنگر نے جنوری 1973 میں امن معاہدہ کروایا، جس میں جنگ بندی اور قیدیوں کی رہائی شامل تھی۔ کچھ قیدی تقریباً چھ سال تک قید رہے تھے۔ 1973 کی وائٹ ہاؤس تقریب میں 1,300 مہمان ایک بڑے خیمے میں جمع ہوئے۔ مہمانوں میں معروف شخصیات جیسے باب ہوپ، جان وین، سیمی ڈیوس جونیئر اور ایروِنگ برلن شامل تھے، جنہوں نے 'گاڈ بلیس امریکہ' گایا۔ اس موقع پر روایتی امریکی کھانے مثلاً سرلوئن اسٹیک، فنگرنگ آلو اور اسٹرابیری موس پیش کیے گئے، جن کی سابق قیدیوں نے قید کے دوران شدید خواہش کی۔ نکسن صدارتی لائبریری نے قیدیوں کی رہائی کی 40 ویں سالگرہ کے موقع پر 18 مئی کو 'این آل امریکن ہوم کمنگ' کے نام سے خصوصی نمائش کا آغاز کیا۔ اس اجتماع میں سابق قیدیوں کے لیے موٹروکیڈ، باربی کیو ڈنر اور لائبریری کے وائٹ ہاؤس ایسٹ روم کی نقل میں رسمی ضیافت شامل ہے، جس میں 1973 کی تاریخی تقریب کو دوبارہ پیش کیا جائے گا۔ اس سال نمایاں مہمانوں میں کانگریس مین ایڈ رائس اور بزنس مین روس پیروٹ شامل ہیں، جبکہ وزیر دفاع چک ہیگل اور سابق وزیر خارجہ ہنری کسِنگر کی وڈیو خراجِ عقیدت بھی پیش کی جائے گی۔ اگرچہ جان مکین 1973 میں رہا ہونے والے 591 قیدیوں میں شامل تھے، وہ اس جمعہ کے ڈنر میں شریک نہیں ہو سکیں گے۔ نِکسن خاندان کے افراد—بڑی بیٹی ٹریشا نکسن کاکس، ان کے بیٹے کرسٹوفر نکسن کاکس، اینڈریا کیٹسیمیٹائڈس اور رچرڈ نکسن کے بھائی ایڈ نکسن—شرکت کریں گے۔ سابق قیدیوں پر مشتمل ایک کوآئر وہ خصوصی نغمہ پیش کرے گی جو قید کے دوران لکھا گیا تھا، جس میں 18 اصل اراکین حصہ لیں گے۔ اگرچہ 1973 کی اصل تقریب اس وقت ہوئی جب نکسن واٹرگیٹ اسکینڈل میں مبتلا تھے، اکثر قیدی پھر بھی انہیں اپنی رہائی کا سہرا دیتے ہیں۔ ریٹائرڈ میرین کیپٹن اورسن سوِنڈل، جو ساڑھے چھ سال شمالی ویتنامی جیلوں میں قید رہے، نے ایسوسی ایٹڈ پریس سے کہا: 'ہمارے لیے وہ ہیرو تھے... انہوں نے ہمیں واپس گھر پہنچایا۔' نیوی کے سابق افسر مائیک میک گراتھ، جن کا جہاز 1967 article_content:
The Nobel Awards Season recently concluded, honoring achievements in Physics, Chemistry, Physiology or Medicine, Literature, Peace, and Economic Sciences, but notably excluding computer science, mathematics, and engineering. This omission raises questions about the recognition of modern technological advancements, particularly those in artificial intelligence (AI).

A prime example is AlphaFold, an AI system developed by DeepMind under the leadership of Demis Hassabis. AlphaFold has revolutionized molecular biology by accurately predicting protein structures, accelerating the early stages of drug discovery. A recent collaboration involving Dr. Michael Levitt, Nobel Laureate in Chemistry, demonstrated that AlphaFold's protein predictions can assist in designing new molecules for liver cancer treatment. Their work showed AlphaFold could quickly identify promising compounds, although real experimental validation is still crucial for drug development.

While AlphaFold's capabilities have limitations—predicted structures are not always perfect—its adoption by the scientific community is remarkable. Published in 2021, the AlphaFold paper has been cited over 14,000 times, and more than half a million scientists worldwide have accessed its database.

The success of AlphaFold highlights broader discussions about the eligibility of AI and consortium-led research for prestigious accolades like the Nobel Prize. Dr. Levitt and other experts suggest that while Nobel Prizes have historically celebrated individual contributions, modern science often relies on collaborative efforts, including AI-driven achievements. Demis Hassabis and AlphaFold's co-author John Jumper recently received the Lasker Basic Medical Research Award, often seen as a precursor to the Nobel.

DeepMind has been lauded not only for its scientific breakthroughs but also for exceptional public relations efforts that inspire public and academic interest, as exemplified by the broadcast of AlphaGo's historic win and the wide reach of its documentary productions.

Although AlphaFold has yet to produce a drug advanced to human clinical trials, its influence on laboratory practice and academic research is significant. Experts believe that with further advancements and successful drug development, AI systems like AlphaFold could one day be honored with a Nobel Prize. Nonetheless, caution is advised when relying exclusively on computational predictions, and experimental confirmation remains vital in drug discovery.

Nobel Laureates such as Dr. Roger Kornberg agree that AlphaFold represents a major advance in chemical science, and its originators may be eligible for the highest scientific recognitions in the future. Demis Hassabis’s leadership and vision have inspired many in the scientific and entrepreneurial community, fueling hope that AI-driven achievements could soon be Nobel-worthy.

نوبل انعامات کا حالیہ سیزن ختم ہو گیا ہے، جس میں طبیعیات، کیمسٹری، طب، ادب، امن اور اکنامک سائنسز میں کارکردگی پر اعزازات دیے گئے، تاہم کمپیوٹر سائنس، ریاضی اور انجینئرنگ شعبے شامل نہیں تھے۔ اس کمی نے جدید ٹیکنالوجی اور خاص طور پر مصنوعی ذہانت (AI) کی اہمیت کو تسلیم کرنے کے حوالے سے سوالات کو جنم دیا ہے۔

اس کی واضح مثال الفا فولڈ ہے، جو ڈیپ مائنڈ نے دیمیس ہسابیس کی قیادت میں تیار کیا۔ الفا فولڈ نے پروٹین سٹرکچر کی درست پیش گوئی کر کے مالیکیولر بایولوجی اور ادویات کی دریافت بدل دی ہے۔ حال ہی میں کیمیاء کے نوبل انعام یافتہ ڈاکٹر مائیکل لیوٹ کی ٹیم نے الفا فولڈ کی مدد سے جگر کے کینسر کے علاج کے لئے دوائیں ڈیزائن کرنے میں کامیابی دکھائی۔ اگرچہ حقیقی تجرباتی تصدیق ابھی درکار ہے، یہ AI سسٹم ابتدائی تحقیق میں تیزی لا رہا ہے۔

الفا فولڈ کی کامیابی نے اس بحث کو جنم دیا ہے کہ کیا AI اور مشترکہ تحقیق کو نوبل جیسے بڑے اعزاز ملنے چاہییں۔ ڈاکٹر لیوٹ سمیت ماہرین متفق ہیں کہ آج کل کی سائنسی کامیابیاں اکثر مشترکہ کوششوں اور AI پر بھی منحصر ہوتی ہیں۔ دیمیس ہسابیس اور جان جمپر کو لاسکر بنیادی میڈیکل ریسرچ ایوارڈ ملا، جو اکثر نوبل انعام سے پہلے ملتا ہے۔

article_content: Georgetown women's basketball coach Tasha Butts passed away Monday after a two-year battle with breast cancer, according to the school's athletic director. She was 41 years old and was diagnosed with advanced stage breast cancer in 2021. Butts stepped away from her coaching duties at Georgetown last month. Her diagnosis led to the 'Tasha Tough' campaign, which has raised awareness and funds to provide quality care for women who cannot afford it through the Kay Yow Cancer Fund. Georgetown athletic director Lee Reed expressed his condolences, saying, 'I am heartbroken for Tasha’s family, friends, players, teammates and colleagues. When I met Tasha, I knew she was a winner on the court and an incredible person whose drive, passion, and determination were unmatched. She showed these qualities both as a leader and in her fight against breast cancer. This is a difficult time for the entire Georgetown community, and we will come together to honor her memory.' Butts joined Georgetown from Georgia Tech in April after a long coaching career and time as a professional WNBA player. She started at Georgia Tech as an assistant coach in April 2019 and was promoted to associate head coach two years later. Georgia Tech coach Nell Fortner remarked, 'The news of Tasha’s passing is incredibly sad. Tasha played a key role in the success of our program. What she did as a member of this coaching staff cannot be underestimated. She was tough in her standards and expectations, yet always supportive and caring towards her players.' In 2021, while at Georgia Tech, Butts revealed her diagnosis of advanced stage metastatic breast cancer. Georgetown president John J. DeGioia said, 'Tasha’s passing is a devastating loss. She was extraordinary—a person of character, determination, vision, and kindness. She will be deeply missed by our community and by so many people around the country whom she inspired.' After Butts stepped away last month, assistant coach Darnell Haney was appointed interim head coach. Haney said he maintained regular contact with Butts during her treatment, updating her about the team and sending her practice videos and messages to keep her spirits up. Teams across the country posted videos on social media every Tuesday in October to encourage Butts and remind her she was not alone in her fight against cancer. Before coaching at Georgia Tech, Butts held assistant coaching roles at Duquesne, UCLA, and LSU and spent eight seasons with LSU. LSU coach Kim Mulkey said, 'Tasha was a great player and went on to have a successful coaching career, impacting many lives along the way. We are saddened to lose her at such a young age.' As a player, Butts starred at Tennessee from 2000-2004 under Hall of Fame coach Pat Summitt. The Lady Vols went 124-17 during her time and reached the NCAA championship game in 2003 and 2004. She contributed to four SEC regular-season titles at Tennessee. Tennessee coach Kellie Harper said, 'Our program is heartbroken to lose a member of our Lady Vol sisterhood so soon. Tasha was someone who connected with people everywhere and made a positive impact on women’s basketball.' Butts had a brief WNBA career after being chosen 20th overall by the Minnesota Lynx in the 2004 draft, playing for Minnesota, Charlotte, and Houston. She is survived by her parents, Spencer Sr. and Evelyn, her brother Spencer Jr., and her nephew Marquis.
translated_content: جارج ٹاؤن خواتین باسکٹ بال کوچ تاشا بٹس پیر کے روز دو سال تک بریسٹ کینسر سے لڑنے کے بعد انتقال کر گئیں، جیسا کہ یونیورسٹی کے ایتھلیٹک ڈائریکٹر نے بتایا۔ ان کی عمر 41 سال تھی اور انہیں 2021 میں بریسٹ کینسر کی ایڈوانسڈ اسٹیج کی تشخیص ہوئی تھی۔ بٹس نے پچھلے مہینے کوچنگ کی ذمہ داریاں چھوڑ دیں۔ ان کی تشخیص کے بعد ‘تاشا ٹف’ مہم شروع ہوئی جس کا مقصد کی یو کینسر فنڈ کے ذریعے مستحق خواتین کو معیاری نگہداشت فراہم کرنے کے لیے شعور اجاگر کرنا اور فنڈ جمع کرنا تھا۔ جارج ٹاؤن کے ایتھلیٹک ڈائریکٹر لی ریڈ نے افسوس کا اظہار کرتے ہوئے کہا، ‘میں تاشا کے خاندان، دوستوں، کھلاڑیوں، ٹیم میٹس اور ساتھیوں کے لیے دل گرفتہ ہوں۔ جب میں نے تاشا سے ملاقات کی تو میں جان گیا تھا کہ وہ کورٹ پر جیتنے والی اور لاجواب شخصیت کی مالک ہیں، ان کا جذبہ، لگن اور عزم بے مثال تھا۔ انہوں نے یہ خصوصیات کھیل میں قیادت اور کینسر کے خلاف جنگ دونوں میں دکھائیں۔ یہ جارج ٹاؤن کمیونٹی کے لیے ایک مشکل وقت ہے اور ہم سب مل کر ان کی یاد کو خراج عقیدت پیش کریں گے۔’ بٹس جارجیا ٹیک سے رواں اپریل میں جارج ٹاؤن آئیں، جہاں وہ کوچنگ اور WNBA میں پروفیشنل کھلاڑی کی حیثیت سے طویل کیریئر رکھتی تھیں۔ انہوں نے اپریل 2019 میں جارجیا ٹیک میں اسسٹنٹ کوچ کے طور پر شمولیت اختیار کی اور دو سال بعد ایسوسی ایٹ ہیڈ کوچ بن گئیں۔ جارجیا ٹیک کوچ نل فورٹنر نے کہا، ‘تاشا کے انتقال کی خبر انتہائی افسوسناک ہے۔ تاشا ہمارے پروگرام کی کامیابی میں کلیدی کردار ادا کرتی رہیں۔ بطور کوچنگ اسٹاف رکن، ان کی خدمات کو کم نہیں سمجھا جا سکتا۔ وہ سخت توقعات رکھنے والی تھیں لیکن ہمیشہ کھلاڑیوں کے لیے سپورٹ اور ہمدردی کا جذبہ بھی رکھتی تھیں۔’ 2021 میں جارجیا ٹیک میں کوچنگ کے دوران، بٹس نے اپنے بریسٹ کینسر کی ایڈوانسڈ اسٹیج میٹاسٹیٹک تشخیص کا انکشاف کیا تھا۔ جارج ٹاؤن یونیورسٹی کے صدر جان جے ڈی جیویا نے کہا، ‘تاشا کا انتقال ایک تباہ کن نقصان ہے۔ وہ غیر معمولی تھیں، کردار، حوصلے، وژن اور مہربانی کی پیکر۔ نہ صرف ہماری کمیونٹی بلکہ ملک بھر میں بہت سے لوگ ان سے متاثر ہوئے اور ان کی کمی کو شدت سے محسوس کیا جائے گا۔’ بٹس کے عہدہ چھوڑنے کے بعد، اسسٹنٹ کوچ ڈارنیل ہینی کو عبوری ہیڈ کوچ مقرر کیا گیا۔ ہینی نے بتایا کہ وہ علاج کے دوران بھی بٹس سے باقاعدہ رابطے میں رہے، ٹیم کی صورتحال سے آگاہ کرتے رہے اور انہیں ویڈیوز اور خوشی بخش پیغامات بھیجتے رہتے۔ ملک بھر کی ٹیمیں اکتوبر میں ہر منگل کو سوشل میڈیا پر ویڈیوز شیئر کرتیں، تاکہ بٹس کو حوصلہ دیں اور یہ یاد دلائیں کہ وہ کینسر کے خلاف جنگ میں اکیلی نہیں ہیں۔ جارجیا ٹیک سے پہلے، بٹس ڈوکین، یو سی ایل اے اور ایل ایس یو میں اسسٹنٹ کوچ رہ چکی ہیں اور ایل ایس یو میں آٹھ سیزن گزارے۔ ایل ایس یو کوچ کم مولکی نے کہا، ‘تاشا بہترین کھلاڑی رہیں اور کامیاب کوچ بھی بنیں، انہوں نے اپنی زندگی میں بہت سوں پر اثر ڈالا۔ ہم ان کے اتنی کم عمر میں جانے پر افسردہ ہیں۔’ بطور کھلاڑی، بٹس نے 2000 سے 2004 تک ٹینیسی میں ہال آف فیم کوچ پیٹ سمنٹ کے رہنمائی میں نمایاں کارکردگی دکھائی۔ ان کے دور میں لیڈی وولز نے 124-17 کا ریکارڈ بنایا اور 2003 اور 2004 میں این سی اے اے چیمپئن شپ گیم میں پہنچیں۔ انہوں نے ٹینیسی میں چار ایس ای سی ریگولر سیزن ٹائٹل بھی جیتے۔ ٹینیسی کوچ کیلی ہارپر نے کہا، ‘ہماری ٹیم اپنی لیڈی وول سسٹرہُڈ کی ایک رکن کے جانے پر غمزدہ ہے۔ تاشا وہ شخصیت تھیں جو جہاں جاتیں سب سے جڑ جاتی تھیں اور خواتین باسکٹ بال پر مثبت اثر ڈالیں۔’ بٹس نے 2004 کے ڈرافٹ میں منیسوٹا لنکس کے ہاتھوں 20 ویں پوزیشن پر منتخب ہونے کے بعد، منیسوٹا، شارلٹ اور ہیوسٹن کی ٹیموں کے لیے WNBA میں مختصر کیریئر گزارا۔ ان کے پسماندگان میں والدین اسپنسر سینئر اور ایولین، بھائی اسپنسر جونیئر، اور بھتیجا مارکیوس شامل ہیں۔

article_content: India and Australia on Tuesday reaffirmed their commitment to strengthening economic and security ties, emphasizing their shared vision of a free, open, inclusive, and rules-based Indo-Pacific. This statement comes amid concerns over China's growing assertiveness in the region. Following the India-Australia Foreign Ministers' Framework Dialogue, External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar noted preparations underway for a Quad meeting with Australia, Japan, and the US, likely next year. The two countries also highlighted progress on the Comprehensive Economic Cooperation Agreement (CECA) negotiations and discussed promoting greater mobility for students and professionals. Jaishankar said the leaders discussed the complex situation in West Asia, especially the Israel-Hamas conflict, stressing India's opposition to terrorism, the urgent need for humanitarian aid in Gaza, and support for a two-state solution. Both sides expressed interest in building more reliable and resilient supply chains in the Indo-Pacific for inclusive growth. At the second India-Australia 2+2 Ministerial Dialogue, ministers focused on expanding defense cooperation, information sharing, and maritime domain awareness. In other news, the Indian Income Tax Department uncovered almost ₹10,000 crore in tax evasion over three years by e-tailers operating on social media platforms like Instagram and Facebook. Forty-five brands have been served notices, with more expected. Indian businesses are reviewing their merger and acquisition strategies in light of over 20,000 GST notices issued since 2022. Separately, Nawaz Modi has accused Raymond MD Gautam Singhania of assaulting her and a daughter two months ago. Other business updates include GST notices affecting Swiggy and Zomato, and optimism surrounding Narayana Hrudayalaya shares.

Cordless vacuums are quickly replacing corded models due to their convenience and strong performance, although they are typically more expensive. The Dyson V15 is a standout among cordless vacuums, featuring advanced technology and currently available at a significant discount for Black Friday at Best Buy — reduced from $800 to $500.

The Dyson V15 offers several high-tech features. It can automatically adjust suction power based on the type of debris, which helps maximize battery efficiency, allowing for up to 60 minutes of run time—longer than most cordless vacuums. An LED screen displays collected debris amounts, adding a unique touch, while the main vacuum head includes features to remove tangled pet and human hair. Its Fluffy Optic cleaning head uses LED headlights to illuminate hard-to-see debris for a thorough clean. The vacuum also comes with multiple attachments, including one that transforms it into a handheld device for tight spaces and upholstery.

article_content: Stunning aerial photographs provide a bird’s-eye view of human life in action, with people at work and play appearing like colorful ants from above. Captured by renowned British aerial photographer Jason Hawkes, these images span cities and landscapes worldwide—notably the UK, Hungary, Morocco, Spain, Malta, and more. Hawkes, who has spent over two decades perfecting his craft, uses helicopters and intricate logistics to showcase familiar places in unfamiliar ways. His photos highlight patterns, colors, and stories often invisible from the ground. The 'People' series includes striking scenes: long shadows on urban expanses, football matches on clustered pitches in Manchester, vibrant rollercoasters in Southend-on-Sea, the iconic view over Nelson’s Column in Trafalgar Square, bustling markets, sun-drenched parks in Manhattan, health enthusiasts bathing in Budapest, music festivals in Hyde Park, and serene beaches in Malta and Spain. Hawkes explains his passion: 'I find it more interesting to shoot abstract, art-formed images of things—natural or man-made—that you only appreciate when you see them from above.' To explore more of Jason Hawkes’s work, visit his website: www.jasonhawkes.com.

article_content:
Iran has decided not to send a ship carrying humanitarian aid to Gaza as initially planned, according to Iran's official news agency. Hossein Sheikholeslam, secretary-general of the International Conference for the Support of the Palestinian Intifada, told reporters that the shipment, originally scheduled for Thursday, was first postponed to Sunday due to Israeli restrictions but ultimately canceled. Instead, the aid will be delivered to Gaza by alternative means.

Sheikholeslam said Iranian officials did not want to politicize humanitarian assistance but emphasized breaking the blockade was the primary goal. He claimed Israel sent a letter to the United Nations warning that it would consider the presence of Iranian and Lebanese ships near Gaza as a declaration of war and would respond accordingly. To avoid giving Israel an excuse, Iran decided to deliver aid without publicizing its involvement.

Israel Defense Forces Chief of Staff Lt. Gen. Gabi Ashkenazi stated on the IDF website that Israel has the right to inspect shipments to prevent weapons from reaching Gaza. He said parties wishing to send aid should use the Ashdod port for inspection and transfer.

Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu recently announced plans to ease the blockade on Gaza, a decision welcomed by major world powers but dismissed by Palestinian officials, who demand the complete lifting of the blockade and an end to Israeli occupation.

The announcement follows a May 31 incident in which Israeli forces intercepted a flotilla attempting to deliver aid to Gaza, resulting in the deaths of nine Turkish activists and international condemnation. Israel stated its troops were attacked during the incident, while passengers claimed they were fired upon without provocation.

CNN’s Shirzad Bozorgmehr contributed reporting from Tehran.

article_content: Over the last year, Meta has been steadily cutting jobs in an effort to boost efficiency and satisfy investors. The latest round of layoffs targets the Reality Labs division, specifically the Facebook Agile Silicon Team (FAST), according to information shared internally and cited by Reuters. This move comes just before Meta is set to launch its Quest 3 headset, with employees being notified about their job status on Wednesday morning. While FAST consists of around 600 people, it isn’t clear how many will be laid off. FAST is charged with designing customized silicon chips for upcoming Meta devices in virtual, augmented, and mixed reality. Up to now, Meta has depended on Qualcomm chips in its headsets. Although CEO Mark Zuckerberg initially promoted the idea of Meta making its own chips for future devices like Quest 3 and Quest 4, the company abandoned that approach for the Quest 3 and also scrapped work on a custom operating system, XROS, in early 2022. Scheduled to launch on October 10, the Meta Quest 3 will use the new Snapdragon XR2 Gen 2 chip from Qualcomm, which promises clear improvements in graphics and performance compared to Quest 2. While Meta may still have ambitions to develop its own silicon for later products, the layoffs signal a shift towards cutting costs now rather than focusing on long-term innovation. Reports suggest that FAST could continue at a smaller scale by focusing on projects such as AR smart glasses. Early reviews of Quest 3 have been positive, but it remains to be seen if the device’s higher price will impact pre-sales.

article_content: A U.S. Navy warship in the Red Sea on Thursday intercepted and destroyed three cruise missiles and several drones launched by Iran-backed Houthi fighters. These projectiles were believed to be headed north from Yemen, potentially targeting Israel, according to Pentagon spokesman Brigadier General Pat Ryder. This rare instance of direct American military action to protect Israel signals that the U.S. is prepared to intervene on behalf of its regional partners, Ryder told reporters. The incident may indicate the possibility of further similar engagements. In response to recent attacks by Hamas on October 7, President Biden has ordered increased military deployment to the region, aiming to deter Israel’s adversaries from expanding the conflict. Nonetheless, experts caution that deterrence works only if opponents do not challenge such threats. Should adversaries act, the U.S. might be compelled to engage directly. The USS Carney, an Arleigh Burke-class destroyer equipped with SM-2 sea-to-air missiles, carried out the interceptions. The Pentagon affirmed that these actions demonstrate the effectiveness of the integrated air and missile defense systems in the Middle East. The USS Gerald Ford, the U.S. Navy's most advanced carrier group, is now closer to Israel in the eastern Mediterranean to reduce response times. The USS Dwight D. Eisenhower Carrier Strike Group also departed Norfolk, Virginia, on October 13, heading toward the Mediterranean. Additional American fighter aircraft have been deployed to U.S. bases in the region. These measures have heightened the U.S. commitment to defend Israel and allies should the conflict with Hamas escalate. The downing of Houthi missiles and drones in the Red Sea shows the extent of U.S. military readiness to protect regional partners. Questions remain regarding the extent of U.S. involvement if Iran-backed Hezbollah attacks Israel. Traditionally, the U.S. has left direct responses to Hezbollah to Israel. Michael O’Hanlon, a senior fellow at the Brookings Institution, notes that moving U.S. carriers near conflict zones signals a readiness to intervene, a significant departure from previous practices. O’Hanlon warns that if the U.S. threatens action but does not respond to provocations, it risks appearing weak. Reflecting on past U.S. policy, such as President Obama’s ‘red line’ on Syrian chemical weapons in 2012, the article highlights the difficulties of deterrence. Obama responded with targeted strikes rather than broader military engagement after chemical weapons were used. President Biden has repeatedly stated that increased U.S. military presence is intended to deter further attacks. In a recent statement, Biden warned hostile actors against attacking Israel. During a Thursday night address, Biden urged Congress to approve funding to support both Israel and Ukraine. He emphasized military aid for Israel as a means to deter Iran-backed forces and prevent conflict escalation. Bill Roggio, a senior fellow at the Foundation for Defense of Democracies, expressed concerns that U.S. deterrence could falter if threats are not backed by action.

میں فضائی اور میزائل دفاع کے نظام کی کامیابی قرار دیا۔ یو ایس ایس جیرالڈ فورڈ، امریکی بحریہ کا سب سے جدید کیریئر گروپ، اب مشرقی بحیرہ روم میں اسرائیل کے قریب موجود ہے تاکہ ردعمل کے وقت میں کمی لائی جا سکے۔ یو ایس ایس ڈوائٹ ڈی آئزن ہاور اسٹرائیک گروپ بھی 13 اکتوبر کو نورفوک، ورجینیا سے بحیرہ روم روانہ ہوا۔ مزید امریکی لڑاکا طیارے اس خطے کی امریکی بیسز پر پہنچا دیے گئے ہیں۔ ان اقدامات سے امریکا کا اسرائیل اور اس کے اتحادیوں کے دفاع کے لیے عزم مزید بڑھ گیا ہے، اگر اسرائیل اور حماس کے درمیان لڑائی مزید پھیلتی ہے۔ بحیرہ احمر میں حوثیوں کے میزائل اور ڈرونز کو مار گرانا امریکا کی علاقائی کارروائیوں کی وسعت ظاہر کرتا ہے۔ اب سوال یہ ہے کہ اگر ایران کے حمایت یافتہ حزب اللہ نے اسرائیل پر حملہ کیا تو امریکا کتنی مداخلت کرے گا، کیونکہ پہلے امریکا براہ راست ردعمل سے گریز کرتا تھا۔ بروکنگز انسٹیٹیوٹ کے بعد کارروائی نہ کرے تو کمزور نظر آ سکتا ہے۔ ماضی کی امریکی پالیسی، جیسا کہ صدر اوباما کی شامی کیمیائی ہتھیاروں پر 'ریڈ لائن'، حوصلہ شکنی کے چیلنجز کی نشاندہی کرتی ہے۔ اوباما نے کیمیائی ہتھیاروں کے article_content: Diseases once thought to be from a bygone era in Britain—such as gout, rickets, whooping cough, tuberculosis, and typhoid—are now making a worrying comeback. Last week, the NHS Health and Social Care Information Centre revealed that these illnesses are re-emerging rapidly. Experts explain why we’re seeing this resurgence and how treatments have improved over the past century. GOUT What is it? Gout is a form of arthritis caused by uric acid crystal buildup in the joints, leading to inflammation. Alcohol and rich foods increase the risk. Historically, it was linked to wealthier individuals who consumed more alcohol, like port. How did it disappear? Improved medical treatments in the 20th century made gout easier to manage, though it never vanished entirely. Why is it back? Dr. John Middleton, vice-president of the UK Faculty of Public Health, notes that obesity and alcohol consumption are now widespread, not just among the wealthy. Last year, 86,866 patients with gout were admitted to hospitals, up from 48,717 in 2009. How is it treated? In the past, opium and whisky were used for pain relief, with cocaine as an anaesthetic. Now, ice packs, painkillers, and medications like allopurinol (which lowers uric acid) are used. Patients are also advised to limit alcohol and red meat. RICKETS What is it? Rickets is mainly a childhood disease caused by vitamin D deficiency, leading to soft bones. In Victorian times, it was epidemic due to smog blocking sunlight, the primary source of vitamin D. How did it disappear? Adding vitamin D to foods in the early 20th century significantly reduced cases. Why is it back? One in four children now doesn’t get enough sunlight, partly due to skin cancer precautions. Dietary deficiency is also a factor, as breast milk contains less vitamin D than formula. There were 702 cases in 2012, up from 561 in 2008. How is it treated? Cod liver oil has long been used to prevent rickets. Currently, government advice is for all children under five to take daily vitamin D supplements and spend about 20 minutes in the sun daily without sunscreen. TUBERCULOSIS (TB) What is it? TB is an infection that mainly affects the lungs but can also impact bones and the nervous system. Symptoms include a persistent cough, weight loss, night sweats, fever, and tiredness. In Victorian times, TB (“consumption”) killed one in four people. How did it disappear? Less crowded living conditions, introduction of the BCG vaccine from the 1920s, and antibiotics like streptomycin helped eliminate much of the threat. Why is it back? Increased immigration from countries with higher TB rates and more urban crowding have contributed to a rise, with 8,963 reported cases in 2011. Dr. Middleton says better treatment services are needed for early identification. How is it treated? Historically, patients were isolated in sanatoriums and treated with herbal steam. Now, high-risk babies are given extra BCG vaccinations, and sufferers are prescribed antibiotics. New tests can detect TB even in those without symptoms. WHOOPING COUGH What is it? This bacterial infection of the lungs and airways begins with a persistent dry cough and leads to fever and characteristic ‘whooping’ coughing fits. In Victorian times, it caused over 1,000 deaths a year. Why did it disappear? Widespread vaccination since the 1950s drastically lowered cases. Why is it back? Vaccinations since the 1990s are less effective, and more resistant bacteria are emerging. Some isolated and deprived communities have low vaccination rates. In 2012, 7,728 cases were reported in the first ten months, with 13 infants dying. How is it treated? Previously, patients were given sugar and salt water to prevent dehydration. Now, antibiotics are used, and pregnant women and children are routinely vaccinated. TYPHOID/CHOLERA What are they? These are bacterial infections contracted from contaminated water, causing diarrhoea, vomiting, and fever. Both were common during the Victorian era due to poor sanitation, with one in five dying. How did they disappear? Vaccines introduced in the late 19th century and antibiotics from the 1940s greatly reduced cases. Why are they back? International travel has reintroduced these diseases. The UK sees about 500 typhoid cases a year. While no cholera cases originate in England or Wales, 12 were reported among travelers in 2012. How are they treated? Historically, salt water, sugar, and bed rest were used. Now, antibiotics and vaccines are recommended for people traveling to high-risk areas.
translated_content: وہ بیماریاں جو برطانیہ میں ماضی کی بات سمجھی جاتی تھیں—جیسے کہ گاؤٹ، رکیٹس، خناق (کھانسی)، تپ دق اور ٹائیفائیڈ—اب دوبارہ پریشان کن حد تک واپس آرہی ہیں۔ گزشتہ ہفتے NHS ہیلتھ اینڈ سوشل کیئر انفارمیشن سینٹر نے ظاہر کیا کہ یہ بیماریاں تیزی سے ابھر رہی ہیں۔ ماہرین وضاحت کرتے ہیں کہ ہم یہ واپسی کیوں دیکھ رہے ہیں اور علاج کس طرح بہتر ہوا ہے۔ گاؤٹ یہ کیا ہے؟ گاؤٹ ایک قسم کا گٹھیا ہے جو یورک ایسڈ کے کرسٹل کے جوڑوں میں جمع ہونے سے ہوتا ہے، جس سے سوجن ہو جاتی ہے۔ شراب اور مرغن کھانے اس میں اضافہ کرتے ہیں۔ تاریخی طور پر یہ بیماری زیادہ شراب پینے والے مالدار افراد میں عام تھی۔ یہ کیسے ختم ہوا؟ بیسویں صدی میں بہتر طبی علاج سے گاؤٹ پر زیادہ مؤثر طریقے سے کنٹرول ہوا، اگرچہ یہ مکمل طور پر ختم نہیں ہوا۔ واپس کیوں آئی؟ ڈاکٹر جان مڈلٹن، یو کے فیکلٹی آف پبلک ہیلتھ کے نائب صدر، کہتے ہیں کہ اب موٹاپا اور شراب نوشی صرف امیروں تک محدود نہیں رہی۔ پچھلے سال 86,866 مریض گاؤٹ کے ساتھ ہسپتال میں داخل ہوئے، جو 2009 میں 48,717 تھے۔ اس کا علاج کیسے ہوتا ہے؟ پہلے زمانے میں درد کے لئے افیون اور وہسکی، اور بے ہوشی کے لئے کوکین استعمال ہوتی تھی۔ اب آئس پیک، پین کلر اور الوپیورنول جیسی دوا، جو یورک ایسڈ کو کم کرتی ہے، دی جاتی ہیں۔ مریضوں کو شراب اور سرخ گوشت سے پرہیز کا مشورہ دیا جاتا ہے۔ رکیٹس یہ کیا ہے؟ رکیٹس زیادہ تر بچوں میں وٹامن ڈی کی کمی کی وجہ سے ہوتا ہے، جس سے ہڈیاں نرم ہوجاتی ہیں۔ وکٹورین دور میں سورج کی روشنی کی کمی اور دھوئیں کی وجہ سے رکیٹس عام تھا۔ یہ کیسے ختم ہوا؟ بیسویں صدی کے آغاز میں جب کھانوں میں وٹامن ڈی شامل کیا گیا تو یہ مسئلہ کم ہوا۔ واپس کیوں آئی؟ ہر چار میں سے ایک بچہ اب وافر سورج کی روشنی نہیں لے رہا۔ اس کی ایک وجہ جلد کے کینسر سے بچاؤ کی کوششیں بھی ہیں۔ ماں کے دودھ میں وٹامن ڈی کم ہونے کی وجہ سے بھی مسئلہ بڑھا ہے۔ 2012 میں 702 کیس ہوئے، جو 2008 میں 561 تھے۔ علاج کیسے ہوتا ہے؟ ماضی میں کوڈ لیور آئل استعمال ہوتا تھا۔ آج حکومت مشورہ دیتی ہے کہ پانچ سال سے کم عمر کے بچوں کو روزانہ وٹامن ڈی سپلیمنٹ دیں اور بغیر سن اسکرین کے روزانہ 20 منٹ دھوپ میں رہیں۔ تپ دق (ٹی بی) یہ کیا ہے؟ تپ دق پھیپھڑوں، ہڈیوں اور اعصابی نظام کو متاثر کرنے والی انفیکشن ہے۔ علامات میں مسلسل کھانسی، وزن میں کمی، رات کا پسینہ، بخار، اور تھکن شامل ہیں۔ وکٹورین دور میں یہ ہر چار میں سے ایک شخص کو مار دیتی تھی۔ یہ کیسے ختم ہوا؟ رہائشی بھیڑ کم ہونے، 1920 کی دہائی میں BCG ویکسین اور اینٹی بائیوٹکس ملنے سے یہ بیماری کافی کم ہو گئی۔ واپس کیوں آئی؟ مخصوص ملکوں سے ہجرت اور زیادہ رش والے شہروں میں شمار میں اضافہ ہوا ہے۔ 2011 میں 8,963 کیس سامنے آئے۔ ڈاکٹر مڈلٹن کے مطابق، ابتدائی علاج کے لیے بہتر سہولیات درکار ہیں۔ علاج کیسے ہوتا ہے؟ ماضی میں مریضوں کو سینیٹوریم میں رکھا جاتا تھا یا جڑی بوٹیوں کی بھاپ دی جاتی تھی۔ اب ہائی رسک بچوں کے لیے اضافی BCG ویکسین اور مریضوں کو اینٹی بائیوٹکس تجویز کی جاتی ہیں۔ نئے ٹیسٹ سے بغیر علامات والے معاملات کا بھی پتا چلتا ہے۔ خناق (کھانسی) یہ کیا ہے؟ یہ پھیپھڑوں اور ایئر ویز کی بیکٹیریا سے ہونے والی انفیکشن ہے، جو خشک کھانسی، بخار اور 'ہوپنگ' کھانسی کا باعث بنتی ہے۔ وکٹورین دور میں یہ ایک ہزار سے زیادہ اموات کا سبب بنتی تھی۔ کیسے ختم ہوئی؟ 1950 کی دہائی میں ویکسینیشن سے اس میں بہت کمی آ گئی۔ واپس کیوں آئی؟ 1990 کی دہائی کے بعد ویکسینز کمزور ہوئیں اور بیکٹیریا مزاحمت بڑھا۔ کچھ علاقوں میں ویکسینیشن نہ ہونے سے معاملہ بگڑا۔ 2012 کے پہلے 10 ماہ میں 7,728 کیس اور 13 بچوں کی ہلاکتیں رپورٹ ہوئیں۔ علاج کیسے ہوتا ہے؟ پہلے شوگر، نمک ملا پانی دیا جاتا تھا۔ اب اینٹی بائیوٹکس اور حاملہ خواتین و بچوں کو ویکسین دی جاتی ہے۔ ٹائیفائیڈ/ہیضہ یہ کیا ہیں؟ یہ آلودہ پانی سے پیدا ہونے والے بیکٹیریا کے انفیکشن ہیں، جن کی شناخت اسہال، قے اور بخار سے ہوتی ہے۔ وکٹورین دور میں ناقص صفائی کے باعث یہ عام تھیں اور پانچ میں سے ایک متاثرہ شخص فوت ہو جاتا تھا۔ یہ کیسے ختم ہوئیں؟ ویکسین اور 1940 کی دہائی میں اینٹی بائیوٹکس آنے سے ان بیماریوں میں نمایاں کمی آئی۔ واپس کیوں آ رہی ہیں؟ بین الاقوامی سفر کے ذریعے انفیکشن دوبارہ آرہے ہیں۔ برطانیہ میں ہر سال تقریباً 500 ٹائیفائیڈ کیس رپورٹ ہوتے ہیں۔ اگرچہ انگلینڈ اور ویلز میں ہیضہ کا کوئی مقامی کیس عرصے سے نہیں آیا، لیکن 2012 میں 12 برطانوی شہری بیرون ملک انفیکٹ ہوئے۔ علاج کیسے ہوتا ہے؟ پہلے نمک، شوگر اور پانی یا آرام کروایا جاتا تھا۔ اب اینٹی بائیوٹکس اور خطرناک علاقوں میں جانے والوں کے لیے حفاظتی ویکسین تجویز کی جاتی ہیں۔

article_content: Starting at a new school or job can be exciting, but the awkwardness of meeting new people often leads to stress and social anxiety. New research from the University at Albany and Duke University finds that talking about products people display, like books on a shelf, can help start conversations and build relationships. In their study published in the Journal of Consumer Psychology, lead author Hillary J.D. Wiener and co-authors James R. Bettman and Mary Frances Luce explored how publicly displayed products influence the way conversations begin between consumers. The authors found that conversations sparked by mentioning such products are often enjoyable and lead to greater self-disclosure. According to Wiener, an assistant professor of marketing at UAlbany, starting a conversation by mentioning a product someone displays can be a simple and effective way to connect, compared to using a list of topics or conversation apps. Their research included three studies, showing that people have better interactions when they mention a product the other person owns, rather than starting with unrelated topics. The study also examined which items are most likely to be mentioned and how they contribute to deeper conversations. While previous research often highlighted the downsides of product-based conversations, the authors suggest that products can actually pave the way for discussions about experiences, interests, or other meaningful topics. Products and experiences need not compete; instead, products can act as a doorway to richer conversations. The authors note that since consumers sometimes struggle with social interactions, using products as conversation starters may help address feelings of 'undersociality.' However, questions remain about exactly how and when these interactions occur. Future research should explore new ways to prompt conversations, beyond common topics like the weather, and further investigate how products help foster enjoyable interactions. The study found that while attractive products often receive compliments, they rarely lead to long conversations. Similarly, luxury or identity-revealing products, such as those indicating religious beliefs, are less likely to be mentioned due to cultural sensitivities. Some interviewees found that displaying products with limited appeal helped them identify friends with similar interests, while others discontinued relationships if their products were met with negative reactions. The authors propose more research to understand these dynamics, especially regarding products tied to stigma. For example, people with stigmatized conditions, like physical disabilities, sometimes display products to steer conversations away from uncomfortable topics. These are among the many questions future studies aim to address.

President Barack Obama addressed the Colorado movie theater shooting on Wednesday night, breaking his silence on the tragedy and discussing gun control. Obama stated, "I believe the majority of gun owners would agree that we should check someone's criminal record before they purchase a gun; that a mentally unbalanced individual should not be able to obtain a gun so easily." He added, "These steps shouldn't be controversial. They should be common sense."

Despite Obama's comments, Democratic strategists view gun control as a politically sensitive topic, especially since Al Gore’s 2000 presidential loss, which some attribute partially to his advocacy for stricter gun laws. As a result, many Democrats consider gun politics risky for the party.

Senate Majority Leader Harry Reid expressed agreement with Obama's remarks but clarified that there would be no action on gun control in the Senate this year. He stated, "With the schedule we have, we're not going to get into the debate on gun control. But I'm glad the president made the statement because it's something that needs to be done."

House Minority Leader Nancy Pelosi supported Obama's leadership, highlighting the need to build national consensus to reduce violence while respecting the Second Amendment. Pelosi remarked, "There are important voices on all sides of this issue. We recognize the importance of the Second Amendment and also the need to reduce violence in our communities."

Views among rank-and-file Democrats varied. Rep. Joe Crowley of New York noted that it is easier to buy ammunition online than cold medicine, emphasizing the necessity of a common-sense discussion about gun sales. Rep. Raul Grijalva of Arizona, who represents a pro-gun district, described the president’s remarks as an important starting point for rational discussion—a conversation often avoided due to political pressure from organizations such as the NRA.

Grijalva mentioned the Democratic Party’s reluctance to address gun control since the 1994 Crime Act and the influence of the NRA, suggesting that most Americans want a rational discussion that both protects fundamental rights and public safety.

Reporting by CNN's Ted Barrett and Deirdre Walsh.

NASA has released a new app called 'Spot The Station' for iOS and Android, making it easier for people to know when the International Space Station (ISS) will be visible from their location. The ISS orbits the Earth every 90 minutes, taking a different path as the planet rotates beneath it. The official Spot The Station website has helped millions spot the football field-sized space laboratory, and the new app builds on this by offering real-time features. The online service remains available, and users can still sign up for daily email alerts about upcoming ISS sightings above their home. With ISS-spotting becoming a popular feature in many astronomy apps, NASA's decision to release its own app is timely—it debuts just ahead of the ISS's 25th anniversary on December 6, 2023.

The app’s interface features a single main page with a 3-D model of Earth and shows the ISS’s current route. It displays your exact location and provides two key pieces of information: the date of the next visible sighting and a countdown timer. Sightings depend on when the ISS will be clearly visible from your location, typically around sunrise and sunset, due to sunlight reflecting off the station’s solar panels. The app also includes notifications 10 minutes before optimal viewing times and allows you to filter out harder-to-see passes. Using a built-in compass and augmented reality, users can point their phones at the sky to find where the ISS will appear or is currently located. An additional tab gives access to recent NASA news on the ISS, such as crew updates and spacewalks.

From the ground, the ISS usually appears in the western sky as a bright, steady white light, moving across the sky and disappearing in the east after one to six minutes, depending on its altitude. It is noticeably different from planes, whose lights typically flash, whereas the ISS remains a constant light. As it passes overhead, the ISS can become very bright for a short time before fading away. Robyn Gatens, the International Space Station director at NASA Headquarters, said, “Even after 23 years of continuous human presence aboard the International Space Station, it’s incredibly exciting to see the station when you look up at just the right moment. The orbiting laboratory that continues to provide so many unique, tangible benefits for humanity really isn’t that far out of reach.”

Enjoy clear skies, and happy ISS spotting!

Viaplay is set to release a three-part documentary series about Ace of Base, titled 'All That She Wants: The Unbelievable Story of Ace of Base.' Scheduled to premiere next year on the Nordic streaming platform, the series will feature never-before-seen personal footage recorded during the band's most challenging periods. Ace of Base ranks as Sweden’s third most successful pop export after ABBA and Roxette. Despite their chart-topping hits and worldwide fame, the band faced significant personal struggles. Group member Ulf Ekberg endured death threats from right-wing extremists, leading him to perform in a bulletproof vest and hire bodyguards while on tour. Meanwhile, Jenny Berggren was the victim of a traumatic attack in her home by a German fan.

Ace of Base rose to international stardom with massive hits like 'All That She Wants' and 'The Sign.' Their 1993 album 'Happy Nation' remains the best-selling Swedish debut in history, shaping the global Swedish pop phenomenon.

"Documentaries about artists can often be polished and selective," says Ekberg. "This series, however, is honest and covers both the highs and the lows. By showing previously unpublished material from the 1990s, viewers can experience our story in a whole new light."

The series is one of the first announced since Viaplay shifted its strategy following the sudden resignation of its CEO. The company, which previously approved one scripted TV series or movie per week, is now focusing on 'local and relevant' unscripted and acquired content due to the economic downturn.

article_content: Intense fighting is underway near the main government buildings in Ramadi, the capital of Iraq's Anbar province, as ISIS forces battle against Iraqi troops and local tribal fighters. According to provincial council deputy head Faleh al-Issawi, the clashes erupted on Friday when ISIS fighters mounted a carefully coordinated attack from multiple directions around the city. The combat has drawn dangerously close, with only about 1,000 feet separating ISIS fighters from the compound that houses Anbar’s government and security offices. Al-Issawi warned that if militants capture this compound, all of Anbar province could be lost to ISIS control. After the intense fighting on Friday, 23 tribal fighters and 12 ISIS militants were reported dead. The police chief of the nearby town al-Habaniya and three of his guards also lost their lives in the clashes. Large parts of Ramadi and most of the province, which is predominantly Sunni, have already fallen under ISIS control. The group continues to gain territory despite ongoing coalition airstrikes. U.S. Central Command confirmed two American airstrikes near Ramadi on Friday. In a related development, the Pentagon recently stated that U.S. military advisers will soon be deployed to Anbar to help support Iraqi security efforts. Additionally, there was a separate report about a father and his sons leaving Germany to join the fight against ISIS.

article_content: Although Paris is often considered the romance capital of the world, a recent analysis shows that Spain is actually the most amorous nation. According to Viber data, Spanish users sent more love-related messages and stickers than any other country in 2014, surpassing France, Italy, and Japan. This may be linked to a recent study by mathematicians, which found that the Spanish language is the happiest and most positive. Spanish speakers use words like ‘love’ and ‘laughter’ more frequently than individuals in other countries. Renowned Spanish couple Javier Bardem and Penélope Cruz are emblematic of this cultural warmth. Viber reported that the most popular sticker among Spanish users — and globally — was the ‘kissing couple’ sticker. In a separate study, researchers led by Dr. Peter Dodds at the University of Vermont built a large database of billions of words from ten widely used languages, including sources like Google Books, Twitter, movie and TV subtitles, song lyrics, and major news outlets. They analyzed 100,000 words per language, finding every language exhibited a positivity bias, with Spanish highest in positive sentiment and Chinese most negatively skewed. The researchers compiled a list of 10,000 commonly used words in each language, labeling them as positive or negative. Words such as ‘lying’ and ‘cried’ were considered negative, while ‘love’ and ‘laughter’ were positive. The study concluded that natural human language generally has a positivity bias, and this holds true across languages and translations. To examine emotional trends further, the team analyzed classic literature: Herman Melville’s Moby Dick, Fyodor Dostoyevsky’s Crime and Punishment, and Alexandre Dumas’ The Count of Monte Cristo. Emotional highs and lows were charted through these narratives. For example, Crime and Punishment is largely positive but ends at a low point, The Count of Monte Cristo ends positively, while Moby Dick’s sentiment peaked early and declined by the end. These trends support the research findings. The results of these studies were published in the Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences. On Valentine’s Day, a report from money transfer service WorldRemit found Ghanaians to be the most generous, sending an average of £63 ($97) more compared to other days in February. People from Bangladesh and Zimbabwe followed, transferring an additional £54 ($83) and £52 ($80) respectively. Separately, Twitter data showed Sweden as the country most likely to tweet ‘I love you’, according to its ‘World of Love’ interactive map that tracks mentions in 100 languages. Relative to population, Sweden ranked first, with Slovenia, Israel, United Arab Emirates, and Norway following. The UK ranked 51st out of 173 countries. Spanish users again led the world on Viber in sending love-themed stickers in 2014, ahead of France, Italy, Japan, and Brazil.

article_content: Best-selling crime writer Patricia Cornwell has been awarded nearly $51 million in damages after a federal jury determined that her former financial management firm, Anchin, Block & Anchin LLP, and ex-principal Evan Snapper were responsible for her financial setbacks. The verdict challenged claims that Cornwell’s money problems were due to overspending, instead highlighting mismanagement by the firm. Cornwell alleged the firm switched her investments from conservative to riskier ventures without her approval. Despite her significant earnings from novels—over $10 million per year at one point—her net worth fell to below $13 million by 2009, forcing her to sell off multiple luxury assets to address debts. The trial brought private aspects of Cornwell’s life into the public eye, such as details of previous relationships, including one with former British police chief Caroline Nicholl and another with FBI agent Margo Bennett. Cornwell’s battle with bipolar disorder also came to light, emphasizing why she depended on financial professionals. Attorneys for Anchin argued the losses resulted from Cornwell’s lavish lifestyle—citing expenses on private jets, high-end cars, and luxury real estate like a $40,000 monthly Trump Tower apartment. Yet Cornwell countered that mismanagement and unauthorized spending by Snapper—including personal gifts and costly purchases—were the real issues. Cornwell testified that these troubles caused her to miss a book deadline for the first time, resulting in a loss of about $15 million in advances and commissions. Her series, starring forensic expert Kay Scarpetta, has achieved global sales of over 100 million copies and influenced the creation of forensic-focused TV shows. The proceedings also spotlighted Cornwell’s political and social connections: she has backed Republican politicians, spent time with former President George H.W. Bush, and represented the Billy Graham family publicly. While the defense portrayed Cornwell as a demanding and impulsive spender, the jury supported her claim that she had been let down by the very managers she trusted with her finances.

article_content: The 2023 Nobel Prize in Physics honors Pierre Agostini, Ferenc Krausz, and Anne L'Huillier for their pioneering work in creating ultra-short flashes of light to observe electrons in action. By producing attosecond pulses—an attosecond is a quintillionth of a second—the trio enabled scientists to study the swift dynamics of electrons within atoms, which was previously impossible. This leap forward allows researchers to follow electron activity in extreme detail, setting the stage for more advanced electron microscopes, speedier electronics, and improved early-stage medical diagnostics. Agostini, Krausz, and L'Huillier are sharing a prize totaling 11 million Swedish krona (approximately £824,000). The Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences recognized them for making possible the study of events at timescales never before accessible. Anne L'Huillier, currently at Lund University in Sweden, is now just the fifth woman to receive a Physics Nobel. She described learning about her win while teaching, noting it made the rest of her lecture quite challenging. Pierre Agostini works at Ohio State University (USA), and Ferenc Krausz is at the Max Planck Institute of Quantum Optics in Germany. In related news, the Nobel Prize for Physiology or Medicine went to Katalin Kariko and Drew Weissman for their contributions to the development of mRNA Covid-19 vaccines.

article_content: Tracey Foster, aged 41 from Rowley Regis, West Midlands, successfully lost 16 stone after overcoming a nearly 20-year addiction to Jammie Dodgers biscuits. At her heaviest, Tracey weighed 28 stone and consumed up to 24 Jammie Dodgers daily, amounting to about 2,000 calories – the recommended daily intake for women. She often skipped meals in favor of the biscuits with sugary tea, and in the evenings would eat takeaways and snack on cheese, crisps, and chocolate. Her weight and eating habits led to a BMI of 50.23, and she spent around £1,255 each year on Jammie Dodgers. Tracey, who also suffers from arthritis, was denied knee surgery in July 2011 due to her high BMI (obesity is defined as a BMI over 30). Instead of choosing gastric band surgery, she joined a local Weight Watchers group, switched to healthier meals, and began regular swimming sessions with her husband Scott, 40. Over two years, she lost 16 stone, reaching size 10 and weighing 12 stone. Tracey credits the support of her family, including her daughter Charlotte, 16, and son Luke, 18. Now a Gold Member at Weight Watchers, Tracey reports a dramatically improved quality of life. While she regrets missing out on experiences due to her previous weight, she is proud to have achieved her goals without surgery. Her Weight Watchers group leader, Anne Wythes, described Tracey as 'inspirational' and among the most successful members she has worked with.

Chris Walton, 47, known as 'The Dutchess' in Nevada and California, holds the Guinness World Record for the longest fingernails. She stopped cutting her nails in 1993, and now their combined length exceeds 20 feet, curling and bending in extraordinary shapes. Despite this, Walton, a grandmother and mother of five, continues to cook, clean, play piano, and use a computer, strengthening her nails with acrylic for balance.

Her dedication earned her a place in the 2012 Guinness Records Book, and she painted her nails gold to celebrate. Apart from losing a nail once while fixing her car engine, she says her lifestyle remains unaffected and manages everything independently.

Although her nails often attract attention, Walton prefers recognition for her singing career. She began performing at 14, recently releasing a single called "Live And Let Live," reflecting her belief in embracing differences and positivity. "We were all put on this earth to be different," Walton says. "Instead of judging, we should live and let live, and stay positive."

ان کی اسی محنت کے باعثانہیں 2012 میں گنیز ورلڈ ریکارڈز بک میں شامل کیا گیا، اور اس خوشی میں انہوں نے ناخن سنہری رنگ سے پینٹ کیے۔ صرف ایک بار، جب وہ اپنی گاڑی کا انجن ٹھیک کر رہی تھیں، انہوں نے ایک ناخن کھویا؛ اس کے علاوہ ان کی زندگی معمول کے مطابق چلتی ہے اور وہ سب کچھ خود کر لیتی ہیں۔

اگرچہ ان کے ناخن اکثر توجہ کا مرکز بنتے ہیں، لیکن کرس والٹن چاہتی ہیں کہ انہیں ان کی گائیکی کے لیے پہچانا جائے۔ وہ چودہ برس کی عمر سے گاتی آ رہی ہیں اور حال ہی میں اپنا سنگل "Live And Let Live" ریلیز کیا، جو اختلاف کو قبول کرنے اور مثبت سوچ کا پیغام دیتا ہے۔ والٹن کہتی ہیں، "ہم سب اس دنیا میں مختلف بن کر آئے ہیں۔ بجائے اس کے کہ دوسروں کو پرکھیں، ہمیں بس جینے دینا چاہیے اور مثبت رہنا چاہیے۔"

DETROIT — General Motors’ Cruise autonomous vehicle unit is recalling all 950 of its vehicles to update their software, following an incident in early October in which one Cruise car dragged a pedestrian along a San Francisco street. According to documents published Wednesday by U.S. safety regulators, the updated software will ensure that Cruise vehicles remain stationary if a similar situation occurs in the future.

The October 2 crash led Cruise to suspend all driverless operations nationwide after the California Department of Motor Vehicles found that its cars posed a public safety risk, revoking the company’s license to transport passengers without human drivers in San Francisco.

In the incident, a human-driven vehicle struck a pedestrian, pushing them into the path of a Cruise autonomous car. The Cruise vehicle initially stopped but subsequently attempted to pull over, dragging the person about 20 feet (six meters) and pinning them under one of its tires. The pedestrian suffered critical injuries.

Cruise stated in documents submitted to the U.S. National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) that updated software is already running in test vehicles monitored by human safety drivers. The company said it would deploy the updated software fleet-wide before resuming driverless operations.

On Wednesday, GM’s Cruise division explained that it initiated the recall even though it calculated the risk of a similar serious crash to be 1 in 10 million to 100 million miles without the update. “We strive to continually improve and to make these events even rarer,” the statement read. Cruise also indicated it expects to file future recalls as software improvements are made to enhance safety.

Following a review, Cruise has appointed a chief safety officer, hired a law firm to review its response to the October 2 crash, enlisted a third-party engineering firm to pinpoint the technical cause, and adopted company-wide principles for safety and transparency.

The problems faced by Cruise could slow the broader deployment of fully autonomous vehicles and potentially increase federal regulation. Meanwhile, NHTSA opened an investigation on October 16 into four allegations that Cruise vehicles might not properly yield to pedestrians, pointing to two injury reports, including the October 2 incident. The complaints describe Cruise cars operating autonomously and encroaching on pedestrians in or near crosswalks.

Documents filed with NHTSA show that Cruise’s system is programmed, in some cases, to pull over after a crash based on the scenario. However, this response proved problematic in the October 2 incident, as the system misclassified the collision and tried moving the vehicle, further harming the pedestrian.

While the DMV did not detail its specific reasons for revoking Cruise’s license, it accused the company of misrepresenting safety details about its autonomous technology. The revocation came after a series of accidents raised concerns about the operation of Cruise’s driverless taxis. The DMV and others also accused Cruise of not immediately sharing complete video footage of the crash, though Cruise maintains it provided the footage to state and federal officials.

General Motors had projected substantial revenue growth for Cruise, expecting annual revenue to reach $1 billion by 2025, a significant increase from $106 million last year. GM has temporarily paused production of the Origin, Cruise’s fully autonomous vehicle, at its Detroit-area factory and will resume production after Cruise restarts its ride-hailing service.

ڈیٹرائٹ — جنرل موٹرز کے کروز سیلف ڈرائیونگ گاڑیوں کے یونٹ نے حالیہ اکتوبر میں سان فرانسسکو میں پیش آنے والے واقعے کے بعد اپنی تمام 950 گاڑیاں واپس منگوا کر سافٹ ویئر اپ ڈیٹ کرنے کا فیصلہ کیا ہے۔ امریکی حفاظتی حکام کی جانب سے بدھ کو جاری ہونے والی دستاویزات کے مطابق، اس نئے سسٹم کی وجہ سے مستقبل میں ایسے کسی بھی واقعے کی صورت میں کروز گاڑیاں اپنی جگہ پر ہی ساکت رہیں گی۔

2 اکتوبر کے اس حادثے کے بعد، کیلیفورنیا ڈیپارٹمنٹ آف موٹر وہیکلز نے کروز کی ڈرائیور لیس سروسز کے لیے لائسنس منسوخ کرتے ہوئے پورے امریکہ میں ان کی خودمختار سروس معطل کردی۔ حکام کا کہنا ہے کہ کروز کی گاڑیاں عوامی تحفظ کے لیے خطرہ بن رہی تھیں۔

اس واقعے میں، ایک انسانی ڈرائیونگ گاڑی نے ایک پیدل شخص کو ٹکر ماری، جس سے وہ کروز کی سیلف ڈرائیونگ گاڑی کے راستے میں آ گیا۔ کروز کی گاڑی پہلے رکی مگر پھر ٹریفک سے ہٹنے کی کوشش میں وہ شخص تقریباً 20 فٹ (6 میٹر) تک گھسیٹ لیا گیا اور ٹائر کے نیچے دب گیا۔ متاثرہ شخص کو شدید چوٹیں آئیں۔

کروز نے امریکی نیشنل ہائی وے ٹریفک سیفٹی ایڈمنسٹریشن (NHTSA) کو بتایا کہ نیا سافٹ ویئر پہلے ہی ان کی انسانی ڈرائیورز کی نگرانی میں چلنے والی ٹیسٹ گاڑیوں میں استعمال کیا جا رہا ہے اور یہ پورے فلیٹ میں اپ ڈیٹ کے بعد ڈرائیور لیس سروس دوبارہ شروع ہو سکے گی۔

بدھ کو GM کے کروز ڈویژن نے کہا کہ اگرچہ بغیر اپڈیٹ کے ایسے سنگین حادثے کا امکان ہر 1 سے 10 یا 100 ملین میل میں ایک بار ہے، پھر بھی ہم نے حفاظتی اقدامات کے تحت گاڑیاں واپس بلائیں۔ "ہم بہتری کے عمل کو جاری رکھیں گے اور ایسے واقعات کو مزید نایاب بنانے کے خواہاں ہیں۔" کروز کا کہنا ہے کہ جیسے جیسے سافٹ ویئر بہتر ہو گا، مزید حفاظتی اپڈیٹس اور ممکنہ ری کالز کے بارے میں اطلاع ملتی رہے گی۔

جائزے کے بعد، کمپنی نے چیف سیفٹی آفیسر کی تعیناتی، حادثے کے ردعمل کا قانونی جائزہ، تکنیکی وجوہات کی تفتیش کے لیے تیسری پارٹی کے انجینئرز، اور حفاظت و شفافیت کے اصول نافذ کرنے کا اعلان کیا ہے۔

کروز کو درپیش ان مسائل کے سبب مکمل سیلف ڈرائیونگ گاڑیوں کی آمد سست ہو سکتی ہے اور وفاقی سطح پر نگرانی بھی بڑھ سکتی ہے۔ ساتھ ہی، NHTSA نے 16 اکتوبر کو چار شکایات پر تفتیش شروع کی کہ آیا کروز گاڑیاں پیدل چلنے والوں کے ارد گرد صحیح احتیاط برت رہی ہیں یا نہیں، جن میں سے دو واقعات میں زخمی ہونے کی اطلاع ہے۔ شکایات میں بتایا گیا ہے کہ خودکار گاڑیاں عموماً پیدل افراد اور کراس واک کے قریب چلی جاتی ہیں۔

دستاویزات کے مطابق، بعض حالات میں کروز سسٹم حادثے کے بعد گاڑی کو ٹریفک سے باہر نکالنے کے لیے پروگرام کیا گیا ہے، لیکن 2 اکتوبر کے واقعے میں سسٹم نے تصادم کو غلط انداز میں جانچا اور گاڑی کو ہٹانے کی کوشش کی جس کے باعث زخمی شخص کو مزید نقصان پہنچا۔

DMV نے اگرچہ لائسنس منسوخی کی وجوہات کی تفصیل فراہم نہیں کی، تاہم کمپنی پر سیلف ڈرائیونگ ٹیکنالوجی سے متعلق حفاظتی معلومات کو غلط پیش کرنے کا الزام لگایا۔ لائسنس کی منسوخی سے قبل بھی کچھ واقعات کے بعد کروز کی ڈرائیور لیس ٹیکسیوں سے متعلق تحفظات بڑھ گئے تھے۔ DMV اور دیگر اداروں نے حادثے کی مکمل ویڈیو فوراً فراہم نہ کرنے کا الزام عائد کیا مگر کروز کا اصرار ہے کہ تمام ویڈیوز ریاستی و وفاقی حکام کو دی گئی تھیں۔

جنرل موٹرز نے کروز کے لیے 2025 میں سالانہ آمدنی کے ایک ارب ڈالر تک پہنچنے کی توقع ظاہر کی تھی، جو کہ گزشتہ سال کی 106 ملین ڈالر آمدنی سے نمایاں اضافہ ہے۔ فی الحال جی ایم نے ڈیٹرائٹ فیکٹری میں Origin سیلف ڈرائیونگ گاڑی کی تیاری عارضی طور پر روک دی ہے اور سروس کی بحالی پر پیداوار دوبارہ شروع ہونے کی امید ہے۔

For the first time since the Great Depression, Americans under 40 are worse off than their parents at the same age, according to a new study by the Urban Institute. The report, titled 'Lost Generations? Wealth Building among Young Americans,' reveals that individuals in their 20s and 30s—commonly referred to as Generation Y and Generation X—are the only age group currently lagging behind their parents financially, compared to three decades ago.

The study highlights that Americans in their 30s have experienced a 21% decline in average net worth compared to those of the same age in 1983. This downturn comes even as overall household wealth and incomes in the U.S. have doubled during the same period. The report notes, ‘For many, the American dream of working hard, saving more, and becoming wealthier than one’s parents holds true. Unless you’re under 40.’

Traditionally, as society becomes more prosperous, each generation is richer than the last. The data shows that Baby Boomers aged 56 to 64 have seen a 120% increase in net worth compared to 1983, while Americans over 74 now have a net worth 149% higher than their counterparts three decades ago.

However, this generational trend has reversed. The study attributes the struggle of young adults to a combination of factors: the Great Recession, stagnant wages, limited job opportunities, declining home values, and an unprecedented rise in student debt. Nearly 60% of college students borrow to finance their education, contributing to approximately $870 billion in outstanding student loans, according to the Federal Reserve Bank of New York. About a quarter of 30-somethings carry student loan debt, compared to only 7.4% of borrowers over 40.

This heavy debt load means that many young Americans spend most of their earnings on essentials like bills, rent, and loan payments, leaving little room for savings. As illustrated by Myya Beck, a 33-year-old small business owner from Wellfleet, Massachusetts, many in this generation find saving money nearly impossible. Beck, who manages her own fitness studio while preparing for motherhood, shared her concerns about balancing her dreams with financial reality as she faces over $15,000 in student loan debt.

The report warns that if current trends continue, younger Americans may become increasingly dependent on government assistance programs in retirement, precisely when those safety nets may be less able to provide adequate support.

عظیم کساد بازاری کے بعد پہلی بار، 40 سال سے کم عمر امریکی اپنے والدین کے ہم عمر ہونے کے وقت کے مقابلے میں مالی طور پر زیادہ مشکل میں ہیں، اربن انسٹی ٹیوٹ کی نئی تحقیق کے مطابق۔ اس رپورٹ کا عنوان ہے 'گمشدہ نسلیں؟ نوجوان امریکیوں میں دولت بنانے کا رجحان'، جس میں بتایا گیا ہے کہ بیس اور تیس سال کی عمر کے افراد—جنہیں جینریشن وائی اور جینریشن ایکس کہا جاتا ہے—واحد عمر گروہ ہیں جو اس وقت اپنے والدین کے مقابلے میں مالی طور پر کمزور ہیں، تین دہائیاں پہلے کے اعداد و شمار کے مطابق۔

تحقیق کے مطابق، آج کے تیس برس کے امریکیوں کی اوسط خالص دولت 1983 میں اتنی ہی عمر کے افراد کے مقابلے میں 21 فیصد کم ہے۔ یہ کمی اس وقت بھی دیکھی گئی ہے جب امریکہ میں مجموعی گھریلو دولت اور آمدنی دگنی ہو چکی ہے۔ رپورٹ میں کہا گیا ہے: ''کئی لوگوں کے لیے امریکی خواب کہ محنت کریں، زیادہ بچائیں اور والدین سے زیادہ امیر بن جائیں، آج بھی سچ ہے، سوائے اُن لوگوں کے جو چالیس سال سے کم ہیں۔''

عمومی طور پر، جیسے معاشرہ خوشحال ہوتا ہے، ہر نئی نسل پہلے سے زیادہ دولت مند ہوتی ہے۔ اعداد و شمار کے مطابق، 56 سے 64 سال کے بیبی بومرز نے 1983 کے مقابلے میں اپنی خالص دولت میں 120 فیصد اضافہ دیکھا، جبکہ 74 سال سے زائد عمر کے امریکیوں کی خالص دولت تین دہائیوں قبل کے مقابلے میں 149 فیصد زیادہ ہے۔

مگر اب یہ رجحان تبدیل ہو گیا ہے۔ تحقیق کے مطابق نوجوان بالغوں کی مشکلات کی کئی وجوہات ہیں: عظیم کساد بازاری، رکی ہوئی اجرتیں، ملازمتوں کے کم مواقع، جائیداد کی کم ہوتی ہوئی قیمتیں اور طالبعلم قرض میں اضافہ۔ تقریباً 60 فیصد کالج اسٹوڈنٹس تعلیم کے لیے قرض لیتے ہیں جس کی وجہ سے فیڈرل ریزرو بینک آف نیویارک کے مطابق زیرِ گردشی طالبعلم قرض تقریباً 870 ارب ڈالر تک پہنچ چکا ہے۔ تیس سالہ امریکیوں میں تقریباً ایک چوتھائی افراد پر ابھی تک قرض باقی ہے، جبکہ 40 سال سے زائد عمر کے لوگوں میں یہ شرح 7.4 فیصد ہے۔

اس زیادہ قرض کا بوجھ یہ بنتا ہے کہ نوجوان امریکی زیادہ تر آمدنی بل، کرایہ اور قرض کی قسطوں میں دیتے ہیں، جس سے بچت تقریباً ناممکن ہو گئی ہے۔ جیسا کہ 33 سالہ کاروباری خاتون، مائیا بیک کی مثال سے ظاہر ہے، جو میساچوسٹس کے ویل فلیٹ میں اپنا فٹنس اسٹوڈیو چلاتی ہیں اور جلد ہی ماں بننے جا رہی ہیں، وہ اپنے خواب اور مالی حقیقت کے درمیان توازن کے بارے میں فکر مند ہیں کیونکہ وہ 15,000 ڈالر سے زیادہ کے طالبعلم قرض کی مقروض ہیں۔

رپورٹ خبردار کرتی ہے کہ اگر موجودہ رجحانات جاری رہے تو نوجوان امریکی ریٹائرمنٹ میں سرکاری امدادی پروگراموں پر پہلے سے زیادہ انحصار کرنے پر مجبور ہوں گے، خاص کر اُس وقت جب یہ پروگرام اتنی مدد فراہم نہ کر سکیں۔

article_content: Vodafone Egypt is facing an investigation after a little-known rapper, Ahmed Spider, alleged that a recent commercial contains coded signals intended for bomb attacks by the Muslim Brotherhood. State security prosecutors in Egypt launched the investigation following Spider's complaint. In an interview with Al-Tahrir TV, Spider claimed decorations on a Christmas tree shown in the advert represent bombs, and that the tree's branches resemble the four-finger gesture used to symbolize last year's security raid on supporters of ousted President Mohamed Mursi. The commercial features the Egyptian puppet character Abla Fahita and her daughter Karkoura searching for a missing SIM card that belonged to her late father. During the ad, Abla Fahita calls her friend 'Mama Touta' and asks about using the mall's sniffer dog to locate the card. Spider asserted that the mall and dog were references to planned attack sites, and that 'Mama Touta' was a code for the Brotherhood, suggesting the possibility of a future explosion at a mall. Vodafone, the world's largest mobile operator by revenue, rejected these claims, stating that the advert, which features a popular puppet character, was created to promote a special offer for customers to reactivate their old SIM cards. Vodafone labeled any alternative interpretations as 'pure fiction and personal opinions,' and indicated it may pursue legal action against anyone attempting to damage the company's reputation. The company clarified that Abla Fahita is a comedic character, and the advert's sole purpose is to market the offer in a humorous and sarcastic way, without hidden messages. Khaled Hegazy, a company spokesman, reported that employees involved in the commercial's creation from Vodafone Egypt's marketing and legal departments had been questioned. He expressed disappointment that such accusations were being taken seriously by prosecutors. Security sources told Reuters that Spider is known as an anti-Islamist and supporter of the Egyptian army, which removed President Mursi from office last July following widespread protests. The case has sparked satire on social media, with users ridiculing the notion that the puppet character could represent terrorism. One tweet jokingly suggested contacting a hotline to find 'Abla Fahita, the Muslim Brotherhood terrorist puppet.' Another user, Iyad El-Baghdadi, quipped that Abla Fahita should become the symbol of resistance to the new regime, replacing the four-finger sign. Egypt's government has designated the Muslim Brotherhood as a terrorist group, accusing it of carrying out a suicide bomb attack in the Nile Delta that killed 16 people, claims the Brotherhood denies. Vodafone Egypt is one of three mobile network operators in the country and is approximately 55 percent owned by Britain's Vodafone Group, with the remaining stake held by state-owned Telecom Egypt.
translated_content: ووڈافون مصر کو تحقیقات کا سامنا ہے جب ایک کم معروف ریپر، احمد اسپائیڈر، نے الزام لگایا کہ ان کے حالیہ کمرشل میں اخوان المسلمون کی جانب سے بم حملوں کے لیے خفیہ اشارے شامل ہیں۔ مصر کے ریاستی سکیورٹی پراسیکیوٹرز نے احمد اسپائیڈر کی شکایت پر تحقیقات شروع کر دی ہیں۔ الطاہر ٹی وی کو دیے گئے انٹرویو میں اسپائیڈر نے دعویٰ کیا کہ اشتہار میں دکھائی گئی کرسمس ٹری کی سجاوٹیں بموں کی نمائندگی کرتی ہیں اور درخت کی شاخیں چار انگلیوں کے اشارے سے ملتی جلتی ہیں، جو گزشتہ سال معزول صدر محمد مرسی کے حامیوں پر سکیورٹی آپریشن کی علامت تھی۔ اس اشتہار میں مصری پتلی کردار عابلہ فاہیتا اور ان کی بیٹی کرکورا کو دکھایا گیا ہے جو اپنے مرحوم والد کا سم کارڈ تلاش کر رہی ہیں۔ اشتہار میں، عابلہ فاہیتا اپنی دوست 'ماما توتا' کو فون کرتی ہیں اور مال کے سنفر ڈاگ سے سم کارڈ تلاش کرنے کا پوچھتی ہیں۔ اسپائیڈر نے کہا کہ مال اور کتا منصوبہ بند حملوں کی جگہوں کے کوڈ ورڈز ہیں اور 'ماما توتا' اخوان المسلمون کے لیے اشارہ ہے، جس سے عندیہ ملتا ہے کہ کسی مال میں بم دھماکہ ہو سکتا ہے۔ ووڈافون، جو ریونیو کے اعتبار سے دنیا کا سب سے بڑا موبائل آپریٹر ہے، نے اس الزام کو مسترد کیا اور کہا کہ یہ اشتہار، جس میں مشہور پتلی کردار شامل ہے، صرف پرانے سم کارڈز کو دوبارہ فعال کرنے کی خصوصی پیشکش کو فروغ دینے کے لیے بنایا گیا ہے۔ ووڈافون نے متبادل تشریحات کو 'محض افسانہ اور ذاتی رائے' قرار دیا اور کہا کہ جو بھی کمپنی کی ساکھ کو نقصان پہنچانے کی کوشش کرے گا، اس کے خلاف قانونی کارروائی پر غور کیا جا سکتا ہے۔ کمپنی نے وضاحت کی کہ عابلہ فاہیتا ایک مزاحیہ کردار ہے اور اشتہار کا واحد مقصد ایک پروموشن کو ہنسی مذاق اور طنزیہ انداز میں پیش کرنا ہے، اس کے علاوہ کوئی خفیہ پیغام نہیں ہے۔ کمپنی کے ترجمان خالد حجازی نے بتایا کہ اشتہار کی تیاری میں شامل ووڈافون مصر کے مارکیٹنگ اور قانونی شعبوں کے ملازمین سے تفتیش کی گئی۔ انہوں نے افسوس کا اظہار کیا کہ ایسے الزامات کو پراسیکیوٹرز سنجیدگی سے لے رہے ہیں۔ سکیورٹی ذرائع نے رائٹرز کو بتایا کہ اسپائیڈر ایک اینٹی اسلامسٹ اور فوج کے حامی کے طور پر جانے جاتے ہیں، جس نے گزشتہ جولائی میں وسیع تر احتجاج کے بعد مرسی کو اقتدار سے ہٹا دیا تھا۔ اس کیس نے سوشل میڈیا پر طنزیہ ردعمل کو جنم دیا، جہاں صارفین نے پتلی کردار کو دہشت گردی سے جوڑنے کے خیال کا مذاق اڑایا۔ ایک ٹویٹ میں مذاق کیا گیا کہ 'اگر کسی کو پتہ ہو کہ عابلہ فاہیتا، اخوان المسلمون کی دہشت گرد پتلی، کہاں چھپی ہوئی ہے تو ہمارے ہاٹ لائن پر اطلاع دیں'۔ ایک اور صارف ایاد البغدادی نے کہا کہ چار انگلیوں کی علامت کو چھوڑ دیں، اب عابلہ فاہیتا کو نئے نظام کے خلاف مزاحمت کی علامت بننا چاہیے۔ مصر کی حکومت نے اخوان المسلمون کو دہشت گرد تنظیم قرار دیا ہے اور اس پر نیل ڈیلٹا میں پولیس کمپاؤنڈ پر خودکش حملے کا الزام لگایا ہے جس میں 16 افراد ہلاک ہوئے، تاہم جماعت اس حملے سے انکار کرتی ہے۔ ووڈافون مصر ملک میں تین موبائل نیٹ ورک آپریٹرز میں سے ایک ہے، جس کی تقریباً 55 فیصد ملکیت برطانوی ووڈافون گروپ کے پاس ہے جبکہ باقی حصہ ریاست کے زیر ملکیت ٹیلی کام مصر نے رکھا ہے۔

article_content: Between January and August 2023, at least 6,064 foreign nationals, mainly children, applied for asylum in Nigeria, according to data from the United Nations Human Rights Council (UNHCR) and Nigeria's National Commission for Refugees, Migrants and Internally Displaced Persons (NCFRMI). Most asylum seekers came from countries experiencing conflict, such as Cameroon, Syria, the Democratic Republic of Congo, the Central African Republic, Lebanon, Chad, Palestine, and Sudan—where fighting between the army and the Rapid Support Forces has intensified since April 2023. Of these asylum seekers, 4,337 are from Cameroon, 843 from Syria, 271 from the Central African Republic, 261 from Sudan, 88 from the Democratic Republic of Congo, 35 from Chad, 33 from Palestine, and 103 from other countries. The breakdown includes 2,759 children, 1,602 men, and 1,703 women. Since August 2022, approximately 22,539 people have fled Cameroon into Nigeria, with most settling in Adamawa State's Madagali, Mubi North, Mubi South, and Michika areas. As of August 31, 2023, 4,095 Cameroonian refugees had been registered by the UNHCR and NCFRMI. Many of these refugees are fleeing the Ambazonian War—a protracted conflict that has displaced over 700,000 people since 2017, particularly in Cameroon's Northwest and Southwest regions. From January to August 2023, Nigeria recorded 6,366 new urban refugees. These included nationals from Cameroon (1,643), Niger (1,439), the Central African Republic (982), the Democratic Republic of Congo (676), Syria (576), Türkiye (409), Mali (145), Côte d’Ivoire (136), and 360 from other nations. Among them are 2,468 men, 1,682 women, and 2,216 children, mostly aged between 18 and 59, as reported by the UNHCR. May 2023 marked the highest point of refugee and asylum seeker arrivals. Experts attribute this to ongoing crises—including conflict in Sudan and the 2022 collapse of Afghanistan’s government, which swiftly rendered millions of Afghans (and Syrians who had sought refuge in Afghanistan) refugees. Data from the United Nations suggests that urban refugees show little inclination for repatriation, with only two returning in the past three years. Nigeria, as a signatory to the 1951 Geneva Convention, recognizes the right to asylum for those fleeing persecution and conflict. In May 2019, the Nigeria Immigration Service issued the first Convention Travel Documents, commonly called Refugee Passports, enabling refugees to reside legally in Nigeria or in any of the other 148 countries participating in the treaty. Experts caution that the growing refugee population increases pressure on Nigeria’s security and infrastructure. Ogbole Amedu-Ode, former Nigerian Ambassador to Singapore, reinforced Nigeria's duty to assist those fleeing persecution under international law, but advised authorities to be alert for potential security risks.

ریپبلک، لبنان، چاڈ، فلسطین اور سوڈان سے آئے ہیں—جہاں اپریل 2023 سے فوج اور ریپڈ سپورٹ فورسز کے درمیان مقابلہ جاری ہے۔ پناہ کے طلبگاروں میں 4,337 کیمرون سے، 843 شام سے، 271 سینٹرل افریقی ریپبلک سے، 261 سوڈان سے، 88 کانگو سے، 35 چاڈ سے، 33 فلسطین سے اور 103 دیگر ممالک سے تعلق رکھتے ہیں۔ ان میں 2,759 بچے، 1,602 مرد اور 1,703 خواتین شامل ہیں۔ اگست 2022 سے اب تک تقریباً 22,539 افراد نے کیمرون سے نائجیریا ہجرت کی، جن میں زیادہ تر آدم آوا اسٹیٹ کے ماداگالی، موپی نارتھ، موپی ساؤتھ اور میچکا علاقوں میں مقیم ہیں۔ 31 اگست 2023 تک 4,095 کیمرونی پناہ گزین اقوام متحدہ اور این سی ایف آر ایم آئی کے ریکارڈ میں رجسٹرڈ ہو چکے تھے۔ زیادہ تر پناہ گزین امبوزونین جنگ—جو 2017 سے جاری ہے اور جس میں 700,000 سے زائد افراد بے گھر ہو چکے ہیں—سے فرار ہو رہے ہیں، خاص طور پر کیمرون کے شمال مغربی اور جنوب مغربی علاقوں سے۔ جنوری سے اگست 2023 کے درمیان نائجیریا میں 6,366 نئے شہری (اربن) پناہ کے طلبگار درج ہوئے۔ ان میں کیمرون (1,643)، نائجر (1,439)، سینٹرل افریقی ریپبلک (982)، کانگو (676)، شام (576)، ترکی (409)، مالی (145)، آئیوری کوسٹ (136) اور دیگر ممالک (360) شامل ہیں۔ ان میں 2,468 مرد، 1,682 خواتین، اور 2,216 بچے شامل ہیں، اور زیادہ تر کی عمریں 18 سے 59 سال کے درمیان ہیں (یو این ایچ سی آر کے article_content: An 18-year-old woman from Kyrgyzstan, Ayperi Alekseeva, was found to have a massive hairball in her digestive system after years of picking up and eating hair from the carpet and chewing the ends of her own hair. Due to her habit, she developed a blockage that left her unable to eat or even drink water without getting sick. Her parents brought her to a hospital in Batken after she complained of severe abdominal pain and began losing weight. Doctors performed X-rays and identified a large blockage, then referred her to Bishkek Hospital, the capital’s leading institution, for emergency surgery. A team led by senior surgeon Professor Bahadir Bebezov removed a hairball weighing nearly 9 pounds (4 kg) from her stomach. The doctors reported that her stomach was so swollen with hair and bits of carpet wool that the mass oozed out when they operated. Professor Bebezov stated that Ayperi, aside from her hair-eating habit, was otherwise psychologically healthy. Such a large hairball had not been documented in 50 years of medical records, according to the surgeons. Ayperi is now recovering after her operation and has promised not to chew her hair in the future.

article_content: On Wednesday, the Income Tax Department conducted survey operations at Hinduja Global Solutions, a company within the Hinduja Group, in Mumbai and other cities, according to official sources. This survey is part of an investigation into possible tax evasion and is linked to the provisions of the General Anti-Avoidance Rules (GAAR). Only office premises are being surveyed, in line with income tax survey regulations. The company did not respond to an email request for comment. Hinduja Global Solutions provides services such as strategic consulting, digital transformation, and IT systems integration. The Hinduja Group, which owns IndusInd Bank, Hinduja Leyland Finance, and Hinduja Bank (Switzerland), is expanding into new technologies, digital services, and fintech, aiming to strengthen its position in the BFSI (Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance) sector through acquisitions. In stock market news, India’s Nifty index rose over 1% on Wednesday, closing above 20,000 for the first time since September 13, as easing concerns over further US rate hikes encouraged investment. Separately, the Directorate of Enforcement (ED) has alleged multiple violations of foreign exchange laws by Think & Learn, the parent company of Byju’s, including failing to submit important documents on time and realize export proceeds. Founder Byju Raveendran has also been named as responsible. The HCL Group is reportedly moving forward with plans to establish an Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Test (OSAT) facility, commonly known as a chip packaging unit, in Karnataka.

article_content: John Okafor, widely recognized in Nigeria as Mr Ibu, has had his leg amputated in a medically necessary procedure, according to his family on Instagram. The operation was performed after all other treatments were unsuccessful. At 62, the comedic actor—star of films like 'Keziah', '9 Wives', and 'Mr Ibu in London'—has now undergone seven surgeries and still requires another. The family has not disclosed what illness led to the amputation. They noted that former Senate President Bukola Saraki helped pay some of Okafor's medical bills and have appealed to fans for more support, without specifying an amount. Media reports indicate that it is not unusual for actors in Nigeria to seek public support for medical costs. This recurring issue has stirred conversation about healthcare affordability and Nollywood actors' earnings, since private medical treatment is expensive and only top actors receive substantial pay.

Although many modern devices come with built-in or sealed batteries, a wide range of products—like TV remotes and children's toys—still require users to supply their own AA or AAA batteries. Fortunately, Black Friday presents excellent opportunities to find deals on both conventional and rechargeable AA and AAA batteries, making it a great time to stock up.

AA batteries are versatile and can be found powering flashlights, calculators, digital thermometers, smoke detectors, wall clocks, remotes, and toys. Many retro gaming enthusiasts even remember swapping out AA batteries in their Nintendo Game Boys. While some newer devices have moved to rechargeable battery options via USB cables, there are still plenty that use AA batteries, so keeping spares at home remains practical.

AAA batteries, which are smaller than AA, are usually found in lighter or more compact devices, such as remote controls, digital cameras, MP3 players, kitchen timers, and bathroom scales. Despite their size, AAA batteries provide reliable performance for several household gadgets. Like AA batteries, their necessity often only becomes apparent when you need them most—such as when your remote stops working—so it's wise to keep extras on hand.
