article_content: The military wing of Hamas, the al-Qassam Brigades, has proposed releasing 70 Israeli hostages—primarily women and children—in return for a five-day ceasefire in Gaza. Al-Qassam spokesperson Abu Ubaida stated on Telegram, as reported by Reuters, that Qatari brokers have been instrumental in the talks. The negotiation aims to exchange the Israeli women and children for 200 Palestinian minors and 75 Palestinian women detained by Israel. The proposed ceasefire would mean a complete pause in hostilities and the delivery of humanitarian aid throughout Gaza. Hamas’ attack in Israel on October 7 left around 1,400 dead and saw around 240 people taken hostage. Since then, negotiations brokered by Qatar have led to four hostages being freed. Additionally, the Israeli military has rescued one hostage. No new hostages have been released since the latest offer. Ubaida accused Israel of stalling and avoiding an agreement, according to Reuters. Previous Hamas proposals—like freeing 50 Israeli hostages for a five-day ceasefire—were rejected by Israel. As reported by The Guardian, the suggested deals included the release of children, women, elderly, and sick individuals in exchange for suspending airstrikes, giving Hamas time to gather the hostages. However, Israel demanded a shorter period than Hamas considered feasible, The New York Times reported. These ongoing talks come as the Gaza Health Ministry reports a death toll above 11,000 amid the ongoing conflict.

Jenson Button brought festive joy to unsuspecting bank customers in a playful 'Secret Santa' event. The 2009 Formula One World Champion hid inside a Santander ATM at a branch, surprising people as they conducted their regular transactions. When prompted to press 'The Jenson Button,' customers were delighted as the British driver, dressed in his McLaren racing suit, appeared from behind the screen and handed them £100 in cash. Many reacted with amusement and amazement at the generous gesture. Button also gave them a gift basket as part of the surprise, all organized by banking giant Santander.

Recently, Button ended speculation about his Formula 1 future by signing a two-year contract with McLaren to race alongside Fernando Alonso. The 34-year-old's career had seemed uncertain, with McLaren previously expected to select Kevin Magnussen for the 2015 season. However, after a strong performance, Button secured his spot, partnering with the former Ferrari driver for the next two years.

William Hackett, a 74-year-old pensioner, has drawn attention in his Plymouth neighborhood due to his front garden, which has grown so dense with fir trees—some reaching 50 feet—that his home and those of his neighbors are now largely hidden from view. Residents living near him on Billacombe Road in Plymstock, Devon, have repeatedly asked Hackett to trim his garden, but so far, he has declined. His collection includes common firs and a Tree of Heaven (Ailanthus altissima), a rarely seen species native to China that can reach heights over 80 feet.

Some neighbors, frustrated by the lack of action, have resorted to dumping rubbish, including car tyres, in Hackett’s garden in hopes of pressuring him. Hackett acknowledges that his front garden is busy, but defends his right to keep the trees, arguing that he should not be blamed simply because others dislike trees. He also questions the logic of blaming his trees for fallen leaves on neighbors' cars, jokingly asking if anyone has DNA-tested the leaves.

The Plymouth City Council recently inspected Hackett's property after receiving complaints. According to Hackett, a council representative took photos and informed him that further correspondence would follow. Hackett, a former member of the Army medical corps and Navy reserves, says this is not the first time his trees have caused controversy, noting that car tyres have been dumped on his property over the past few years. He estimates the removal of each tyre costs £2, but suspects that clearing them will only prompt more dumping.

Hackett expresses disappointment that rubbish is being dumped on his property, and points out that he has lived there since before most of the complainants arrived. He believes some residents are simply intimidated by large trees, but maintains trees are valuable and necessary for the environment. A Plymouth City Council spokesman confirmed that officials had visited the property, but only to assess if the trees might cause a hazard to the nearby highway.

article_content: Amid rising political tensions in Romania, Prime Minister Victor Ponta has decided to move out of his regular office, claiming that President Traian Basescu may have been listening in on his phone calls. To ensure greater security, Ponta has set up his office within the defense ministry, believing that the military environment offers increased safeguards. This shift is part of an ongoing rivalry between Ponta and Basescu, who have traded accusations of corruption and displayed deep mutual mistrust. Ponta alleges one of his office phone calls, mentioned during a corruption probe targeting a party member, was monitored without authorization. As President Basescu prepares to leave office at the end of his term, Ponta is expected to run against Basescu’s preferred candidate in November’s elections. Critics argue that Ponta’s surveillance claims might be aimed at influencing the electoral atmosphere. Ponta, in turn, has called Basescu a 'corrupt communist' and predicted legal trouble for the president.

article_content: Figures obtained under Freedom of Information requests show that several Sussex Police officers received compensation for work-related injuries. One notable case involved a female officer who was paid £9,000 after tripping over a pothole in her station's car park in Eastbourne, East Sussex. In another incident, an officer received £500 after being bitten by a police dog. The records cover a range of incidents, such as an officer hurting his tooth by using a riot shield incorrectly, another officer suffering burns during firearms training, and a case where an officer was injured when a window fell on his hand. Between 2011 and 2013, Sussex Police settled claims amounting to over £21,000 out of court. There are ongoing cases that could raise this total, with some expected to exceed £100,000. These include claims of slipping on ice, injuries during police dog exercises, and reported post-traumatic stress from undercover operations. The TaxPayers' Alliance has criticized the extent of these claims, arguing that they could cause frustration among the public and police officers. In response, Sussex Police states that all claims are carefully investigated and that compensation is only paid when justified, with the aim of both supporting affected staff and preventing future incidents.

Apple's iPhone has lost its leading position in China's smartphone market, according to an analyst note from Jefferies cited by CNBC. The lackluster launch of the iPhone 15 enabled Huawei to claim the number one spot in market share. While Apple anticipated strong sales for its most expensive iPhone 15 model, Jefferies analysts project a double-digit sales decline this year. Since the release of the latest model, iPhone sales volume has been negative, and initial reports indicated that Apple cut iPhone 15 production by 8 million units before its official release. Apple did not immediately comment when asked.

Meanwhile, Huawei's smartphone sales in China surged with high double-digit growth in 2023, outperforming Apple even as the regional smartphone market slowed down. Jefferies analysts noted, “The trend suggests iPhone would lose to Huawei in 2024. We believe weak demand in China would eventually lead to lower-than-expected global shipments of iPhone.”

Huawei launched the Mate 60 Pro, its latest flagship phone powered by a domestically-produced processor. Although its 7-nanometer processor isn't as advanced as Apple's 3-nanometer chip, Huawei’s progress marks a notable development in the ongoing US-China technology competition. Counterpoint Research has also recorded declining iPhone sales in China, which they attribute to an economy still recovering from the effects of the COVID-19 pandemic. Despite this, Counterpoint analysts predict Huawei could sell 5 to 6 million units of the Mate 60 Pro in 2023, with sales possibly exceeding 10 million in 2024.

Geopolitical tensions between the US and China continue to shape the smartphone market. Last month, Chinese officials banned government employees from using iPhones at work, just a week before Apple introduced the iPhone 15. China has pledged to reduce its reliance on foreign technology, a move that could affect Apple's market capitalization in Asia. These restrictions mirror US measures, such as the Federal Communications Commission's designation of Huawei as a national security risk.

ایپل کا آئی فون چینی اسمارٹ فون مارکیٹ میں اپنی پہلی پوزیشن کھو بیٹھا ہے، جیفرِیز کے اینالسٹ نوٹ کے مطابق جسے CNBC نے رپورٹ کیا۔ آئی فون 15 کی کمزور لانچ کی وجہ سے ہواوے نے مارکیٹ شیئر میں پہلا نمبر حاصل کر لیا۔ اگرچہ ایپل نے امید کی تھی کہ اس کا مہنگا ترین آئی فون 15 سب سے زیادہ بکے گا، مگر جیفرِیز کے اینالسٹس اس سال اس کی فروخت میں ڈبل ڈیجیٹ کمی کی پیشگوئی کر رہے ہیں۔ نئے ماڈل کی لانچ کے بعد سے آئی فون کی سیلز میں کمی آئی ہے، اور ابتدائی رپورٹس کے مطابق ایپل نے سرکاری اعلان سے پہلے آئی فون 15 کی پروڈکشن 80 لاکھ یونٹس کم کر دی تھی۔ ایپل نے اس پر فوراً کوئی تبصرہ نہیں کیا۔

ہواوے نے میٹ 60 پرو لانچ کیا، جو اس کا نیا فلیگ شپ فون ہے اور چینی ساختہ پروسیسر پر چل رہا ہے۔ اگرچہ اس کا 7-نانومیٹر پروسیسر ایپل کے 3-نانومیٹر چپ جتنا جدید نہیں، پھر بھی ہواوے کی یہ پیش رفت امریکہ-چین ٹیک مقابلے میں اہم سنگ میل سمجھی جا رہی ہے۔ کاؤنٹرپوائنٹ ریسرچ نے بھی چین میں آئی فون کی فروخت میں کمی ریکارڈ کی ہے، جس کی وجہ وہ کووِڈ-19 کے بعد معیشت کی سست ریکوری کو قرار دیتے ہیں۔ اس کے باوجود، کاؤنٹرپوائنٹ کے اینالسٹس پیشگوئی کرتے ہیں کہ ہواوے اس سال صرف میٹ 60 پرو کی 50 سے 60 لاکھ یونٹس فروخت کر سکتا ہے، اور یہ 2024 میں 1 کروڑ سے اوپر جا سکتی ہے۔

article_content: Efforts for Middle East peace gained new momentum on Friday as U.S. Secretary of State John Kerry announced an agreement that creates a foundation for resuming direct final status negotiations between the Palestinians and Israel. Speaking in Amman, Jordan, Kerry described this as a significant and positive development. During his visit to the region, Kerry worked closely with Palestinian negotiators to encourage renewed talks. On Friday, he presented his plan to chief Palestinian negotiator Saeb Erekat in Amman, hoping to bring Palestinians back to the negotiating table. Kerry also met with Palestinian President Mahmoud Abbas in Ramallah—the third meeting during this trip. According to the Palestinian Authority’s official news agency, Wafa, preliminary talks could start soon in Washington. However, the Authority's spokesman, Nabil abu Rudaineh, noted that some key details still need to be resolved. If progress continues, Kerry plans to invite Saeb Erekat and an Israeli representative to Washington for initial discussions in the coming days. Israeli Justice Minister Tzipi Livni welcomed the opportunity for renewed talks, acknowledging recent months were marked by skepticism. Livni expressed appreciation for Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s decisions and credited Kerry’s diplomatic efforts in bringing both sides together. While she acknowledged the negotiations would be complex, she emphasized their importance for Israel’s future, security, and values. In Gaza, Hamas dismissed the peace process, calling it ineffective and unlikely to yield results for Palestinians or address issues such as prisoners or borders. Israel has maintained an economic blockade of Gaza since Hamas took control in 2006. Kerry stated the agreement is not yet finalized, and he declined to discuss the specifics. If all goes well, both sides’ representatives are expected to meet him in Washington soon for initial talks, with a formal announcement to follow. Reports have speculated the talks could be based on pre-1967 borders and land swaps, echoing long-standing United Nations resolutions. While such principles could shape a contiguous Palestinian state alongside Israel, Israeli officials have denied formally agreeing to these terms. Netanyahu spokesperson Mark Regev questioned the Reuters report on this topic. Kerry has shared his plan with the Arab League and briefed the Palestinian leadership. In reaction, prominent Palestinian legislator Mustafa Barghouti called for written commitments to the 1967 borders and guarantees against further settlement construction, reflecting a central Palestinian concern. Recent Israeli announcements about West Bank settlement expansion have prompted strong reactions from Palestinians and criticism from Western allies. Major contentious issues for negotiations include: the status of Jerusalem, Jewish settlements in the West Bank, Palestinian security, and the rights of refugees displaced after the 1948 and 1967 wars. Israel captured East Jerusalem, the West Bank, Gaza, Sinai, and the Golan Heights in 1967. It subsequently annexed East Jerusalem, returned Sinai to Egypt through a peace treaty, and withdrew from Gaza, which is now controlled by Hamas. Israel still occupies the West Bank and the Golan Heights. Multiple negotiation attempts have failed to achieve lasting peace, highlighting ongoing challenges to Israeli-Palestinian relations.

article_content: Getting married is often seen as a lasting commitment, ideally filled with countless memorable moments and knowledge you may never need again. My partner and I organized our wedding in just under three months, and it went off with few issues: friends became closer, everyone enjoyed great food and drinks, someone even conceived a baby (not us), and guests left ecstatic and joking about attending a wedding reunion. I also learned a great deal about handling stress, managing expectations, and relying on loved ones—much of which isn’t covered in typical bridal magazines. Over six years later, with our relationship thriving, I’d like to share some perspectives for future brides and grooms. 1. Embrace unpredictability. No matter what minor disasters crop up, you’ll still end up married. I spent way too much energy worrying about details and things beyond my control, only to realize—thanks to good advice from a friend—that what matters is gathering with the people you care about to celebrate love. The focus should be the joy, not the quest for a perfect event. 2. Your guests are there to support you. If something funny or awkward happens, most people are simply glad to share in the experience—not to point out mistakes. Anyone not rooting for you probably doesn’t need to be on your guest list. 3. Welcome help on your terms. We opted for a simple, do-it-yourself wedding to reflect our personalities and reduce expenses. We didn’t have a formal wedding party, but instead gave friends and family the chance to contribute in ways that suited them—whether it was music, decorating, or helping organize. Sharing responsibilities made everyone feel included and connected to our celebration. 4. Be present and soak it all in. It’s common for people to recall their wedding day as a blur. A counselor’s advice inspired me to pause throughout the day and commit these memories to heart, so now I have vivid recollections of important moments, regardless of what the photos show. 5. A post-wedding emotional drop is normal. After the excitement fades, it’s common to feel an emotional dip. For me, saying goodbye to singlehood brought tears, but it was also an exciting moment to move forward as a spouse. These mixed feelings are part of entering a new chapter in life. — Kat Kinsman

Medical examiners are scheduled to perform an autopsy and toxicology tests on 'Glee' actor Cory Monteith after he was found dead at age 31 in his hotel room at the Fairmont Pacific Rim Hotel in Vancouver, Canada. According to police, hotel staff discovered Monteith’s body on Saturday after he failed to check out. Barbara McLintock, a spokeswoman for the B.C. Coroner’s Service, stated that the autopsy will help provide the best possible information to determine the cause of death. While the immediate cause was not apparent, authorities have ruled out foul play.

Monteith had openly discussed his struggle with addiction and had checked into a rehab facility in late March, marking his second treatment stint. In a June interview with Glamour magazine, Monteith shared, 'It’s all about perseverance. Absolute perseverance. You can always get back up.'

Monteith starred as Finn Hudson in the popular Fox series 'Glee' and credited the show’s success with helping turn his life around. In June 2012, he told GoldDerby about the show’s humble beginnings and its impact on him. Following news of his passing, tributes from fans and colleagues flooded social media. The Facebook page 'RIP Cory Monteith' had over 669,000 likes early Monday. The 'Glee' staff released a statement expressing deep sadness at the loss, describing Monteith as 'an exceptional talent and an even more exceptional person.'

Monteith’s co-star and girlfriend, Lea Michele, has not made a public statement but her representatives have asked for privacy on her behalf, adding that she is 'devastated' by his passing. The couple had been dating for over a year, and Michele had previously expressed her support for Monteith’s rehabilitation efforts. Adam Shankman, a director on 'Glee,' shared that he last spoke with Monteith on Saturday and described him as the 'glue' of the show. Shankman said Monteith was feeling positive during their conversation, and expressed his own shock and confusion at the unexpected news.

article_content: Acclaimed fashion designer Tory Burch has engaged Morgan Stanley to help evaluate major pathways for her company, such as a potential sale or taking the brand public, Women's Wear Daily reports. This step suggests that the thriving company—currently facing no significant risks—is open to new possibilities. Among the reasons for considering such strategic changes are succession planning as Tory Burch, at age 57, looks ahead to the future of her enterprise—a common focus for founders as they mature. As successful companies grow, their leadership often shifts from bold, entrepreneurial approaches to more protective decision-making. However, this can mean missing out on bigger deals or expansions. Bringing in new investors, either via a sale or IPO, allows original owners to reduce risk and can reactivate growth. Another typical scenario involves a variety of interests among stakeholders. In the case of Tory Burch's company, overlapping personal and business ties, including her ex-husband Chris Burch as a shareholder, illustrate how differing priorities can spur discussions of liquidity. Some investors may want to exit, while others want to stay invested. Morgan Stanley is reportedly receiving significant interest from potential buyers and investors worldwide, drawn by the brand’s global ambitions and the rarity of such an opportunity in the fashion world. A fitting new partner would offer strong financial backing and share the brand’s vision for expansion. Should the company proceed with a sale, it is expected that there will be competition among bidders. With expert bankers managing the process, Tory Burch’s company would be well placed to achieve a high sale price and prepare for the next phase of growth.

article_content: Amazon Prime Video has launched its first dedicated sports channel in collaboration with Dream Sports-owned FanCode. The channel will live stream over 15 sports globally, including cricket and football. Amazon has previously streamed live cricket matches, such as India vs. New Zealand, and continues efforts to expand in the sports streaming arena. The partnership with FanCode, recognized for both sports streaming and merchandise, further strengthens Amazon’s entry into India’s sizeable sports fan market, where online viewership for cricket can surpass 50 million. FanCode holds streaming rights for cricket in certain regions and partners with various major sports leagues and organizations. Amazon Prime stated that FanCode brings more than 15 sports, including cricket, football, rugby, kabaddi, basketball, and horse racing, to Indian fans. Prime members can subscribe to FanCode on Prime Video Channels through an annual add-on for an introductory price of Rs 249. FanCode has exclusive partnerships with the ICC Pathways, Cricket West Indies, EFL, CONMEBOL, Volleyball World, and FIBA. Subscribers gain access to tournaments such as the Carabao Cup, Women’s Big Bash League, FIFA U17 World Cup, Barclays Women’s Super League, AFC Champions League, AFC Cup, and Yuva Kabaddi. Upcoming events also include the Super Smash and England’s tour of the West Indies later this year. Vivek Srivastava, head of Prime Video Channels in India, stated that the addition of FanCode allows Prime Video to offer an even broader selection of entertainment, now including live sports. The partnership follows a recent intense competition in India’s sports broadcasting market. Mukesh Ambani’s Reliance secured digital rights for the IPL, while Disney Star retained television rights. Ambani also obtained media rights for Indian domestic cricket, and Sony is reportedly near merging with Zee to create a new $10 billion media entity. Reports indicate that India’s cricket authority has tried to attract giants such as Amazon and Alphabet to participate in the auction for team media rights. Additionally, Reliance is reportedly leading discussions to acquire Disney Star's India operations, suggesting shifting market dynamics. Amazon has also been reported to be in talks with Disney to purchase a minority stake in its ESPN streaming service. Yannick Colaco, co-founder of FanCode, emphasized that the association with Prime Video aims to reach sports fans nationwide. FanCode stands out as the first sports platform available through the service. Analyst Karan Taurani at Elara remarked that while the collaboration brings another player to sports streaming, Amazon currently lacks acquisition of major cricket rights (held by Star and Reliance). He noted, however, a significant opportunity exists for Amazon in non-cricket sports, which remains fragmented in India. Other news highlights include India’s central bank tightening capital norms for unsecured loans, Mohammed Shami’s increased endorsement fees during the Cricket World Cup, and Hindustan Zinc Ltd needing government approval for business restructuring.

Somi Guha, a 36-year-old Indian-born actress from Tower Hamlets, east London, has expressed pride in challenging Jeremy Clarkson and the BBC following another controversy involving racist remarks on Top Gear. Guha criticized Clarkson after he used the term 'slope', a derogatory word for people of Asian descent, during a Burma special episode aired in March. After her complaint, Guha received a barrage of hateful messages from Top Gear supporters and saw fake online accounts created in her name. Despite this backlash, Guha stands by her actions and is prepared to speak out again if needed. She sought legal advice from Equal Justice and submitted a formal complaint addressed to BBC Trust chairman Lord Patten. In her letter, Guha condemned ongoing casual racism and racial profiling in the media, especially at the BBC. Equal Justice praised Guha's decision to address the issue.

The controversy arose when the Top Gear hosts—Jeremy Clarkson, Richard Hammond, and James May—built a bridge over the River Kwai in Thailand. Clarkson commented that 'there's a slope on it' as an Asian man crossed the bridge, referring both to the incline and using an offensive term. Co-host Richard Hammond responded: 'You're right, it's definitely higher on that side.' Ofcom, the UK communications regulator, later found that the BBC breached its broadcasting code by including an 'offensive racial term' and failing to assess its potential to cause offense, despite the use being scripted in advance. The BBC explained they saw the word as slang and didn't anticipate its offensiveness outside the UK. The broadcaster later apologized and is now focused on producing new episodes of Top Gear.

This was not Clarkson's first controversy. Shortly after this incident, unaired footage appeared to show Clarkson using the n-word while quoting a nursery rhyme, leading to public outcry and a subsequent apology from Clarkson. He had also been accused of racism for naming his black dog after footballer Didier Drogba and making other inflammatory comments in his newspaper columns.

سومی گوہا، مشرقی لندن کے علاقے ٹاور ہیملٹس سے تعلق رکھنے والی 36 سالہ بھارتی نژاد اداکارہ، نے جیریمی کلارکسن اور بی بی سی کے خلاف ٹاپ گیئر پر نسلی تبصرے کے بعد چیلنج کرنے پر اپنے فخر کا اظہار کیا ہے۔ گوہا نے کلارکسن کی اس وقت مذمت کی جب انہوں نے برما اسپیشل ایپیسوڈ کے دوران 'سلوپ' لفظ (جو ایشیائی افراد کے لیے تحقیر آمیز ہے) استعمال کیا۔ شکایت کے بعد، گوہا کو ٹاپ گیئر کے شائقین کی طرف سے نفرت انگیز پیغامات ملے اور ان کے نام سے جعلی اکاؤنٹس بنائے گئے۔ اس کے باوجود، گوہا اپنے مؤقف پر قائم ہیں اور کہتی ہیں کہ ضرورت پڑی تو وہ پھر آواز اٹھائیں گی۔ انہوں نے قانونی مشورہ لیا اور بی بی سی ٹرسٹ کے چیئرمین لارڈ پیٹن کو باقاعدہ شکایت جمع کروائی۔ اپنے خط میں انہوں نے میڈیا میں معمولی نسل پرستی اور نسلی پروفائلنگ کی مذمت کی، خاص طور پر بی بی سی میں۔ ایکوال جسٹس نے گوہا کے فیصلے کو سراہا۔

یہ تنازع اس وقت سامنے آیا جب ٹاپ گیئر کے میزبان—جیریمی کلارکسن، رچرڈ ہیمونڈ اور جیمز مے—نے تھائی لینڈ میں دریائے کوائی پر ایک پل بنایا۔ کلارکسن نے ایشیائی شخص کے پل پر آنے پر کہا: 'اس پر سلوپ ہے'، جس سے پل کے زاوئیے اور توہین آمیز لفظ دونوں مراد لیے جا سکتے ہیں۔ رچرڈ ہیمونڈ نے کہا: 'آپ ٹھیک کہہ رہے ہیں، یہ واقعی اس طرف اونچا ہے۔' برطانیہ کے ریگولیٹر آف کام نے پایا کہ بی بی سی نے نشر کرنے کے قوانین کی خلاف ورزی کی ہے، کیوں کہ اسکرپٹ میں 'توہین آمیز نسلی اصطلاح' پہلے سے شامل تھی اور براڈکاسٹ سے پہلے اس کے اثر کا جائزہ نہیں لیا گیا۔ بی بی سی نے کہا کہ انہوں نے اس لفظ کو صرف سلیگ سمجھا اور اس کی بین الاقوامی حساسیت کا اندازہ نہیں تھا۔ بعد میں براڈکاسٹر نے معذرت کی اور اب ٹاپ گیئر کے نئے پروگرام بنانے پر توجہ مرکوز کی ہے۔

یہ کلارکسن کی پہلی متنازعہ حرکت نہیں تھی۔ اس واقعے کے بعد، غیر نشر شدہ فوٹیج میں کلارکسن کو ایک نظم میں این ورڈ استعمال کرتے ہوئے سنا گیا، جس پر کافی شور ہوا اور کلارکسن نے معذرت کی۔ ان پر اپنے سیاہ رنگ کے کتے کو معروف فٹبالر ڈیدیئر ڈروگبا کے نام پر رکھنے اور اپنے کالمز میں مزید متنازعہ تبصرے کرنے پر بھی نسل پرستی کے الزامات لگے ہیں۔

article_content: The presidential inauguration is a symbol of American democracy’s orderly transfer or continuation of power. Every four years, the winner of the November election swears an oath to defend the Constitution. As cannons fire and bands play, the event takes place outdoors before large crowds. Although the location, pageantry, and ceremony have evolved since George Washington took the first oath 224 years ago, the core practices have remained consistent throughout American history—occurring 56 times before this occasion. Thirteen years after the Declaration of Independence and over a year after the Constitution was ratified, Washington was sworn in on April 30, 1789, at Federal Hall in New York City. At that time, what is now Washington, D.C. was just a swamp. Setting precedents, Washington kissed the Bible after his oath and started the inaugural parade, led by government officials, Congress members, Army units, and citizens. In 1853, Franklin Pierce broke the tradition of kissing the Bible—instead, he placed his left hand on it. The presidential oath of office, specified in Article II, Section 1 of the Constitution, is unique from oaths for other federal officials. The text reads: 'I do solemnly swear (or affirm) that I will faithfully execute the Office of President of the United States, and will to the best of my ability, preserve, protect and defend the Constitution of the United States.' The phrase '(or affirm)' allows the president-elect to choose between swearing or affirming. Only Franklin Pierce and Herbert Hoover affirmed rather than swore their oath. Though the words 'so help me God' are not part of the Constitutional oath, it is widely believed Washington added them, setting a custom. For example, President Barack Obama requested to include this phrase in his oath. The personal aspect of using a Bible also varies. John F. Kennedy, as the first Catholic president, faced controversy regarding his religious identity. Only three presidents did not use a Bible: John Quincy Adams used a law book, Theodore Roosevelt used no book at all in 1901, and Lyndon B. Johnson used Kennedy’s Catholic missal after Kennedy’s assassination. Inaugural addresses vary widely in length and tone—some set an agenda, others describe governing style. Washington delivered the shortest address (135 words) at his second inauguration in Philadelphia. The longest, about 8,500 words, was William Henry Harrison’s in 1841; he didn’t wear a coat on the cold day and died from pneumonia within a month. Famous inaugural lines include Abraham Lincoln’s 'With malice toward none, with charity for all' (1865); Franklin D. Roosevelt’s 'the only thing we have to fear is fear itself' (1933); and John F. Kennedy’s 'ask not what your country can do for you—ask what you can do for your country' (1961). When January 20 falls on a Sunday—as in 1917, 1957, and 1985—the official oath is performed in private with a public ceremony held the next day. For his second inauguration, Obama took the official oath privately at the White House and then participated in a public ceremony at the Capitol. He is the first president to have both public and private oaths administered. In 2009, when Chief Justice John Roberts made an error administering the oath to Obama, the oath was repeated the following day at the White House to ensure accuracy. Additional milestones: Thomas Jefferson was the first president inaugurated in Washington, D.C., in 1801; the first January 20 inauguration was in 1937 due to the 20th Amendment; Andrew Jackson was the first to take the oath on the Capitol’s East Front, Ronald Reagan the first on the West Front in 1981, and Jimmy Carter in 1977 was the first to walk from the Capitol to the White House. Bill Clinton’s second inauguration in 1997 was the first streamed live on the Internet. CNN’s Connor Finnegan and Robert Yoon contributed to this report.

اور بینڈ بجتے ہیں تو یہ تقریب بڑی عوامی بھیڑ کے سامنے کھلی فضا میں منعقد ہوتی ہے۔ اگرچہ مقام، شان و شوکت اور تقریب وقت کے ساتھ بدلتی رہی ہے، مگر بنیادی روایات 224 سال پہلے جارج واشنگٹن کے پہلے حلف سے آج تک تقریباً ویسی ہی ہیں اور یہ رسم 56 بار ادا ہو چکی ہے۔ آزادی کے اعلان کے تیرہ سال بعد اور آئین منظور ہونے کے ایک سال بعد، واشنگٹن نے 30 اپریل 1789 کو نیو یارک سٹی کے فیڈرل ہال میں حلف لیا۔ اس وقت، آج کا واشنگٹن ڈی سی ایک دلدلی علاقہ تھا۔ واشنگٹن نے بائبل کو چوم کر حلف اٹھانے اور سرکاری اہلکاروں، کانگریس کے ارکان، فوجی دستوں اور شہریوں کے ہمراہ افتتاحی جلوس کی بنیاد رکھی۔ 1853 میں، فرینکلن پیئرس نے بائبل کو چومنے کی روایت توڑی؛ انہوں نے اپنی بائیں ہاتھ اس پر رکھا۔ صدر کا حلف نامہ، جو آئین کے آرٹیکل II، سیکشن 1 میں درج ہے، دیگر وفاقی عہدوں کے حلف سے الگ ہے۔ اس میں لکھا ہے: 'میں سنجیدگی سے حلف اٹھاتا ہوں (یا تصدیق کرتا ہوں) کہ میں امریکہ کے صدر کے عہدے کو ایمانداری سے نبھاؤں گا، اور اپنی پوری صلاحیت کے مطابق آئین کے تحفظ اور دفاع میں کوتاہی نہیں کروں گا۔' '(یا تصدیق کرتا ہوں)' کے الفاظ نو منتخب صدر کو حلف یا تصدیق کے آپشن دیتے ہیں۔ صرف فرینکلن پیئرس اور ہربرٹ ہوور نے تصدیق کا انتخاب کیا۔ اگرچہ 'اللہ کی قسم' کے الفاظ آئینی حلف میں شامل نہیں ہیں، کہا جاتا ہے کہ واشنگٹن نے ان الفاظ کا اضافہ کیا اور یہ ایک روایت بن گئی۔ مثال کے طور پر، صدر باراک اوباما نے یہ فقرہ اپنے حلف میں شامل کرنے کی درخواست کی۔ بائبل کے ذاتی استعمال میں بھی تبدیلیاں ہیں۔ جان ایف کینیڈی پہلے کیتھولک صدر تھے، جن کے مذہبی پس منظر پر بحث ہوئی۔ صرف تین صدور نے بائبل استعمال نہیں کی: جان کوئنسی ایڈمز نے قانون کی کتاب پر حلف اٹھایا، تھیوڈور روزویلٹ نے 1901 میں کوئی کتاب استعمال نہیں کی، اور لنڈن بی جانسن نے کینیڈی کے قتل کے بعد انکا کاتھولک نسخہ استعمال کیا۔ افتتاحی تقاریر لمبائی اور انداز میں مختلف ہوتی ہیں؛ کچھ صدور ایجنڈا پیش کرتے ہیں، کچھ حکمرانی کے انداز کی وضاحت کرتے ہیں۔ واشنگٹن کی دوسری تقریب (فلاڈیلفیا) میں سب سے چھوٹی تقریر (135 الفاظ) تھی۔ سب سے طویل تقریر (8500 الفاظ) ولیم ہنری ہیریسن نے 1841 میں کی تھی، جنہوں نے سرد دن کوٹ نہیں پہنا اور ایک ماہ بعد نمونیا سے انتقال کر گئے۔ یادگار افتتاحی جملوں میں شامل ہیں: ابراہم لنکن کا 'کسی کے خلاف بغض نہیں، سب کے لیے ہمدردی' (1865)، فرینکلن ڈی روزویلٹ کا 'ہمیں صرف خوف سے خوفزدہ ہونا چاہیے' (1933)، اور جان ایف کینیڈی کا 'یہ نہ پوچھو ملک تمھارے لیے کیا کر سکتا ہے، پوچھو تم ملک کے لیے کیا کر سکتے ہو' (1961)۔ جب 20 جنوری اتوار کے دن آ جائے، جیسا کہ 1917، 1957، اور 1985 میں ہوا، تو سرکاری حلف نجی طور پر اور عوامی تقریب اگلے دن ہوتی ہے۔ article_content: Lionel Messi's performance in the World Cup semi-final against the Netherlands has generated much discussion. While some analysts point to his limited touches in the opponent's penalty area and his decisive penalty in the shoot-out, others highlight his leadership during extra time. However, it was Javier Mascherano who provided crucial motivation after the Dutch team pressed in the early minutes of extra time, helping to lead Argentina into the final against Germany. Messi was less influential on the pitch during this match, but his footballing talent is unquestionable. To be ranked alongside legends like Pele, Maradona, Garrincha, and Di Stefano, he may need a match-winning performance in the final at the Maracana, especially as his earlier World Cup displays have received some criticism. There were indications during the semi-final that Messi might not have been at peak fitness, with a sense of heaviness in his movement and signs of fatigue. The intense tackling throughout Brazil 2014 may also be impacting his form. Despite this, expectations remain high for the final. Argentina triumphed over the Netherlands in a penalty shoot-out on Wednesday, securing their place in the World Cup Final. In another significant development, Alan Hansen, the respected BBC football pundit and former Liverpool and Scotland star, is retiring from broadcasting after the final. Hansen, known for his insightful analysis and calm presence, made a major impact both as a player and a broadcaster. During his career, he won three European Cups, eight English league titles, two FA Cups—including the 1986 domestic double as Liverpool captain—and several other honors. Although he was sometimes less recognized in Scotland due to strong competition for international spots and perceptions of his style, Hansen remains one of football’s most thoughtful figures. As Hansen prepares to conclude more than 20 years with the BBC, his legacy as a discerning analyst and outstanding player remains strong. Many regard him as a symbol of intelligence in football, both on and off the pitch.

article_content:
Britney Spears' life has often been defined by confinement: first by poverty, then fame, and finally, family control. From her teenage years, she endured relentless media scrutiny and invasive questions about her appearance and private life. As an adult, Spears lived for 13 years under a court-ordered conservatorship led by her father, which stripped her of basic rights. She could not see her two sons without approval, lost her driving license, had no say in her diet or even the option to drink tea or coffee, and was denied the removal of her contraceptive IUD.

This conservatorship ended two years ago when a judge restored her autonomy. However, as Spears reveals in her memoir 'The Woman In Me,' emotional and physical scars remain. She describes ongoing struggles and doubts whether her family understands the true harm inflicted. For fans awaiting new music, Spears writes that the conservatorship crushed her creative spirit.

Her story traces these hardships back to her career's start in 1998, when sudden fame met public doubt over her independence. Spears' creative contributions, like influencing the sound and imagery of '...Baby One More Time,' were often underestimated or dismissed.

Behind the scenes, Spears influenced key artistic choices, but publicly, her image was tightly managed—presenting her as innocent and wholesome, which often contrasted with her real experiences. She notes that she kept to this narrative, but now states her personal life was never as wild as rumored. She avoided hard drugs, occasionally using prescribed Adderall for her mental health.

Spears' carefully shaped image made her vulnerable to backlash. The memoir reveals deep personal traumas, including a secret abortion during her relationship with Justin Timberlake, for which she did not seek hospital care due to fear of publicity. After their breakup, Spears faced harsh tabloid coverage and invasive journalism.

Under mounting stress, Spears famously shaved her head in 2007—a gesture of defiance after years of public objectification and criticism. Instead of interpreting it as rebellion, the media cited it as evidence of instability. Soon after, the conservatorship was imposed.

In her memoir, Spears writes plainly, detailing her trauma under forced medication and lack of privacy. Relationships were strictly controlled, and any resistance threatened her access to her sons. Despite being deemed incapable of managing her own life, Spears was required to work, judging on X Factor and performing a multi-year Las Vegas residency, generating significant income for others while living on a strict allowance.

The #FreeBritney movement gave Spears hope, leading her to seek legal help and report her situation. Now free, she recognizes her recovery will take time. She expresses deep anger towards her father, described as controlling and abusive, though he has not publicly responded. Spears' memoir stands as a warning about unchecked power and the costs of fame, but also offers hope for her journey toward autonomy and self-discovery.

برٹنی اسپیئرز کی زندگی کافی عرصہ مختلف قسم کی پابندیوں میں گزری: پہلے غربت، پھر شہرت، اور آخرکار اپنے خاندان کے کنٹرول میں۔ نوجوانی میں اُنہیں میڈیا کے بے لگام سوالات اور ذاتی معاملات میں دخل اندازی کا سامنا رہا۔ بالغ ہونے کے بعد وہ تیرہ سال تک اپنے والد کی زیر نگرانی عدالت کے نافذ کردہ کنزرویٹرشپ میں رہیں، جس نے اُن کے بنیادی حقوق سلب کر لیے۔ وہ اجازت کے بغیر اپنے دو بیٹوں سے نہیں مل سکتیں تھیں، اُن کا ڈرائیونگ لائسنس ضبط کیا گیا، کھانے پینے حتیٰ کہ چائے یا کافی پینے کی آزادی نہیں تھی، اور مانع حمل IUD نکلوانے کی درخواست بھی مسترد کر دی گئی۔

یہ کنزرویٹرشپ دو سال پہلے ختم ہوئی جب عدالت نے اُنہیں خود مختاری دی۔ تاہم اپنی کتاب 'دی وومن ان می' میں وہ اب بھی جسمانی و جذباتی اذیت کا ذکر کرتی ہیں اور شکوہ کرتی ہیں کہ اُن کا خاندان اس نقصان کی شدت کو نہیں سمجھ سکا۔ پرستاروں کے لیے بری خبر یہ ہے کہ برٹنی کے مطابق کنزرویٹرشپ نے ان کے تخلیقی جذبے کو بری طرح متاثر کیا۔

برٹنی کی مشکلات کا آغاز 1998 میں اُن کی شہرت کی شروعات سے ہوا جب ان کی صلاحیتوں اور خودمختاری پر شک کیا گیا۔ اگرچہ ’…بیبی ون مور ٹائم‘ کے اندازِ گائیکی اور ہائی اسکول ویڈیو کے تصور میں اُن کا کردار اہم تھا لیکن اکثر نظرانداز کیا گیا۔

اسٹیج کے پیچھے وہ اہم تخلیقی فیصلوں میں شامل تھیں مگر عوامی سطح پر اُنہیں معصوم اور نیک سیرت کے روپ میں پیش کیا جاتا رہا جو اُن کی حقیقت سے مختلف تھا۔ وہ کہتی ہیں کہ اپنی شبیہہ کے مطابق چلتی رہیں لیکن فی الحقیقت اُن کی ذاتی زندگی اتنی ہنگامہ خیز نہیں تھی جتنی خبروں میں دکھائی گئی۔ انہوں نے کبھی نشہ آور منشیات استعمال نہیں کیں، صرف دماغی صحت کے لیے بعض اوقات ایڈرال لی۔

ان کی نوکیلی اور کنٹرولڈ شبیہہ نے میڈیا اور عوام کو تنقید کا موقع دیا۔ یادداشت میں ان کی نجی تکالیف موجود ہیں، جیسے جسٹن ٹمبرلیک کے ساتھ تعلق کے دوران خفیہ اسقاط حمل، جس پر اسپتال نہ جانے کا فیصلہ خبروں کی اشاعت کے خوف کے باعث کیا گیا۔ رشتہ ختم ہونے کے بعد میڈیا نے بڑھ چڑھ کر اُن پر تنقید کی اور ان کے نجی معاملات کو اچھالا۔

دباؤ کے نتیجے میں 2007 میں برٹنی نے اپنے بال منڈوا لیے جو ان کے مطابق معاشرتی دباؤ کے خلاف ایک احتجاج تھا، لیکن میڈیا نے اسے نفسیاتی مسائل کے طور پر پیش کیا۔ کچھ ہی عرصہ بعد اُن پر کنزرویٹرشپ نافذ کر دی گئی۔

برٹنی اپنی آپ بیتی سادہ اور حقیقت پسندانہ انداز میں بیان کرتی ہیں، زبردستی ادویات لینے اور نجی زندگی کی کمی کی بات کرتی ہیں۔ اُن کے تعلقات پر مکمل کنٹرول تھا اور مزاحمت کی صورت میں بیٹوں سے ملنے کا حق بھی چھن سکتا تھا۔ خود مختاری سے محرومی کے باوجود انہیں کام کرنا پڑا—ایکس فیکٹر پر جج کا کردار اور لاس ویگاس میں سالوں طویل پرفارمنس—جس سے دوسروں کو مالی فائدہ ہوا جبکہ وہ خود محدود رقم پر گزارہ کررہی تھیں۔

#FreeBritney کی مہم اُن کے لیے امید بنی، جس کے بعد انہوں نے قانونی مدد حاصل کی اور اپنی صورتحال بیان کی۔ آزادی کے بعد بھی انہیں علم ہے کہ مکمل بحالی میں وقت لگے گا۔ وہ اپنے والد پر شدید غصہ محسوس کرتی ہیں جنہیں کنٹرول کرنے والا اور سخت گیر قرار دیتی ہیں جبکہ والد نے اس پر کوئی ردعمل نہیں دیا۔ برٹنی کی کتاب شہرت اور بے لگام اختیار کے نقصانات اور اپنی شناخت کی تلاش میں جدو جہد کا سبق دیتی ہے۔

article_content: Holly Bleasdale, a young British pole-vaulter, experienced a day of mixed emotions at the Olympic Games. She finished sixth in the pole vault final and was visibly upset after not winning a medal. However, her mood shifted when her boyfriend, Paul Bradshaw, proposed to her following the event. The couple shared their engagement news on Twitter, with Bleasdale describing it as an 'epic day.' During the final, Bleasdale appeared nervous and emotional while attempting to clear 4.55 meters, frequently looking to her coach, Julien Raffalli-Ebezant, for support. She was unable to clear the height on her third attempt and was clearly devastated. Despite the disappointment, she smiled and acknowledged the cheering crowd after regaining her composure. Bleasdale, only 20 years old and in her first Olympic appearance after just three years of competitive vaulting, said she was focusing on the positives despite her heartbreak, highlighting her achievement of finishing among the top eight. Earlier that year, she had set a new British indoor record with a 4.87m vault, ranking her second in the world all-time. She has also addressed negative comments about her physique from internet critics, emphasizing that strength is essential for success in pole vaulting, rather than adhering to specific body expectations. In another Olympic event, Welsh athlete Dai Greene placed fourth in the 400m hurdles, just missing out on a medal.

article_content: At Japan’s Asahiyama Zoo in Hokkaido, zookeepers parade their penguins twice daily through the snow from December to March. This Penguin Walk, now a celebrated attraction, helps keep the birds healthy during the winter months, when they tend to accumulate more fat due to reduced activity. Each 30-minute walk encourages exercise to prevent obesity and draws crowds of tourists from around the world. London photographer Paul Brown recently visited the zoo and captured the lively event. He described the friendly atmosphere, observing how the penguins—relaxed and comfortable in front of the audience—waddle together like friends on a casual stroll. Children watched eagerly, waving and clapping, while staff ensured that visitors remained seated and refrained from startling the birds. The event is well-organized, with signs in Japanese and English advising against the use of flash photography. The penguins, accustomed to attention, calmly complete their walk, occasionally stopping to stretch or shake off snow, seemingly unfazed by the crowds.

article_content: A group of British MPs has suggested that the country should restrict immigration while citizens are struggling to find jobs. Frank Field (Labour) and Nicholas Soames (Conservative), who lead the Cross Party Group on Balanced Migration, believe the government should have the power to halt immigration during periods of high unemployment. Writing in the Daily Telegraph, the MPs expressed concern over what they described as unsustainable immigration levels, despite efforts by the Coalition government to reduce them. They emphasized the need to address immigration from EU countries, particularly with the anticipated influx from Bulgaria and Romania. The MPs suggested that EU members should have the option to limit the free movement of labor during times of high unemployment, a right currently protected by EU law. Field and Soames supported Prime Minister David Cameron's recent proposals to limit access to benefits, the NHS, and social housing for European immigrants, but argued these measures did not go far enough. They advocated for an entitlement card system to access NHS services and argued that access to public services should be linked to contributions. The MPs also responded to criticisms that stricter immigration controls could harm economic growth, stating that controls should not prevent businesses from hiring necessary talent and that the process for recruiting skilled workers should be simplified and expedited.

article_content: French bishop Georges Colomb faces a preliminary charge of attempting to rape an adult man in 2013, as stated by the Paris prosecutor's office. This case is the latest amid increasing reports of sexual abuse involving Catholic clergy in France. Colomb denies the allegation and asserts his right to be presumed innocent. He has requested that the Vatican temporarily remove him from his role as bishop of La Rochelle and Saintes, in order to prepare his defense. The investigative outlet Mediapart has reported that senior Church officials had knowledge of these accusations for several years. Prosecutors, however, were only informed in May when attorneys for the Paris Archdiocese and the Foreign Missions of Paris (MEP) submitted a formal report concerning the 2013 incident. At the time, Colomb headed MEP and the alleged victim was residing at their premises. Colomb was appointed bishop in 2016. Following the investigation, he was taken into custody for questioning, and a preliminary charge was filed last Friday. He remains under judicial supervision and is prohibited from contacting the accuser or any witnesses during the investigation. The accuser’s name has not been disclosed. After the alleged event, he reportedly confided in MEP official Gilles Reithinger, now the bishop of Strasbourg. As per Reithinger, the accuser said Colomb suggested an oil massage that made him uncomfortable but did not mention direct sexual misconduct. Reithinger stated that he informed Colomb’s then-superior but did not see grounds to alert law enforcement. The French bishops' conference expressed concern for the alleged victim and offered support to those impacted by the situation. Colomb’s legal counsel did not respond to requests for comment. France continues to confront its history of church-related sexual abuse. In 2021, a report estimated around 330,000 children suffered abuse by clergy or church-affiliated individuals over the past 70 years, as determined by the National Institute of Health and Medical Research.

article_content:
Prime Video updates its streaming catalog monthly, adding new films and occasionally removing others. This means you might feel rushed to watch certain movies before they leave, or you may accidentally miss out on new additions perfectly suited to your tastes. To help, we’re highlighting three underrated movies to watch on Prime Video this November: a visually striking sci-fi horror, an intense psychological thriller, and an endearing romantic comedy.

'Hollow Man' is a sci-fi horror movie starring Kevin Bacon, directed by Paul Verhoeven. Although it received mixed reviews at its 2000 release, it's still renowned for its special effects, even earning an Academy Award nomination in this category. Bacon plays Sebastian Caine, a scientist who experiments with invisibility serum, only to face dire consequences when the process can’t be reversed. His subsequent actions fuel a suspenseful plot. The film co-stars Elisabeth Shue, Josh Brolin, and Kim Dickens.

If thrillers are more your style, check out 'Along Came a Spider.' Morgan Freeman returns as retired detective Alex Cross in this sequel to 'Kiss the Girls.' When the daughter of the U.S. president is kidnapped, Cross teams up with Secret Service agent Jezzie Flannigan, played by Monica Potter, to solve the case. Critics noted the film’s familiar formula, but it remains a gritty and entertaining neo-noir psychological thriller.

For a lighter pick, '10 Things I Hate About You' is a 1990s teen romantic comedy inspired by Shakespeare’s 'The Taming of the Shrew.' The film stars Heath Ledger as Patrick and Julia Stiles as Kat, whose unlikely romance develops through witty dialogue and charming performances. The movie is celebrated for its clever script and memorable cast, making it one of the decade’s standout rom-coms.

All three titles are available to stream now on Prime Video.

'ہالو مین' ایک سائنس فکشن ہارر فلم ہے جس میں کیون بیکن مرکزی کردار ادا کرتے ہیں، اور اسے پال ورہوون نے ڈائریکٹ کیا ہے۔ اگرچہ 2000 میں اس فلم کو ملے جلے تبصرے ملے تھے، لیکن آج بھی اس کے اسپیشل ایفیکٹس کو سراہا جاتا ہے اور اس کیٹیگری میں اکیڈمی ایوارڈ کے لیے نامزدگی بھی ملی تھی۔ کیون بیکن اس میں سائنسدان سباسچن کین کے کردار میں جلوہ گر ہیں، جو خود پر اَن دیکھی ہونے والا سیرم استعمال کرتے ہیں مگر جب اس کے اثرات واپس نہیں ہو پاتے تو صورتحال خطرناک ہو جاتی ہے۔ اس کی حرکات سے کہانی میں مزید سنسنی آ جاتی ہے۔ اداکارہ الزبتھ شو، جوش برولن اور کم ڈکنز بھی نمایاں کرداروں میں ہیں۔

اگر آپ سنسنی اور تھرل پسند کرتے ہیں تو 'آلانگ کیم آ سپائیڈر' ضرور دیکھیں۔ اس میں مورگن فری مین ایک بار پھر ریٹائرڈ ڈیٹیکٹیو ایلکس کراس کے کردار میں واپسی کرتے ہیں، جو 'کس دی گرلز' کا سیکوئل ہے۔ جب امریکی صدر کی بیٹی کو اغوا کیا جاتا ہے تو کراس، سیکریٹ سروس ایجنٹ جیزی فلینگن (مونیكا پوٹر) کے ساتھ مل کر تحقیقات کرتے ہیں۔ اگرچہ ناقدین نے اس فلم کی روایت پسندی کو نشانہ بنایا، پھر بھی یہ ایک جاندار اور دلچسپ نیو نائر سائیکولوجیکل تھرلر ہے۔

اگر آپ ہلکی پھلکی، محبت بھری فلم دیکھنا چاہتے ہیں تو 'ٹین تھنگز آئی ہیٹ اباؤٹ یو' ایک شاندار انتخاب ہے۔ یہ 1990 کی دہائی کی ٹین رومانوی کامیڈی ہے، جو شیکسپیئر کے 'دی ٹیمِنگ آف دی شرو' سے متاثر ہے۔ ہیٹ لیجر (پیٹرک) اور جولیا اسٹائلز (کیٹ) کی جاندار اداکاری اور دلکش مکالموں کے ساتھ داستان پیش کرتی ہے۔ اسے ذہین اسکرپٹ اور منفرد کاسٹ کی وجہ سے سراہا جاتا ہے اور یہ اس دہائی کی بہترین روم کومز میں شامل ہے۔

article_content: A 16-year-old Muslim student at Camden School for Girls in North London has not started her A-level studies due to a dispute about her wish to wear a full-face veil (niqab) in the coeducational sixth form. The student, who has attended the school for five years without wearing a niqab, now wants to cover her face and hair for religious reasons. Headmistress Elizabeth Kitcatt has reportedly stated that the student cannot join the sixth form if she insists on wearing the niqab, as it conflicts with the school’s appearance policy. Although the sixth form does not have a uniform, all students must follow a dress code concerning appearance, health and safety, and requirements for effective teaching and learning. Over 700 people have signed a petition on Change.org, criticizing the school’s decision as Islamophobic. The student initially believed she wasn’t eligible for the sixth form after receiving a C in English language, but was later told she actually achieved an A and was eligible. Her sister, Sagal Ahmed, stated the decision was very upsetting and that her education should not be affected by her clothing. Headmistress Kitcatt said the school does not comment on individual cases, but emphasized that the appearance policy exists to uphold standards necessary for teaching and learning. Former pupils have supported the girl’s choice to wear the niqab, noting the school’s history of supporting individuality and feminist ideals. Notable alumnae include Sarah Brown, Geri Halliwell, Emma Thompson, and Tamsin Greig.

article_content: Jessica Laney, a 16-year-old from Hudson, Florida, died by suicide after friends say she faced ongoing online bullying. They report that Jessica received frequent anonymous abuse on Ask.fm, a site where users can ask questions without revealing who they are. The negative messages targeted her appearance and personal life, with some urging her to end her life. Jessica had used her social media profiles to share struggles with family tensions, school disputes, and loneliness. Despite her hardships, she also posted words of encouragement for others, assuring them that tough periods can improve. After her passing, her friends and classmates launched efforts to close Ask.fm, arguing its anonymity enables harassment. Over 3,000 people signed a petition, and students at Fivay High School honored Jessica by wearing purple. Officials from Pasco County noted that Jessica’s family and boyfriend weren't aware of the bullying, and the school had not received formal reports about it. Authorities are investigating and examining her social network activity. Ask.fm, aimed at teenagers and boasting over 20 million users, has faced criticism after being linked to several teen suicides, including cases in Ireland. While its terms of service prohibit harmful content, critics question the effectiveness of these measures. Jessica's death has led to online tributes and renewed calls to address bullying. The site's founder has defended Ask.fm as a communication tool, urging people to practice kindness and responsibility. Nonetheless, her community continues to push for action against bullying.

article_content: Maya Joseph, a woman from Luton living with dwarfism and limited vision, was unable to walk for ten years due to a spinal condition. According to Maya, her condition changed suddenly after a prayer session at St George’s Church in Milton Keynes, where Reverend George Booty prayed for her. Maya says the chronic pain in her legs disappeared during the service, enabling her to walk unassisted for the first time in a decade. Although her doctors had been doubtful about her ability to walk again, Maya now reports feeling stronger and regularly goes on walks. Reverend Booty, who was ordained in 2003 after previous careers as a psychotherapist and in other fields, attributes the experience to faith, insisting he serves merely as a channel. He also notes that others have described health improvements following his services, but these are unverified. Maya, who works as an author and actress, is currently raising funds for an advanced eye surgery in the United States in hopes of improving her vision.

The Wall Street Journal reported today that Meta is planning to charge $14 a month for an ad-free version of Instagram or Facebook. The 'or' in this context indicates that users will need to pay separately if they want both platforms without ads. This subscription pricing is reportedly intended only for European users who do not consent to the company using their online activity for targeted advertising. Under European Union regulations, companies must seek user consent before displaying personalized ads. Meta is introducing this option in response to EU regulatory demands for improved user data protection. Earlier this year, Mark Zuckerberg stated he was open to paid service options as privacy scrutiny increased.

Other social platforms, such as TikTok, Snapchat, X, and Meta, have also introduced paid subscription features and user verification programs. Snapchat, for example, has limited certain features behind a subscription, leading some users to express privacy concerns and reconsider using the service. Many individuals want safer, private platforms for sharing with friends and family, but subscription models are becoming more widespread.

Meta's proposal gives European users a choice between continuing to use Instagram and Facebook for free with personalized ads or paying for an ad-free version, according to sources familiar with the matter. Meta has submitted the proposal to EU regulatory commissions for review. It remains unclear if similar paid options will be introduced in the U.S. in the future.

article_content: China's travel agencies are now required to follow a comprehensive new set of regulations after the country implemented its first tourism law. The 112-article law, approved in April and effective from October 1, is designed to promote sustainable growth in the tourism industry. Its measures address key issues within the domestic sector—including tourist safety, unfair competition, and the controversial practice of forced shopping trips, where low-cost tours are subsidized by shop commissions. According to state media agency Xinhua, tour operators in China have increased their prices as a result of the new law. Joseph Tung Yao-chung, executive director of the Hong Kong Travel Industry Council, told Mingpao newspaper that on October 1 (Hong Kong's National Day), 250 Chinese tourist groups registered to visit Hong Kong, which is 30% fewer than the previous year. Experts say the new regulations are intended to foster fair competition. Wang Yanqi, director of the Research Center of Leisure Economy of China, described the rise in tour prices as a return to fair business practices, in contrast to previous price wars. The law also mandates state planning for tourism development. Agencies and guides breaking its provisions may face steep penalties, with fines reaching up to RMB 300,000 (roughly $49,000). While the law mainly focuses on domestic tourism, it also contains articles addressing the rights of travelers on outbound trips arranged by Chinese companies. With the UN World Tourism Organization projecting that 100 million Chinese travelers will go abroad by 2015, and with Chinese tourists having overtaken Americans and Germans as the world's top international tourism spenders in 2012, there is mounting global scrutiny of Chinese tourist behavior. Responding to such concerns, Chinese Vice Premier Wang Yang appealed earlier this year for tourists to improve their manners and cultivate a positive image worldwide. The new law highlights appropriate behavior, with Article 14 urging tourists to observe public order, respect local customs and culture, protect the environment, and follow norms of civilized conduct. To reinforce these standards, the National Tourism Administration distributed a 64-page illustrated 'Guidebook for Civilized Tourism' that includes practical advice—such as saying 'please,' 'thank you,' and 'excuse me'—alongside cultural do's and don'ts for specific countries. The guide advises, for example, against discussing babies' eyes in Iran, or giving handkerchiefs as gifts in Italy. Other sections advise tourists not to deface historical relics, to maintain cleanliness, respect queues, tip for good service where customary, and to be considerate at buffets and live shows. Guidance on etiquette extends to proper toilet use and considerate photography. The guidebook also covers specific cultural advice: in the UK, avoid asking people 'Where are you going?' or 'Have you eaten yet?'; in Korea, wait for elders to start eating and face sideways when drinking; in Spain, women are encouraged to wear earrings when going out. Through these initiatives, the Chinese government aims to raise the quality and reputation of its outbound tourism amid rapidly expanding global travel.

article_content: Clint Eastwood, the iconic actor and director, publicly endorsed Mitt Romney during a private fundraiser in Sun Valley, Idaho. At the gathering on Friday night, Eastwood joined hundreds of supporters and stressed that the country needs revitalization, stating his plan to vote for Romney in the presidential race. Previously, Eastwood clarified that while some interpreted his Super Bowl 'Halftime in America' commercial as supportive of President Obama, he was not endorsing any candidate at that time. At the fundraiser, Eastwood recounted seeing Romney in political ads years earlier in Massachusetts while working on 'Mystic River,' and joked about Romney having a presidential look. Now 82 and a part-time Sun Valley resident, Eastwood expressed hope that Romney would implement a fairer tax system to reduce divisions over taxation. His endorsement adds to Romney’s list of celebrity backers that includes Jon Voight and Kid Rock. Grateful for the support, Romney remarked, 'He just made my day.' The campaign has not confirmed whether Eastwood will take on further campaign activities. Meanwhile, as President Obama celebrated his 51st birthday, the Republican National Committee sent him a cake with the words 'Happy birthday Mr President. You didn't bake this,' referencing Obama’s previous remark about government support in business. A Republican spokesperson wished Obama a happy birthday and emphasized their focus on job creation.

article_content: District Judge Tim Devas criticized government rules requiring compulsory victim surcharges, after he ordered a serial thief to pay £1 in compensation for a 'very mean' crime, then handed over the payment himself. Judge Devas, presiding at Mansfield Magistrates’ Court, passed the £1 coin to a surprised clerk to clear the penniless defendant's debt. He commented that courts must impose compensation orders regardless of criminals' financial circumstances and joked, 'My chances of getting a knighthood are pretty slim anyway.' The case involved Daniel Northridge, a 20-year-old homeless man with limited means and little family support, who admitted to stealing two letters from a communal mailbox in his block of flats during the Christmas period, hoping to find cash. Prosecutor Robert Carr stated Northridge was caught on CCTV and had prior convictions for theft and burglary. He was automatically recalled to custody for 28 days, and, after serving the sentence, returned to court for this theft. Northridge was believed to be living in emergency accommodation. Judge Devas handed down a six-month community order and ordered the £1 compensation, calling the offense 'very mean,' especially at that time of year. After the hearing, a spokesperson from the Ministry of Justice explained that the judge's comments referred to required Victim Surcharge payments, which are usually £60 for community sentences. Javed Khan from Victim Support criticized the low compensation, calling it 'insensitive,' and emphasizing that offenders should be held personally accountable for paying compensation, regardless of the amount.

article_content: Mexico's government airlifted thousands of stranded tourists from the hurricane-devastated resort of Los Cabos as a weakened Hurricane Odile moved over the Gulf of California on Wednesday, heading toward Arizona. Another storm, Polo, was forming to the south. Odile, initially a Category 3 hurricane, was downgraded to a tropical storm and was expected to reach Arizona by Wednesday evening, with the Tucson area forecasted to be hit hardest. Phoenix was also at risk of heavy rain and strong winds, according to the US National Hurricane Center. Parts of Arizona and New Mexico could receive up to 6 to 9 inches of rain, potentially causing flash floods. In Los Cabos, extensive damage left about 26,000 tourists—both Mexican and foreign—stranded. The Mexican armed forces airlifted tourists free of charge to airports in Tijuana, Mazatlan, Guadalajara, and Mexico City, where they could catch connecting flights. The Los Cabos International Airport was closed to commercial flights due to severe damage. Residents of Baja California Sur faced power outages, water shortages, and long lines for emergency supplies. Reports of looting were scattered amid the chaos. Some 685 U.S. tourists flown to Tijuana were later transported to the US border. Among the stranded were a group of eight women attending a bachelorette party and a tourist from California celebrating his birthday. Many described the destruction as overwhelming. Authorities estimated it would take two days to evacuate approximately 30,000 tourists, most of whom were foreigners from the US, Canada, and Great Britain. Temporary shelters and hotels provided refuge. No deaths directly related to Odile were reported, though 135 people suffered minor injuries. Humanitarian aid was being dispatched, and efforts to restore utilities were underway. Meanwhile, Tropical Storm Polo threatened to develop into a hurricane and could pass near Los Cabos by Sunday, though its center was expected to remain offshore. In the Atlantic, Hurricane Edouard was causing life-threatening rip currents along the US East Coast. Residents in Arizona were preparing for Odile's remnants by filling sandbags to protect their homes from possible flooding.

Eddie Redmayne, celebrated for his role as Stephen Hawking in 'The Theory of Everything,' is now preparing to embody Lili Elbe, a groundbreaking transgender figure in history. Lili, originally Einar Wegener, was a Danish painter who, with the unwavering support of her wife Gerda Gottlieb, became among the first people to undergo gender reassignment surgery in the early 1930s.

Directed by Tom Hooper, the upcoming film will delve into Lili's extraordinary life, her journey toward self-discovery, and the deep bond with Gerda, who is portrayed by Alicia Vikander. The couple met at the Royal Danish Academy of Fine Arts and married in 1904, working together as illustrators across Europe. Lili’s identity began to come forward after Einar posed as a female model for Gerda’s artwork. Eventually, the couple settled in Paris, where Lili lived openly as a woman, supported by Gerda.

Lili underwent a series of pioneering and risky surgeries in Germany led by Dr. Magnus Hirschfeld and Dr. Warnekros between 1930 and 1931. Despite medical advances, Lili tragically died in 1931 due to complications from an experimental uterus transplant. After Lili’s passing, Gerda remarried Major Fernando Porta, but the marriage ended after a few years, and she died single in 1940. Lili Elbe’s story remains a testament to courage, love, and the enduring search for authenticity.

article_content: ChromeOS 119 is arriving on many Chromebooks, bringing several useful upgrades. One of the main additions is a new shortcut for Steam in the app drawer, letting users install Steam more easily without having to turn on any special settings. Steam is not automatically installed—you’ll only get it if you want it. This update also adds more functionality. The Privacy Hub now offers quick switches for your camera and microphone, making privacy management simpler. Chromebook Plus devices gain the Google Drive File Sync option, so you can access your files offline, though this relies on having enough space on your Chromebook. For example, the Acer Chromebook Plus 515 has 128GB built-in storage; if your Google One plan includes 200GB, syncing is still limited by the device's capacity. ChromeOS 119 improves tab management too. You can enable a feature to save and recall Tab Groups, which makes it easier to keep your browser organized. This requires turning on an experimental flag, after which you can save groups and later restore them from your bookmarks bar—even on Windows or macOS if you’ve enabled the same flag. Most Chromebooks have already updated automatically, but users can check for ChromeOS 119 manually. Lastly, the Acer Chromebook 516 GE is highlighted for its excellent gaming features like a high-refresh display and an RGB keyboard, making it a strong choice even for non-gamers.

article_content: Heinrich Himmler's love letters to his wife will be published for the first time. Hundreds of private letters, notes, and photographs from the notorious SS commander, dating from 1927 to 1945, will be released on Sunday by Germany’s Die Welt newspaper. Himmler, who orchestrated the Holocaust that took the lives of six million Jews, met his future wife Marga—then the manager of a Berlin nursing home—in 1927. These documents shed light on the early days of their relationship and document the breakdown of their marriage from 1938, when Himmler began an affair with his private secretary. Now stored in Tel Aviv, the documents were once held by an Israeli family. They are expected to reveal further details about Himmler’s extreme anti-Semitism and provide new insights into the Nazi regime’s rise and fall. After Himmler committed suicide in Allied custody by swallowing a cyanide pill, US soldiers took the documents from a safe in the Himmler family home. It remains unclear how they eventually reached Israel. Die Welt states the letters have been independently authenticated. Michael Hollmann, president of the German Federal Archive, told The Telegraph: ‘We are sure about these documents. There is no reason to doubt the authenticity of the documents in Tel Aviv.’ While the letters do not change the overall understanding of the Nazi regime, they contribute many previously unknown details about Himmler’s character, daily life, and surroundings.

Model Gigi Hadid has publicly condemned the targeting of innocent people following the recent large-scale attacks by Hamas on Israel and the subsequent declaration of war by Israel. In a detailed Instagram post on Tuesday, Hadid stated, “While I have hopes and dreams for Palestinians, none of them include the harm of a Jewish person.” She expressed deep empathy and heartbreak for the Palestinian struggle and conditions under occupation.

According to official reports, the death toll since Hamas’ surprise attack has reached 1,200 Israelis and, as of Tuesday, 900 Gazans, as reported by CBS News. Many civilians are among those who have lost their lives.

Both Gigi Hadid and her sister, Bella Hadid, have previously shown support for the Palestinian cause. Their father, Mohamed Hadid, a Palestinian-American real estate developer, has shared his experience of becoming a refugee as a baby in 1948 after the outbreak of the Arab-Israeli war, according to Mondoweiss. Mohamed Hadid reshared his daughter’s statement shortly after its posting, emphasizing his own distress over recent events and criticizing Israel’s government for escalating tensions. In his recent social media posts, he condemned the killing of civilians, women, and children, and stated, “There is a boiling point… I don’t know nor do I care for Hamas as much as I don’t know nor do I care where these settlers come from. But they are not angels.”

In the months leading up to the recent attacks, both sisters, along with other celebrities, were recognized for raising awareness and sympathy for the Palestinian cause among segments of the US left, as noted by Insider’s Isobel van Hagen. Gigi Hadid stressed in her Instagram post that the terrorizing of innocent people is not aligned with and does not help the 'Free Palestine' movement.

As of Wednesday, Bella Hadid had not made a public statement on Instagram about the recent events, though her followers have been urging her to comment.

سرکاری رپورٹس کے مطابق، حماس کے اچانک حملے کے بعد اب تک ہلاک ہونے والوں کی تعداد 1,200 اسرائیلی اور منگل تک 900 غزہ کے افراد ہے، جیسے سی بی ایس نیوز نے رپورٹ کیا۔ مرنے والوں میں بہت سے عام شہری بھی شامل ہیں۔

حال ہی میں ہونے والے حملوں سے پہلے دونوں بہنیں اور دیگر مشہور شخصیات فلسطینی مقصد کے لیے امریکی بائیں بازو میں ہمدردی بڑھانے میں کردار ادا کر چکی ہیں، جیسا کہ انسائیڈر کی اسوبل وان ہیگن نے بتایا۔ جیجی حدید نے اپنی انسٹاگرام پوسٹ میں بھی کہا کہ معصوم لوگوں کو نشانہ بنانا 'فری فلسطین' تحریک کا حصہ نہیں اور اس سے کوئی فائدہ نہیں ہوتا۔

بدھ تک بیلا حدید نے اس حوالے سے انسٹاگرام پر کوئی بیان نہیں دیا تھا، البتہ ان کے فالوورز اُن سے ردعمل کی توقع کر رہے ہیں۔

article_content: Australian actor Sam Worthington was arrested in New York following an altercation with a photographer at the Cubbyhole bar in Greenwich Village. The incident reportedly occurred after the photographer allegedly kicked Worthington’s partner, Lara Bingle, 26. Worthington, 37, then punched the photographer and referred to Bingle as his 'wife' during the incident, shouting, 'you kicked my wife.' There has been speculation this year that Worthington and Bingle secretly married in Western Australia before a trip to the Maldives. However, a friend of Lara’s stated to MailOnline that Worthington was likely speaking figuratively and that, to their knowledge, the couple is not married. Both have been seen wearing matching rings. New York Police Department Lieutenant John Grimpel confirmed Worthington’s arrest, stating the photographer kicked Lara Bingle and Worthington then punched him, leading to lacerations on the photographer’s nose. Worthington has been charged with assault and released on bail, due to appear in court on February 26. The photographer was also arrested and charged with assault, reckless endangerment, and harassment. Eyewitnesses saw Worthington being taken away by police, with several sharing accounts of the incident on Twitter. The Cubbyhole is a well-known gay bar in Manhattan's West Village. This marks Worthington’s second reported altercation with a photographer; in 2012, he was arrested and pepper-sprayed in Atlanta after an argument outside a restaurant. Worthington and Bingle have been in New York since the start of Fashion Week, attending events together and being photographed publicly. Bingle, who designs for Cotton On Body, has expressed her intention to move to New York due to concerns about privacy in Australia and discomfort with frequent media attention. MailOnline has contacted representatives for Worthington and Bingle for comment.

article_content: Spectators at Edgbaston Stadium's fireworks display have called for refunds after weather conditions severely affected the show. Videos posted online show thick smoke obscuring the display on Saturday evening. Touted as Birmingham's 'biggest fireworks spectacular', the event left many ticket holders disappointed, some taking to social media to voice their frustrations. The venue confirmed that adverse weather, including a lingering mist, impacted the event. Hundreds gathered in the stands, anticipating the show. One attendee's video shared with the BBC shows the display beginning as planned, with colorful fireworks lighting up the sky. However, thick plumes of smoke quickly filled the area, making it difficult to see the fireworks. Several videos on X show families leaving early, while others appear shocked by the situation. Steph Darby from Tipton said she spent nearly £100 for her family to attend. She told the BBC, 'Within about 20 seconds, it was obvious something was wrong. Smoke filled the area so quickly that you couldn't see the fireworks or even where they were being launched. Some of the fireworks were hitting the floodlights, and the smoke just didn't clear.' She added, 'It was disappointing, especially as my two children had never seen fireworks before and were excited. People were leaving just five minutes in.' Bernie Phillips from Kings Heath, who attended with her daughter, told the BBC, 'As the smoke came in, many young children were frightened and families left. Some of the only fireworks visible were those hitting the floodlights, which was scary. They continued the show, which seemed like a waste.' Many people called for refunds. One user on X said, 'We had to go inside; the smoke was choking us. I've never seen so much smoke from a fireworks display. The display should have been stopped and delayed after the first minute.' Another wrote, 'Shame. We had high hopes, but after seeing fireworks bounce off the floodlights, it was a disaster. We're very disappointed and would like a refund.' A spokesperson for Edgbaston Stadium said, 'The Fireworks Spectacular is one of our most popular annual events, with families returning every year, so we're disappointed that adverse weather affected last night's show. The same fireworks were used on Friday, when 4,000 visitors enjoyed a great display in clear conditions. However, last night, the mist and atmospheric conditions prevented the smoke from dispersing. We understand other displays in the region were also affected.' The stadium added that an experienced pyrotechnics company staged the event and thorough risk assessments are conducted before and during displays. An investigation is underway, and the stadium will contact all ticket holders as soon as possible. Follow BBC West Midlands on Facebook, X, and Instagram. مگر پھر جلد ہی دھواں بھر گیا، جس سے کچھ بھی نظر آنا مشکل ہوگیا۔ سوشل میڈیا پلیٹ فارم X پر شیئر کی گئی ویڈیوز میں کئی خاندانوں کو جلد چلے جاتے دیکھا گیا جبکہ دیگر لوگوں کو صورتحال پر حیران دیکھا گیا۔ ٹیپن کی اسٹیف ڈاربی نے بتایا کہ انہوں نے اپنے خاندان کے لیے تقریباً £100 خرچ کیے۔ انہوں نے بی بی سی کو بتایا: 'بیس سیکنڈ کے اندر ہی واضح ہو گیا کہ کچھ غلط ہے۔ دھواں اتنی تیزی سے پھیل گیا کہ آتشبازی یا لانچنگ پوائنٹ نظر نہیں آرہا تھا۔ کچھ پٹاخے فلڈ لائٹس سے ٹکرا رہے تھے اور دھواں چھٹ ہی نہیں رہا تھا۔' انہوں نے مزید کہا: 'یہ بہت مایوس کن تھا، خاص طور پر کیونکہ میرے دونوں بچے پہلی بار آتشبازی دیکھنے آئے تھے۔ لوگ شو شروع ہونے کے پانچ منٹ بعد ہی جانے لگے۔' کنگز ہیتھ کی برنی فلپس، جو اپنی بیٹی کے ساتھ آئی تھیں، نے بی بی سی کو بتایا: 'جیسے ہی دھواں آیا، بہت سے بچے ڈر گئے اور خاندان جلدی واپس چلے گئے۔ جو کچھ آتشبازی دکھائی دے رہی تھی وہ فلڈ لائٹس سے ٹکرا رہی تھی، جو کافی ڈراؤنی تھی۔ شو جاری رہا، جو پیسے اور وقت کا ضیاع محسوس ہوا۔' کئی لوگوں نے ریفنڈ کا مطالبہ کیا۔ ایک صارف نے ایکس پر لکھا: 'ہمیں اندر جانا پڑا، دھواں سانس لینے میں مشکل کر رہا تھا۔ میں نے کبھی کسی آتشبازی کے شو میں اتنا دھواں نہیں دیکھا۔ شو کو پہلے منٹ میں روک کر موخر ہونا چاہیے تھا۔' ایک اور نے کہا: 'افسوس، بڑی امیدیں تھیں لیکن فلڈ لائٹس سے ٹکراتی آتشبازی کے بعد سب کچھ خراب ہوگیا۔ ہم بہت مایوس ہیں اور ریفنڈ چاہتے ہیں۔' ایجبسٹن اسٹیڈیم کے ترجمان نے کہا: 'فائر ورکس اسپیکٹیکل ہمارا سب سے مقبول سالانہ ایونٹ ہے اور کئی خاندان ہر سال آتے ہیں، اس لیے ہمیں افسوس ہے کہ خراب موسم نے اس بار شو کو متاثر کیا۔ جمعہ کی رات اسی قسم کی آتشبازی ہوئی تھی اور 4,000 مہمانوں نے صاف آسمان میں شو انجوائے کیا۔ تاہم گزشتہ رات کہر اور موسم کی صورتحال نے دھواں چھٹنے نہیں دیا۔ ہمیں معلوم ہے کہ علاقے کے دیگر شوز پر بھی اثر پڑا۔' اسٹیڈیم نے مزید کہا کہ ایونٹ تجربہ کار پائرور ٹیکنکس کمپنی کے ساتھ ترتیب دیا گیا اور شو سے پہلے اور دوران مکمل رسک اسیسمنٹ کی جاتی ہے۔ واقعے کی تحقیقات جاری ہیں اور اسٹیڈیم جلد تمام ٹکٹ ہولڈرز سے رابطہ کرے گا۔ بی بی سی ویسٹ مڈلینڈز کو فیس بک، ایکس اور انسٹاگرام پر فالو کریں۔ اپنی خبریں بھیجیں: newsonline.westmidlands@bbc.co.uk

article_content: Mangaluru International Airport (MIA) has announced a new initiative in its front yard called 'Airport Village', designed to provide a range of food, beverage, retail, and gaming options for both passengers and visitors. Previously, these amenities were available only to passengers and those with terminal access. With Airport Village, this experience will be accessible to everyone visiting the airport, including city residents, according to a press release from MIA. Set in the forecourt on the lower ground floor, Airport Village will transform the area into an active, mall-like environment. "Airport Village will cater not only to the thousands of travelers who use the airport daily, but also to their friends and family who accompany them to the airport," the release noted. Airport Village will provide flexible spaces for businesses looking to establish shops there. "The master plan focuses on creating a unique, curated experience that enhances the travel experience and offers non-travelers a chance to enjoy the vibrant atmosphere airports strive to provide globally," the statement added.
